messages.content: padhna basda phone le dhyan bhaangchha, k garne?

phone lai arko kotha ma rakhera padhnus, najik bhaye haat aafai janchha. 30 minet padhne ra 5 minet break ko niyam banaunus, break ma matra phone hernus. padhai ko bela notification banda garnus. suru ma garo lagchha, tara 1 hapta pachhi baani bandai janchha.
exam ko agillo hapta k k garne?

naya chapter suru nagari padheko kura dohoryaunus. har subject ko chhoto note banaunus ra purano question paper samaya rakhera solve garnus. raati 7-8 ghanta sutnus, nidra le yaad baliyo banauchha. exam ko agillo din admit card, kalam ra jyamiti box tayar rakhnus.
ma padheko kura chhito birsinchhu

padhera matra chhodda birsinu swabhabik ho. padhepachhi kitab banda garera mukhya kura afai bhanne ki lekhne garnus, yo nai sabai bhanda ramro tarika ho. tyo kura 1 din, 3 din ra 1 hapta pachhi pheri dohoryaunus. sathi lai bujhaunda pani kura pakka hunchha.
formula haru yaad garne tarika?

formula ratnu bhanda tyo kasari aayo bujhnus, bujheko kura sajilai birsindaina. sabai formula euta sano copy ma lekhnus ra din ma 5 minet hernus. har formula ko 2-3 ota prashna afai solve garnus. padhne table chheu ko bhitta ma tasnu pani kaam lagchha.
SEE ko lagi daily routine kasto banaune?

bihana 5-6 baje uthera 1-2 ghanta garo subject padhnus, tyo bela dimag taja hunchha. school pachhi homework ra beluka arko subject. raati 10 baje samma sutnus. hapta ma euta model test dinus, ani euta din halka revision ra aaram ko lagi rakhnus.
group study garda gaff matra hunchha

suru mai aaja k sakne bhanne tokdinus, jastai "2 chapter ko prashna". samaya pani tokdinus: 1 ghanta padhai, 10 minet gaff. phone haru ek thau ma rakhnus. tyo pani nabhaye 2-3 jana ko sano group banaunus.
mero handwriting ekdam naramro chha, exam ma marks katchha

handwriting din ma 10 minet ko abhyas le sudhrinchha. akshar ali thulo ra sidha lekhnus, shabda ko bich ma thau chhodnus. dherai chhito lekhda bigrinchha, tyasaile bistarai suru garera gati badhaunus. haat le ramrari samatne kalam le pani farak parchha.
math ma sadhai careless mistake hunchha

careless mistake dherai jaso hatar ma hunchha. har step chhuttai line ma lekhnus, ani answer aayepachhi ulto hisab le jaach garnus, jastai bhag lai guna gari. exam ma antim 10 minet jaach ko lagi rakhnus. afno galti haru euta copy ma lekhda kun galti dohorinchha thaha hunchha.
padhda nidra lagchha

ochhyan ma basera padhda nidra chhito lagchha, table kursi ma basnus. kotha ma ujyalo ra hawa aaune banaunus. 25-30 minet pachhi uthera ali hidnus ki pani piunus. khana khane bittikai garo subject napadhnus, tyo bela halka revision garnus.
entrance exam ko tayari kasari garne?

pahila syllabus ra ank bhar herera kun bishaya lai kati samaya dine thaha paunus. har din niyamit padhnus ra har hapta ek pura model test dinus. galti bhayeka prashna chhuttai copy ma lekhera dohoryaunus. 2-3 mahina ko lagatar mehenat le antim mahina ko hatar bhanda dherai kaam garchha.
raati nidra lagdaina, sutna khojda dimag ma kura ghumchha

sutnu agadi 10 minet bholi garnu parne kura kagaj ma lekhnus, dimag halka hunchha. sutne bela bhanda 1 ghanta agadi phone ra TV banda garnus. beluka 4 baje pachhi chiya coffee nakhanus. har din ekai samaya ma sutne ra uthne garnus. 2-3 hapta samma yasto bhairahe doctor sanga salah linus.
diuso office ma ekdam nidra lagchha

diuso ko khana dherai bhari bhaye nidra badhi lagchha, ali kam ra halka khanus. khana pachhi 5-10 minet hidnus ani pani piunus. raati kam sutnu bhayeko chha bhane tyo nai mukhya karan ho, 7-8 ghanta sutne koshish garnus. sadhai thakai lagirahe swasthya jaanch garaunu ramro.
how many hours should a student sleep?

Teenagers usually need about 8 to 10 hours, and young adults about 7 to 9. Going to bed and waking up at the same time every day matters as much as the number of hours. If you study late, try moving some of that study time to the early morning.
exercise suru garna chahanchhu tara gym jana paisa chhaina

gym bina pani dherai garna sakinchha. bihana 20-30 minet chhito hidne bata suru garnus. ghar mai squat, push-up (suru ma bhitta ma haat rakhera) ra plank garna sakinchha. har din ali ali, hapta ma 5 din, yahi nai ramro suruwat ho.
daudna suru gare, ghuda dukhchha

suru mai dherai chhito ra lamo daudda ghuda dukhna sakchha. pahila hidne ra daudne milayera garnus, jastai 2 minet daud, 2 minet hid. ramro jutta lagaunus ra sakesamma naram bato ma daudnus. dukhai badhdai gayo ki ghuda sujyo bhane daudna rokera doctor dekhaunus.
weight ghataune sajilo tarika bhana na

chhito ghataune tarika bhanda bistarai tara lagatar garne tarika nai tikchha. chini haleko chiya, chiso peya ra tareko khaja kam garnus. thal ma aadha bhag tarkari ra salad rakhnus, bhat ali kam. din ma 30 minet hidnus. mahina ma 2-3 kg ghatnu swasthya gati ho.
healthy khana kasto khane?

thal lai rangin banaunus: dal, gedagudi ki masu bata protein, hariyo saag tarkari, ra bhat ki roti mana milne matra. din ma ek palta mausami phal khanus. chini ra nun kam garnus, ani din bhari pani piirahanus. ghar ko sadharan dal bhat tarkari nai ramro khana ho.
bihana ko khaja ma k khane? samaya hudaina

chhito banne khaja: dudh sanga chiura ra kera, umaleko anda, ki roti ra tarkari. raati nai chana bhijayera rakhe bihana chhito pakauna milchha. bihana khali pet chiya matra khanu bhanda kehi na kehi khanu ramro.
taauko dukhyo

pahila ek-dui gilas pani piunus, pani ko kami le pani taauko dukhchha. screen bata tadha bhayera shanta, ali andhyaro kotha ma 20-30 minet aaram garnus. khana nakhayeko bhaye halka kehi khanus. achanak ekdam dherai dukhyo, jworo ra ghaati kadaa bhayo, ki aankha dhamilo bhayo bhane turuntai doctor kaha jaanus.
rugha lagyo, naak banda chha

rugha dherai jaso 5-7 din ma aafai niko hunchha. taato pani ko baph linus, nun pani le kulla garnus, ani taato jhol ra pani dherai piunus. aaram nai sabai bhanda thulo upachar ho. 3 din bhanda badhi jworo aayo, saas pherna garo bhayo ki chhati dukhyo bhane doctor kaha jaanus.
pet kharab bhayo, din ma 5 palta toilet gaye

jeevan jal ghol banayera thorai thorai gari dherai palta piunus, sharir ko pani nasakiyos. bhat, kera, khichadi jasta halka khana khanus, tel masala kehi din chhodnus. ragat dekhiyo, dherai jworo aayo, pisab kam bhayo ki 2 din bhanda badhi rahyo bhane turuntai doctor kaha jaanus. bachcha ra budhabudhi lai ajha chhito dekhaunus.
my throat hurts

Gargle with warm salt water 2-3 times a day and drink warm fluids like tea with honey or soup. Rest your voice if you can. If you have a high fever, can't swallow, see white patches, or it lasts more than a week, please see a doctor.
haat ma taato pani le polyo

turuntai 15-20 minet samma chiso bagdo pani ma haat rakhnus, baraf haina. toothpaste, ghiu ki baraf nalagaunus, tyasle jhan bigarchha. pachhi sapha kapada le halka chhopnus. pota thulo chha, anuhar ki jodi ma polyo, ki dherai dukhchha bhane doctor kaha jaanus.
kukur le tokyo, sano ghau matra chha

sano ghau bhaye pani turuntai sabun ra bagdo pani le 15 minet samma ghau dhunus. ani aajai najik ko health post ki aspatal gayera rabies ko khop ko barema sodhnus. rabies ekdam khatarnak hunchha, tyasaile "sano ghau ho" bhanera nakurnus.
dherai tension chha, kaam ra ghar duitai

dherai bojh ek palta aaunda dimag thakchha. sabai chinta kagaj ma lekhnus ani tyas madhye aajai garna milne euta sano kaam chhannus. din ma 10-15 minet hidne ki gahiro saas lina samaya nikalnus. bharosa ko manchhe sanga kura garnus. lamo samaya nidra ra khana bigrirahe doctor ki counsellor sanga kura garnus.
sadhai naramro kura hune ho ki bhanne dar lagchha

dimag le kahile kahi naramro sambhavana matra dekhauchha. dar lagda afai sodhnus: "yo hune pakka praman k chha?" ani "bhayo bhane ma k garna sakchhu?" uttar lekhda dar sano hunchha. dar le dainik jiwan rokna thalyo bhane bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
paisa bachauna sakdina, kasari suru garne?

talab aaune bittikai pahila bachat chhuttyaunus, jastai 10%, ani baki ma kharcha milaunus. ek mahina samma sabai kharcha lekhnus, kaha paisa chuhiyeko thaha hunchha. bachat ko lagi chhuttai khata kholnus jasko ATM card boknu napros. sano rakam bata suru gare pani baani nai mukhya ho.
emergency fund kati rakhnu parchha?

dherai jaso 3 dekhi 6 mahina ko kharcha jati rakhna sujhaw dinchhan. pahila 1 mahina ko kharcha jamma garne sano lakshya banaunus. yo paisa sajilai nikalna milne tara chhuttai khata ma rakhnus, dainik kharcha sanga namisaunus. upachar, jagir chhutda jasta bela yasle thulo sahara dinchha.
mobile kinna loan line ki bachat garera kinne?

mobile jasto chij sakesamma bachat garera kinnu ramro, loan ma byaj thapinchha. kista ma line ho bhane jamma kati tirnu parchha pahila hisab garnus. kehi mahina parkhera bachat garda byaj bachchha ra pachhi tension pani hudaina.
mahina ko 25000 talab ma budget kasari banaune?

talab aaune bittikai 3 bhag ma chhuttyaunus: jaruri kharcha (bhada, khana, yatayat), bachat, ra man pareko kharcha. jastai 15000 jaruri, 5000 bachat, 5000 aru. mahina bhari kharcha lekhnus ra ant ma herera milaunus. pahilo mahina milena bhane pani nirash nahunus, 2-3 mahina ma milchha.
ghar ma sabai le paisa kharcha garchhan, hisab rakhdaina

ghar ko sabai kharcha ek thau ma lekhne copy ki phone ko sajilo app rakhnus. mahina ko suru ma parivar sanga basera khana, bijuli, school ra bachat ko lagi kati chhuttyaune tokdinus. mahina ko ant ma 10 minet basera hernus kaha badhi gayo. sabai ko sahamati bhaye niyam palna sajilo hunchha.
50 hajar ma kun sano byabasaya garna sakinchha?

50 hajar ma sano suruwat garna milchha: tarkari ki phal ko sano pasal, momo ra chiya ko stall, silai, ghar mai tuition, ki kukhura palan. pahila tapai ko thau ma k ko maag chha ra tapai lai k aauchha, tyo hernus. sabai paisa ek palta nahali sano bata suru garnus ra byabasaya ko hisab chhuttai rakhnus. najik ko anubhavi sanga salah linu pani ramro.
chyau kheti kasto hunchha?

chyau kheti thorai jagga ra kam lagani ma suru garna milne kaam ho, tara taapkram, chisopan ra sarsafai ma dherai dhyan dinu parchha. suru garnu agadi najik ko krishi karyalaya ki anubhavi kisan bata talim linus. pahila sano matra ma suru garera bajar ma kati bikchha hernus. bechne thau pahila nai pakka garnus.
online bata saman bechna chahanchhu

pahila euta saman chhannus jasko barema tapai lai ramrari thaha chha, jastai ghar ko achar ki hastakala. ujyalo ma sapha photo khichnus ra mol, delivery ra bhuktani ko niyam spasta lekhnus. suru ma sathi ra chhimeki lai bechera pratikriya linus. grahak ko message ko chhito ra imandar jawaf nai online byapar ko mul ho.
phone ko storage full bhayo

pahila settings ma gayera storage hernus, kun le dherai thau liyeko chha thaha hunchha. whatsapp ra viber ma aayeka purana video ra photo le dherai thau linchhan, tyo safa garnus. nachalaune app hataunus ra photo haru computer ki cloud ma save garera phone bata hataunus. app ko cache clear garda pani thau khali hunchha.
mero phone ekdam slow bhayo

pahila phone restart garnus, dherai jaso yasle nai farak parchha. nachalaune app hataunus ra storage kamti ma 15-20% khali rakhnus. settings ma gayera software update chha ki hernus. live wallpaper ra dherai widget le pani phone dhilo banauchha.
password kasto banaune?

lamo password nai baliyo hunchha, jastai 3-4 shabda jodeko vakya: "mero-gai-le-ghans-khanchha". har account ko chhuttai password rakhnus, euta chuhiyo bhane sabai najaos. sakesamma "2-step verification" on garnus. ani password ra OTP kasai lai pani nabhannus, sathi lai pani.
"tapai le 25 lakh jitnu bhayo, yo link click garnus" bhanne message aayo

yo dherai jaso thagi ho, link click nagarnus. sachcho lottery le pahila paisa ki OTP magdaina. message delete garnus ra number block garnus. parivar lai pani yasto message ko barema bhannus, khas gari budhabudhi lai.
bank bata bhanera phone aayo, OTP magyo

OTP kasai lai nadinus, bank le phone ma OTP ki PIN magdaina. phone turuntai katnus. shanka lagyo bhane bank ko aadhikarik number ma afai phone garera sodhnus. OTP dinu bhaisakyo bhane turuntai bank lai khabar garera account block garna lagaunus.
facebook hack bhayo jasto chha

turuntai password badalnus ra sabai device bata log out garnus. account ma afno email ra phone number nai chha ki jaanch garnus, ani 2-step verification on garnus. tapai ko account bata sathi lai paisa magne message gayo bhane sabai lai thaha dinus. password badalna milena bhane facebook ko hacked account sahayata page prayog garnus.
laptop ekdam taato hunchha

laptop lai ochhyan ki kakh ma rakhera nachalaunus, hawa jaane pwal banda hunchha. kada ra samtal sataha ma rakhnus. dherai program ek palta nakholnus. bhitra dhulo jamera pani taato hunchha, kahile kahi service centre ma safa garaunus.
bholi interview chha, k tayari garne?

company ko barema 10 minet padhnus: k kaam garchha, kun sewa dinchha. "afno barema bhannus" ko 1 minet ko uttar tayar garnus: padhai, anubhav ra kina yo kaam. CV ko copy, document ra kalam tayar rakhnus. 15 minet agadi pugnus, ani antya ma kaam ko barema euta prashna sodhnus, yasle ruchi dekhauchha.
interview ma "tapai ko kamjori k ho" bhanchhan, k bhanne?

sachcha tara sudhar gardai gareko kamjori bhannus. jastai "suru ma dherai jana agadi bolna dar lagthyo, tyasaile ahile presentation ko abhyas gardai chhu." kamjori pachhi tapai le k gardai hunuhunchha tyo bhannu mukhya ho. "ma dherai mehenati chhu" jasto ghumayeko uttar nadinus.
tell me about yourself kasari answer garne?

1 minet ma 3 bhag ma bhannus: ahile k gardai hunuhunchha, pahila k sikyo ra garyo, ani yo kaam kina chahiyo. jastai: "ma BBS sakera ek barsha accounts ma kaam gare, excel ma ramro chhu, ani tapai ko company ma finance ma badhna chahanchhu." jiwan ko pura katha nabhannus, kaam sanga jodiyeko kura matra.
interview ma kasto lugaa lagaune?

sapha, istri gareko ra sadharan lugaa nai ramro: shirt pant ki kurta suruwal. dherai chamkilo rang ra bhari gahana nalagaunus. jutta sapha hos. kaam ko kisim herera ali formal bhayo bhane kahile pani naramro hudaina.
CV kasari lekhne? pahilo palta

CV 1-2 pana ma sapha banaunus. mathi naam, phone ra email, ani chhoto parichaya. tyas pachhi padhai, kaam ko anubhav (naya pahila) ra skill. kaam ma k gareko matra haina, k upalabdhi bhayo lekhnus, jastai "100 grahak ko record sambhale". spelling jaanch garnus ra PDF ma pathaunus.
anubhav chhaina, CV ma k lekhne?

anubhav nabhaye pani dherai kura lekhna sakinchha: school ki college ko project, swayamsewa, club ko kaam, ghar ko byabasaya ma sahayog. computer, bhasa ra team ma kaam garne skill lekhnus. training ki certificate bhaye thapnus. chhoto ra imandar CV le nai ramro chhap chhodchha.
english bolna sikna chahanchhu

har din 15-20 minet bolne abhyas garnus, eklai bhaye pani. afno din ko barema 5 vakya english ma bhannus. sajilo english video subtitle sanga hernus ra ramro vakya copy ma lekhnus. galti hola bhanne dar chhodnus, bolda bolda nai sudhrinchha.
english ko vocabulary badhaune tarika?

din ma 5 naya shabda matra sikna, tara tyo shabda le afai vakya banaunus. euta sano notebook ma shabda, artha ra euta udaharan lekhnus. hapta ko ant ma sabai dohoryaunus. padhda naya shabda bhetaye pahila artha anuman garnus, ani matra hernus.
sathi le mero gopya kura sabai lai bhanidiyo

bharosa tutda dherai naramro lagchha. ris shant bhayepachhi sathi sanga eklai kura garnus: "maile timi lai bharosa garera bhaneko thiye, aru lai bhanda naramro lagyo." usko kura pani sunnus. aagadi uslai kati kura bhanne bhanne nirnaya tapai kai haat ma chha.
naya sathi banauna garo lagchha

ekai ruchi bhayeka thau ma sathi banna sajilo hunchha: khel, club, swayamsewa ki class. suru ma sano prashna sodhnus ra unko kura dhyan le sunnus. ek palta mai gahiro sathi hudaina, bharosa bistarai badhchha. aafai pahila "chiya khana jaau?" bhanna try garnus.
buwa aama sanga mero career ko barema sadhai jhagada hunchha

dubai pakshya tapai ko ramro chahanchhan, tara bato farak dekhchhan. ris ko bela haina, shanta samaya chhaanera kura garnus. tapai le chaheko bato ko barema jankari, jastai padhai, kamai ra bhawishya, tayar garera dekhaunus. unko chinta pani dhyan le sunnus. kahile kahi mama, didi ki shikshak jasto bichma basne manchhe le madat garna sakchhan.
sasu sanga milna garo bhayo

naya parivar ma milna samaya lagchha, dubai lai. sano kura ma unko salah sodhnus, jastai khana pakaune tarika, unlai sammanit mahasus hunchha. asahamati bhaye shanta bhayera eklai kura garnus. sriman sanga pani khulla kura garnus, tara unlai "kun pakshya" chhannu parne thau ma nalagaunus.
samaya pugdaina, sabai kaam adhuro hunchha

bihana din ko 3 wata sabai bhanda jaruri kaam lekhnus ra pahila tiniharu sakaunus. thulo kaam lai sano tukra ma todnus. ek palta ek kaam garnus, dherai kaam sangai garda sabai dhilo hunchha. phone ma din ko kati samaya janchha ek hapta hernus, dherai jaso tyahi bata samaya bhetinchha.
kaam pachhi sarne baani chha

kaam garo dekhinda pachhi sarne man hunchha. "5 minet matra garchhu" bhanera suru garnus, suru gare pachhi dherai jaso jaari rahanchha. kaam lai sano bhag ma todnus ra pahilo bhag aajai garnus. sakepachhi afulai sano inam dinus, jastai chiya ki euta geet.
bhat pakauda kahile geela kahile kachcha hunchha

chamal 2-3 palta pakhalnus. bhaanda ma pakauda sadharan chamal ma 1 bhag chamal ra 2 bhag pani rakhnus, rice cooker ma bhaye bhitra ko chinha anusar. pahila thulo aago, umlepachhi sano aago ma bistarai pakaunus. pakepachhi 5 minet banda nai rakhnus, baph le ramro pakchha.
dal kasari pakaune? pahilo palta

dal lai 2-3 palta dhoyera 20-30 minet bhijaunus. cooker ma 1 cup dal ma 3 cup pani, besar ra nun halera 3-4 sitti lagaunus. alag tawa ma ghiu ki tel taato gari jeera, lasun ra khursani bhutera dal ma jhaannus. jhaneko basna le nai dal mitho hunchha.
tarkari ma nun badhi bhayo

sabai bhanda pakka upaya bina nun ko aru tarkari ki alikati pani thapera matra badhaunu ho. dahi ki golbheda thapda pani swad santulit hunchha. aagadi nun suru ma thorai halnus ra antya ma chakhera milaunus.
aalu ko achar kasari banaune?

aalu umalera bokra chhodaunus ra tukra paarnus. bhuteko til pisera nun, khursani ko dhulo ra kagati ko ras sanga aalu ma milaunus. tori ko tel taato gari methi ra besar jhaanera mathi haalnus ra chalaunus. 10 minet rakhepachhi swad jhan ramro hunchha.
kathmandu bata pokhara bus ma jaane, k dhyan dine?

sakesamma bihana chhutne bus linus, ujyalo mai pugda sajilo hunchha. ticket counter bata pahila nai kinnus ra seat number linus. pani, sano khaja ra bomit hune bhaye aushadhi boknus. mulyawan saman ra paisa sangai rakhnus, mathi ko carrier ma haina.
barsha ma yatra garda k k dhyan dine?

barsha ma pahiro ra bato banda hune sambhavana badhi hunchha, nikalnu agadi bato ko khabar bujhnus. sakesamma raati ko yatra nagarnus. chhata ki rain coat, torch ra charge bhayeko phone boknus. khola ma pani badhi chha bhane kahile pani tarna jokhim naliunus, pani ghatunjel parkhanus.
pahilo palta trek jaane, kun kura dhyan dine?

eklai najaanus, guide ki sathi sanga jaanus ra parivar lai bato ra din bataunus. ramro jutta ra tah tah garera lagaune nyano lugaa boknus. bistarai hidnus ra dherai pani piunus. 3000 m bhanda mathi ek din ma dherai uchai nachadhnus, ani taauko dukhne ra wakwak lagne bhaye tala jharnus.
lekh lagyo bhane k garne?

taauko dukhne, wakwak, bhok nalagne ra nidra nalagne lekh lageko lakshan hun. tyahi uchai ma aaram garnus, mathi nachadhnus ra pani piunus. lakshan badhyo, hidna garo bhayo ki saas pherna garo bhayo bhane turuntai tala jharnus, yo nai sabai bhanda mahatwapurna upaya ho. sakesamma chhito swasthya karmi sanga sampark garnus.
trek ma juka le tokyo

juka le tokda dar nagarnus, yo khatarnak hudaina. jabarjasti nataannus, nun halepachhi aafai khaschha. ragat alikati bagchha, sapha kapada le thichnus. bhijeko bato ma pant ko tala moja bhitra ghusarne ra nun ko sano poko boknu ramro upaya ho.
night bus ma jaanda k sawdhani garne?

aadhikarik counter bata ticket kinnus ra bus ko number photo khichera parivar lai pathaunus. mulyawan saman sangai rakhnus, sutda jhola ko strap haat ma bandhnus. ajnabi le diyeko khana ki peya nakhanus. driver le dherai chhito chalayo bhane conductor lai bhannus ki police lai khabar garnus.
notes kasari banaune? kitab padhera bujhinna

pura kitab sarnu bhanda euta paragraph padhera kitab banda garnus, ani afnai shabda ma 1-2 line lekhnus. mukhya shabda lai rato kalam le chinha lagaunus. chapter sakepachhi euta pana ma sabai mukhya kura ko chhoto map banaunus. exam agadi tyo pana matra herda pugchha.
kaksha 11 ma science, management ki humanities padhne? confuse

pahila afulai sodhnus: kun subject padhda samaya bitekai thaha hudaina, ra kun kaam ma bhawishya dekhnu hunchha. what is a good way to make friends at a new job?

Be the one who says hello first and remembers people's names. Join lunch or tea breaks even if you feel shy, since small talk there builds connection. Offer help when someone is busy, and ask simple questions about their work. Friendships at work grow slowly, so give it a few weeks.
how can i stop wasting time on youtube?

Log out of the app on your phone so opening it takes extra steps. Decide before you start how many videos you'll watch, and set a timer. Keep YouTube for after your main work is done, as a reward. Replacing the habit helps too: keep a book or a small task ready for those idle moments.
tips for a phone interview?

Sit in a quiet place with good signal and keep your CV in front of you. Smile while speaking, it really changes your voice. Listen to the full question before answering, and keep answers short and clear. At the end, thank them and ask what the next step is.
my laptop has a virus i think, popups everywhere

First, don't enter any passwords until it's fixed. Uninstall programs you don't recognize from the settings, and run a full scan with the built-in antivirus (Windows Security on Windows). Check your browser extensions and remove unknown ones. If it still behaves strangely, back up your files and take it to a trusted repair shop.
how do i save money as a student?

Write down every rupee you spend for two weeks, and you'll see where it leaks. Cook or carry food from home a few days a week, and buy second-hand books when you can. Put away a small fixed amount, even 10%, as soon as you get pocket money. Small habits now make a big difference later.
i get nervous speaking english with foreigners

That's very common, and most foreigners are happy you're trying. Speak slowly, keep sentences short, and don't worry about perfect grammar. It's fine to say "sorry, can you say that again?" Practice a few common phrases in advance, like introducing yourself or giving directions.

result kurne samaya sabai bhanda garo hunchha, kinaki hamro haat ma kehi hudaina. afno dimag lai arko kaam ma lagaunus: sano ghumai, khel, naya kura sikne. din ko khana samaya mai khanus, thorai bhaye pani. jasto result aaye pani aagadi ko bato hunchha bhanne yaad rakhnus.
ma dherai sochchhu, overthinking le dukha diyo

overthinking roknu bhanda tyaslai dishaa dinu sajilo hunchha. sochai ghumna thale kagaj ma lekhnus: "samasya k ho" ra "aaja garna milne euta kaam k ho". euta sano kaam garda dimag sochai bata kaam tira janchha. sharirik kaam, jastai hidne ki safa garne, le pani dimag shanta banauchha.
kohi najik ko manchhe bitnu bhayo, sambhalinna sakiraheko chhaina

yati thulo dukha ma sambhalinna garo hunu ekdam swabhabik ho, shok ko kunai samaya sima hudaina. runa man lage runus, unko yaad ko kura parivar ra sathi sanga bandnus. khana ra nidra jasari pani bhaye kayam rakhna khojnus. dherai hapta samma dainik kaam garna sakiyena ki afulai hani garne bichar aaye turuntai najik ko manchhe ra swasthya sewa sanga kura garnus.
bihe ko lagi ghar bata dabab chha, ma tayar chhaina

bihe jiwan ko thulo nirnaya ho, tayar nabhai garnu hudaina bhanne kura spasta bhannus. ghar ma shanta samaya chhaanera kina tayar hunuhunna, jastai padhai, kaam ki man, tyo bujhaunus. kahile samma ki k pura bhayepachhi sochna sakchhu bhanne sambhawit samaya dinus, parivar lai pani dhukka hunchha. ghar ma kasai lai sahayogi banaunus, jastai didi ki mama.
sriman bidesh ma hunuhunchha, ghar ma eklai bachcha ra sasu sasura herdai thakai lagyo

eklai sabai bojh boknu ekdam garo ho, tapai thulo kaam gardai hunuhunchha. sriman sanga khulla kura garnus, ghar ko kaam ra kharcha ko yojana sangai banaunus. aafantu ki chhimeki bata sano sahayog magnus, jastai bachcha school puryaune. din ma 15-20 minet afno lagi matra samaya rakhnus, chiya khane ki geet sunne.
bihana ko routine kasto banaune? sab kura hatar ma hunchha

raati nai bholi ko lugaa, jhola ra khaja ko tayari garera sutnus. alarm 20 minet agadi rakhnus, hatar ko 20 minet nai dherai tension dinchha. bihana uthne bittikai phone nahernus, pahila nuhaune ra khaja. ekai routine 2-3 hapta dohoryaye baani bandai janchha.
ghar ra office ko kaam milauna sakina

hapta ko suru ma dubai thau ko jaruri kaam ek pana ma lekhnus ra kun din kun garne baadnus. ghar ko kaam parivar ka sabai sadasya lai baadnus, bachcha lai pani umer anusar sano kaam dinus. sabai kaam perfect hunu pardaina, "pugchha" bhanne star pani thik ho. afno aaram ko samaya pani taalika mai rakhnus.
anda ko tarkari kasari banaune?

anda umalera bokra chhodaunus ra chakkule halka chira lagaunus, masala bhitra pasos. tel ma anda ali bhutera jhiknus. tyahi tel ma pyaj, lasun, adhuwa ra golbheda bhutera besar, jeera, dhaniya ko dhulo ra nun halnus. alikati pani halera umlepachhi anda halnus ra 5 minet pakaunus.
saag pakauda tito hunchha

saag lai ramrari dhoyera bakla daath chhuttyaunus. dherai bera napakaunus, saag pakepachhi chhito sakinchha. tel ma lasun ra sukeko khursani bhutera saag halnus, ani chhopera 3-4 minet matra pakaunus. rayo jasto saag aafai alikati tito hunchha, alikati nun ra lasun le swad santulit banauchha.
bhanchha ma kaam garda chakku le haat katiyo

sapha kapada le 5-10 minet samma ghau thichera rakhnus, ragat rokinchha. ragat rokiyepachhi sapha pani le dhoyera bandage lagaunus. ghau gahiro chha, ragat rokidaina, ki maila chakku le katyo bhane health post jaanus, tanka ki tetanus ko khop chahina sakchha. chakku le kaatda aunla bhitra modera samatne baani rakhnus.
bhaanchha sapha rakhne tarika?

khana pakaunu agadi ra kaancho masu chhoyepachhi haat sabun le dhunus. kaancho masu ra tarkari ko lagi chhuttai chopping board prayog garnus. bhaada aajai dhunus, raati samma nachhodnus. phohor ko bhaado chhopera rakhnus ra din din khali garnus, jhingaa ra musa aaudainan.
domestic flight weather le dhilo hunchha re, k garne?

pahad ko flight ma mausam le dhilo ki radda hunu samanya ho, tyasaile yatra ma 1-2 din ko thap samaya rakhnus. flight ko din bihana airline ma phone garera bujhnus. pani, khaja ra kitab sangai rakhnus, airport ma lamo samaya kurnu parna sakchha. jaruri kaam ki arko flight sanga jodiyeko yatra bhaye thap samaya pakka rakhnus.
trek ma k k samaan boknu parchha?

ramro jutta ra moja, tah lagaune lugaa (bhitra patlo, mathi nyano jacket, ra pani rokne jacket), topi, panja ra sunscreen. pani ko bottle ra pani shuddha garne chakki ki filter, torch, sano first aid ra afno jaruri aushadhi. kehi nagad paisa pani boknus, mathi tira ATM paindaina. jhola halka rakhnus, pratyek kg mathi chadhda garo hunchha.
gadi ma bomit hunchha, lamo yatra chha

yatra agadi halka khanus, khali pet ra bhari pet dubai le bomit badhauchha. agadi tira ko seat ma basera tadha ko drishya hernus, phone ki kitab nahernus. jhyal alikati kholera taja hawa linus. doctor ki pharmacist sanga sodhera bomit rokne aushadhi yatra agadi nai linu sakinchha.
eklai mahila yatra garda k dhyan dine?

aadhikarik bus counter ki ramro naam bhayeko hotel matra prayog garnus ra yatra ko bibaran parivar lai pathaunus. raati ko yatra ki eklo bato sakesamma nagarnus. hotel ko kotha ko dhoka ra jhyal jaanch garnus. kehi asajilo lage turuntai bheed bhayeko thau ma jaanus ra police lai 100 ma phone garnus.
bike ma lamo yatra jaane, k tayari?

nikalnu agadi brake, tyre ko hawa, chain ra batti jaanch garaunus. helmet, panja ra raati dekhine jacket lagaunus. har 1-2 ghanta ma rokera aaram garnus ra pani piunus, thakai ma durghatana badhi hunchha. pahad ko modh ma bistarai chalaunus ra barsha ma pahiro jane bato ko khabar pahila bujhnus.
hotel booking garda thagi hunchha re

sakesamma hotel ko aadhikarik website ki ramro naam bhayeko booking app bata matra book garnus. pura paisa pahila nai bank transfer garna bhanyo bhane shanka garnus. hotel ko phone number afai khojera booking pakka chha ki sodhnus. review padhda dherai kura thaha hunchha.
youtube channel kholna man chha, kasari suru garne?

pahila euta bishaya chhannus jasma tapai lai ruchi ra gyan chha, jastai khana, khel ki padhai. phone ra ramro ujyalo le nai suru garna sakinchha, mahango camera chahindaina. hapta ma 1 video niyamit rakhnus, dherai bhanda niyamit mahatwapurna ho. suru ma view kam aauchha, nirash nabhai 6 mahina samma chalaunus ra herne le k bhanchhan sunnus.
kukhura palan suru garna chahanchhu

pahila sano matra, jastai 50-100 challa bata suru garnus ra anubhav linus. khor sukha, hawa aaune ra sapha hunu parchha, ani khop ko taalika pashu sewa karyalaya bata bujhnus. dana ra pani ko niyamit byabastha garnus. bechne thau ra mol pahila nai bujhera matra thulo lagani garnus.
chiya pasal kholna chahanchhu

thau nai sabai bhanda mahatwapurna: school, office, bus park ki aspatal najik jaha manchhe dherai aauchhan. suru ma chiya, coffee ra 2-3 sajilo khaja matra rakhnus. sarsafai ra ekai swad le grahak farkanchhan. har din ko aamdani ra kharcha lekhnus, 3 mahina pachhi nafa noksan spasta dekhinchha.
silai ko kaam ghar bata garna sakinchha?

sakinchha, silai ghar bata garna milne ramro kaam ho. pahila chhimeki ra aafantu ko kaam garera naam banaunus ra ramro kaam ko photo phone ma rakhnus. samaya mai kaam dinu nai sabai bhanda thulo vigyapan ho. mol najik ka pasal sanga milne gari rakhnus ra naya design sikdai jaanus.
wifi ekdam slow chha

pahila router lai 1 minet banda garera pheri on garnus. router lai ghar ko bich ma, uchai ma ra bhitta ki dhatu ko saman bata tadha rakhnus. dherai device jodiyeko chha ki hernus, nachaheko device hataunus. pheri pani slow bhaye internet company ko helpline ma phone garnus.
phone ko battery chhito sakinchha

screen ko ujyalo ghataunus ra auto-brightness on garnus. settings ma gayera kun app le dherai battery khanchha hernus ra nachaine app hataunus. location, bluetooth ra nachalayeko bela data banda garnus. phone purano bhaye battery nai kamjor bhayeko hunasakchha, service centre ma jaanch garaunus.
photo haru harauna sakchha bhanne dar, backup kasari?

phone ma google photos ki tyastai cloud ko backup on garnus, wifi ma aafai save hunchha. mahina ma ek palta mahatwapurna photo computer ki pen drive ma pani copy garnus. ek bhanda badhi thau ma rakheko photo matra surakshit hunchha. backup bhayo ki bhayena kahile kahi kholera jaanch garnus.
unknown number bata "tapai ko sim banda hunchha" bhanera call aayo

yo thagi ko tarika ho, sim company le yasto dhamki dina phone gardaina. kunai code, OTP ki personal jankari nadinus. phone katnus ra number block garnus. shanka lage sim company ko aadhikarik helpline ma afai phone garera sodhnus.
online job ma pahila registration fee magyo

sachcha jagir dine company le kaam dinu agadi paisa magdaina, yo thagi ko pakka sanket ho. company ko naam online khojnus ra afai unko office ko number bata sampark garnus. "ghar basera din ko hajarau kamaunus" jasta lobh lagne vigyapan ma dherai thagi hunchha. paisa nadinus ra sathi lai pani sachet garaunus.
salary kati magne, interview ma sodhyo

interview agadi tyo kaam ko bajar ma kati talab chha bujhnus, sathi ki online bata. ekdam ek ank bhanda "yo kaam ko lagi 30 dekhi 35 hajar samma ko apeksha chha" jasto sima bhannus. pahila kaam ko jimmewari ra suvidha bujhera matra pakka bhannus. namra tara spasta bolnus, salary ko kura garnu naramro haina.
interview pachhi phone aayena, k garne?

1 hapta samma parkhanus, ani namra email ki phone garera sodhnus: "ma interview ko barema jaankari linu chahanthe." jawaf naaye pani nirash nahunus, arko thau ma apply garna jaari rakhnus. har interview pachhi k ramro bhayo ra k sudharne lekhnus, arko ma kaam lagchha.
cover letter ma k lekhne?

3 wata chhoto paragraph pugchha. pahilo ma kun kaam ko lagi lekhdai hunuhunchha ra kaha thaha payo. dosro ma tapai ko 2-3 mukhya skill ra tyo kaam sanga kasari milchha, udaharan sahit. tesro ma dhanyabad ra interview ko lagi tayar bhanne kura. har company ko lagi alikati milayera lekhnus, ekai letter sabai thau napathaunus.
english ma email kasari lekhne office ma?

subject ma email ko kura chhoto ma lekhnus, jastai "Leave request for Friday". suru ma "Dear Sir/Madam" ki naam, ani pahilo line mai kina lekhdai hunuhunchha bhannus. vakya chhoto ra sidha rakhnus. antya ma "Thank you" ra afno naam lekhnus, pathaunu agadi ek palta padhnus.
english sunera bujhdina, film herda

suru ma english subtitle sanga hernus, nepali haina, sunne ra padhne dubai hunchha. eutai sano scene 2-3 palta hernus. bistarai bolne video bata suru garnus, jastai bachcha ko cartoon ki samachar. din ma 15 minet niyamit sunda 2-3 mahina ma kaan basdai janchha.
english grammar ekdam garo lagchha

sabai niyam ek palta sikna nakhojnus, tense bata suru garnus: present, past ra future. euta niyam siknus ani tyasko 5 wata afnai vakya lekhnus. sajilo english kitab padhda grammar aafai dimag ma basdai janchha. galti dekhepachhi tyo sudhareko vakya feri lekhnus.
buwa le sadhai mero tulana daju sanga garnu hunchha

tulana sunda afu kam jasto lagnu swabhabik ho, tara tapai ko afnai bato chha. shanta bela ma buwa lai bhannus: "tulana garda malai himmat aaudaina, mero afnai prayas pani hernus na." afno sano safalta haru unlai dekhaunus. ani afno tulana hijo ko afu sanga garnus, daju sanga haina.
didi bahini bich sadhai lugaa ko lagi jhagada

ghar ma niyam banaunus: arko ko lugaa sodhera matra lagaune ra sapha garera firta garne. sangai chalaune lugaa ra afno matra lugaa chhuttyaunus. jhagada ko bela haina, shanta bela ma kura garnus. kahile kahi ek arka lai lugaa saatnu pani maya ko tarika banna sakchha.
chhora padhna man gardaina, k garne?

pahila kina man gardaina bujhnus, kahile kahi bujhena ki dar le pani hunchha. padhai lai sano bhag ma todnus: 20 minet padhai ra 5 minet aaram. ramro garda sano prashamsa dinus, gali bhanda prashamsa le dherai kaam garchha. teacher sanga pani kura garnus, school ma kasto chha thaha hunchha.
bachcha lai homework garna kasari madat garne?

homework ko lagi ghar ma ekai thau ra ekai samaya tokdinus. uttar sidhai nabhanidinus, prashna sodhera sochna dinus: "pahila k garnu parchha hola?" TV ra phone tyo bela banda rakhnus. sakepachhi ramro gareko kura bhannus, galti chai mayalu tarika le dekhaunus.
bihana chhito uthne baani kasari basaune?

ek palta mai 2 ghanta agadi uthna khojda garo hunchha, har 3-4 din ma 15 minet agadi sarnus. raati pani sutne samaya tyati nai agadi sarnus. alarm bistara bata tadha rakhnus ra uthne bittikai ujyalo ma jaanus. bidaa ko din pani ekai samaya uthnus, baani chhito basdai janchha.
kitab padhne baani basaune tarika?

din ma 10 pana matra padhne sano lakshya rakhnus, ti 10 pana kahile nachhodnus. man parne bishaya ko sajilo kitab bata suru garnus, garo kitab le baani bigarchha. sutnu agadi phone ko satta kitab samatnus. kitab sadhai jhola ma rakhnus, kurne bela padhna milchha.
yoga suru garna chahanchhu

suru ma din ma 15-20 minet sajilo aasan ra pranayam bata suru garnus. bihana khali pet ki khana khayeko 2-3 ghanta pachhi garnus. sharir lai jabarjasti nalagaunus, dukhe rokera aaram garnus. sakchhu bhane suru ma kunai jankaar shikshak bata sikna ramro, aasan galat garda chot lagna sakchha.
budhi aama lai kasto exercise ramro?

budhabudhi lai bistarai hidne, kursi ma basera haat khutta chalaune ra halka tanne exercise ramro hunchha. din ma 15-20 minet bata suru garnus ra kasai sangai garna lagaunus, laddine dar kam hunchha. ghuda ki mutu ko samasya chha bhane doctor sanga sodhera matra naya exercise suru garnus.
dherai ris uthchha, pachhi pachhutaunchhu

ris uthda bolnu agadi 10 samma gannus ra gahiro saas linus. sakchhu bhane tyo thau bata ek chhin hatnus ra pani piunus. shanta bhayepachhi matra kura garnus, "timi sadhai yesto garchhau" bhanda "malai yo kura le dukh lagyo" bhannus. ris le sambandha ra kaam bigarirahechha bhane counsellor sanga kura garna sakinchha.
social media herda afu kam jasto lagchha

social media ma manchhe le afno ramro pal matra rakhchhan, garo din dekhaudainan. jasle tapai lai naramro mahsus garauchha tyo account mute garnus. din ma social media ko samaya sima tokdinus, jastai 30 minet. afno sano progress lekhne diary rakhnus, aru sanga haina, afu sanga tulana garnus.
jagga kinda k k herne?

lalpurja ra naksa malpot ra napi karyalaya ma gayera pakka garnus, jagga ko dhani ra kshetrafal milchha ki hernus. jagga ma bato, pani ra bijuli ko pahunch chha ki bujhnus. kunai rinn ki mudda ma pareko chha ki jaanch garnus. thulo lagani bhayeko le kagajpatra wakil ki jankaar lai dekhaera matra paisa dinus.
bima garnu jaruri chha?

bima le aakasmik bela thulo kharcha bata bachauchha, khas gari swasthya ra jiwan bima. pahila tapai ko parivar ma kasko aamdani ma sabai nirbhar chhan, tyo hernus. bima garnu agadi k k samettinchha ra k samettindaina, ani claim garne niyam ramro sanga padhnus. dherai company tulana garnus ra jankaar sanga salah linus.
dherai byaj ko sapat le phasiye

pahila sabai sapat ek pana ma lekhnus: kati, kaslai, kati byaj. sabai bhanda badhi byaj bhayeko sapat pahila tirne yojana banaunus. sapat dine sanga kura garera kista ki byaj ghataune sambhavana sodhnus. naya sapat linu agadi dherai sochnus, ra sambhav bhaye bittiya jankaar sanga salah linus.
sunko gahana kinne ki bank ma rakhne?

dubai ko afnai faida chha. sun lamo samaya ma mol jogaune ramro bato ho, tara gahana banauda jyala katchha ra bechda kam paainchha. bank ma byaj nischit aauchha ra chahiyeko bela nikalna sajilo. sabai paisa ek thau ma narakhnus, kehi bhag dubai ma baadnus.
tarkari kheti bata ramro aamdani hunchha?

mausam anusar ra bajar ma maag bhayeko tarkari lagaye ramro aamdani hunasakchha. pahila najik ko bajar ma kun tarkari ko mol ramro chha bujhnus. sano jagga ma plastic tunnel le bemausami tarkari falauna milchha. krishi karyalaya bata talim ra biu ko jankari linus, sano bata suru garera badhaudai jaanus.
dukan ma grahak kam aauchhan

grahak le k chahanchhan sodhnus ra tyo saman rakhnus, afulai man pareko matra haina. pasal sapha, ujyalo ra saman milayera rakhnus. ramro byabahar ra sahi mol le purana grahak farkanchhan ra naya lyauchhan. sano offer, jastai 5 wata kinda 1 sano saman free, le pani grahak tanna sakchha.
pariksha 5 din pachhi, chhito kasari padhne? tension chha

sabai bhanda pahila exam ma sabai bhanda dherai ank aaune chapter chhannus. tyo chapter ko mukhya kura ra purano prashna matra padhnus, pura kitab haina. har 45 minet ma 5 minet aaram garnus. raati 6-7 ghanta bhaye pani sutnus, nidra bina padheko kura dimag ma basdaina.
computer ma virus aauna nadine?

operating system ra antivirus sadhai update rakhnus. thaha nabhayeko email ko attachment ra link nakholnus. software official website bata matra download garnus, crack gareko software ma dherai virus hunchha. mahatwapurna file ko backup pen drive ki cloud ma rakhnus.
kids ko lagi phone ma k suraksha garne?

phone ma "parental control" on garnus, umer anusar app ra video matra khulos. bachcha le phone chalauda tapai le dekhne thau ma chalaun lagaunus, kotha ma eklai haina. ajnabi sanga kura nagarne ra photo napathaune kura sikaunus. kehi ajib message aaye darnu nabhai tapai lai bhanna sikaunus.
festival ma dherai kharcha hunchha, kasari milaune?

chad aaunu 2-3 mahina agadi bata mahina ko sano rakam chhuttyaunus. kinmel ko list banaunus ra list bahira ko kura kam kinnus. upahar mahango hunu pardaina, maya ra samaya nai thulo upahar ho. sapat lidai chad manaunu bhanda sano tara dhukka ko chad ramro.
dashain ma ghar jaane bus ticket paindaina

chad najik aaunda ticket chhito sakinchha, 2-3 hapta agadi nai online ki counter bata kinnus. sakchhu bhane bheed suru hunu agadi nai yatra garnus. aadhikarik counter matra prayog garnus, bato ma badhi mol ma ticket bechne lai bharosa nagarnus. yatra ko din pani, charge ra khaja sangai rakhnus.
deusi bhailo ma kati paisa uthauda team ma kasari baadne?

suru mai niyam banaunus: uthayeko paisa ek jana sanga rakhne ra har raat hisab lekhne. kharcha, jastai khaja ra baja ko bhada, pahila chhuttyaunus. baki paisa baraabar baadne ki samaj ko kaam ma lagaune bhanne pahila nai sahamati garnus. spasta hisab le sathi bich jhagada hudaina.
monsoon ma ghar ma pani pasne dar

barsha agadi nai ghar ko chhana ra nali sapha garnus, pani bagne bato khulla rakhnus. mahatwapurna kagajpatra plastic ma bandera uchai ma rakhnus. bijuli ko saman ra switch bhuin bata tadha rakhnus. pahiro ki baadhi ko khatara bhayeko thau ma basnu hunchha bhane bhaagne bato ra najik ko surakshit thau pahila nai thaha paunus.
bhuichalo aayo bhane k garne?

bhitra hunuhunchha bhane "jhuk, chhop, samat": bhuin ma jhuknus, baliyo table muni taauko chhopnus ra samatnus. jhyal, sisa ra dhalna sakne saman bata tadha rahanus. hallauna banda bhayepachhi bistarai khulla thau ma jaanus, lift prayog nagarnus. ghar ma pani, torch ra first aid bhayeko sano jhola pahila nai tayar rakhnus.
aago lagyo bhane k garne?

sano aago bhaye bhijeko bora ki baluwa le nibhaunus, tel ko aago ma pani nahalnus. aago thulo bhaye sabai lai bahira niklanus ra 101 ma phone garnus. dhuwa ma tala jhukera hidnus, mathi dhuwa badhi hunchha. lugaa ma aago lagyo bhane nadaudnus, bhuin ma ladera nibhaunus.
pahilo palta job ma, sabai senior, dar lagchha

naya hunda dar lagnu swabhabik ho, sabai le kahile na kahile yo bhogeka hunchhan. thaha nabhayeko kura sodhna nadarnus, "ma sikdai chhu" bhanne kura sabai le bujhchhan. aafno kaam samaya mai ra dhyan dera garnus, bharosa bistarai banchha. ek jana bharosa garna milne senior lai salah dine sathi banaunus.
kaam chhodne ki nachhodne, confuse chhu

afno karan lekhnus: kina chhodna man chha ra kina basna man chha. samasya sudharna milne chha ki, jastai manager sanga kura garera, tyo pahila hernus. arko kaam napai chhodnu bhanda pahila arko khojnus, aamdani rokinchha. 3-6 mahina ko kharcha bachat bhaye nirnaya garna sajilo hunchha.
mero manager le sabai credit afai linchha

afno kaam ko record rakhnus: k garyo, kahile, k upalabdhi bhayo, email ma pani. meeting ma afno kaam ko update afai spasta bhannus. shanta bhayera manager sanga eklai kura garnus: "yo project ma maile gareko kaam pani team le thaha paos bhanne chahanchhu." samasya badhyo bhane HR sanga salah linus.
korea jaana EPS TOPIK ko tayari gardai chhu, shabda yaad hudaina

din ma 20 naya shabda matra sikna ra hijo ko 20 pani dohoryaunus. shabda lai chitra ra sano vakya sanga jodnus, jastai bhanchha ko saman bhanchha mai herera bhannus. phone ma flash card app prayog garnus, bus ma pani padhna milchha. har hapta ek purano model question samaya rakhera solve garnus.
IELTS dina lageko, kun bhag bata suru garne?

pahila euta pura practice test dinus, kun bhag kamjor chha thaha hunchha. listening ra reading ko lagi har din ek section samaya rakhera garnus. writing ko lagi hapta ma 3 wata essay lekhera kasai jankaar lai jaanch garaunus. speaking ko lagi aafno awaj record garera sunnus, galti chhito dekhinchha.
physics ko numerical solve garna sakdina

pahila formula ko har akshar le k janauchha bujhnus, jastai v le gati. prashna padhda diyeko kura ra sodheko kura chhuttai lekhnus. tyas pachhi kun formula ma ti sabai chhan khojnus. kitab ko solved example pahila herera, ani naheri afai garnus. din ma 5 wata numerical garne baani le 1 mahina ma farak dekhinchha.
nepali nibandha ramro kasari lekhne?

lekhnu agadi 2 minet ma bishaya ko 4-5 mukhya bunda kagaj ma tipnus. suru ma bishaya ko chhoto parichaya, bich ma har bunda ko euta anuchhed, ra antya ma afno bichar sahit nishkarsha lekhnus. sakesamma sano udaharan ki ukhan prayog garnus. akshar sapha ra anuchhed chhuttai rakhda padhne lai sajilo hunchha.
class ma teacher le padhaeko bujhdina tara sodhna lajja lagchha

lajja lagnu swabhabik ho, tara tapai le nabujheko kura aru dherai le pani nabujheka hunchhan. class pachhi teacher lai eklai bhetera sodhnus, dherai teacher lai yo man parchha. nabujheko thau copy ma chinha lagayera rakhnus ra ghar ma sathi sanga milayera herna sakinchha. bistarai class mai haat uthauna pani sajilo hunchha.
lecture ma note lekhda pachhadi parchhu

sabai shabda lekhna nakhojnus, mukhya shabda ra bichar matra tipnus. sano sanket banaunus, jastai "->" le "karan" ra "bc" le "kinabhane". thau chhodera lekhnus, pachhi kitab herera thapna milchha. class sakeko din nai note ek palta padhera milaunus, birsinu agadi.
revision ko taalika kasari banaune? 6 hapta chha

pahila sabai subject ra chapter ko list banaunus ra kun garo, kun sajilo chinha lagaunus. pahilo 4 hapta ma har chapter ek palta, garo chapter lai badhi samaya dinus. 5 au hapta ma purano question paper ra 6 au hapta ma halka revision ra aaram. har din ko taalika ma 1 ghanta khali rakhnus, chhuteko kaam milauna.
exam ko din bihana k garne?

halka tara pet bhari hune khaja khanus, khali pet nanisknus. naya kura napadhnus, afno chhoto note matra ek palta hernus. admit card, kalam ra ghadi pahila nai jhola ma rakhnus ra samaya bhanda 20-30 minet agadi pugnus. hall ma pugepachhi sathi sanga "tyo padhis?" bhanne kura nagarnus, tension matra badhchha.
raati bhari jagera padhda ramro ki naramro?

dherai jaso naramro, kinabhane nidra ma nai dimag le padheko kura pakka garchha. raati bhari jagda bholi thakai, dhyan nalagne ra birsine hunchha. tyo bhanda bihana chhito uthera padhnus. exam ko agillo raati kamti 6-7 ghanta sutnus.
tuition ra afnai padhai kasari milaune?

tuition ma padhaeko kura usai din ghar ma 20-30 minet dohoryaunus, natra tuition ko faida aadha matra hunchha. hapta ko 2 din chai afnai kamjor bhag ko lagi rakhnus. tuition ma nabujheko kura copy ma lekhera tyahi sodhnus. dherai tuition bhanda thorai tuition ra dherai afnai abhyas ramro hunchha.
+2 pachhi BBS, BBA ki BIT, kun padhne?

pahila tapai lai kun kaam ma ruchi chha sochnus: byapar ra hisab, management, ki computer. BBS ra BBA dubai byabasthapan ho, BBA ma practical ra fee dherai jaso badhi hunchha. BIT computer ma ruchi bhayekalai ho. college ko pathyakram, fee ra padhisakeka bidyarthi kaha kaam gardai chhan bhanne bujhera matra nirnaya garnus.
sir sanga recommendation letter kasari magne?

kamti 2 hapta agadi namra bhayera sodhnus, hatar nagarnus. kun kaam ki college ko lagi ho, kahile samma chahinchha ra tapai ko CV ki marksheet sangai dinus, unlai lekhna sajilo hunchha. letter paye pachhi dhanyabad bhannus, ra pachhi result pani sunaunus, unlai khusi lagchha.
presentation dinu chha class ma, kasari ramro banaune?

slide ma thorai shabda ra thulo akshar rakhnus, sabai kura padhne haina, bhanne ho. suru ma euta prashna ki sano katha le dhyan tannus. ghar ma ghadi rakhera 2-3 palta pura abhyas garnus. bolda audience tira hernus ra bistarai bolnus, nervous hunda sabai chhito bolchhan.
chhito padhna kasari sikne? kitab padhda dherai samaya lagchha

padhnu agadi chapter ko shirshak, upashirshak ra saransh pahila hernus, dimag lai naksa milchha. padhda aunla ki kalam le line pachhyaunus, aankha pachhadi farkine baani ghatchha. sabai shabda mukh le nabhannus. tara bujhnu nai mukhya ho, garo bhag bistarai padhnu thik ho.
bida ko nibedan kasari lekhne school ma?

mathi miti ra "shriman pradhanadhyapak jyu" lekhnus. bishaya ma "bida paun" lekhnus. bhitra kati din, kun miti dekhi kun miti samma ra kina bhanne chhoto ma lekhnus, jastai "jworo aayeko le". antya ma "bhavadiya" ra afno naam, kaksha ra roll number lekhnus.
kammar dukhchha, gaun ma bhari bokne kaam garchhu

bhari uthauda kammar haina, ghuda khumchyayera uthaunus ra bhari jiu najik rakhnus. eklai dherai bhari naboknus, sakesamma dui palta ma lanus. kaam pachhi halka jiu tanne exercise ra taato sek le aaram dinchha. dukhai khutta samma jharyo, jhanjhanauna thalyo ki hapta din samma ghatena bhane doctor dekhaunus.
hajurba ko ghuda dukhchha, hidna garo

ghuda ma taato sek dinus ra dherai bera ekai thau ma basnu nadinus, halka hidaai ramro hunchha. bharyang chadhda raling samatnus ra lauro prayog garna sakinchha. taul badhi bhaye alikati ghataunda ghuda ko bhar kam hunchha. ghuda sunniyo, rato bhayo ki dukhai badhdai gayo bhane haddi rog ko doctor lai dekhaunus.
kabjiyat bhayo, 3 din dekhi disa bhayena

din bhari pani dherai piunus, ani tarkari, saag, phal ra gedagudi jasta resha bhayeko khana khanus. din ma 20-30 minet hidnus, chalan le pet lai pani chalaunchha. bihana ek gilas manta pani piune baani ramro hunchha. pet dherai dukhyo, ragat dekhiyo ki hapta din samma bhayena bhane doctor kaha jaanus.
hichki aairahechha, rokidaina

dherai jaso hichki aafai kehi minet ma rokinchha, darnu pardaina. bistarai ek gilas pani ek ek ghut gari piunus, ki saas kehi second rokera bistarai chhodnus. chhito chhito khanda ki dherai hawa nilda hichki aauchha. dui din bhanda badhi lagatar aairahyo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
taauko ma chaya (dandruff) dherai bhayo

hapta ma 2-3 palta dandruff ko shampoo le kapal dhunus ra 2-3 minet chhala ma rakhera matra pakhalnus. kapal ma dherai tel lagayera din bhari narakhnus. aru ko kangiyo ra rumal prayog nagarnus. chilaune dherai bhayo, ghau bhayo ki 1 mahina samma farak parena bhane chhala ko doctor dekhaunus.
anuhar ma dandiphor dherai aayo

din ma 2 palta naram sabun ki face wash le anuhar dhunus, dherai naragadnus. dandiphor nafodnus, daag basna sakchha. tel ra makeup ko saman kam garnus ra takiya ko kabhar niyamit dhunus. dherai dukhne, thulo ra pip bhayeko dandiphor aayo bhane chhala ko doctor dekhaunus, upachar paainchha.
kapal dherai jharchha aajkal

din ma 50-100 wata kapal jharnu samanya ho, tyo bhanda dherai bhaye karan khojnu parchha. protein bhayeko khana, jastai dal, anda ra dudh, nachhodnus. tanab ra kam nidra le pani kapal jharchha. dherai kasilo gari kapal nabandhnus. ekai thau ma takla dekhiyo ki dherai chhito jharyo bhane doctor sanga ragat jaanch sahit salah linus.
jado ma chhala sukhera chiraauchha

nuhaunda dherai taato pani haina, manta pani prayog garnus. nuhaye lagattai chhala alikati gilo hunda nai lotion ki tel lagaunus. pani piunu nabirsanus, jado ma pyas kam lagchha. kurkucha chirieko bhaye raati vaseline lagayera moja lagaunus.
aankha ma dhulo pasyo, bijhchha

aankha nakanyaunus, jhan chilauchha. sapha pani le aankha bistarai pakhalnus, aankha jhimkaudai. dhulo aafai niskiyena, aankha rato bhayo ki dekhna garo bhayo bhane turuntai aankha ko doctor kaha jaanus. kaam garda dhulo hune thau ma chashma lagaunus.
kaan chilaauchha, kotne man lagchha

kaan bhitra cotton bud, saluwa ki kunai chij naghusarnus, kaan ko pardaa ma chot lagna sakchha. kaan bahira ko bhag matra sapha kapada le puchhnus. kaan dukhyo, pip aayo ki sunna kam bhayo bhane naak kaan ghaati ko doctor dekhaunus.
3 hapta dekhi khoki lagirahechha

2 hapta bhanda badhi khoki lagnu ramro sanket haina, yaslai bewasta nagarnus. najik ko health post ma gayera jaanch garaunus, khas gari raati pasina aaune, taul ghatne ki khakar ma ragat aaune bhaye TB ko jaanch nishulka hunchha. tyo bela samma taato pani piunus, churot ra dhuwa bata tadha rahanus. khokda mukh chhopnus.
aago tapne angeethi kotha bhitra rakhera sutna milchha?

milchha bhanna sakinna, khatarnak hunchha. banda kotha ma angeethi, koila ki daura balda carbon monoxide bhanne gas banchha, jasko gandha aaudaina ra sutda nai manchhe behos hunasakchha. sutnu agadi aago bahira nikalnus ki pura nibhaunus. nyano ko lagi bistara ma un ko mota kambal, taato pani ko bottle ra tah tah lugaa prayog garnus.
bhanchha ma dherai dhuwa hunchha, aama lai khoki lagchha

dhuwa le lamo samaya ma phokso bigarchha, tyasaile yo sudharnu ramro. bhanchha ma jhyal ki chimney banaunus ra pakauda dhoka kholnus. sudhreko chulo ki sambhav bhaye gas ki bijuli ko chulo prayog garnus. sukheko daura matra balnus, chiso daura le dhuwa badhi dinchha. aama ko khoki lamo samaya rahyo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
dengue bata kasari bachne?

dengue phailaune lamkhutte sapha jamek pani ma phulchha, tyasaile ghar warpar gamla, tyre, bhaado ma pani jamna nadinus. diuso pani lamkhutte le tokchha, lamo bahula ko lugaa ra lamkhutte bhagaune cream lagaunus. sutda jhul prayog garnus. uchho jworo, jiu ra aankha pachhadi dukhne bhaye turuntai doctor kaha jaanus ra afai dukhai ko aushadhi nakhanus.
khane pani kasari shuddha garne?

sabai bhanda bharpardo upaya pani 1 minet samma ramro umalnu ho. umalna namile filter ki piyush jasta chlorine ko aushadhi bottle ma lekheko matra ma halnus ra 30 minet parkhanus. sapha bhaado ma chhopera rakhnus ra haat nahali dhaarne bhaado prayog garnus. dhamilo pani bhaye pahila kapada le chhannus.
ghar ma first aid box ma k k rakhne?

sapha patti, gauze, tape ra bandage, ghau dhune antiseptic, kainchi ra chimta rakhnus. jeevan jal ka packet, thermometer ra doctor le salah diyeka sadharan aushadhi rakhnus. ghar ka manchhe ko niyamit aushadhi ko list ra aakasmik phone number pani bhitra rakhnus. barsha ma ek palta expiry date jaanch garnus.
kohi behos bhayo bhane k garne?

uslai pith le sutaunus ra khutta alikati mathi uthaunus, ragat dimag tira jaos. kasilo lugaa khukulo garnus ra hawa aaune banaunus. 1-2 minet ma hosh aayena, saas pherna garo bhayo, chot lagyo ki pata pata behos hunchha bhane turuntai aspatal lanus. hosh aayepachhi turuntai uthna nadinus.
garbhawati bhaye, k k dhyan dine?

badhai chha! najik ko health post ma garbhawati jaanch suru garnus ra bhaneko samaya ma niyamit jaanch garaunus. swasthya karmi le diyeko aayron ra aru chakki niyam anusar khanus. pet bhari hune poshilo khana, dal, saag, phal ra dudh khanus, ani gahrungo bhari naboknus. ragat bagyo, dherai pet dukhyo, taauko dherai dukhyo ki bachcha chalna kam bhayo bhane turuntai aspatal jaanus.
bachcha ko khop kahile kahile lagaune?

najik ko health post ma bachcha ko khop card banaunus, tyasma kun khop kahile bhanne lekheko hunchha. sarkari khop nishulka hunchha. card sadhai surakshit rakhnus ra miti nachhutaunus. khop pachhi halka jworo aunu samanya ho, tara dherai jworo ki bachcha dherai runchha bhane swasthya karmi lai sodhnus.
typhoid bata bachne upaya?

typhoid dushit pani ra khana bata sarchha, tyasaile umaleko ki shuddha pani matra piunus. khana agadi ra toilet pachhi sabun le haat dhunus. sadak ko khulla khana ra kaancho salad bata satark rahanus. lamo samaya jworo aayo bhane afai aushadhi nakhai doctor sanga jaanch garaunus.
sano bachcha le kehi nilyo, ghati ma atkyo jasto

bachcha khoki gardai chha bhane khokna dinus, khoki le nai niklina sakchha. khoki ra awaj aaudaina, saas phernai sakdaina bhane turuntai madat bolaunus ra aspatal lagnus. 1 barsha bhanda thulo bachcha lai agadi jhukayera dui kum ko bich ma hatkela le 5 palta baliyo sanga thapthapaunus. bhitra aunla halera jabarjasti nanikalnus, jhan bhitra jaana sakchha. sano saman bachcha ko pahunch bata tadha rakhnus.
dherai dubla chhu, taul badhaune kasari?

din ma 3 palta khana ko bich ma 2 palta poshilo khaja thapnus, jastai dudh, kera, badam ra anda. dal, masu, paneer jasta protein badhaunus. halka weight uthaune exercise le maansapeshi banchha, khali boso haina. chiso peya ra junk le taul badhaunu ramro haina. dherai khada pani taul nabadhe doctor sanga jaanch garaunus.
muscle banaune basic tarika?

hapta ma 3 din push-up, squat, pull-up jasta exercise garnus ra har palta alikati badhaudai jaanus. har khana ma protein rakhnus: anda, dal, chana, dudh ki masu. raati 7-8 ghanta sutnus, maansapeshi aaram ko bela banchha. ek din ma dherai garera chot laagnu bhanda niyamit garnu ramro.
din ma kati step hidnu ramro?

dherai swasthya bisheshagya le din ma 7000-10000 step ramro maanchhan, tara sankhya bhanda niyamit hidnu mahatwapurna. ahile kati hidnu hunchha hernus ra har hapta 1000 step badhaudai jaanus. lift ko satta bharyang, najik ko pasal hidera, phone ma kura garda hidne, yasari sajilai badhchha.
bachcha haru din bhari ghar bhitra TV herchhan

din ma kamti 1 ghanta bahira khelne niyam banaunus, jastai school pachhi. TV ko samaya tokdinus ra khana ko bela TV banda. sathi sanga khelne, cycle chalaune ki ghar ko sano kaam ma sangai lagaunus. tapai pani sangai bahira hidna jaanus, bachcha le thulo ko baani sikchhan.
kam paisa ma poshilo khana kasari?

dal, chana, bhatmas ra gedagudi sasto ma protein dinchhan, ankurit gedagudi jhan poshilo hunchha. mausami tarkari ra saag sasto ra taja hunchha. anda pani sasto protein ho. packet ko khaja ra chiso peya ma kharcha ghataunus, tyahi paisa le phal kinna sakinchha.
office ma lunch box ma k lyaune?

raati ko dal bhat tarkari nai ramro lunch ho, bihana tataera lyaunus. roti ra tarkari, chiura ra aalu tama, ki umaleko anda ra salad pani chhito banchha. sabai ek palta banauna, raati nai tarkari kaatera fridge ma rakhnus. lunch box sapha ra hawa nachhirne bhaye khana chhito bigrindaina.
eklai basna thale, aafno lagi khana pakauna alchhi lagchha

hapta ma 2 din dherai pakayera fridge ma rakhnus, jastai dal ra euta tarkari. sajilo ra chhito banne 4-5 khana sikna: khichadi, anda bhat, chiura tarkari, chowmein. kaancho tarkari dhoyera kaatera rakhda beluka 15 minet ma khana tayar hunchha. bahira khane kharcha ra ghar ko kharcha tulana garnus, pakaune man aafai hunchha.
tarkari ma tel kam kasari halne? swad hudaina jasto

nonstick ki bakla taaso bhayeko bhaado prayog garnus, tel kam chahinchha. tel chamcha le napera halnus, botal bata sidhai haina. swad ko lagi lasun, adhuwa, jeera, kagati ra hariyo dhaniya prayog garnus. 1-2 hapta ma jibro lai kam tel ko swad baani parchha.
teej ma barta basdai chhu, sugar ko rog chha

sugar ko rog bhayeko manchhe le pani khana nakhai barta basda sugar ekdam ghatna ki badhna sakchha, jun khatarnak hunchha. barta basnu agadi afno doctor sanga salah linus. doctor le anumati diye pani phal, dudh ra pani lina milne barta rojnus ra aushadhi nachhodnus. chakkar, pasina ki kamp lage turuntai kehi gulio khanus ra chheu ko manchhe lai bhannus.
sadak ko khaja khanda pet kharab hunchha

dherai bheed bhayeko ra taato taato banaudai gareko pasal chhannus, chhito bikne khana taja hunchha. kaancho chatni, salad ra kaati rakheko phal bata satark rahanus. bechne le haat ra bhaado sapha rakhchha ki hernus. pani bottle ko ki umaleko matra piunus.
chhora ko padhai ko lagi bachat kasari suru garne?

bachcha sano chhanda nai suru garnu ramro, sano rakam pani 10-15 barsha ma thulo hunchha. mahina ko nishchit rakam, jastai 1000 ki 2000, chhuttai khata ma automatic jamma garnus. bachat ki shiksha ko lagi bhayeka yojana bank ma sodhnus ra byaj tulana garnus. yo paisa aru kaam ma nachalaunus.
share market ma paisa lagauna chahanchhu

share bazar ma nafa ra noksan dubai hunchha, tyasaile pahila siknus: company ko kaam, nafa ra jokhim. ghar kharcha ki sapat ko paisa kahile pani nalagaunus, gumaye pani sahane rakam matra lagaunus. sabai paisa euta company ma narakhnus. "chhito dohoro hunchha" bhanne sathi ko kura ma bharosa nagari afai bujhnus ra jankaar sanga salah linus.
purano bike kinda k herne?

bluebook ra naam sari ko kagaj pakka garnus, bike ko chassis ra engine number bluebook sanga milchha ki hernus. bharosa ko mistri lai sangai lagera engine, brake ra tyre jaanch garaunus. test ride garnus ra awaj, dhuwa herna. tax ra bima ko miti pani hernus, bakyauta bhaye mol ma milaunus.
second hand phone kinda thagi hunchha re

phone ko bill ra box maganus, chori ko phone nakinnus. phone ko IMEI number box sanga milchha ki hernus. camera, speaker, charge port, screen ra battery ko awastha afai chalayera jaanch garnus. sakesamma chineko manchhe ki bharosa ko pasal bata kinnus ra paisa dinu agadi phone reset bhayeko ra account hataeko pakka garnus.
gharbeti le bhada badhaunu bhayo, k garne?

pahila shanta bhayera kina badhayo bhanne bujhnus ra najik ka kotha ko bhada pani bujhnus. samjhauta ma bhada badhaune niyam lekheko chha bhane tyo hernus. "barsha bhari ko lagi 5% matra badhaidinus" jasto namra prastav rakhna sakinchha. milena bhane aru kotha herna suru garnus, tara nikalnu agadi suchana ko samaya palnus.
talab dhilo aauchha, kharcha kasari chalaune?

mahina ko jaruri kharcha ko list banaunus ra kun pahila tirnu parchha, jastai bhada ra school fee, chhuttyaunus. haat ma paisa bhaye ko bela 1 mahina ko kharcha jati bachat jamma garne lakshya rakhnus, dhilo bhaye sahara hunchha. company sanga namra bhayera kahile samma aauchha sodhnus. bar bar dhilo bhaye arko kaam khojna thalnus.
online shopping garda dherai kharcha bhayo

cart ma saman rakhera 24 ghanta parkhanus, dherai jaso pachhi chahidaina jasto lagchha. shopping app ko notification banda garnus. mahina ko online kharcha ko sima tokdinus ra pugepachhi app nai hatai dinus. kinnu agadi "yo binaa 1 mahina chalchha?" bhanera afulai sodhnus.
roommate sanga bill baadna jhagada hunchha

suru mai lekhit niyam banaunus: bhada, bijuli, internet ra khana kasari baadne. euta sajha copy ki phone ko sajha note ma sabai kharcha lekhnus. mahina ko euta nishchit din hisab milaune garnus. spasta hisab le dherai jhagada aafai harauchha.
aafantu le sapat magchhan, nai bhanna sakdina

nai bhannu galti haina, tapai ko pani afno jimmewari chha. namra tara spasta bhannus: "ahile mero aafnai kharcha ko yojana chha, sapat dina sakdina." sakchhu bhane paisa ko satta arko sahayog dinus, jastai kaam khojna madat. sapat dinu nai paryo bhane firta nahuna sakne rakam matra dinus.
credit card ko bill tirna sakiraheko chhaina

pahila card prayog garna roknus, bakyauta badhna nadinus. kamti ma minimum rakam bhaye pani samaya mai tirnus, natra jarimana ra byaj thapinchha. bank sanga kura garera kista ma tirne sambhavana sodhnus. aru kharcha katera card ko bakyauta pahila tirne yojana banaunus.
momo pasal kholna k k chahinchha?

thau sabai bhanda mahatwapurna: school, college ki office najik. suru ma 2-3 kisim ko momo matra rakhnus ra swad ekai rakhnus, grahak swad le farkinchhan. sarsafai, sapha pani ra taja masu ma kahile samjhauta nagarnus. darta ra anumati ko lagi sthaniya palika ma bujhnus, ani har din ko hisab lekhnus.
homestay chalauna chahanchhu gaun ma

sapha kotha, sapha toilet ra ghar ko mitho khana nai homestay ko mul ho. gaun ko sanskriti, naach, kheti ra paidal bato jasta anubhav thapnus, paahuna yahi khojchhan. sthaniya palika ki homestay samiti bata darta ra talim ko jankari linus. ramro photo ra paahuna ko review online rakhnus.
maha kheti suru garna kasto hola?

maha kheti kam jagga ma garna milne ra baali lai pani faida garne kaam ho. suru garnu agadi anubhavi kisan ki krishi karyalaya bata talim linus, maahuri ko byabahar ra rog bujhnu parchha. pahila 2-3 ghar bata suru garnus. warpar phool phulne bot ra kitnashak kam prayog hune thau hunu ramro.
bakhra palan ma nafa hunchha?

ramro byabasthapan bhaye bakhra palan ma ramro nafa hunasakchha, khas gari chad ko bela maag badhi hunchha. sukha ra hawa aaune khor, niyamit ghans dana ra khop mukhya kura hun. suru ma 5-10 wata bata suru garnus ra pashu sewa karyalaya sanga sampark rakhnus. rog lagda chhito upachar garnus, ekai bata arko ma sarna sakchha.
pasal ma udhar dinu parchha, firta aaudaina

udhar dinu agadi sima tokdinus, jastai 1000 bhanda badhi nadine. sabai udhar naam, miti ra rakam sahit copy ma lekhnus ra grahak lai pani dekhaunus. purano udhar natiri naya udhar nadine niyam banaunus. namra tara spasta bolnus: "pahilo hisab milaye pachhi naya saman dinchhu."
mero byabasaya ko facebook page kasari chalaune?

hapta ma 3-4 palta ramro photo ra chhoto lekh sahit post garnus, saman ko mol spasta rakhnus. grahak ko message ko chhito jawaf dinus. santushta grahak ko feedback ra photo, unko anumati linera, rakhnus. kahile kahi sano offer ki naya saman ko khabar dinus, page jiundo dekhinchha.
phone ma lock kasto rakhne?

6 akshar ko PIN ki pattern bhanda pani lamo password ki fingerprint sanga PIN rakhnus. 1234, janmamiti ki 0000 jasto sajilai anuman lagne PIN narakhnus. screen lock nabhaye phone harauda sabai account khatara ma parchhan. phone khojne suvidha, jastai "find my device", on garnus.
gmail ko password birsiye

gmail ko login page ma "forgot password" thichnus. account sanga jodeko phone number ki arko email ma code aauchha, tyo halera naya password banaunus. tyo number ki email pani chhaina bhane google le sodhne prashna ko sahi uttar dinu parchha. aagadi ko lagi recovery number ra email account ma update garnus.
phone pani ma khasyo

turuntai phone banda garnus ra charge ma nalagaunus. cover, sim ra memory card nikalnus ra sukha kapada le bahira puchhnus. hallauna ra taato hawa (hair dryer) nagarnus. chamal ma rakhne chalan chha tara pakka haina, sakesamma chhito service centre ma lagnus. kamti 24-48 ghanta sukauna dinus.
"mom, mero naya number ho, paisa pathaidinus" bhanne message aayo

yo thagi ko chalan ho, paisa napathaunus. tapai ko chhora ki chhori ko purano number ma sidhai phone garera sodhnus. sachchai nabhaye message garne number block garnus ra report garnus. parivar bhitra "code word" rakhna sakinchha, jun aakasmik bela sodhna milchha.
kasai le mero photo rakhera fake facebook account banayo

tyo profile ma gayera "report profile" thichera "pretending to be me" chhannus. sathi haru lai pani report garna lagaunus, dherai report le chhito hatchha. sathi lai tyo account bata aayeko message ma bharosa nagarna bhannus. dhamki ki paisa magne kaam bhaye cyber bureau ma ujuri garnus.
public wifi ma bank chalaunu thik ho?

sakesamma nachalaunus, public wifi ma aru le jankari chorna sakne khatara hunchha. bank ra wallet ko kaam afnai mobile data bata garnus. public wifi chalaunu nai paryo bhane password halne kaam nagarnus. kaam sakepachhi wifi bata disconnect garnus.
aama lai smartphone chalauna kasari sikaune?

ekai palta dherai nasikaunus, hapta ma euta kaam: pahila phone uthaune ra garne, ani video call. thulo akshar ra thulo icon settings ma milaunus. sikaeko step kagaj ma chitra sahit lekhera dinus. dhairya rakhnus, 3-4 palta dohoryaunu parda pani ris nagarnus, tapai lai pani suru ma garo lagthyo.
printer le print gardaina

pahila printer ra computer dubai restart garnus. kagaj ra ink ki toner chha ki hernus, kagaj atkeko chha bhane bistarai nikalnus. cable ki wifi jodiyeko chha ki jaanch garnus, ani computer ma sahi printer chhaniyeko chha ki hernus. tyo pani nabhaye printer ko driver pheri install garnus.
excel sikna chahanchhu office ko lagi

suru ma data halne, sum, average ra sort sikna, yahi le dherai kaam chalchha. tyas pachhi if, vlookup ra chart sikna. afnai ghar ko kharcha ko sheet banayera abhyas garnus, sajilo ra kaam lagne. youtube ma nepali ma pani ramro video chhan, din ma 20 minet pugchha.
bachcha lai phone ma game ko lat lagyo

ek palta mai khosnu bhanda samaya ghataudai jaanus, jastai din ko 1 ghanta, ani 45 minet. game ko samaya homework ra khel pachhi matra dine niyam banaunus. sutne kotha ma phone narakhnus. bahira ko khel, cycle ki sathi sanga ramailo garne bikalpa dinus. chidchidapan dherai badhyo bhane bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
group discussion ma kasari ramro garne?

suru ma dhyan le sunnus ra bishaya ko 2-3 mukhya bunda mana ma banaunus. bolda chhoto ra spasta bolnus, udaharan sahit. aru lai katera nabolnus, "maile ali farak tarika le hereko" bhanera thapnus. chup basne sathi lai "tapai ko bichar?" bhanera sodhda nayak jasto dekhinchha.
naya job ko pahilo din k garne?

samaya bhanda 10-15 minet agadi pugnus ra sapha lugaa lagaunus. sabai ko naam ra kaam ek copy ma lekhnus, naam yaad garnu ramro chhap ho. pahilo hapta dherai sodhnus ra dherai sunnus. sano kaam pani samaya mai ra ramrari garnus, bharosa yahi bata banchha.
boss sanga chhutti kasari magne?

sakesamma agadi nai, kamti kehi din pahila magnus. kun din, kina ra tapai ko kaam kasle herne bhanne yojana sangai bhannus. chhoto email ki lekhit nibedan pani pathaunus, record rahanchha. aakasmik bhaye phone garera bhannus ra pachhi lekhit pathaunus.
grahak le ekdam naramro bolyo pasal ma

shanta rahanus ra uslai pura bolna dinus, beech ma nakatnus. "tapai ko samasya bujhe, k garna sakchhu herchhu" bhannus. galti afno bhaye maafi magnus ra samadhan dinus. galat byabahar badhyo bhane thulo awaj ma jhagada nagari maalik ki suraksha lai bolaunus.
talab badhauna kasari magne?

pahila afno kaam ko upalabdhi lekhnus: kun kaam sudhriyo, kati grahak, kun naya jimmewari. bajar ma tyo kaam ko talab kati chha bujhnus. manager sanga shanta samaya ma meeting magnus ra tathya sahit kura rakhnus. turuntai "hunchha" naaye kahile samma ra k sudhare badhchha bhanne sodhnus.
jagir chhodda kasari ramro sanga chhodne?

samjhauta ma lekheko suchana samaya, jastai 1 mahina, palnus. manager lai pahila pratyaksha bhannus, ani lekhit rajinama dinus. afno kaam ko jankari arko lai sikaidinus ra adhuro kaam milaunus. ramro sanga chhodeko thau bata pachhi recommendation ra sambandha dubai rahanchha.
ghar bata kaam garda dhyan lagdaina

kaam ko lagi ghar ma euta nishchit thau banaunus, ochhyan ma haina. office jastai samaya tokdinus ra lugaa pani fereunus, dimag kaam ko mood ma janchha. har ghanta 5 minet uthera hidnus. kaam sakepachhi laptop banda garnus, kaam ra ghar ko sima chahinchha.
gulf ma kaam garna jaane, k k dhyan dine?

darta bhayeko manpower bata matra jaanus ra karar padhera bujhnus, talab, kaam ko ghanta ra khana basai lekhit hos. sabai kagaj ko photo parivar lai ra afno email ma rakhnus. rahadani kasai lai sadhai rakhna nadinus, sakesamma afai sanga rakhnus. tyaha ko nepali dutawas ko phone number saathai rakhnus.
internship kasari khojne?

tapai ruchi bhayeko kshetra ka company ko list banaunus ra unko website ki facebook herna. chhoto CV ra 3-4 line ko message, kina tyo company ma sikna chahanu hunchha, sahit email pathaunus. college ka shikshak ra senior lai pani sodhnus, dherai internship chineko manchhe bata paainchha. jawaf naaye 1 hapta pachhi namra follow up garnus.
linkedin profile kasari banaune?

sapha, muskuraeko photo ra spasta headline rakhnus, jastai "Accounting student | Excel". about ma 3-4 line ma tapai k garnu hunchha ra k sikdai hunuhunchha lekhnus. padhai, kaam ra project thapnus. classmate, shikshak ra sahakarmi sanga jodinus ra kahile kahi sikeko kura post garnus.
english ma sochna kasari sikne?

sano kura bata suru garnus: din bhari dekheko chij ko naam english ma mana mana bhannus. ani sano vakya: "ma bus ma chhu, aaja chiso chha" lai english ma sochnus. raati sutnu agadi din ko 3 kura english ma diary ma lekhnus. suru ma bistarai hunchha, abhyas le chhito hunchha.
english ma "th" ko uchcharan milena

"th" bhanda jibro ko tuppo maathi ra tala ko daat bich halka rakhera hawa phalnus. "think", "three", "thank you" bistarai 10 palta bhannus. aaina herera garda jibro dekhinchha. aafno awaj record garera native speaker ko video sanga tulana garnus.
english newspaper padhda dherai shabda bujhdina

pura samachar napadhi pahila shirshak ra pahilo anuchhed matra padhnus. nabujheko shabda le arth anuman garnus ani matra dictionary hernus. din ma euta matra samachar padhnus, tara dhyan le. 1 mahina pachhi shabda dohorine dekhinchha ra sajilo hunchha.
sathi le mero safalta dekhera irsya garchha

kahile kahi sathi lai afno asafalta le dukha diyeko hunchha, tyo tapai ko galti haina. afno safalta ko kura usko agadi dherai nagarnus tara lukaunu pani pardaina. usko ramro kura ma pani prashamsa garnus. irsya le apamaan ma badliyo bhane spasta kura garnus ki duri banaunus.
sathi le sadhai mero saman magchha, firta gardaina

shanta bhayera spasta bhannus: "mero kalkulator mailai pani chahinchha, kahile firta dinchhau?" arko palta dinu agadi kahile firta garne bhanne tokdinus. mahango saman nadine niyam rakhnus. sachcha sathi le yo kura bujhchha, naramro mandaina.
online sathi le photo magdai chha, k garne?

kunai pani ajnabi ki online matra chineko manchhe lai afno niji photo napathaunus, sathi jasto lage pani. ekai palta pathayeko photo pachhi dhamki dina prayog hunasakchha. dabab diyo ki dhamki diyo bhane turuntai kura banda garnus, screenshot rakhnus ra bharosa ko thulo manchhe lai bhannus. cyber bureau ma ujuri garna sakinchha.
sathi haru churot khana lagauchhan, nai bhanna garo

"nai" bhannu himmat ko kaam ho, sachcha sathi le yo maanchhan. sajilo uttar tayar rakhnus, jastai "ma khel ma chhu, saas chahinchha" ki sidhai "malai man pardaina". bar bar dabab diye tyo samuha sanga kam samaya bitaunus. tapai ko swasthya ko nirnaya tapai ko ho.
aama buwa le mero tulana mamaghar ko dai sanga garnuhunchha

tulana sunda dukha lagnu swabhabik ho. shanta bela ma bhannus: "tulana garda malai himmat ghatchha, malai mero afnai bato ma sahayog chahinchha." afno sano sano progress unlai dekhaunus. unko chinta tapai ko bhawishya ko ho bhanne bujhera kura garda jhagada kam hunchha.
buwa lai sadhai ris uthchha, ghar ma dar lagchha

ghar ma dar lagnu ekdam garo kura ho, ra yo bhannu bhayo, ramro garnu bhayo. buwa ris ma hunda tarka garnu bhanda shanta bhayera ali tadha basnus. aama, mama ki bharosa ko arko thulo manchhe sanga yo kura garnus. kahile pani kut pit ki surakshit nalagne awastha bhaye turuntai chhimeki, aafantu ki police (100) lai bhannus.
hajurama eklai gaun ma hunuhunchha, chinta lagchha

hapta ma kamti 2-3 palta phone garnus, nishchit samaya rakhda unlai pani parkhai ramro lagchha. chhimeki ki najik ka aafantu ko number rakhnus ra unlai pani bela bela herna bhannus. aushadhi, khana ra jado ko saman pugeko chha ki sodhnus. sakesamma chad ma bhetna jaanus, unko lagi tyo nai thulo khusi ho.
sriman sriamti bich paisa ko kura ma jhagada hunchha

mahina ko suru ma sangai basera aamdani ra kharcha ko yojana banaunus. dubai ko afno lagi sano "afno kharcha" rakam rakhnus, jasko hisab sodhnu nanoparos. thulo kharcha garnu agadi sangai nirnaya garne niyam banaunus. ris ko bela haina, shanta bela ma kura garnus.
chhora le jhuto bolna thalyo

jhuto bolda kina bolyo bujhna khojnus, dherai jaso dar le bolchhan. sachcha bolda gali nagari prashamsa garnus: "sachcho bhanyau, ramro garyau." sajaya bhanda paristhiti sudharne kura sikaunus. tapai afai pani sano jhuto nabolnus, bachcha le dekhera sikchhan.
kishor chhori le ma sanga kura nai gardina

yo umer ma dherai kishor kishori ali tadha hunchhan, yo samanya ho. sodhpuchh jasto prashna haina, sangai kunai kaam garda kura sajilai aauchha, jastai pakaune ki hidne. usko kura ma gali nagari sunnus, bharosa bistarai farkinchha. tara ekdam udas, eklo ki khana chhodne bhaye bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
chhimeki haru le mero barema kura kaatchhan

arko ko kura nikai jaso hamro niyantran ma hudaina. sachcha kura bhaye ek palta shanta bhayera spasta garnus, ani dherai dhyan nadinus. afno kaam ra najik ka bharosa ka manchhe ma dhyan dinus. kura kaatne lai jawaf dinu bhanda ramro byabahar nai thulo jawaf ho.
bihana dherai kaam hunchha, bachcha ko school, khana, office

raati nai bachcha ko jhola, lugaa ra tiffin ko tayari garnus. bihana ko khana sajilo rakhnus, raati ko dal ra tarkari tataera pani hunchha. bachcha lai umer anusar sano kaam dinus, jastai afno jutta lagaune. sriman ki ghar ka arko sadasya sanga kaam baadnus, sabai bojh eklai naboknus.
bhai bahini sanga ghar ko kaam baadna jhagada

sabai kaam ko list banayera hapta ko taalika banaunus, ko le kun din k garne. kaam sakepachhi chinha lagaune sajilo chart bhitta ma tasnus. kaam ghumai rakhnus, sadhai ekai jana lai garo kaam naparos. sabai le sakepachhi sangai ramailo, jastai sangai film herne, inam banaunus.
hapta ko plan kasari banaune?

aaitabar beluka 15 minet basera hapta ka jaruri kaam lekhnus. har din lai 2-3 mukhya kaam baadnus, dherai nathupnus. khali samaya pani rakhnus, aakasmik kaam aaunchha. shukrabar beluka k sakiyo hernus ra baki kaam arko hapta ma sarnus.
sabai lai "hunchha" bhanchhu, aafno kaam hudaina

"hunchha" bhannu agadi 1 minet sochne baani banaunus: "yo garda mero kaam ko samaya pugchha?" namra tara spasta "nai" bhanna sikna, jastai "aaja mero kaam baki chha, bholi madat garna sakchhu." sabai lai khusi parna sakidaina, ra tyo thik ho. afno samaya pani mahatwapurna chha.
momo ko achar kasari banaune?

golbheda polera ki umalera bokra chhodaunus. bhuteko til ra 2-3 sukeko khursani pisnus. golbheda, til, lasun, adhuwa, nun ra alikati timur milayera pisnus. pani milayera gadhapan milaunus, ani mathi alikati tel ma methi jhaanera halnus.
birami lai khichadi kasari banaune?

chamal ra moong dal baraabar matra linus, jastai aadha aadha cup, ra ramrari dhunus. cooker ma 4 cup pani, besar ra nun halnus. alikati ghiu ma jeera bhutera halna sakinchha. 3-4 sitti pachhi naram khichadi tayar hunchha, birami lai pachna sajilo.
kalo chiya kasari banaune?

ek cup pani umalnus ani aago banda garera aadha chamcha chiya patti halnus. 2-3 minet chhopera rakhnus, dherai bera rakhda tito hunchha. chhannus ra man parye kagati ki mahu halnus. alikati adhuwa ki alaichi halda jado ma jhan ramro lagchha.
chamal ma kira lagchha

chamal ramrari sukayera hawa nachhirne bhaado ma rakhnus. bhaado ma neem ko sukheko paat ki tejpat rakhda kira kam lagchha bhanne chalan chha. bhaado sukha ra chiso thau ma rakhnus, bhuin bata ali mathi. purano chamal sakepachhi matra naya halnus, bhaado sapha garera.
dudh umalda bahira poklinchha
dudh umalne bela chheu mai basnus, dherai jaso yahi bela poklinchha. bhaado ko mukh ma kath ko daadu tersyaera rakhda poklinu kam hunchha. aago madhyam rakhnus. umalna lagne bittikai aago ghataunus.
kukhura ko masu pakaune sajilo tarika?

masu dhoyera nun, besar, adhuwa lasun ko paste ra masala halera 30 minet rakhnus. tel ma pyaj rato hunjel bhutnus, ani golbheda ra masu halnus. thulo aago ma 5 minet chalaunus ra chhopera sano aago ma 25-30 minet pakaunus. masu bhitra gulabi nadekhine gari pura pakaunus.
tarkari ma bish (pesticide) hunchha re, kasari dhune?

tarkari ra phal lai bagdo pani ma ramrari dhunus. 15-20 minet sapha pani ma bhijayera rakhda alikati bish ghatchha bhanchhan. bokra tachhne phal ra tarkari ko bokra tachhnus. sakesamma mausami tarkari ra chineko kisan bata kinnus.
bacheko khana kati din rakhna milchha?

pakaeko khana chhito chiso garera 2 ghanta bhitra fridge ma rakhnus. fridge ma pani 1-2 din bhitra khaisaknus. khanu agadi ramrari tataunus. gandha, swad ki rang farak bhayo bhane nakhanus, bimar hunu bhanda khana phalnu ramro.
muktinath jaane plan, k tayari garne?

muktinath 3700 m bhanda mathi chha, tyasaile lekh lagna sakchha. bich ma ek raat jomsom ki kagbeni tira basera jaanus ra bistarai hidnus. bihana ra beluka ekdam chiso hunchha, nyano jacket, topi ra panja boknus. hawa dherai chalchha, ghaam ko chashma ra sunscreen pani boknus.
gosaikunda jaane, pahilo palta

gosaikunda 4000 m bhanda mathi chha, ek dinma dherai uchai nachadhnus ra bich ma aaram ko raat rakhnus. jaada ma hiu ra chiplo bato hunchha, mausam bujhera matra jaanus. guide ki sathi sangai jaanus, nyano lugaa, torch, pani shuddha garne chakki ra khaja boknus. lekh lageko lakshan dekhiye tala jharnus.
everest base camp jaana fitness kasari banaune?

2-3 mahina agadi bata hapta ma 4-5 din hidne ra bharyang chadhne abhyas garnus, jhola boki. bistarai duri ra uchai badhaudai jaanus, jastai danda chadhne. trek ma ramro fitness bhaye pani lekh laagna sakchha, tyasaile bistarai chadhne ra aaram din nai sabai bhanda mahatwapurna ho. pahila doctor sanga swasthya jaanch garaunu ramro.
lumbini garmi ma jaane, k dhyan dine?

garmi ma lumbini ekdam taato hunchha, bihana sabere ra beluka ghumnus, dupahar ma chhaya ma aaram garnus. pani dherai boknus ra topi, chashma lagaunus. halka, kapas ko lugaa lagaunus. lumbini ko kshetra thulo chha, cycle ki rickshaw prayog garda thakai kam hunchha.
bachcha sanga lamo bus yatra garda k garne?

bachcha lai bomit hune bhaye yatra agadi halka khana dinus ra jhyal chheu basaunus. khelauna, kitab ra khaja jhola ma rakhnus, hatar ma nikalna milos. har 2-3 ghanta ma rokda pisab ra hidaai ko lagi utaarnus. sapha pani ra 1-2 jodi thap lugaa nabirsanus.
jeep ma kachchi bato ma jaanda k sawdhani?
