halka sabun pani ra naram kapada le bistarai puchhnus. toothpaste ki baking soda halka ragadda pani kehi daag janchha. rang uchkine gari kada ragadnus nai haina. bachcha lai kagaj ra chitra banaune thau dinus, bhitta ma lekhne baani ghatchha.
naya kotha ma basai sarne, kasari milaune?

sarnu agadi saman lai kotha anusar box ma rakhera bahira naam lekhnus. pahilo din chahine saman, jastai lugaa, charger ra aushadhi, euta chhuttai jhola ma rakhnus. bhaada ra sisa ko saman kagaj ma berera rakhnus. naya kotha ma pahila sapha garnus ani saman milaunus.
gaun ma aago lagauda jungle ma aago sarne dar

sukha mausam ma jungle najik aago nabalnus. kheti ko jhaar jalaunu parda hawa nachalda, sano matra ma ra pani tayar rakhera matra garnus. aago pura nibhayeko pakka garnus. jungle ma aago dekhiye turuntai sthaniya prashasan ra samudayik ban samuha lai khabar garnus.
kaam ko interview ma "5 barsha pachhi aafulai kaha dekhnu hunchha" bhanchhan

imandar ra kaam sanga jodiyeko uttar dinus: "yo kshetra ma anubhav badhayera team lai netritwa garne thau samma pugna chahanchhu." company sanga sangai badhne ichchha dekhaunus. "tapai ko kursi ma" jasto majak nagarnus. lakshya spasta bhaye uttar bharosa ko lagchha.
interview ma talab kati chahincha bhanda kam bhane jasto lagyo

offer letter aaunu agadi namra bhayera pheri kura garna sakinchha: "kaam ko jimmewari herda ali badhi apeksha garchhu." bajar ko talab ko jankari sahit bhannus. talab badhena bhane aru suvidha, jastai training ki chhutti, ko barema sodhnus.
kaam chhodda boss risaye

namra ra pesewar bhayera suchana ko samaya palnus ra kaam ramro sanga hastaantaran garnus. "yo company ma dherai sikye, dhanyabad" bhannus. ris ko jawaf ris le nadinus. ramro sanga chhodda pachhi recommendation ra sambandha dubai bachchha.
kaam ma mero idea kasai le sundainan

idea lai chhoto ra spasta lekhit rup ma, faida ra kharcha sahit prastut garnus. manager sanga meeting ko samaya magnus. sano prayog bata suru garna prastav garnus, nattija dekhepachhi manchhe sunchhan. sahakarmi ko sahayog pahila linus.
naya bike kinne ki purano?

budget kam bhaye ramro awastha ko purano bike sasto parchha, tara mistri sanga jaanch garaunus. naya bike ma warranty ra kam marmat kharcha hunchha. din ma kati chalaune ra kati barsha rakhne hisab garnus. dubai ma bima ra helmet nachhodnus.
ghar ma CCTV rakhna kati ramro?

CCTV le suraksha badhauchha ra chori ko praman dinchha. camera ko password badalnus, natra aru le herna sakchhan. chhimeki ko ghar bhitra najhalkine gari rakhnus, gopaniyata ko sammaan garnus. recording kati din samma rahanchha bujhnus.
gharbeti le kotha chhodna 1 hapta ko samaya diyo

pahila samjhauta ma suchana ko samaya k lekheko chha hernus. shanta bhayera thap samaya magnus. turuntai arko kotha khojna suru garnus ra advance firta ko kura lekhit garnus. samasya badhe wada karyalaya ma sahayog magna sakinchha.
sathi le mero bike sapat magyo, dine?

sathi le license ra helmet chha ki pakka garnus. durghatana bhaye ko jimmewari ko kura pahila spasta garnus. bike ko kagaj ra bima ko awastha hernus. bharosa nabhaye namra bhayera "nai" bhannu pani thik ho.
online ma sathi banayo, bhetna bolayo

pahilo bhet sarvajanik ra bheed bhayeko thau ma, diuso garnus. parivar ki sathi lai kaha, kasko sanga bhetna jaadai hunuhunchha bhannus. afnai yatayat ma jaanus ra farkine samaya pakka garnus. kehi asajilo lage turuntai niklanus.
bachcha lai bhanna sikaune ki "nai" bhanna paunchhau?

bachcha lai sikaunus ki uslai asajilo lagne chhuai ki kura ma "nai" bhanna paunchha, thulo manchhe lai pani. "gopya rakha" bhanne kura ma asajilo lage aama buwa lai bhanna sikaunus. bhanda gali nagarnus, bharosa dinus.
kishor chhora le raksi khaeko thaha bhayo

ris ma kutpit nagarnus, shanta bhayera kina khayo bujhnus: sathi ko dabab, tanab ki jigyasa. raksi ko swasthya ra kanuni jokhim spasta bhannus. ghar ko niyam ra parinam tay garnus. bar bar bhaye ki lat ko sanket dekhiye bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
dherai sutchhu tara pani thakai

nidra ko samaya bhanda pani gunastar mahatwapurna ho. sutne ra uthne samaya niyamit rakhnus ra sutnu agadi phone nahernus. din ma alikati hidnus ra ghaam ma basnus. lamo samaya thakai rahe ragat ko kami, thyroid ki aru karan ko jaanch doctor sanga garaunus.
din ma pani pyas lagdaina, pani birsinchhu
bihana uthne bittikai ek gilas pani piune niyam banaunus. har khana sangai ek gilas pani rakhnus. phone ma reminder rakhnus. jhol, phal ra tarkari bata pani pani milchha.
dhulo le aankha polchha bike chalauda
helmet ko sisa (visor) banda garera chalaunus ki chashma lagaunus. ghar pugepachhi sapha pani le aankha pakhalnus, nakanyaunus. aankha rato, dukhne ki dhamilo bhairahe aankha ko doctor dekhaunus.
gaun ma pakki charpi banaune, k dhyan dine?

charpi pani ko srot, jastai dhara ki kuwa, bata kamti 15-20 m tadha banaunus. khalto ramro gahiro ra mathi chhopne gari banaunus. haat dhune thau ra sabun charpi chheu rakhnus. sthaniya palika ko sarsafai karyakram ma sahayog paina sakinchha, bujhnus.
kheti ko lagi bank bata loan line

krishi karja ko byaj ra sartabare 2-3 bank ma tulana garnus. sarkari anudan ki sahuliyat karja ko yojana pani sodhnus. kun baali ma kati lagani ra kati aamdani hune lekhit yojana banaunus. kista ko samaya baali kaatne samaya sanga milaunus.
tarkari ko mol bajar ma dherai ghatyo, noksan bhayo

ekai tarkari sabai le lagaunda mol ghatchha, aru kisan sanga milera farak baali lagaune yojana banaunus. sahakari ki samuha banayera thok bajar ma sidhai bechna sakinchha. bemausami tarkari ra bhandaran ko upaya sochnus. sano matra ma bibidh baali lagaunda jokhim ghatchha.
bachcha ko janma darta kasari garne?

bachcha janmeko 35 din bhitra wada karyalaya ma darta garnu parne niyam chha bhanne thaha chha, tara pakka samaya ra kagaj wada ma bujhnus. aama buwa ko nagarikta ra aspatal ko janma praman (bhaye) lagnus. darta ko praman patra surakshit rakhnus, school ra aru kaam ma chahinchha.
gharelu hinsa bhairahechha, kaslai bhanne?

tapai ko suraksha sabai bhanda pahila. turuntai khatara bhaye prahari lai 100 ma phone garnus. bharosa ko aafantu, chhimeki ki mahila sahayog sanstha sanga kura garnus. jaruri kagaj, aushadhi ra phone ek thau ma tayar rakhnus. tapai ko galti haina, sahayog paainchha.
dherai kharcha bhayo, credit card ko minimum matra tirchhu

minimum matra tirda baki rakam ma dherai byaj lagdai janchha ra rin badhchha. sakesamma pura bakyauta tirnus ki minimum bhanda badhi tirnus. card prayog roknus jabasamma bakyauta ghatdaina. bank sanga kista ma milaune bato sodhnus.
kaksha 12 ko exam ra entrance ko tayari sangai kasari?

board exam ko syllabus ra entrance ko syllabus ma milne bhag pahila padhnus. bihana board ko, beluka entrance ko prashna abhyas garnus. board exam najik aaye tyasmai dhyan dinus. har hapta euta model test dinus.
bihana ko school ra beluka ko kaam, homework ko samaya chhaina

lunch break ra bus ma sano homework sakaunus. bidaa ko din pura hapta ko yojana banaunus. teacher lai awastha bhannus, kahile kahi samaya thap milchha. nidra nachhodnus, thakeko dimag le kaam dhilo hunchha.
bhai lai english padhauna kasari?
sajilo katha ko kitab sangai padhnus ra chitra herera shabda sikaunus. ghar ka saman ko naam english ma bhanne khel khelnus. galti sudharda maya le bhannus. din ma 15 minet niyamit garnus.
kitab padhda arth nabujhine shabda dherai
pahila vakya bata artha anuman garnus. sabai bhanda dherai dohorine shabda matra dictionary ma hernus ra copy ma lekhnus. ali sajilo kitab chhannus. bistarai shabda bhandar badhdai janchha.
bachcha ko school ko project ma dherai madat garnu parchha
project bachcha ko ho, tyasaile kaam afai garna dinus ra tapai le margadarshan matra garnus. kaam sano bhag ma todera taalika banaidinus. saman jutaune ra surakshit kaam ma matra sahayog garnus.
din bhari sitting job, taul badhyo
har ghanta uthera 2-3 minet hidnus. lunch pachhi 10 minet hidaai garnus. lift ko satta bharyang prayog garnus. ghar ma halka exercise ra khana ko matra ma dhyan dinus.
chiso pani piuda daat sirsiraunchha
sensitive daat ko lagi naram brush ra sensitive toothpaste prayog garna sakinchha. daat jor le naragadnus. amilo ra dherai chiso kura kam garnus. dukhai lagatar bhaye dentist dekhaunus.
nidra ma khutta tanchha (cramp)
sutnu agadi khutta ko halka stretching garnus ra pani pugdo piunus. cramp aauda khutta sidha gari aunla aafu tira tannus. bar bar aaye doctor sanga salah linus.
bachcha lai bihana ko khana ruchdaina

bachcha lai man parne 2-3 bikalpa dinus ra afai chhanna dinus. sano matra ma sundar tarika le thal ma dinus. raati dhilo khaja dina chhodnus, bihana bhok laagchha. sangai basera khanda bachcha le pani khanchha.
kam paisa ma ghar ma bijuli bachaune upaya?
LED batti prayog garnus ra kotha bata nisknda batti banda garnus. fridge ko dhoka bar bar nakholnus. charger ra TV ko plug prayog nabhaye nikalnus. diuso prakritik ujyalo prayog garnus.
kam aamdani ma bachcha ko padhai kasari?

sarkari school ra chhatravritti ko jankari linus. kitab ra uniform purano ramro awastha ko prayog garna sakinchha. bachcha ko padhai ko lagi mahina ko sano rakam chhuttyaunus. school sanga fee ko sahuliyat ko barema sodhnus.
dherai kharcha bhayera chinta, sutna sakdina

sutnu agadi kharcha ra aamdani ko yojana ek pana ma lekhnus, dimag halka hunchha. bholi ko lagi euta sano kadam tokdinus. raati thulo nirnaya nagarnus. chinta le lamo samaya nidra bigre bharosa ko manchhe ki counsellor sanga kura garnus.
phone ma sabai photo mixed, kasari milaune?
album banaunus: pariwar, kaam, yatra. nachaine ra dohoro photo hataunus. mahina ma ek palta photo milaune samaya rakhnus. backup cloud ma rakhnus.
whatsapp ma ajnabi le group ma add garyo

shanka lagne group bata turuntai niklanus ra number block garnus. privacy setting ma "group ma ko le add garna milchha" ma "my contacts" rakhnus. group ko link ra lobh lagne message ma kahile pani click nagarnus.
kaam ma bonus aayo, k garne?
pahila sapat bhaye tirnus. kehi bhag aakasmik kosh ma rakhnus. bacheko bata pariwar ko lagi sano khusi ki afno lagi kaam lagne kura kinnus. sabai ek palta kharcha nagarnus.
kaam ma training ma pathaunu bhayo, k garne?
training ma dhyan dera note linus ra prashna sodhnus. sikeko kura office ma kasari lagu garne bhanne yojana banaunus. farkera team lai sano saransh dina sakinchha. naya sathi ra samparka banaunus.
english ko listening test ma chhito bolchhan
suru ma bistarai bolne audio bata abhyas garnus ra bistarai gati badhaunus. prashna pahila padhera k sunne bhanne thaha paunus. mukhya shabda matra tipnus, pura vakya lekhna nakhojnus.
sathi haru le mero chhoto height ko majak garchhan
height le manchhe ko moolya napdaina. ek palta spasta bhannus ki yo majak man pardaina. afno sip ra ramro guna ma dhyan dinus. majak hepai ma badliyo bhane bharosa ko thulo manchhe lai bhannus.
bachcha haru aapas ma jhagada gari ris le kutchhan

kut pit kahile pani nagarne niyam spasta rakhnus. ris uthda shanta hune tarika, jastai 10 samma ganne, sikaunus. jhagada pachhi dubai ko kura sunnus ra milna sikaunus. tapai pani shanta byabahar dekhaunus.
pariwar ma kasai ko mrityu pachhi bachcha lai kasari bhanne?

sajilo ra sachcho shabda ma bhannus, "bhagwan kaha gayo" jasta alamal shabda bhanda sidha kura ramro. bachcha ko prashna ko uttar dhairya le dinus ra runa dinus. bachcha ko routine sakesamma rakhnus. lamo samaya dherai udas bhaye bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
bihana padhda pani nidra lagchha

uthne bittikai ek gilas pani piunus ra 5 minet halka chalan garnus. jhyal kholera ujyalo bhitra aauna dinus. ochhyan ma basera napadhnus, table kursi ma basnus. raati pugdo nidra nabhaye bihana nidra lagchha, sutne samaya pani hernus.
pariksha ko dar le pet dukhchha ra bomit jasto hunchha

dar le sharir ma yasto hunu samanya ho. exam agadi halka khana khanus, khali pet najaanus. hall ma pugera 4 second saas bhitra, 6 second bahira, 5 palta garnus. lakshan dherai ki lagatar bhaye doctor sanga pani salah linus.
kitab kinna paisa chhaina

school ki gaun ko library ma kitab sodhnus. senior bidyarthi bata purano kitab sasto ma ki sapat ma lina sakinchha. sathi sanga kitab baadera padhne yojana banaunus. kehi bishaya ko padhne samagri online pani nishulka paainchha.
group project ma sathi haru le kaam gardainan

suru mai sabai ko kaam ra miti lekhit baadnus. hapta ma ek palta chhoto meeting garera progress hernus. kaam nagarne lai namra bhayera samjhaunus. tyo pani nabhaye teacher lai shanta bhayera awastha bataunus.
teacher le sabai ko agadi gali garnu bhayo

sabai ko agadi gali sunda lajja ra dukha dubai lagchha. galti thiyo bhane sudharne koshish garnus ra pachhi eklai teacher sanga bolnus. anyay jasto lage aama buwa sanga kura garnus. ek din ko ghatana le tapai ko moolya ghataudaina.
naya school ma sarne, dar lagchha
naya thau ma dar lagnu swabhabik ho. pahilo din samaya mai pugnus ra chheu ma baseko sanga parichaya garnus. kunai club ma judnus, sathi chhito banchhan. purano sathi sanga samparka pani rakhnus.
kitab ko saransh kasari lekhne?

pahila pura kitab ki chapter padhnus ra mukhya ghatana ki bichar 4-5 bunda ma tipnus. tyas pachhi afnai shabda ma suru, bich ra antya kram ma lekhnus. sano detail chhodnus. antya ma afno bichar 1-2 vakya ma thapna sakinchha.
mukh sadhai sukha hunchha

din bhari bela bela pani piunus ra chiya coffee kam garnus. mukh le saas line baani bhaye naak banda chha ki hernus. sukha mukh le daat ma kira lagne khatara badhchha, daat ramrari majhnus. lamo samaya rahe, khas gari dherai pyas ra pisab sangai bhaye, doctor sanga sugar jaanch garaunus.
jiu ma rato bimiro aayo, chilauchha

kunai naya sabun, khana ki aushadhi le allergy bhayeko hunasakchha, pahila tyo roknus. chiso pani le nuhaunus ra khukulo kapas ko lugaa lagaunus. nakanyaunus. saas pherna garo, oth ki anuhar sunniyo bhane turuntai aspatal jaanus.
pet ma gas bhayera phulchha

chhito chhito khanda ra kura gardai khanda hawa nilinchha, bistarai khanus. chiso peya, dherai gedagudi ra tareko khana kam garnus. khana pachhi halka hidnus. dukhai dherai, bomit ki taul ghatne bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
raati dherai palta pisab garna uthnu parchha

sutnu bhanda 2 ghanta agadi dherai pani ra chiya nakhanus. tara din bhari pani pugdo piunus. raati 2 bhanda badhi palta bar bar uthnu parchha, pisab polchha, ki dherai pyas lagchha bhane doctor sanga jaanch garaunus, sugar ki prostate jasta karan hunasakchha.
chhati ma polne jasto, khana pachhi

khana pachhi turuntai nasutnus ra ek palta ma dherai nakhanus. piro, tel ra chiya coffee kam garnus. tara chhati ko dukhai haat, ghaati ki jaw tira phailiyo, pasina aayo ki saas phulyo bhane yo mutu ko samasya hunasakchha, turuntai aspatal jaanus.
kaan ma sadhai sui sui awaj aauchha

dherai thulo awaj ma geet sunne baani bhaye ghataunus ra earphone ko awaj kam rakhnus. tanab ra kam nidra le pani badhauna sakchha. kaan ma tel ki kunai chij nahalnus. lagatar rahe ki sunna kam bhaye naak kaan ghaati ko doctor dekhaunus.
sano bachcha lai khoki lagyo, mahu dina milchha?

1 barsha bhanda sano bachcha lai mahu nadinus, yo khatarnak hunasakchha. 1 barsha bhanda thulo lai alikati manta pani ma mahu dina sakinchha. bachcha lai dherai pani ra aaram dinus. saas phulne, uchho jworo ki khoki dherai din samma rahe doctor dekhaunus.
jworo aauda nuhauna hunchha?

halka jworo ma manta pani le chhito nuhauna ki jiu puchhna sakinchha, sharir sapha ra halka hunchha. dherai chiso ki dherai taato pani prayog nagarnus. nuhayepachhi turuntai sukha lugaa lagaunus. dherai kamjori ki chakkar bhaye nuhauna bhanda bhijeko kapada le puchhnus.
bihana kun stretching garne?

ochhyan bata uthera haat mathi tanne, kammar bistarai dayan bayan ghumaune ra ghuda chhati tira tanne garnus. ghaati bistarai ghumaunus. har stretching 15-20 second rakhnus, jhatka nadinus. 5 minet ko stretching le pura din jiu halka hunchha.
plank kasari garne?

kuhino ra khutta ko aunla ma jiu sidha rakhnus, kammar tala na mathi, sidha line ma. pet ko maansapeshi kasilo rakhnus ra saas nachhodnus. suru ma 20-30 second, bistarai samaya badhaunus. kammar dukhe roknus.
cycle ma office jaane soch, k dhyan dine?

helmet ra chamkilo lugaa sadhai lagaunus. sadak ko bayan chheu ma chalaunus ra mod ma haat le sanket dinus. pasina aaune bhaye office ma ferne lugaa rakhnus. cycle ko brake ra hawa hapta ma ek palta jaanch garnus.
football khelda ghuda markiyo

khel roknus ra ghuda lai aaram dinus. chiso sek 15-20 minet dinus ra khutta mathi rakhnus. sujan ra dukhai badhe, ghuda hallinchha ki hidna sakinna bhane doctor dekhaunus. niko nahunjel khel ma nafarkinus.
dahi kahile khanu ramro?

dherai jaso le din ko khana sangai ki khaja ma dahi khanchhan, yo pachna ramro maninchha. chini dherai haleko dahi bhanda sadharan dahi ramro. raati khada kasai lai rugha ki gas jasto lagchha bhane diuso khanus. dudh ko allergy bhaye satark rahanus.
chhito pakne poshilo khana?

dal ra bhat cooker ma, ani anda bhurji, chana tarkari ki khichadi chhito banchha. raati nai chana ra gedagudi bhijayera rakhnus. hariyo saag 5 minet ma pakchha. sajilo khana ma pani dal, saag ra phal rakhda poshilo hunchha.
gedagudi khanda pet ma gas

gedagudi raati bhari bhijayera pani phalera matra pakaunus. pakaunda jwano, hing ki adhuwa halda pachna sajilo hunchha. suru ma thorai matra khanus ra bistarai badhaunus. ramrari pakeko gedagudi matra khanus.
bachat khata ra fixed deposit ma farak k ho?

bachat khata ma jahile pani paisa nikalna milchha tara byaj kam hunchha. fixed deposit ma paisa tokeko samaya (jastai 1 barsha) samma rakhnu parchha ra byaj badhi hunchha. bichai ma nikalda byaj katna sakchha. aakasmik paisa bachat khata ma ra lamo samaya ko paisa FD ma rakhnu ramro.
online banking surakshit kasari chalaune?

bank ko official app matra prayog garnus ra phone ma screen lock rakhnus. password ra OTP kasai lai nadinus. public wifi ma bank nachalaunus. har transaction ko SMS herdai garnus, shanka lage turuntai bank lai phone garnus.
kharcha ko diary kasari rakhne?

euta sano copy ki phone ma har din ko kharcha miti, kura ra rakam sahit lekhnus. hapta ko ant ma jodnus ra kun thau ma badhi gayo hernus. kharcha lai khana, yatayat, bill, ramailo jasta bhag ma chhuttyaunus. 1 mahina lekhda nai dherai kura spasta hunchha.
maha bechne byabasaya kasto?

sudh maha ko maag ramro chha, tara gunastar ra sarsafai mahatwapurna. sapha bottle ma naam, miti ra thau lekhnus. pahila sathi, chhimeki ra sthaniya pasal bata bechna suru garnus. maha ma kehi namilaunus, bharosa nai byapar ko mul ho.
beauty parlour kholne soch

pahila talim prapta bhayera sip pakka garnus. sapha, ujyalo thau ra sapha saman nai grahak ko pahilo chhap. suru ma sano thau ra kehi sewa bata suru garnus. sthaniya palika ma darta ko kura bujhnus ra social media ma kaam ko photo rakhnus.
gaun ma anda bechne kaam suru garne

najik ko pasal, hotel ra school canteen sanga pahila kura garera maag bujhnus. kukhura ko khana, khop ra sarsafai ma dhyan dinus. anda sapha, taja ra tray ma rakhera bechnus. har din ko utpadan ra bikri lekhnus.
phone ma photo le dherai thau liyo

ekai photo ka dherai copy ra burst photo hataunus. cloud backup on garera phone bata purana photo hataunus. whatsapp ko media folder sapha garnus. camera ko setting ma photo ko quality ali ghataunda pani thau bachchha.
naya app le dherai permission magchha

app lai chahine permission matra dinus, jastai torch app lai contact ki location chahindaina. settings ma gayera app permission bela bela jaanch garnus. shanka lagne app hataunus. official store bata, ramro review bhayeko app matra download garnus.
laptop ko battery chhito sakinchha

screen ko ujyalo ghataunus ra "battery saver" mode prayog garnus. nachalaune program ra browser ko tab banda garnus. laptop lai dherai taato thau ma narakhnus. 2-3 barsha purano battery bhaye kamjor bhayeko hunasakchha, service centre ma jaanch garaunus.
galti le file delete bhayo

computer ma pahila "recycle bin" ma hernus, tyahi bata restore garna milchha. phone ma photo bhaye "recently deleted" folder hernus. tyo pani khali bhaye naya file save nagarnus ra recovery software ko barema jankaar sanga sodhnus. aagadi ko lagi backup ko baani rakhnus.
naya kaam ma gaun ko yaad aauchha

naya thau ma suru ma yaad aaunu swabhabik ho. ghar sanga niyamit phone garnus ra chhutti ma jaane yojana banaunus. naya thau ma sathi banaunus ra sthaniya karyakram ma judnus. bistarai naya thau pani afno lagna thalchha.
office ma lunch eklai khanchhu, sathi chhaina

sahakarmi lai "sangai lunch garaun?" bhanera sodhnus, dherai jaso khusi hunchhan. office ko chiya break ma kura suru garnus. kunai office ko karyakram ma bhag linus. eklai lunch garnu pani thik ho, tara euta sano kadam le sathi banna sakchhan.
hotel line ma career banaune soch

hotel ma reception, kitchen, housekeeping jasta dherai bhag chhan, tapai lai kun man parchha hernus. sambandhit training ki course garnus ra english ra byabahar ko sip badhaunus. suru ma internship ki sano hotel ma kaam garera anubhav linus. dhairya ra mehenat le agadi badhna sakinchha.
army ma bharti ko tayari kasari garne?

sharirik tayari mukhya ho: daud, push-up, sit-up ra chin-up niyamit garnus. bharti ko suchana aadhikarik thau bata bujhnus ra chahine kagaj tayar rakhnus. likhit pariksha ko lagi samanya gyan ra math padhnus. dalal ko lobh ma naparnus, bharti ma paisa lagdaina bhanne kura ma dhyan dinus.
english speaking test ma k garne?

prashna dhyan le sunnus, bujhena bhane "Could you repeat, please?" bhannus. uttar ma 2-3 vakya ra euta udaharan dinus. bistarai ra spasta bolnus, dherai garo shabda prayog garnu pardaina. galti bhaye rokinu nabhai aagadi badhnus.
english ma sapana dekhne bhaye ramro sanket?
english ma sochne ra sapana dekhne hunu bhaneko bhasa dimag ma basdai gayeko sanket hunasakchha! niyamit padhne, sunne ra bolne abhyas jaari rakhnus. sapana bhanda niyamit abhyas nai mukhya ho.
naya bhauju ghar aaunu bhayo, kasari milne?

unlai swagat garnus ra ghar ko niyam bistarai sajilo tarika le bataunus. unko ruchi sodhnus ra sangai kehi kaam garnus, jastai pakaune ki ghumne. unko pariwar ko kura ko sammaan garnus. naya thau ma unlai pani samaya chahinchha.
chhora lai kun umer ma mobile dine?

pakka umer bhanda bachcha ko jimmewari ra kaam ko awashyakta herna ramro. dinu bhaye suru ma sadharan phone ra niyam sahit dinus: samaya, kun app, ra raati phone bahira. parental control prayog garnus. online suraksha ko kura pahila nai sikaunus.
sathi haru ko jhagada ma ma bichma pare

kasaiko paksha nalinus ra dubai lai shanta bhayera sunnus. "timi dubai mero sathi, sangai kura gara na" bhannus. ek arka ko kura arko lai nalagaunus. milaun sakena bhane samaya dinus, jabarjasti nagarnus.
bachcha lai sachcho bolna kasari sikaune?

tapai afai sano kura ma pani sachcho bolnus, bachcha le herera sikchha. sachcho bolda gali bhanda prashamsa garnus, "sachcho bhanyau, ramro garyau." sajaya ko dar dherai bhaye bachcha jhuto bolchha, tyasaile shanta bhayera samadhan sikaunus.
kishori chhori ko sathi ko barema chinta

sathi haru ko barema sodhpuchh bhanda unlai ghar ma bolaunus, chinne mauka milchha. chhori sanga khulla kura garnus ra bharosa ko sambandha banaunus. kaha jaane, kahile farkine bhanne niyam sangai tay garnus. shanka ko kura dekhe gali haina, shanta bhayera kura garnus.
nati natini lai herna thakai lagchha

bachcha herne kaam dherai thakai dine ho, tapai ko swasthya pani mahatwapurna. chhora buhari sanga kati samaya sakinchha bhanera imandar kura garnus. bachcha sutda tapai pani aaram garnus. sajilo khel ra katha le tapai lai pani kam thakai hunchha.
dherai kaam sangai garda sabai bigrinchha

ek palta ek kaam garnus, multitasking le dimag thakchha ra galti badhchha. kaam ko list banayera jaruri ko kram ma lagaunus. har kaam ko lagi samaya tokdinus, jastai 30 minet email, 1 ghanta report. ek kaam sakepachhi matra arko suru garnus.
pomodoro bhaneko k ho?

25 minet dhyan dera kaam garne, ani 5 minet aaram garne tarika ho. 4 palta pachhi 15-30 minet lamo aaram linus. timer prayog garnus ra kaam ko bela phone tadha rakhnus. thulo kaam pani sano tukra ma chhito sakinchha.
calendar ma kaam lekhne baani kasari?
phone ko calendar ki euta diary ma har kaam ko miti ra samaya lekhnus. bihana 2 minet aaja ko kaam hernus. jaruri kaam ma reminder rakhnus. hapta ko suru ma pura hapta ek palta hernus.
bara (wo) kasari banaune?

kalo dal raati bhijayera bokra hatayera pisnus, alikati pani matra rakhnus. adhuwa, lasun, jeera ra nun milaunus. taato tawa ma tel lagayera golo pankha jasto patlo halnus ra dubai tira pakaunus. mathi anda halera pani banauna sakinchha.
aalu tama kasari banaune?

tama (bans ko tusa) lai pakhalnus. tel ma methi ra besar halera aalu bhutnus, ani tama, golbheda ra nun halnus. bodi ki kalo moong halna pani sakinchha. pani halera 15-20 minet pakaunus, amilo ra mitho jhol tayar.
chana ko tarkari kasari?

chana raati bhijayera cooker ma 4-5 sitti lagayera pakaunus. tel ma pyaj, lasun, adhuwa ra golbheda bhutnus, ani besar, jeera, dhaniya ko dhulo ra nun. pakeko chana ra alikati pani halera 10 minet pakaunus. hariyo dhaniya ra kagati mathi halnus.
masu ko achar kasari banaune?

masu sano tukra ma kaatera nun ra besar halera sukha hunjel bhutnus. tori ko tel ma methi, khursani ko dhulo, jeera, lasun ra adhuwa halera masu milaunus. kagati ko ras ra nun milaunus. chiso bhaye pachhi sapha sukha bottle ma rakhnus ra kehi din bhitra khanus.
kathmandu durbar square ghumda k herne?

purano darbar, mandir ra kala ko banot herna samaya linus, bihana ko samaya bheed kam hunchha. gyan dine guide ki jankari ko board padhnus. mandir ma jaanda sammaan ra chalan palnus. jutta kholnu parne thau ma kholnus ra photo khichnu agadi anumati hernus.
boudha ra pashupati ghumne, k dhyan dine?

boudha ma stupa ko warpar ghadi ko suwi ko disha ma ghumne chalan chha. pashupati ma kehi thau ma sabai lai bhitra jaana dindainan, niyam ko sammaan garnus. aryaghat ma antyeshti hune bhayekale photo khichda sambedanshil rahanus. bandar ra bheed bata saman jogaunus.
airport ma mero jhola haraayo

airport bhitrai airline ko "lost baggage" ki counter ma turuntai ujuri dinus ra ticket ra baggage tag dekhaunus. jhola ko rang, akar ra bhitra ko saman ko bibaran dinus. phone number ra thegana chhodnus. mulyawan saman ra aushadhi aagadi bata haat ko jhola mai rakhnus.
bus ma saman chori bhayo

turuntai conductor ra driver lai bhannus ra bus ko number tipnus. najik ko prahari ma ujuri dinus. card ki parichaya patra harayo bhane bank ra sambandhit karyalaya lai khabar garnus. aagadi mulyawan saman sangai ra jhola agadi rakhnus.
taxi app ma bharosa garne ki nagarne?

ramro naam bhayeko app ma driver ko naam, photo ra gadi ko number aauchha, chadhnu agadi milchha ki hernus. yatra ko bibaran parivar lai share garna milchha bhane garnus. raati eklai hunda agadi ko seat ma nabasnus. asajilo lage surakshit thau ma rokna bhannus.
mountain flight herna jaane, k jankari?

mountain flight bihana chhito hunchha ra mausam ramro bhaye matra udchha, radda ki dhilo hunasakchha. jhyal chheu ko seat ko barema sodhnus. airline ko samaya ra niyam pahila bujhnus. camera ra phone charge garera lagnus.
hiundo ma bachcha lai school pathauda?

tah tah nyano lugaa, topi, panja ra moja lagaidinus. bihana ko khaja nyano dinus ra pani ko bottle ma manta pani. bato ma kuhiro bhaye chamkilo lugaa lagaunus. rugha ki jworo bhaye ghar mai aaram garna dinus.
ghar ma bachcha ko lagi surakshit banauna k garne?
aushadhi, rasayan ra chakku bachcha le napaune uchai ma rakhnus. bijuli ko socket chhopnus ra bharyang ma dhoka ki bar rakhnus. jhyal ma jali ki bar rakhnus. pani ko baltin ra tanki chhopera rakhnus.
bachcha haru ko jhagada kasari milaune?

shanta bhayera dubai ko kura sunnus, kasaiko paksha turuntai nalinus. "k bhayo, kina ris uthyo?" bhanera bhawana ko naam sikaunus. sangai samadhan khojna lagaunus, jastai palo palo khelne. kut pit kahile pani nagarne niyam spasta rakhnus.
shrimati sanga ris ma bolna chhodyau 2 din

lamo samaya nabolda dukha jhan badhchha. pahila tapai shanta bhayera bolnus: "mero kura le dukha lagyo bhane sorry, kura garau." dubai ko kura dhyan le sunnus. samasya ko kura garda ek arka lai dosh nadinus, samadhan khojnus.
buwa sanga rajniti ko kura ma jhagada hunchha

farak bichar hunu swabhabik ho, sambandha bigrinu pardaina. tyo bishaya ma kura garda dherai bahas nagarnus, "hamro bichar farak chha" bhanera rokna sakinchha. sangai garna man parne aru kura ma samaya bitaunus.
dherai bolne sathi le mero kura sundaina
kura garda bichma namra bhayera bhannus: "ek chhin, maile pani euta kura bhanna khojeko." chhoto ra spasta bolnus. sathi lai bhannus ki tapai lai pani sunida ramro lagchha. sachcho sathi le bujhchha.
sathi ko bihe ma jaana na sakda k garne?
sathi lai pahila nai imandar karan sahit bhannus. bihe ko din phone ki message ma shubhakamana pathaunus. sambhav bhaye pachhi bhetera sano upahar dinus. sathi le sambandha ma tapai ko maya bujhchha.
ghar ma kasai ko chhuttai kotha chhaina, padhna garo

ghar ko euta kuna lai padhne thau banaunus, jastai jhyal chheu sano table. ghar ka manchhe sanga padhai ko samaya tokera shanta rahana anurodh garnus. bihana sabere ki raati sabai sute pachhi padhna sakinchha. library pani ramro bikalpa ho.
gaun ma bijuli nahune bela padhai kasari?

solar batti ki rechargeable lamp ko byabastha garnus. ujyalo hune bela, bihana ra diuso, garo subject padhnus. raati mainbatti ma padhnu parda kagaj ra kapada bata tadha rakhnus. sathi haru sanga milera ujyalo bhayeko thau ma sangai padhna sakinchha.
naya computer ma k k software chahinchha?

pahila operating system update garnus ra antivirus chalu rakhnus. kaam anusar office software, browser ra PDF herne program rakhnus. software official website bata matra download garnus. nachahine program nahalnus, computer slow hunchha.
phone ko keyboard ma nepali lekhna kasari?

phone ko settings ma "language and input" ma gayera keyboard ma nepali bhasa thapna sakinchha. romanized lekhda nepali akshar banaidine keyboard pani hunchha. dherai jaso phone ma yo nishulka hunchha. thapepachhi keyboard ko globe ki language button thichera bhasa badalnus.
printer ko ink chhito sakinchha

sadharan kagaj ko lagi "draft" ki "economy" mode ma print garnus. jaruri nabhayeko rangin print nagarnus. print garnu agadi preview herera galti sudharnus. nakkali ink le printer bigarna sakchha, bharosa ko pasal bata kinnus.
dherai din dekhi rokieko kaam suru garna man lagdaina
kaam lai ekdam sano bhag ma todnus ra pahilo bhag 5 minet ma sakne gari rakhnus. "5 minet matra" bhanera suru garnus. kaam garne thau sapha ra tayar rakhnus. sakepachhi sano inam dinus, jastai chiya.
sabai kura birsinchhu, chabi, phone

ghar ma chabi ra phone rakhne euta nishchit thau banaunus, dhoka chheu sano bhaado. ghar bata niklanu agadi "phone, chabi, paisa" bhanera jaanch garnus. jaruri kaam phone ma lekhnus. bar bar dherai birsine bhaye ra dainik kaam ma asar pare doctor sanga kura garnus.
dherai sochchhu ki manchhe le mero barema k sochchhan

dherai jaso manchhe afnai kura ma byasta hunchhan, hamro barema sochne samaya kam hunchha. aru ko bichar bhanda afno mulya ma dhyan dinus. sano kura ma afno nirnaya afai garne abhyas garnus. yo chinta le jiwan rokchha bhane counsellor sanga kura garnus.
ma sadhai arko ko kaam garidinchhu, afno samaya chhaina

madat garnu ramro ho, tara afno samaya pani mahatwapurna. "hunchha" bhannu agadi afno kaam ko list hernus. namra tara spasta bhannus: "aaja sakdina, bholi herchhu." afno lagi samaya rakhnu swarthi hunu haina.
bihe pachhi pani sathi haru sanga bhetna paunu parchha?

sathi sanga sambandha jogaunu swastha kura ho. jiwan sathi sanga khulla kura garnus ra samaya milaunus. hapta ki mahina ma ek palta sathi bhetne yojana banaunus. jiwan sathi lai pani sathi sanga chinaune ra sangai bhetne garnus.
ghar ko kaam ma kati paisa chhuttyaune?

ghar ko marmat ra saman ko lagi mahina ko aamdani ko sano bhag, jastai 5%, chhuttai rakhnus. ghar ko kun kaam jaruri chha list banaunus ra kram ma garnus. thulo kaam ko lagi pahila nai 2-3 mistri bata mol linus. aakasmik marmat ko lagi pani alikati bachat rakhnus.
ghar ma pani chuhinchha chhana bata

barsha agadi nai chhana ko phuteko ra chira pareko thau hernus ra marmat garaunus. pani bagne nali ra pipe sapha rakhnus. bhitri bhitta ma pani pasyo bhane bijuli ko taar bata tadha rakhnus. thulo samasya bhaye anubhavi mistri lai dekhaunus.
hiundo ma pani ko pipe jamchha

bahira ko pipe lai purano kapada, bora ki foam le berera rakhnus. raati dhara alikati chuhine gari chhodda pani jamna kam hunchha. jameko pipe ma taato pani bistarai halnus, aago le sidhai nataataunus. pipe phutyo bhane main valve banda garnus.
kitchen garden kasari suru garne?

ghar warpar ghaam lagne thau chhannus ra mato ma compost milaunus. suru ma sajilo tarkari: saag, dhaniya, golbheda ra khursani. bihana ki beluka pani dinus. kira lage haat le hataunus, bish ko satta ghar ko upaya pahila try garnus.
gai ko khor kasto banaune?

khor sukha, hawa aaune ra ghaam lagne thau ma banaunus. bhuin ali dhalkine banaunus, pisab ra pani bagos. ghans ra pani rakhne thau sapha rakhnus. hiundo ma chiso hawa rokne ra garmi ma chhaya ko byabastha garnus.
bhaisi le ghans khadaina

taja ra sapha ghans ra pani dinus, ghans bigreko ta chhaina hernus. khor ma tanab, garmi ki birami le pani khana chhodna sakchha. jworo, dudh ghatne ki pet phuleko jasta lakshan bhaye pashu chikitsak lai turuntai dekhaunus.
hamro gaun ma bandar le baali nashta garchha

gaun bhari milera palo palo kheti ko herchah garne byabastha garnus. baali ko warpar jali ki bar lagaunus. bandar lai khana nadinus, baani bigrinchha. sthaniya palika ra ban karyalaya sanga samasya ko samadhan ko barema kura garnus.
khet ma pani jamera baali kuhinchha

khet ma pani nikasha ko nali banaunus ra nali sapha rakhnus. kehi baali uchai dhik ma lagaunda jara kuhine dar kam hunchha. barsha ma pani rokine thau ma pani sahane baali chhannus. krishi praabidhik sanga mato ra baali ko salah linus.
sathi le galti le mero phone phodyo, k bhanne?

ris shanta bhayepachhi sathi sanga kura garnus. galti le bhayeko ho bhane marmat ko kharcha baadne ki sathi le tirne bhanne kura namra bhayera garnus. marmat ko mol pahila thaha paunus. sambandha ra saman dubai jogaune samadhan khojnus.
dherai pahuna aaunda ghar ma thau pugdaina

sabai lai ek palta bolauna bhanda dui palta ma bolaunus. bichhyaune gundri ra kambal chhimeki ki aafantu bata sapat lina sakinchha. khana ko lagi buffet jasto byabastha garda thau bachchha. pahila nai kati jana aaune bhanne bujhnus.
dashain ma jua khelne chalan, paisa haarne dar

chad ko ramailo ma sano rakam ko khel bhaye pani sima tokdinus, haarna sakne bhanda badhi nalagaunus. sapat liyera ki ghar ko kharcha ko paisa le kahile pani nakhelnus. haareko paisa farkauna jhan khelne baani khatarnak ho. khel bhanda pariwar sanga aru ramailo kura garnus.
chad ma dherai raksi khane chalan, ma chhoda chahanchhu

chhodne nirnaya ramro ho. sajilo jawaf tayar rakhnus: "ma ahile khanna, juice nai thik chha." chad ma juice, chiya ki aru peya sangai rakhnus. najik ko sathi ra parivar lai pahila nai bhannus, sahayog garchhan.
tihar ma patakha le kukur darauchha

patakha padkine samaya kukur lai ghar bhitra shanta kotha ma rakhnus. jhyal dhoka banda garnus ra halka sangeet ki TV chalaunus. kukur lai jabarjasti bahira nanikalnus. dherai darayo bhane pashu chikitsak sanga salah linus.
deusi khelna jaane, k dhyan dine?
samuha ma jaanus ra raati dherai dhilo nagarnus. ghar ka thulo lai kaha jaane bataunus. sarak ma hidda gadi ko dhyan dinus ra chamkilo lugaa lagaunus. uthayeko paisa ko hisab spasta rakhnus.
holi ma rang aankha ma paryo

aankha nakanyaunus ra turuntai sapha chiso pani le bistarai pakhalnus, aankha jhimkaudai. contact lens bhaye nikalnus. bijhne, rato ki dhamilo dekhine lakshan rahe aankha ko doctor kaha jaanus. arko palta chashma lagayera khelnus.
teej ma dherai naachda khutta sunniyo

khutta mathi rakhera aaram garnus ra manta pani ma 10-15 minet khutta dubaunus. pani ra jhol piunus, barta bhayeko bela pani sakesamma pani piunus. dukhai, rato ra sujan dherai bhaye ki ek khutta matra sunniyo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
SEE ko science ko practical ko tayari

practical ko copy ma prayog ko uddeshya, saman, tarika ra nattija spasta lekhnus. har prayog ko chitra ra label abhyas garnus. viva ma "kina" bhanne prashna sodhchhan, tyasaile prayog ko karan bujhnus. lab ko saman surakshit tarika le chalaunus.
computer ko pariksha ma typing chhito chahinchha
din ma 15 minet typing ko abhyas garnus, kibord naheri. sahi aunla ko thau sikna online typing khel prayog garnus. gati bhanda pahila shuddhata. 2-3 hapta ma gati aafai badhchha.
kaksha 1 ko bachcha lai akshar sikaune tarika

ek din ma 2-3 akshar matra, khel ra chitra sanga sikaunus. baluwa ma aunla le lekhne ki rang le banaune jasta ramailo tarika prayog garnus. har din chhoto samaya, 15-20 minet pugchha. sikda prashamsa garnus, gali haina.
bachcha le homework ma sadhai rununchha

homework sanga garo bhawana jodiyeko hunasakchha. ekai samaya ra shanta thau tokdinus, ani sano bhag ma garna dinus. "pahila sajilo prashna" bata suru garnus. dherai garo bhaye teacher sanga kura garnus, kahile kahi homework bachcha ko star bhanda garo hunchha.
bachcha lai ganit ko table ramailo tarika le sikaune
table lai geet jastai gaayera sikaunus. sidhi chadhne khel, card khel ra bajar ko hisab ma prayog garnus. har din 5 minet matra ra ekai table 2-3 din. sikda sano inam, jastai stickers, dinus.
hamro bachcha lai kitab bhanda phone man parchha

phone ko samaya ra kitab ko samaya dubai tokdinus. bachcha ko ruchi ko kitab, jastai chitra katha ki janawar ko kitab, chhannus. sutnu agadi tapai sangai padhnus. library lagera afai kitab chhanna dinus.
jado ma bihana nuhauda rugha laagchha

nuhaune pani manta taato rakhnus ra kotha ma chiso hawa napasos. nuhaye lagattai taauko ra jiu ramrari sukaunus ra nyano lugaa lagaunus. diuso ko nyano samaya ma nuhaunu ramro. rugha ko karan bhaairus pani ho, haat dhune baani pani nachhodnus.
daat majhda gija bata ragat aauchha

naram brush ra bistarai majhnus, kada ragadnu hudaina. din ma 2 palta majhnus ra daat ko bich sapha garnus. ragat aaunu gija ko rog ko sanket hunasakchha. 1-2 hapta ma sudhar nabhaye dentist dekhaunus.
kammar ra ghaati sadhai kasilo

lamo samaya ekai tarika le nabasnus, har ghanta uthera jiu tannus. sutne takiya dherai uchai ki dherai nichai nahos. taato sek ra halka stretching le aaram dinchha. dukhai sanga sunnine, kamjori ki jworo bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
dherai pasina aaune garmi ma kasto lugaa?
kapas jasta halka, khukulo ra hawa chhirne lugaa lagaunus. halka rang le ghaam ko taap kam linchha. pasina le bhijeko lugaa chhito fernus. topi ra pani ko bottle sangai rakhnus.
bihana khali pet kagati pani piunu ramro?

dherai lai manta pani ma kagati man parchha ra pani piune baani ramro hunchha. tara gastric ki acidity hune lai khali pet amilo le polna sakchha. kunai ek peya le taul ghataune ki rog niko parne jaadu gardaina. santulit khana ra hidaai nai mukhya.
chiya ma chini chhodna sakdina

ek palta mai nachhodnus, har hapta alikati ghataunus. alaichi, adhuwa ra dalchini le swad ramro banauchha, chini kam chahinchha. chini ko satta mahu prayog garda pani matra dhyan dinus. 1 mahina ma jibro lai naya swad baani parchha.
gharma sano bachcha ra kukur sangai, surakshit kasari?

bachcha ra kukur lai kahile pani eklai sangai nachhodnus. bachcha lai kukur ko khana ra sutne bela najik najaana sikaunus. kukur ko khop ra sarsafai niyamit garnus. kukur ko byabahar ma parivartan dekhiye pashu chikitsak sanga salah linus.
ghar bahira jaanda biralo lai k garne?

pugne jati khana ra sapha pani rakhnus, litter box sapha garnus. 1-2 din bhanda badhi bhaye chhimeki ki sathi lai herna anurodh garnus. jhyal ra dhoka surakshit garnus. lamo samaya bhaye pashu herne thau ma rakhna sakinchha.
bachat ko lagi mahina ko kharcha kasari ghataune?

ek mahina sabai kharcha lekhnus ra najaruri kharcha chhuttyaunus. bahira khane ra online kinmel ghataunus. bijuli ra pani bachaunus. bachat talab aaune bittikai chhuttyaunus, baki bata matra kharcha garnus.
sapat ko byaj kasari hisab garne?

sadharan byaj: mool x dar x samaya / 100. jastai 10000 ma 12% le 1 barsha: 10000 x 12 x 1 / 100 = 1200. sapat linu agadi barshik dar ra kista ko jamma rakam lekhit maganus. mahina ko dar lekheko bhaye barsha ma kati hunchha hisab garnus.
bidesh bata paisa pathauda ramro dar kasari paune?

aadhikarik bank ra darta bhayeko remittance company matra prayog garnus. 2-3 thau ko dar ra sewa shulka tulana garnus. hundi jasto anadhikrit bato ma jokhim ra kanuni samasya hunchha. pathayeko rasid ra code surakshit rakhnus.
ghar ko jagga kinna sahakari bata loan line?

sahakari ko darta, byaj dar ra sartabare ramrari padhnus. bank ra sahakari dubai ko dar tulana garnus. kista tirna sakne rakam matra linus, mahina ko talab ko 30-40% bhanda badhi nahos. jagga ko kagaj jankaar le jaanch garepachhi matra lagani garnus.
mero bhai le jhuto bolera paisa magchha

shanta bhayera spasta bhannus ki jhuto bolda bharosa ghatchha. paisa ko kura ma sidha karan sodhnus ra jaruri kura ma matra madat garnus. ghar ka thulo lai pani bhannus. jua, nasha jasta khatarnak kura ko shanka bhaye turuntai parivar sanga milera sahayog khojnus.
sathi le mero kura arko lai lagaidinchha
aagadi tyo sathi lai gopya kura nabhannus. shanta bhayera bhannus: "maile timi lai bharosa garera bhaneko thiyo." bharosa ra sima dubai rakhnus. sabai sathi sanga sabai kura bhannu pardaina.
kaam ma boss le sadhai thap kaam dinchhan

afno ahile ko kaam ko list lekhera boss lai dekhaunus ra "kun pahila garne?" bhanera sodhnus. thap kaam ko lagi samaya ki sahayog magnus. lagatar dherai bhaye kaam ko bojh ko barema shanta bhayera kura garnus. sabai kura ma "hunchha" bhanda gunastar ghatchha.
kaam ma naya manchhe lai sikaunu parne bhayo
suru ma kaam ko thulo chitra bataunus, ani step step sikaunus. ekai palta dherai kura nabhannus, lekhit note dinus. prashna sodhna protsahan dinus ra dhairya rakhnus. ramro gare prashamsa garnus.
office ko party ma k lagaune?

party ko kisim herera sapha ra ramro lugaa lagaunus, dherai bhadkilo ki dherai sadharan haina. sahakarmi sanga ramailo garnus tara pesewar byabahar nachhodnus. raksi ko matra sima ma rakhnus. samaya mai pugnus ra dhanyabad bhanera bidaa magnus.
gaun ma mobile repair pasal kholna kasto hola?
gaun ma repair ko maag hunchha bhane ramro bikalpa ho. pahila talim ra anubhav linus. sano aujar ra spare part bata suru garnus. imandar mol ra samaya mai kaam le grahak badhchha.
tarkari ko pasal ma ghaam le tarkari oilaunchha

pasal ma chhaya ko byabastha garnus ra tarkari ma bela bela pani chharknus. saag jasta kura bhijeko kapada ma berera rakhnus. bihana taja tarkari matra lyaunus ra beluka sasto ma sakaunus. pani ra chhaya le noksan dherai ghatchha.
ghar ko lagi solar panel kinne?

ghar ma kati bijuli chahinchha, jastai batti, fan, phone charge, hisab garnus. darta bhayeko company bata warranty sahit kinnus. panel ghaam ramro lagne thau ma rakhnus ra dhulo sapha garnus. sarkari anudan ko kura sthaniya palika ma bujhnus.
phone ma ad haru dherai aauchha browser ma

browser ko settings ma pop-up block on garnus. shanka lagne website ko notification "allow" nagarnus, garisaknu bhayo bhane settings bata hataunus. purano ra nachahine app hataunus. official browser matra prayog garnus.
computer ma sabai file milayera kasari rakhne?
mukhya folder banaunus: padhai, kaam, photo, document. file ko naam spasta rakhnus, jastai "2081_bijuli_bill". desktop ma sabai file narakhnus. mahina ma ek palta backup ra nachahine file hataunus.
ghar ma sabai jana ko phone ko charger harauchha
ghar ma euta "charging station" banaunus, sabai charger tyahi rakhne niyam. charger ma naam ki rang ko tape lagaunus. bahira lagda chhuttai charger rakhnus. sasta naqali charger nakinnus.
english ma "how are you" ko jawaf k dine?
sajilo jawaf: "I'm fine, thank you. And you?" ki "I'm good, thanks!" thakeko bhaye "A bit tired, but okay." pani bhanna sakinchha. jawaf pachhi "how about you?" sodhnu ramro byabahar ho.
english ma email ma sorry kasari lekhne?

"I'm sorry for the delay in replying." ki "I apologize for the mistake in my report." jasto sidha vakya lekhnus. tyas pachhi k sudhar gardai hunuhunchha bhannus: "I have corrected it and attached the new file." dherai lamo bahana nalekhnus.
hamro ghar ma budhi aama lai sunna garo

kura garda samne basera bistarai ra spasta bolnus, chichyaunu pardaina. TV ko awaj ko satta subtitle prayog garna sakinchha. kaan jaanch garaunus, sunne yantra (hearing aid) le dherai farak parna sakchha. dhairya ra maya le kura garnus.
buwa ko aankha kamjor, bato hidna garo

aankha ko doctor sanga niyamit jaanch garaunus, motiyabinda jasto samasya upachar hune hunasakchha. ghar ma ujyalo ramro rakhnus ra bato ma saman narakhnus. bahira jaanda sangai jaanus ki lauro prayog garna sikaunus.
dherai din samma khoki, churot khanchhu

churot khane ko lamo khoki phokso ko samasya ko sanket hunasakchha, doctor sanga jaanch garaunus. churot chhodne yojana banaunus, yo nai sabai bhanda thulo upachar. dhuwa ra dhulo bata bachnus. khakar ma ragat, taul ghatne ki saas phulne bhaye turuntai jaanus.
gaun ma bachcha haru lai poshan kasari pugaune?

sthaniya ra sasto khana nai poshilo hunasakchha: dal, gedagudi, saag, anda, dudh ra mausami phal. lito ma dherai anna milayera banaunus. bachcha lai din ma 3 palta khana ra bich ma khaja dinus. bachcha ko taul ra uchai health post ma niyamit naap garaunus.
pani ko dhara tadha chha, bachcha haru le pani bokchhan

bachcha lai unko umer anusar sano bhaado matra boknu dinus. pani bokda bato surakshit hos ra padhai ko samaya nabigros. gaun ma milera dhara najik lyaune yojana sthaniya palika sanga garnus. pani surakshit rakhna bhaado chhopnus.
bihe ko bhoj ma khana bachyo, k garne?

bacheko khana chhito chiso garera surakshit rakhnus ra 1 din bhitra baadnus. chhimeki, kaam garne ra garib pariwar lai sapha bhaado ma baadna sakinchha. bigreko khana kasai lai nadinus. aagadi pahuna ko sankhya anusar khana ko matra milaunus.
chad ma dherai mithai, daat ko dar

mithai khaye pachhi pani le kulla garnus ra raati sutnu agadi daat majhnus. din bhari pata pata thorai mithai khanu bhanda ek palta khanu ramro. bachcha lai pani yo baani sikaunus. daat dukhe dentist dekhaunus.
kath ko furniture ma dhamira lagyo

dhamira lageko furniture lai aru saman bata chhuttyaunus. dhamira ko upachar garne jankaar ki pest control sanga salah linus. furniture lai bhitta ra bhuin bata ali tadha, sukha thau ma rakhnus. chisopan nai dhamira ko mukhya karan ho.
ghar ko bhitta ma chira paryo bhuichalo pachhi

chira sano ra mathi matra ho ki gahiro ra thulo, ramrari hernus. thulo chira, dhoka jhyal nabanda hune ki bhitta dhalkiyo bhane engineer lai turuntai dekhaunus. tyo bela samma tyo bhag ma nasutnus. sthaniya palika ko sahayog ko barema pani bujhnus.
ghar ko bhuin ma chiplo, budhabudhi khasne dar
bhuin ma chiplo nahune mat ra carpet rakhnus. bathroom ma samatne dandi lagaunus. pani poklyo bhane turuntai puchhnus. budhabudhi lai chiplo nahune chappal lagaunus.
pahilo palta ghar kinne, k k herne?

jagga ra ghar ko kagaj, naksa pass ra bato ko pahunch jaanch garnus. ghar ko banot, chira ra pani chuhine samasya engineer lai dekhaunus. pani, bijuli ra dhal ko byabastha bujhnus. kanuni kura wakil sanga ra loan ko kura bank sanga pakka garnus.
ghar bhada ma dine, k dhyan dine?

bhadawal sanga lekhit samjhauta garnus: bhada, advance, bijuli pani ko niyam ra kati samaya. bhadawal ko parichaya patra ko copy rakhnus. ghar ko awastha ko photo khichera rakhnus. sthaniya niyam anusar bhadawal ko jankari wada ma dinu parne bhaye bujhnus.
ghar ma kaam garne didi rakhne, k dhyan dine?

kaam, samaya ra talab spasta lekhit tay garnus. sammaan sanga byabahar garnus ra bida ko din dinus. unko parichaya patra ko copy rakhnus. bachcha ki budhabudhi ko herchah garne bhaye pahila kehi din sangai basera sikaunus.
driving license ko likhit pariksha ko tayari

traffic ko niyam ra chinha ko kitab ki aadhikarik samagri padhnus. purano prashna ko abhyas garnus. chinha ko chitra herera artha bhanne abhyas garnus. pariksha ko din samaya mai pugnus ra kagaj sangai lagnus.
bike ko trial ma 8 banauna garo

khali chaur ma ita ki bottle rakhera 8 ko akar banayera abhyas garnus. gati ekdam kam ra santulan clutch le milaunus. aankha jaane thau tira rakhnus, tala haina. har din 20-30 minet abhyas le 1-2 hapta ma sudhar hunchha.
gadi chalauda raati aankha chamkinchha agadi ko batti le
agadi ko gadi ko batti ma sidhai nahernus, bato ko bayan chheu tira hernus. aafno gadi ko sisa sapha rakhnus. thakai ra nidra lageko bela raati nachalaunus. aankha ko jaanch pani garaunus.
kathmandu ma kotha khojda budget kam

shahar ko kendra bhanda ali tadha ko thau ma bhada kam hunchha, yatayat ko kharcha pani hisab garnus. sathi sanga kotha share garna sakinchha. kotha herda pani, bijuli ra suraksha jaanch garnus. advance diyepachhi rasid nalinu nagarnus.
hostel ma khana mitho chhaina, swasthya bigrinchha bhanne dar

hostel ko khana ma dal ra tarkari dherai linus. phal, chana ra dahi jasta poshilo khaja afai kinera rakhnus. pani pugdo piunus. khana ko gunastar ko barema hostel prashasan lai samuha ma namra sujhaw dinus.
bidesh ma padhda kaam ra padhai milauna garo

tyas desh ko kanun anusar padhne bidyarthi le kati ghanta kaam garna paune bhanne bujhnus ra palnus. hapta ko taalika ma padhai ko samaya pahila rakhnus. kaam ra padhai dubai ma thakai le swasthya nabigros. college ko sahayog sewa ma salah linus.
bidesh ma pahilo din k k garne?
pahila basne thau ra college ki kaam ko thau ko bato bujhnus. sim card ra bank khata ko kaam garnus. nepal ko dutawas ra aakasmik number phone ma rakhnus. parivar lai surakshit pugeko khabar dinus.
sathi ko kotha ma chori bhayo, ma mathi shanka garchhan

shanta rahanus ra sachcho kura spasta bhannus. tapai sanga bhayeko jankari, jastai kaha thiyo, kosanga, imandar sanga dinus. prahari ki prashasan le sodhe sahayog garnus. aagadi arko ko kotha ma eklai najaane niyam rakhnus.
mero bichar sabai le hasi udauchhan

naya bichar lai suru ma manchhe le bujhdainan, yo samanya ho. bichar lai sano prayog garera nattija dekhaunus. sakaratmak sujhaw dine manchhe sanga kura garnus. aalochana bata sikne kura linus, haso ma dhyan nadinus.
kunai pani kaam ma josh harauchha suru pachhi

suru ko josh sadhai rahadaina, tyasaile baani ma bharosa garnus. lakshya lai sano bhag ma todnus ra har sano bhag sakda chinha lagaunus. sathi sanga lakshya baadnus, jimmewari badhchha. thakai lagda aaram linus tara pura nachhodnus.
ma dherai alchhi chhu jasto lagchha

alchhi jasto lagnu ko karan thakai, nidra ko kami ki kaam garo dekhinu hunasakchha. sabai bhanda sajilo pahilo kadam chhannus ra 5 minet matra garnus. ramro nidra, khana ra chalan le josh badhauchha. afulai alchhi bhanne label bhanda "suru gardai chhu" bhannus.
gaun ko school ma kitab daan garna man chha

school sanga kun kaksha ko ra kun kitab chahinchha bhanera pahila sodhnus. purano kitab ramro awastha ma chha ki jaanch garnus. sathi ra chhimeki sanga milera sangai jamma garnus. kitab sangai copy ra kalam pani dina sakinchha.
raktadan garna chahanchhu, k dhyan dine?

raktadan garnu agadi ramro nidra ra halka khana khanus, khali pet najaanus. raktadan kendra le umer, taul ra swasthya ko jaanch garchha. pachhi pani ra jhol piunus ra din bhari bhari kaam nagarnus. birami ki aushadhi khadai hunuhunchha bhane pahila bataunus.
swayamsewa garna man chha, kaha bata suru garne?

tole ko sarsafai, school ma padhaune, ki aspatal ra budhabudhi ko sewa jasta sthaniya kaam bata suru garnus. sthaniya yuwa club ki sanstha sanga sampark garnus. hapta ma 2-3 ghanta matra pani thulo farak parchha. aafno sip, jastai computer ki sangeet, sikaunu pani swayamsewa ho.
hamro tole ma bachcha haru ko lagi khel maidan chhaina

chhimeki sanga milera khali sarkari jagga ki school ko maidan bidaa ko din prayog garna anurodh garnus. tole sudhar samiti banayera sthaniya palika ma nibedan dinus. sano thau ma pani badminton ki volleyball ko byabastha garna sakinchha.
naya chhimeki aaye, kasari swagat garne?

sano mithai ki phal lagera bhetna jaanus ra afno parichaya dinus. tole ko pani, phohor gadi ra bazaar ko jankari dinus. aakasmik bela ko lagi phone number saatnus. ramro chhimeki nai dukha sukha ko pahilo sathi ho.
chhimeki le gadi mero ghar agadi park garchhan

shanta bhayera chhimeki sanga kura garnus: "yaha gadi rakhda mero gadi nikalna garo hunchha." samadhan sangai khojnus, jastai park garne samaya ki thau milaune. ris ma chithi tasnu bhanda pratyaksha kura ramro. samadhan nabhaye tole samiti ko madat linus.
bachcha ko school ko meeting ma k sodhne?

bachcha ko padhai ma kun subject ma ramro ra kun ma kamjor bhanne sodhnus. kaksha ma byabahar ra sathi sanga ko sambandha ko barema bujhnus. ghar ma kasari sahayog garna sakinchha bhanne salah magnus. teacher ko phone ki samparka garne tarika linus.
mero chhori lai dance class ki music class?

chhori lai k ma badhi ruchi chha sodhnus ra dubai ko euta trial class ma lagnus. ruchi bhayeko kura ma bachcha lamo samaya tikchha. samaya ra kharcha herera euta chhannus. pachhi ruchi badlina pani sakchha, thik ho.
bachcha haru ko sutne samaya kati?
dherai jaso school jaane bachcha lai 9-11 ghanta nidra chahinchha bhanchhan. sutne ra uthne samaya niyamit rakhnus. sutnu bhanda 1 ghanta agadi screen banda garnus. kotha shanta ra andhyaro rakhnus.
buwa aama sanga basne ki chhuttai basne bihe pachhi?

dubai ko faida ra chunauti chha. sangai basda sahayog ra maya, chhuttai basda swatantrata. jiwan sathi ra parivar sanga khulla kura garnus ra kaam, kharcha ra jimmewari ko hisab herera nirnaya garnus. jaha base pani buwa aama ko herchah ra sammaan nachhodnus.
exam ma bichma pen ko masi sakiyo bhane?
exam ma sadhai 2-3 wata kalam ra pencil sangai lagnus. sakiyo bhane shanta bhayera invigilator lai haat uthayera bhannus. exam agadi nai kalam chalchha ki jaanch garnus.
padhda sadhai bhok lagchha
padhnu agadi halka poshilo khaja khanus, jastai phal ki bhuteko chana. table ma pani rakhnus, kahile kahi pyas lai bhok jasto lagchha. chips ra mithai kam garnus, nidra laagchha.
ghar ma TV ko awaj le padhna sakdina
ghar ka manchhe sanga padhai ko samaya tokera TV ko awaj ghataunu anurodh garnus. earplug ki bina shabda ko halka sangeet prayog garnus. sakesamma arko kotha ma padhnus.
exam pachhi uttar milayera tension linchhu
exam sakepachhi uttar milaunu le kehi badaldaina, tension matra badhchha. arko exam ko tayari ma dhyan dinus. sabai exam sakepachhi matra herna sakinchha.
hiundo ma bihana padhna uthna garo
raati nai nyano lugaa ra padhne saman tayar rakhnus. ochhyan bhitrai 5 minet padhera suru garnus, ani table ma janus. taato chiya ki pani le sharir jagauchha.
bachcha le sadhai "malai aaudaina" bhanchha
"aaudaina" ko satta "ajhai sikdai chhu" bhanna sikaunus. sajilo prashna bata suru garera safalta dinus. prayas ko prashamsa garnus, nattija ko matra haina.
dherai bolera ghaati baschha, teacher hu
class ma bistarai ra sajilo awaj ma bolnus, chichyaunu pardaina. bich bich ma manta pani piunus. bidyarthi lai pani bolne kaam dinus. lamo samaya rahe doctor dekhaunus.
jado ma haat chiso hunchha, lekhna garo
lekhnu agadi haat ragadera ki taato pani ko cup samatera nyano banaunus. aunla nikaleko panja (fingerless) lagaunus. kotha ko jhyal ko chiso hawa rokna sakinchha bhane rokinus.
bachcha lai bihana school jaana uthauna garo
raati sutne samaya 30 minet agadi sarnus ra phone TV banda garnus. bihana jhyal kholera ujyalo bhitra aauna dinus. raati nai jhola ra lugaa tayar rakhnus, bihana hatar kam hunchha.
din ma kati pani piunu?
dherai jaso thulo manchhe lai din ma 2-3 litre jati pani chahinchha, garmi ra kaam anusar badhi. pisab halka pahelo bhaye pugeko sanket. mirgaula ki mutu ko rog bhaye doctor le bhaneko matra piunus.
khana khanda pani piune ki napiune?
khana sangai thorai pani piunu dherai jaso lai thik hunchha. ek palta dherai pani piyera pet bharnu bhanda bich bich ma thorai. gastric bhaye khana pachhi kehi bera parkhera piunus.
bihana khali pet hidda chakkar
halka kehi khayera matra hidnus, jastai kera ki biscuit. pani sangai boknus. chakkar bar bar lagchha bhane doctor sanga sugar ra pressure jaanch garaunus.
buwa lai ghuda dukhera hidna mann hudaina

halka hidaai ra ghuda ko exercise doctor ko salah anusar garna protsahan dinus. sangai hidna jaanus, ramailo bhaye hidna man laagchha. taul ghataunda ghuda halka hunchha. dukhai dherai bhaye haddi rog ko doctor dekhaunus.
bachcha lai khana khuwauda TV chahinchha

khana ko samaya TV banda garne niyam bistarai lagu garnus. sangai basera gaff gardai khanus. bachcha lai khana pakaune ra thal milaune kaam ma sahabhagi garaunus. suru ma runa sakchha, dhairya rakhnus.
bihe ma dherai khana bigrinchha
pahuna ko sankhya pakka garera matra khana ko matra tay garnus. buffet ma sano thal ra "chahine jati matra linus" bhanne sujhaw rakhnus. bacheko ramro khana turuntai baadnus.
bihe ko lagi sapat line ki bachat garera?
sakesamma bachat garera sano ra sundar bihe garnus. sapat lida pachhi ko jiwan ma byaj ko bojh badhchha. budget pahila nai tokdinus ra pariwar sanga sahamati garnus.
gharma sano byabasaya garda pariwar ko samaya chhaina
kaam ko samaya ra pariwar ko samaya chhuttai tokdinus. hapta ma euta din pariwar ko lagi rakhnus. pariwar lai byabasaya ko sano kaam ma sahabhagi garaunus. thakai le sambandha bigrina nadinus.
gaun ma ghar banauda bhuichalo bata kasari surakshit?
bhuichalo pratirodhi naksa ra prabidhik ko salah anusar ghar banaunus. ramro jag, dandi ra pillar ma samjhauta nagarnus. sthaniya palika bata naksa pass garaunus. talim prapta mistri rakhnus.
ghar ma purano bijuli ko meter, bill dherai
meter ko unit aafai bela bela lekhera hernus. shanka lage bijuli karyalaya ma meter jaanch ko nibedan dinus. ghar ma chuhine bijuli, jastai purano taar, pani jaanch garaunus.
gaun ma raati bato ma batti chhaina
raati hidda torch sadhai sangai rakhnus. samuha ma hidnus ra chamkilo lugaa lagaunus. gaun ma milera solar batti ko lagi sthaniya palika ma nibedan dinus.
dherai sathi le ek palta phone garchhan, ris uthchha

phone ko notification ra ringtone kehi samaya silent garnus. jaruri manchhe ko lagi matra awaj rakhne setting prayog garnus. sathi lai pani "ma kaam ma chhu, pachhi phone garchhu" bhanne message pathaunus.
naya phone kinna purano bechne
purano phone ko data backup garnus ra sabai account bata log out garnus. factory reset garera matra bechnus. charger ra box sangai dida ramro mol paainchha. bharosa ko manchhe ki pasal ma bechnus.
ghar ko computer bachcha le kharab garchha

bachcha ko lagi chhuttai account banaunus ra parental control prayog garnus. mahatwapurna file ko backup rakhnus. computer chalaune niyam ra samaya tokdinus. bachcha lai computer ko sahi prayog sikaunus.
kaam ma dherai dhilo samma basnu parchha
kaam ko samaya ra bojh ko barema manager sanga imandar kura garnus. kaam ko priority milayera garnus. lagatar dhilo samma basda swasthya bigrinchha, aaram ra nidra jogaunus.
kaam ma sahakarmi le mero barema gali garchha
ris ma jawaf nadinus, tathya ra ghatana lekhera rakhnus. sambhav bhaye shanta bhayera eklai kura garnus. samasya badhe manager ki HR lai bhannus. afno kaam ramro sanga garirahanus.
kaam ma interview linu parne bhayo pahilo palta

pahila nai kaam ko jimmewari ra chahine sip ko list banaunus. sabai lai ekai kisim ka prashna sodhnus, tulana sajilo hunchha. umedwar lai bolne mauka dinus ra notes lekhnus. namra ra pesewar byabahar rakhnus.
english ma "I am fine" bahek k bhanne?
"I'm good, thanks!", "Not bad, how about you?", "Pretty busy today, but okay." jasta jawaf prayog garna sakinchha. jawaf pachhi arko lai pani sodhnu ramro byabahar ho.
english ma number lekhda galti hunchha, jastai forty
"forty" ma "u" hudaina, "four" ma hunchha. "nineteen", "ninety" ma "e" rahanchha. galti hune shabda ko list banayera 3-3 palta lekhnus. padhda dhyan dida chhito sikinchha.
sathi le mero bike ma petrol napari farkayo
shanta bhayera bhannus: "bike sapat diyeko ma petrol halidinu bhaye ramro." arko palta sapat dinu agadi niyam spasta garnus. sano kura ma jhagada nabadhaunus.
bachcha le chakleti ko lagi pasal ma rununchha
pasal jaanu agadi niyam bhannus: "aaja chakleti kinne din haina." runda ris nagari shanta rahanus ra niyam napaltaunus. kahile kahi chakleti kinne din tokdinus, bachcha lai pani thaha hunchha.
buhari ra chhora sanga basda gopaniyata chhaina
ghar ma sabai ko lagi niji samaya ra thau ko sammaan garne niyam banaunus. dhoka ghachghachyaera matra pasne baani rakhnus. shanta bela ma sabai sanga basera kura garnus.
tihar ma rangoli ko rang kasari banaune ghar mai?
chamal ko pitho, besar, rato mato ra pisaeko paat le prakritik rang banauna sakinchha. phool ko pankhuda ra diyo pani prayog garnus. prakritik rang le bhuin ra haat lai hani gardaina.
tihar ma ghar sapha garda bijuli ko batti kasari surakshit?
purano ra phuteko taar ko batti nalagaunus. ek socket ma dherai batti nathupnus. pani ra bhijeko thau bata tadha rakhnus. raati sutda ki ghar bahira jaanda batti banda garnus.
dashain ma ghar jaada bus ma dherai saman
saman ko sankhya ghataunus, jaruri saman matra lagnus. jhola ma naam ra phone number lekhnus. mulyawan saman haat ko jhola mai rakhnus. bus ko chhat ma rakheko saman ko sankhya gannus.
bhai tika ma didi lai k upahar dine?
didi ko ruchi anusar, jastai kitab, lugaa ki kaam lagne saman dinus. sano tara man bata diyeko upahar mahatwapurna. haat le lekheko chithi sangai dinus, didi lai dherai khusi lagchha.
kitab ma highlight garne ki nagarne?

dherai highlight garda sabai mahatwapurna jasto dekhinchha ra kaam lagdaina. euta anuchhed padhepachhi matra sabai bhanda mukhya euta shabda ki vakya matra chinha lagaunus. highlight bhanda kitab banda gari afai bhanne abhyas dherai kaam lagchha. margin ma sano prashna lekhne baani pani ramro.
exam ma kun prashna pahila garne?

pahila pura paper padhnus ani sabai bhanda pakka aaune prashna bata suru garnus. dherai ank ko ra afu ramro bhayeko prashna lai pahila samaya dinus. aadkiye ko prashna ma chinha lagayera pachhi farkinus. antim 10 minet jaach ko lagi rakhnus.
class ma prashna sodhda sabai hasdinchhan

prashna sodhnu himmat ko kaam ho, hasne le kahile kahi afai nabujheko hunchha. teacher lai class pachhi sodhna sakinchha. sodhne baani le tapai ko bujhai badhchha, haso kehi din ko ho. teacher lai yo kura bhanda class ko vatavaran sudharna sakchhan.
bhai lai math padhauda dhairya rahadaina

bhai sanga 20-30 minet matra padhaunus, lamo samaya dubai lai thakai lagchha. uslai bujhauna ghar ko udaharan, jastai paisa ra phal, prayog garnus. galti garda karaunus nai haina, "kaha bata farak paryo, herau" bhannus. sano sahi uttar ma prashamsa garnus.
padhai ko lagi afulai inam (reward) dine tarika?

sano lakshya sakepachhi sano inam rakhnus, jastai euta chapter sakepachhi 15 minet man parne kaam. thulo lakshya, jastai hapta bhari ko taalika pura, ma ali thulo inam. inam padhai pachhi matra, agadi haina. yasle baani banauna madat garchha.
flashcard kasari banaune?

sano kagaj ko ek tira prashna ki shabda ra arko tira uttar lekhnus. har din card haru herera uttar afai bhannus, ani palta pheri jaanch garnus. thaha bhayeko card chhuttai rakhnus, garo card bar bar dohoryaunus. phone ko flashcard app pani prayog garna sakinchha.
mind map kasari banaune?

kagaj ko bich ma mukhya bishaya lekhnus. tyas bata haanga jastai rekha tanera sano bishaya lekhnus, ani tiniharu bata detail. rang ra sano chitra prayog garda yaad garna sajilo hunchha. euta chapter ek pana ma aaunda revision chhito hunchha.
lamo answer yaad hudaina

lamo uttar lai 4-5 mukhya bunda ma todnus ra bunda ko pahilo akshar le sano shabda banaunus. har bunda ko 1-2 vakya afnai shabda ma lekhne abhyas garnus. ratnu bhanda bujhera lekhda exam ma afai aauchha. sutnu agadi ek palta bunda dohoryaunus.
nepali kavita ko bhavarth lekhna aaudaina

pahila kavita 2-3 palta thulo swar ma padhnus ra garo shabda ko artha khojnus. har shlok ki anuchhed ko mukhya kura afnai sajilo shabda ma lekhnus. kavi le k bhanna khojeko, kun bhawana chha bhanne antya ma lekhnus. kitab ko udaharan herera dhancha siknus.
science ko paribhasha yaad hudaina

paribhasha ka mukhya shabda chinha lagaunus ra tyo kina mahatwapurna bujhnus. afnai shabda ma bhanne ra pachhi kitab sanga milaune abhyas garnus. paribhasha lai udaharan sanga jodnus. har din 5 wata paribhasha matra dohoryaunus.
accountancy ma trial balance milena

pahila ledger ko sabai balance sahi tarika le sareko chha ki hernus. debit ra credit ko jod pheri garnus, sano hisab galti dherai jaso hunchha. kunai account chhutyo ki dohoro paryo jaanch garnus. galti bhetiyepachhi tyo kisim ko galti chhuttai copy ma lekhnus.
economics ko graph bujhdina

pahila graph ko dui aksha k ho padhnus, jastai mol ra matra. rekha mathi janda ki tala janda k hunchha sajilo udaharan le sochnus. kitab ko graph afai haat le 2-3 palta banaunus. graph ko kura shabda ma lekhda bujhai pakka hunchha.
english tense ekdam confuse hunchha

pahila 3 mukhya tense: present, past ra future, ani tyasko simple ra continuous. har tense ko 5 wata afno din ko vakya banaunus. "yesterday", "now", "tomorrow" jasta shabda le tense chinna madat garchha. din ma 10 minet abhyas pugchha.
lok sewa ko samanya gyan kasari padhne?

nepal ko bhugol, itihas, sambidhan ra samsamayik ghatana ma dhyan dinus. har din samachar padhnus ra mukhya kura copy ma tipnus. purano prashna ko abhyas garnus. aadhikarik ra bharosa yogya srot matra prayog garnus.
law padhne ki nadhne, kasto hunchha?

law ma padhne ra lekhne kaam dherai hunchha, tarka garne ra niyam bujhne ruchi chahinchha. padhai lamo hunchha ra suru ma kamai kam hunasakchha. law padhirakheka ki kaam gardai gareka sanga kura garnus. tapai ko ruchi ra dhairya anusar nirnaya garnus.
krishi bishaya padhne bhaye bhawishya kasto?

nepal krishi pradhan desh bhayekale krishi ma sarkari ra niji dubai kshetra ma kaam chha. aafno byabasaya, jastai bemausami tarkari ki pashupalan, suru garna pani sip kaam lagchha. practical anubhav ra naya prabidhi sikne ruchi chahinchha. padhisakeka senior sanga anubhav sodhnus.
aankha phadkinchha, kina hola?

dherai jaso tanab, kam nidra, dherai chiya coffee ki screen ko thakai le aankha phadkinchha. ramro nidra linus, screen bata bela bela aaram dinus ra chiya kam garnus. dherai din samma rahyo, anuhar ko arko bhag pani hallyo ki aankha banda hune bhayo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
lamo samaya ubhinda khutta ko nasa phulchha

bich bich ma hidnus ra baschha bela khutta ali uchai rakhnus. lamo samaya ekai thau ubhinu parne kaam bhaye khutta chalaune abhyas garnus. taul ghataunu ra niyamit hidnu le pani madat garchha. dukhai, sujan ki chhala ko rang badlinchha bhane doctor dekhaunus.
haat ramrari kasari dhune?

haat bhijayera sabun lagaunus ra kamti 20 second ragadnus: hatkela, haat ko pith, aunla ko bich, nang ra naadi. bagdo pani le pakhalnus ra sapha kapada le puchhnus. khana agadi, toilet pachhi ra bahira bata aayepachhi dhunus.
mask kahile lagaune?

rugha khoki lageko bela aru lai nasarne gari, bheed ra aspatal ma, ani dhulo dherai bhayeko thau ma mask lagaunu ramro. mask le naak ra mukh dubai chhopnus. kapada ko mask din din dhunus. phateko ki bhijeko mask fernus.
phalaam le chot lagyo, tetanus ko sui chahinchha?

ghau sabun pani le ramrari dhunus ra sapha patti lagaunus. maila ki khiya lageko phalaam le gahiro chot lagyo bhane tetanus ko khop chahina sakchha, khas gari pahila ko khop kahile lagayeko yaad chhaina bhane. turuntai najik ko health post ma sodhnus.
pressure ko aushadhi bihana khana birsiye

doctor le diyeko niyam ma bhar parchha, tyasaile afai dobar matra nakhanus. pharmacist ki doctor lai phone garera sodhnus. aagadi birsina nadina phone ma alarm ki aushadhi ko sano baksa prayog garnus. taauko dherai dukhyo ki chakkar lagyo bhane turuntai doctor dekhaunus.
garmi ma bachcha ko pisab kam bhayo

yo pani ko kami ko sanket hunasakchha. bachcha lai bela bela pani, jhol ra jeevan jal dinus. chhaya ma rakhnus ra halka lugaa lagaunus. bachcha dherai sust, oth sukha, aansu nanikalne ki 6-8 ghanta pisab nabhaye turuntai doctor kaha jaanus.
mahinawari niyamit chhaina

tanab, taul ma ekdam parivartan, kam nidra ra dherai exercise le kahile kahi mahinawari bigarna sakchha. santulit khana ra niyamit dinacharya rakhnus. 3 mahina bhanda badhi nabhaye, dherai ragat bagne ki dherai dukhne bhaye mahila doctor dekhaunus. sharam manu pardaina, yo samanya swasthya ko kura ho.
garbhawati bela bihana wakwak lagchha

ek palta ma dherai nakhai thorai thorai dherai palta khanus. bihana uthne bittikai sukha khaja, jastai biscuit, khanus. tel ra gandha aaune khana bata bachnus ra pani bela bela piunus. dherai bomit, kehi pani nakhana sakne ki kamjori bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
sugar ko jaanch kahile garaune?

pariwar ma sugar ko itihas, taul badhi, dherai pyas ra pisab jasta lakshan bhaye chhito jaanch garaunus. 40 barsha pachhi barsha ma ek palta jaanch garaunu ramro maninchha. doctor le bhaneko anusar khali pet ki khana pachhi jaanch garnus.
phone herda ghaati dukhchha

phone lai aankha ko uchai samma uthayera hernus, ghaati tala jhukaunu napros. har 20-30 minet ma ghaati bistarai ghumaunus ra kandh tannus. lamo samaya phone herna ghataunus. dukhai haat samma jharyo ki sunnine bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
din ma khana chhodchhu kaam le

khana chhodda thakai, ris ra pachhi dherai khane baani badhchha. jhola ma chhito khana milne khaja rakhnus, jastai phal, chana ki roti. khana ko samaya phone ma reminder rakhnus. bihana ko khaja kahile nachhodnus.
raati bhok lagera dherai khanchhu

din ma niyamit khana khanus, din bhari bhoko basda raati bhok badhchha. beluka ko khana ma dal ra tarkari badhaunus, pet lamo bhari rahanchha. raati bhok lagda halka kura, jastai phal ki dudh. ghar ma chips ra mithai narakhnus.
khana ma nun dherai khanchhu

pakaunda nun ghataudai jaanus ra thal ma mathi bata nun nahalnus. achar, papad, chauchau ra packet ko khana ma dherai nun hunchha, kam garnus. kagati, lasun, jeera jasta masala le swad badhaunus. pressure ko rog bhaye doctor ko salah palnus.
seto chamal ki khairo chamal ramro?

khairo chamal ma resha ra poshak tatva ali badhi hunchha, pet lamo samaya bhari rakhchha. tara seto chamal pani sahi matra ma dal tarkari sanga khanu thik ho. matra ra sangai k khanu hunchha bhanne kura badhi mahatwapurna. sugar ko rog bhaye doctor ki dietitian ko salah linus.
thulo manchhe le dudh piunu parchha?

dudh ra dahi bata protein ra calcium paainchha, tara jaruri matra anusar. dudh pachdaina bhane dahi, paneer ki aru calcium bhayeko khana, jastai saag ra til, khana sakinchha. chini haleko dudh bhanda sadharan dudh ramro.
hostel ma basda mahina ko budget kasari banaune?

pahila fix kharcha, jastai hostel fee ra yatayat, chhuttyaunus. khaja, kitab ra mobile ko lagi sima tokdinus. hapta ko kharcha lekhnus ra hapta ko ant ma hernus. aakasmik ko lagi alikati rakam chhuttai rakhnus.
bachcha lai pocket money dine ki nadine?

umer anusar sano pocket money dinu le paisa ko byabasthapan sikauchha. niyam spasta rakhnus: kati, kahile ra k ma kharcha garna milchha. kehi bachat garne baani sikaunus. bachcha le galti garda pani sikne mauka dinus.
mobile ko bill dherai aauchha

kun ma badhi kharcha hunchha hernus: call, data ki nachaine sewa. tapai ko prayog anusar ko pack linus. nachaine subscription ra caller tune jasta sewa banda garnus. ghar ma wifi bhaye data kam prayog garnus.
nachaine subscription le paisa katchha
phone ko app store ra bank statement ma "subscription" hernus. nachaine sewa turuntai cancel garnus. free trial lida antim miti calendar ma lekhnus. shanka lagne katti bhaye bank sanga sodhnus.
bima agent le dherai dabab dinchha

dabab ma nirnaya nagarnus, kagaj ghar lagera padhnus. k samettinchha, k samettindaina, premium ra samaya bujhnus. arko company ko sanga tulana garnus. tapai ko awashyakta anusar matra kinnus, "nai" bhanna paunu hunchha.
dhikuti ma basna bhanyo sathi le

dhikuti ma sadasya bich bharosa ra niyam mahatwapurna hunchha, kahile kahi paisa dubne samasya pani hunchha. sadasya chineko ra bharosa yogya chhan ki hernus. niyam lekhit hos ra hisab sabai le herna milos. gumaye pani sahana sakne rakam matra halnus.
online kapada bechna chahanchhu

ramro ujyalo ma sapha photo ra size ko spasta jankari rakhnus. return ko niyam spasta lekhnus. suru ma cash on delivery le grahak ko bharosa badhchha. grahak ko feedback sunera saman ra sewa sudharnus.
sano bakery kholne soch

pahila ghar mai bread, cake ra biscuit banayera chhimeki lai bechera bajar bujhnus. sarsafai ra khana ko gunastar sabai bhanda mahatwapurna. oven ra saman ko lagat hisab garnus. darta ra anumati sthaniya palika ma bujhnus.
machha palan suru garna chahanchhu

pani ko srot ra pokhari ko lagi jagga pahila hernus. krishi ki matsya karyalaya bata talim ra biu (bhura) ko jankari linus. pani ko gunastar ra dana ko byabasthapan mahatwapurna. sano pokhari bata suru garnus ra bajar ko maag bujhnus.
phool ra bot ko nursery kholne
tapai ko thau ma kun bot ra phool ko maag chha bujhnus. biu, gamla ra mato ko byabastha garnus. bot ko herchah ko gyan siknus. ghar ra office lai bechne ra social media ma photo rakhne garnus.
mainbatti banayera bechna sakinchha?

sakinchha, chad ra bihe ma maag hunchha. talim ki video bata surakshit tarika siknus, taato mom le jalna sakchha. sundar packing ra sugandhit mainbatti ma ramro mol paainchha. pahila sano matra ma banayera pasal ma rakhera hernus.
ghaam ma phone taato bhayo

phone lai ghaam bata chhaya ma rakhnus ra cover nikalera chiso hune dinus. fridge ma narakhnus, achanak chiso le bhitra pani jamna sakchha. taato bela charge nagarnus. gadi bhitra ghaam ma phone nachhodnus.
memory card le kaam gardaina

card nikalera pheri ramrari lagaunus ra phone restart garnus. computer ma card reader le kholera herna sakinchha. data dekhiyo bhane turuntai backup garnus. pheri pani nachale card format garnu parna sakchha, tyasle data metchha.
phone bata PDF kasari banaune?

dherai phone ma document ki photo "print" garda "save as PDF" ko bikalpa hunchha. scan garne app le kagaj ko photo khichera PDF banauna milchha. file ko naam spasta rakhnus. pathaunu agadi PDF kholera sabai pana sahi chha ki hernus.
kagaj phone le kasari scan garne?

kagaj lai samtal, ujyalo thau ma rakhnus. scan garne app ki phone ko camera ko document mode prayog garnus. kuna milayera crop garnus ra kalo seto mode ma rakhda padhna sajilo hunchha. PDF ma save garera pathaunus.
email ma thulo file pathauna mildaina
email ma file ko size ko sima hunchha. thulo file lai zip garnus ki cloud ma rakhera link pathaunus. photo bhaye size ghatayera pathaunus. pathaunu agadi link kholna milchha ki jaanch garnus.
phone chori hunabata kasari bachaune?
bheed ma phone haat ma ki pachhadi ko jeb ma narakhnus. screen lock ra "find my device" on garnus. phone ko IMEI number lekhera rakhnus. bus ra bazaar ma kaan ma earphone lagayera bebastha nahunus.
naya jagir ma "ma yo kaam garna sakdina" jasto lagchha

naya kaam ma yasto lagnu dherai jana ko anubhav ho. tapai lai chhaneko karan chha, tapai ko sip le nai. sikna samaya lagchha, sodhnu ra galti sudharnu samanya ho. aafno sano progress lekhnus, bharosa bistarai badhchha.
boss lai naramro khabar kasari dine?
chhito ra sidha bhannus, lukauna nakhojnus. k bhayo, kina bhayo ra aba k garna sakinchha bhanne samadhan sangai lyaunus. shanta ra pesewar rahanus. pachhi ko sudhar ko yojana pani bhannus.
jagir garne ki mathillo padhai?

tapai ko lakshya ra arthik awastha herera nirnaya garnus. kehi kshetra ma anubhav pachhi padhda badhi faida hunchha, kehi ma padhai pahila chahinchha. jagir sangai padhne bikalpa, jastai bihana ki online, pani hernus. tyo kshetra ka anubhavi sanga salah linus.
raati ko kaam ma mahila ko lagi suraksha

kaam ko thau bata surakshit yatayat ko byabastha bujhnus, company le dinchha ki sodhnus. sahakarmi sanga sangai yatra garnus ra parivar lai samaya bataunus. phone charge ra aakasmik number tayar rakhnus. asurakshit lagne kura HR ki prahari lai bhannus.
salary slip ma k k herne?

mul talab, bhatta, katti ra haat ma aaune rakam hernus. katti, jastai kar ra sanchaya kosh, sahi chha ki bujhnus. har mahina ko slip surakshit rakhnus, loan ra aru kaam ma chahinchha. galti dekhiye HR lai turuntai bhannus.
sanchaya kosh ra SSF ko paisa ko barema bujhna chahanchhu

tapai ko company le kun kosh ma kati katchha bhanne HR sanga sodhnus. aafno khata number ra online ma balance herne tarika bujhnus. niyam samaya sangai badalna sakchha, aadhikarik website ki karyalaya ma jaanch garnus. kagaj surakshit rakhnus.
british ra american english ko spelling farak
kehi shabda ko spelling farak hunchha, jastai "colour" ra "color", "centre" ra "center". dubai sahi ho, tara ek lekh ma ekai kisim prayog garnus. school ki exam le kun manchha bhanne bujhnus.
english ma silent letter le confuse garchha

"knife" ma k, "write" ma w, "hour" ma h jasta akshar bolidaina. yasta shabda ko euta list banaunus ra uchcharan sunera abhyas garnus. dictionary app ma shabda ko awaj sunna sakinchha. bistarai baani parchha.
english ma a, an, the kahile?

swar dhwani (a, e, i, o, u ko awaj) bata suru hune shabda agadi "an": "an apple", "an hour". aru ma "a": "a book". kunai khas ki pahila bhaneko kura ma "the": "the book on the table". padhda dhyan dida chhito sikinchha.
in, on, at kahile prayog garne?

samaya ma: "at 5 o'clock", "on Monday", "in March". thau ma: "at the bus stop", "on the table", "in the room". sajilo tarika: sano bindu ma "at", sataha mathi "on", bhitra "in". udaharan sangai abhyas garnus.
kasai ko prashamsa kasari garne, lajja lagchha

sidha ra sachcho bhannus: "tapai ko presentation ekdam spasta thiyo." kaam ki prayas ko prashamsa garnus, rup ko matra haina. chhoto bhaye pugchha. prashamsa garda arko lai ramro lagchha ra sambandha ramro hunchha.
bidesh ko online sathi le paisa magyo

online matra chineko manchhe lai paisa napathaunus, katha jati dukhad bhaye pani. yasto dherai jaso thagi hunchha. personal jankari ra photo pani nadinus. dabab ki dhamki diyo bhane kura banda garnus ra cyber bureau ma ujuri garnus.
naya bhai janmyo, chhori ris garchhe

naya bachcha aauda thulo bachcha lai maya ghatyo jasto lagna sakchha. uslai bhai ko herchah ma sano kaam dinus, jastai kapada lyaune, ra prashamsa garnus. din ma kehi samaya chhori sanga matra bitaunus. uslai "timi ajhai pani hamro maya ho" bhannus.
hajurba hajurama le bachcha lai dherai mithai dinu hunchha

unko maya ko kadar garnus ra shanta bhayera daat ra swasthya ko chinta bhannus. mithai ko satta phal ki ghar ko khaja dina sujhaw dinus. kahile kahi mithai dina sima tay garnus. jhagada nagari maya le kura garnus.
aama buwa le mero sambandha man paraunu hunna

shanta bhayera unko chinta k ho bujhnus. jiwan sathi lai bistarai parivar sanga chinaune ra samaya dinus. imandar ra sammaan sahit kura garnus, ris le kura bigrinchha. nirnaya jiwan bhari ko bhayekale dhairya rakhnus ra afu pani ramrari sochnus.
antarjatiya bihe garne, ghar ma dabab

yo garo awastha ho, tara sabai ko maya ra sammaan jogauna khojnus. pariwar sanga shanta bhayera kura garnus ra unko chinta sunnus. samay ra dhairya le dherai pariwar ko bichar badlinchha. kanuni adhikar ra suraksha ko kura pani bujhnus, ra bharosa ko aafantu ko sahayog linus.
bidaa ko din dherai sutchhu, pachhi pachhutaunchhu

bidaa ko din pani sadharan din bhanda 1 ghanta bhanda badhi dhilo nauthnus, natra sombar garo hunchha. bihana uthera ghaam ma basnus. aaram ko lagi diuso 20-30 minet ko chhoto nidra linus. bidaa ko din ko lagi euta ramailo yojana rakhnus.
ghar ko kaam ek ek gari garda thakai
ekai kisim ka kaam sangai garnus, jastai sabai lugaa ek din dhune ra sabai bazaar ek palta. sapha garna 20 minet ko timer rakhnus. parivar lai kaam baadnus. hapta ko taalika le kaam halka hunchha.
sukuti kasari banaune ghar mai?

chillo kam bhayeko masu lamo patlo tukra ma kaatnus. nun, besar, khursani ra adhuwa lasun ko paste lagaunus. ghaam ma ki aago ko mathi dhuwa ma ramrari sukaunus, bhitra bhijeko nahos. sukepachhi hawa nachhirne bhaado ma rakhnus.
chatamari kasari banaune?
