chamal ko pitho ma pani milayera patlo ghol banaunus. taato tawa ma tel lagayera ghol golo gari phailaunus. mathi masu ko kima, anda ki tarkari halera chhopnus ra sano aago ma pakaunus. taato taato achar sanga khanus.
momo bataune tarika sikau

patlo golo pitho ko bich ma masala rakhnus, dherai narakhnus. ek chheu bata sano sano patyaera (pleat) bichma jodnus ra ghumaudai band garnus. suru ma half-moon akar ma bataunu sajilo hunchha. 10-20 wata banaepachhi haat basihalchha.
aanp ko achar kasari?

kaancho aanp sano tukra ma kaatera nun ra besar halera 1-2 din ghaam ma sukaunus. tori ko tel taato gari methi, sauf ra khursani ko dhulo milaunus. chiso tel ra masala aanp ma milayera sapha sukha bottle ma rakhnus. kehi din ghaam ma rakhda swad ramro hunchha.
kathmandu bata lumbini jaane, kasari?

bus ki jahaj (bhairahawa samma) dubai bikalpa chhan. bus ma 8-10 ghanta jati lagna sakchha, bihana chhutne bus ramro. bhairahawa bata lumbini najik chha. garmi ma pani ra topi boknus ra lumbini ma ghumna 1 din chhuttyaunus.
tilicho taal jaane, k tayari?

tilicho dherai uchai ma chha, tyasaile lekh lagne khatara badhi hunchha. manang ma aaram ko din rakhnus ra bistarai chadhnus. nyano lugaa, ramro jutta ra pani boknus. mausam ra bato ko jankari manang ma bujhnus, eklai najaanus.
annapurna base camp trek ko tayari

1-2 mahina agadi bata hidne ra bharyang chadhne abhyas garnus. guide ki anubhavi sathi sanga jaanus ra permit ko jankari bujhnus. barsha ma pahiro ra hiundo ma hiu ko dhyan dinus. lekh lageko lakshan dekhiye tala jharnus.
langtang trek pahilo palta

syabrubesi bata suru hune bato ma bistarai uchai badhchha, tyasaile aaram ko din rakhnus. lodge ma basne ra khane kharcha pahila bujhnus. nyano lugaa, pani shuddha garne upaya ra sano first aid boknus. mausam kharab bhaye bato nachhodnus.
bandipur ghumna jaane, k herne?

bandipur ko purano bazaar, newari ghar ra danda bata himal ko drishya herna ramro hunchha. bihana ra beluka ko drishya sundar hunchha. najik ka hidne bato ma gufa ra mandir pani chhan, sthaniya manchhe sanga sodhnus. sapha ra shanta thau, phohor naphalnus.
gorkha durbar herna jaane

gorkha bazaar bata durbar samma ukalo bharyang chhan, bihana chhito chadhnus ra pani boknus. durbar ra mandir ma niyam ra chalan ko sammaan garnus. mathi bata himal ra gorkha ko drishya ramro dekhinchha. jutta ra photo ko niyam pahila sodhnus.
janaki mandir jaanda k dhyan dine?
mandir bhitra jutta bahira kholnus ra shanta rahanus. bheed hune bela saman ra phone ko dhyan dinus. photo khichne niyam sodhnus. garmi ma pani boknus ra halka lugaa lagaunus.
phewa ma dunga chadhda k dhyan dine?
life jacket lagaunus, pauri aaye pani. dunga ma ubhinu ra hallinu hudaina. dherai manchhe ek dunga ma nachadhnus. mausam bigrida, hawa chalda dunga chadhna nakhojnus.
gaun ma pahuna aaunda bhasa nabujhine, k garne?
muskan ra sanket le dherai kura bujhinchha! sajilo shabda ra bistarai bolnus. kehi sthaniya shabda, jastai namaste ra dhanyabad, sikaunus. phone ko anuwad app pani prayog garna sakinchha.
ghar ma dherai purano saman thupriyo, k garne?

1 barsha dekhi nachalayeko saman chhuttyaunus: dine, bechne ra phalne. ramro saman garib pariwar ki sanstha lai dinus. kabadi ma kagaj, plastic ra phalaam bechna sakinchha. naya saman kinda "ek aayo, ek gayo" niyam palnus.
ghar ma pani dherai kharcha hunchha
dhara khulai narakhnus, bhaada dhuda baltin prayog garnus. chuheko dhara turuntai marmat garnus. lugaa dhune pani bagaincha ma halna sakinchha. barsha ko pani jamma garda dherai pani bachchha.
hamro kotha ma ghaam aaudaina, chiso ra osilo
diuso jhyal kholera hawa chalaunus. bhijeko lugaa bhitra nasukaunus. kotha ma ujyalo rang ra sukha rakhne saman prayog garnus. chisopan dherai bhaye dhusi lagna sakchha, bela bela sapha garnus.
sano kotha ma pakaune, dhuwa ra gandha

pakaunda jhyal kholnus ra sakesamma exhaust fan lagaunus. pakaune thau sutne thau bata ali tadha rakhnus. gas ko chulo prayog garnus ra pakaepachhi turuntai sapha garnus. kotha ma bela bela hawa chalaunus.
bachcha haru TV dherai najik basera herchhan

TV bata kamti 2-3 m tadha basne niyam banaunus ra sofa ki gundri tyahi rakhnus. TV ko samaya sima tokdinus. aankha michkaune ki taauko dukhne bhanchhan bhane aankha jaanch garaunus. bahira khelne samaya badhaunus.
hamro gaun ma internet kam, padhai online kasari?

video download garera pachhi herna milne bikalpa prayog garnus. network ramro aaune thau ra samaya, jastai bihana sabere, khojnus. kitab ra notes sangai rakhnus, internet ma matra bharosa nagarnus. school ra teacher sanga offline samagri ko barema sodhnus.
hamro gaun ko bachcha haru lai computer sikaune

euta purano computer ki laptop bata pani suru garna sakinchha. typing, paint ra sano document lekhne jasta sajilo kura bata suru garnus. palo palo sikne taalika banaunus. sthaniya school ra sanstha sanga sahayog magnus.
kaksha 10 ma chhu, kun line padhne thaha chhaina

afno ruchi, ramro ank aaune subject ra bhawishya ko kaam sochnus. science, management, humanities ra technical bishaya ko barema senior ra teacher sanga sodhnus. sathi gayo bhanera nachhannus. ghar ma pani khulla kura garnus.
exam ko 1 mahina agadi k garne?

pahila sabai subject ko chapter ko list banaunus ra kamjor chapter lai badhi samaya dinus. har hapta purano question paper samaya rakhera solve garnus. nidra ra khana niyamit rakhnus. antim hapta naya kura bhanda revision ma dhyan dinus.
padhda sabai kura mahatwapurna jasto lagchha

syllabus ra purano prashna herda kun kura bar bar aauchha thaha hunchha. chapter ko suru ko saransh ra antya ko prashna le mukhya kura dekhauchha. teacher le jod diyeko kura chinha lagaunus. sabai kura baraabar padhnu bhanda priority banaunus.
bachcha lai padhda dhyan dina sakdaina, chalbalaauchha

15-20 minet ko chhoto padhai ra bich ma 5 minet chalne aaram dinus. padhai lai haat le garne kaam, jastai chitra ra khel, sanga jodnus. khana, nidra ra bahira khelne samaya pugeko chha ki hernus. lamo samaya dherai samasya bhaye bachcha ko doctor ki bisheshagya sanga salah linus.
padhne kotha kasari milaune?
table ra kursi jhyal najik rakhnus, prakritik ujyalo aaos. table ma chahine kitab ra kalam matra rakhnus. bhitta ma taalika ra lakshya tasnus. phone ra TV padhne kotha bahira rakhnus.
dherai din dekhi taauko ko ek tira dukhchha

kam nidra, tanab ra screen ko thakai le pani hunasakchha, tara lagatar dherai din rahe doctor dekhaunu jaruri. dukhai ko samaya ra karan lekhera doctor lai dekhaunus. achanak tibra dukhai, bolna ki hidna garo, ki aankha dhamilo bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
jado ma joint dukhchha
jodi lai nyano rakhnus ra taato sek dinus. halka exercise ra hidaai le jodi chalayemaan rakhchha. taul ghataunda jodi ko bhar kam hunchha. sujan, rato ki hidna garo bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
bhai lai pet ma juka (kira) chha jasto

bachcha ko pet dukhne, gudi ma chilaune ki taul nabadhne lakshan bhaye doctor ki health post ma dekhaunus, jukaa ko aushadhi doctor ko salah ma linus. khana agadi ra toilet pachhi haat dhune baani sikaunus. nang chhoto rakhnus ra pani umalera piunus.
chhala ma ghaam le kalo daag aayo
bahira jaanda topi, chhata ra sunscreen prayog garnus. dherai ghaam ma lamo samaya nabasnus. daag ko aakar, rang ki chilaune ma parivartan aaye chhala ko doctor dekhaunus.
tighra ma dabba (fungal) aayo garmi ma
thau sukha rakhnus ra kapas ko khukulo lugaa lagaunus. nuhaye pachhi ramrari puchhnus. afno towel chhuttai rakhnus. pharmacist ki doctor sanga sodhera sahi malam linus ra bhaneko jati din lagaunus.
hiundo ma bachcha ko oth ra gaala phutchha
bachcha ko anuhar ma naram cream ra oth ma lip balm ki vaseline lagaunus. chiso hawa ma bahira jaanda gaala chhopnus. bachcha lai pani piunus. ghau ki ragat aaye doctor dekhaunus.
kammar ko tala dukhchha, garbhawati

garbhawati bela kammar dukhnu samanya ho, tara doctor lai bhannus. sutda kolte pari ghuda bich takiya rakhnus. bhari naboknus ra halka hidaai garnus. dukhai sanga ragat, pani bagne ki tibra pet dukhai bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
bihe ma dherai khana khayera pet kharab
halka khana, jastai khichadi ra dahi, khanus ra tel piro chhodnus. jeevan jal ra pani piunus. aaram garnus. dherai bomit, disa ki jworo bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
din bhari kaam pachhi khutta dukhchha
beluka manta pani ma khutta dubaunus ra khutta mathi rakhera aaram garnus. ramro, naram talo ko jutta lagaunus. din bhari bich bich ma jiu tannus. dukhai lagatar ki sujan bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
bihana bihana chhyau aauchha
kotha ma dhulo ra dhusi kam garnus, bistara ko kapada niyamit dhunus. chiso hawa ma naak chhopnus. lakshan dherai, aankha chilaune ra saas pherna garo bhaye doctor sanga allergy ko barema sodhnus.
din ma kati chiya piunu thik?
dherai jaso lai 2-3 kappa thik hunchha, tara chini kam rakhnus. beluka ra raati chiya nidra bigarna sakchha. khali pet dherai chiya le gastric badhauna sakchha. pani ko satta chiya piunu ramro haina.
bachcha ko lagi dudh ki jusa?
bachcha ko lagi dudh ra pani nai ramro, packet ko jusa ma dherai chini hunchha. phal ko jusa bhanda pura phal khuwaunus. jusa dinu paryo bhane sano matra ma, khana sangai dinus.
kheti ko kaam garda chhito thakchhu
bihana sabere ra beluka chiso bela kaam garnus. pani ra halka khaja sangai rakhnus. har ghanta 5-10 minet aaram garnus. bhari bokda sahi tarika le uthaunus ra sabai kaam ek din ma nathupnus.
budhi aama lai ghar mai exercise garaune

kursi ma basera haat mathi uthaune, khutta sidha garne ra khutta ko pataka ghumaune jasta sajilo exercise garaunus. 10-15 minet bata suru garnus. laddine dar bhaye samatne thau najik rakhnus. dukhai ki chakkar bhaye roknus ra doctor sanga sodhnus.
bihana jog garda ghuda dukhchha

naram bato ma daudnus, kada ra dhalan ko bato ma kam. ramro jutta lagaunus ra daudnu agadi warm up garnus. dukhai bhaye ek-dui din aaram garnus ra hidaai ma badalnus. lagatar dukhai bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
2000 rupiya ma bajar ko budget banaunu chha
pahila jaruri saman ko list: chamal, dal, tel, tarkari. mausami ra sasto tarkari chhannus. thok ma kinda sasto parne kura sathi sanga milayera kinnus. list bahira ko kura nakinnus.
ghar ko loan ko kista tirna garo bhayo

bank sanga chhito sampark garnus, dhilo nagarnus. kista ko samaya lamo garne ki kehi samaya ko sahuliyat ko barema sodhnus. ghar ko aru kharcha ghataunus ra aamdani badhaune upaya khojnus. jarimana ra byaj badhna nadina samaya mai kura garnus.
sun ma lagani ramro ki jagga ma?

dubai ma mol badhne sambhavana chha tara jokhim pani. sun sajilai bechna milchha, jagga ma lamo samaya lagchha ra kagaj ko kura dherai. aafno lakshya ra kati samaya samma paisa chahidaina bhanne herera nirnaya garnus. sabai paisa ek thau ma nahalnus.
paisa jamma garna gullak ki bank?
sano bachat ko suruwat gullak le ramro baani basauchha. tara dherai paisa bhaye bank ma rakhnus, surakshit ra byaj pani aauchha. mahina ma ek palta gullak ko paisa bank ma jamma garne niyam banaunus.
sathi ko bihe ko lagi sapat line?
bihe ko upahar ki kharcha ko lagi sapat linu ramro haina. afno budget anusar upahar dinus, maya ko kadar hunchha. sapat ko byaj ra tanab pachhi dherai garo hunchha.
tole ma ramro pasal khulne thau kasari chhanne?

dherai manchhe aaune thau, jastai school, aspatal ki bus stop najik hernus. tyo thau ma kun saman ko pasal chhaina ki kam chha bujhnus. bhada ra aamdani ko anuman hisab garnus. kehi din tyo thau ma basera manchhe ko aawat jaawat hernus.
byabasaya ko naam kasto rakhne?

chhoto, bolna ra samjhana sajilo naam rakhnus. byabasaya le k garchha bhanne sanket diyos bhane jhan ramro. arko pasal ko naam sanga nadohoriyos. darta garnu agadi tyo naam pahila nai chha ki bujhnus.
grahak udharo tirna aaudaina, phone pani uthaudaina
namra message pathaunus ra sambhav bhaye pratyaksha bhetnus. kista ma tirna sujhaw dinus. aagadi udharo ko sima ra lekhit hisab rakhnus. thulo rakam bhaye sthaniya milapatra ko sahayog linus.
pasal ma CCTV rakhne ki?
pasal ko suraksha ra chori rokna CCTV kaam lagchha. camera ko password badalnus ra recording ko samaya bujhnus. grahak ko gopaniyata ko sammaan garnus. ramro ujyalo ra tala ko byabastha pani garnus.
computer ma "disk full" bhanchha
download folder ra recycle bin khali garnus. purano video ra photo external disk ki cloud ma sarnus. nachalaune program hataunus. disk cleanup jasta tool prayog garnus.
phone ma online class ko video record garna milchha?

teacher ki school ko anumati linus, sabai ko gopaniyata mahatwapurna. anumati bhaye phone ko screen record ko suvidha prayog garna sakinchha. storage pahila nai khali garnus. record gareko video aru lai napathaunus.
sabai jana ko ekai wifi, slow
video download ra update raati garnus. nachaine device disconnect garnus. router ko thau ghar ko bich ma rakhnus. dherai jana bhaye internet company sanga thulo plan ko barema sodhnus.
phone ma "low storage" le photo khichna mildaina

purano video ra nachaine app pahila hataunus, tiniharu le dherai thau linchhan. photo cloud ma backup garera phone bata hataunus. whatsapp ko media folder sapha garnus. thulo game hataunda dherai thau khali hunchha.
kaam ma pahilo din nai galti bhayo
pahilo din galti hunu samanya ho. sidhai manager lai bhannus ra sikeko kura lekhnus. sodhna lajja nagarnus. ek galti le tapai ko pura chhabi bigrindaina, sudharne prayas le bharosa badhchha.
interview ma "kina tapai lai rojne?" bhanchhan

tapai ko 2-3 mukhya sip ra tyo kaam sanga kasari milchha bhanne udaharan sahit bhannus. company ko lagi k garna sakchhu bhanne kura ma jod dinus. arko bhanda ramro bhanne bhanda "ma yo garna sakchhu" bhanne bharosa dekhaunus.
interview ma afno kamjori bhanda pheri pani dar

imandar ra sano kamjori bhannus jun kaam lai dherai asar gardaina, ani sudhar ko prayas bhannus. jastai "kahile kahi dherai detail ma jaanchhu, tyasaile aajkal samaya tokera kaam garchhu." sudhar ko kura nai mukhya ho.
kaam ma ramro gare pani prashamsa paudina

afno kaam ko record rakhnus ra meeting ma progress spasta bhannus. manager sanga niyamit feedback magnus. prashamsa nabhaye pani tapai ko sikai ra anubhav badhdai chha. lamo samaya kadar nabhaye career ko arko bato sochnus.
english bolda accent ko dar
accent hunu samanya ho, sabai ko hunchha. mukhya kura spasta ra bistarai bolnu ho. shabda ko sahi uchcharan siknus, accent pura hataunu pardaina. sunne le bujhe pugchha.
english ma "I am agree" bhanna milchha?
sahi "I agree" ho, "I am agree" haina. "agree" kriya ho, tyasaile "am" chahidaina. "I don't agree" ra "Do you agree?" pani yahi niyam.
english ma sorry ra excuse me ko farak

"excuse me" kasai ko dhyan tanna ki bato magna prayog hunchha: "Excuse me, where is the bank?" "sorry" galti bhayepachhi maafi magna: "Sorry, I'm late." kahile kahi dubai milchha, tara yahi sajilo niyam samjhanus.
sathi le "timi ta badal" bhanyo, chot lagyo

sathi le k kura ma bhanyo sodhnus, kahile kahi galatfahami hunchha. tapai le afno jiwan ma parivartan gareko bhaye tyo galat haina. sambandha jogauna man chha bhane sangai samaya bitaunus. bhawana imandar sanga bhannus.
dherai sathi tara kasai sanga gahiro mitrata chhaina

gahiro mitrata samaya ra bharosa le banchha. kunai 1-2 jana sanga niyamit bhetne ra man ko kura bhanne garnus. unko kura dhyan le sunnus ra garo bela madat garnus. dherai sathi bhanda kehi sachcha sathi ramro.
buwa aama sanga khulera kura garna sakdina

sano kura bata suru garnus, jastai din ko ramailo kura. sangai kaam garda, jastai pakaunda, kura sajilo hunchha. garo kura bhanna chithi lekhna pani sakinchha. unko pani tapai sanga kura garne ichchha hunchha.
chhora le ghar ko kaam ma madat gardaina
umer anusar sano kaam tokdinus ra niyamit garna lagaunus. kaam garda prashamsa garnus. sabai pariwar ko kaam ko chart banaunus. tapai pani sangai garnus, bachcha herera sikchha.
buwa ko swasthya ko chinta, tara jaanch garaun mannu hunna

shanta bhayera ra maya le kura garnus: "tapai swastha raheko hami sabai lai chahinchha." sangai jaane ra sajilo samaya milaune prastav garnus. parivar ko arko sadasya ki doctor sathi bata bhanna lagaunus. dabab bhanda dhairya ramro.
bihe ko pahilo barsha jhagada dherai

naya jiwan ma milna samaya lagchha, dubai ko baani farak hunchha. ris ko bela haina, shanta bela ma kura garnus. ek arka ko kura sunnus ra sano sahamati garnus. dherai garo bhaye counsellor ki bharosa ko thulo sanga salah linus.
din ko kaam ra raati ko padhai, nidra pugdaina

hapta ko taalika ma nidra ko samaya pahila rakhnus, kamti 6-7 ghanta. padhai ko samaya chhoto tara niyamit banaunus. bidaa ko din dherai padhnus. thakai le swasthya bigre padhai ko gati alikati ghataunu thik ho.
kaam ko list banaunchhu tara sakdina
list ma dherai kaam nathupnus, din ma 3-5 wata matra. har kaam ko samaya anuman garnus. sabai bhanda jaruri kaam pahila garnus. sakeko kaam ma chinha lagaunda josh badhchha.
tihar ko tayari kasari plan garne?
2 hapta agadi ghar safa garne, diyo ra malla ko saman kinne ra mithai ko yojana banaunus. bhai tika ko lagi sabai kura ek din agadi tayar rakhnus. kaam pariwar ma baadnus. budget pahila nai tokdinus.
ghar mai momo ko masala kasari banaune?

kima masu ma pyaj, lasun, adhuwa, hariyo pyaj ra dhaniya sano kaatera milaunus. nun, besar ra alikati jeera ko dhulo halnus. alikati tel ki pani milayera ramrari mujnus. 15-20 minet rakhepachhi momo banaunus.
masu ko jhol ma tel dherai bhayo
jhol chiso hune dinus, mathi tel jamchha ra chamcha le nikalna sajilo hunchha. taato mai ho bhane kagaj ko tukra le mathi ko tel sosna sakinchha. aagadi tel suru mai kam halnus.
bhat bhaado ko tala tasyo, jalyo

aago turuntai ghataunus ra jaleko gandha nalagos bhanera mathi ko bhat arko bhaado ma sarnus. tala ko jaleko bhaado ma pani halera bhijaunus, sapha garna sajilo hunchha. aagadi pani ali badhi ra sano aago ma pakaunus.
chiura tarkari kasari banaune?

tel ma pyaj, khursani ra kari patta bhutnus, ani aalu ki tarkari halera pakaunus. chiura dhoyera halka bhijaunus ra pani nikalnus. tarkari ma chiura, nun ra besar halera chalaunus. kagati ra hariyo dhaniya halera taato khanus.
lassi kasari banaune?
dahi, alikati chini ra chiso pani milayera ramrari phenus. alaichi ko dhulo halda basna ramro hunchha. mitho nachahine bhaye nun ra jeera halera namkin lassi banauna sakinchha. chiso chiso piunus.
dherai chhimeki le pakaeko mitho khana dinchhan, k pharkaune?
bhaado sapha garera farkaunus ra sakesamma afno haat ko kehi mitho khana rakhera dinus. dhanyabad bhannus. chhimeki sanga yasto saatsaat le sambandha mitho banauchha.
pahilo palta bidesh ko flight ma transit chha

transit ko samaya ra airport ko gate ko jankari ticket ma hernus. saman sidhai antim thau samma jaanchha ki pheri linu parchha airline ma sodhnus. pasport ra boarding pass sadhai haat ma rakhnus. bujhena bhane airport ko help desk ma sodhnus.
airport ma immigration ma dar lagchha
pasport, visa, ticket ra chahine kagaj ek folder ma milayera rakhnus. sodheko prashna ko sidha ra sachcho uttar dinus. shanta rahanus ra namra bolnus. bujhena bhane pheri sodhna paunu hunchha.
trekking ma pahilo din nai thakai
pahilo din bistarai hidnus ra lamo bato najaanus. pani ra khaja niyamit linus. jhola ko taul ghataunus. sharir lai 2-3 din ma baani parchha, tara dherai thakai ra lekh ko lakshan bhaye aaram garnus.
gaun ma bihe ma bheed ma bachcha haraune dar

bachcha lai chamkilo rang ko lugaa lagaunus ra phone number bhayeko card khalti ma rakhnus. haraye kaha bhetne bhanne thau tokdinus. bachcha lai ajnabi sanga najaana sikaunus. thulo manchhe palo palo herchah garnus.
chad ma ghar khali chhodera gaun jaane
jhyal dhoka ramro sanga banda garnus ra chhimeki lai bhannus. bijuli ko saman ra gas banda garnus. mulyawan saman surakshit thau ma rakhnus. social media ma ghar khali chha bhanne kura narakhnus.
chad pachhi ghar ma dherai phohor

sabai jana lai euta kotha ko jimmewari dinus ra ekai din sapha garnus. kuhine ra nakuhine phohor chhuttyaunus. bacheko khana chhito milaunus. sangai geet bajayera garda kaam chhito ra ramailo hunchha.
chad ma kharcha bhayo, aba mahina kasari chalaune?
baki mahina ko jaruri kharcha ko list banaunus ra najaruri kinmel rokdinus. ghar ma bhayeko saman bata khana pakaunus. aagadi ko chad ko lagi mahina ko sano rakam chhuttyaune yojana banaunus.
dashain pachhi pheri kaam ma farkina man lagdaina

lamo chhutti pachhi yasto lagnu samanya ho. pahilo din sajilo kaam bata suru garnus ra sahakarmi sanga chad ko gaff garnus. chhutti ko ramro yaad le pani urja dinchha. 2-3 din ma routine pheri basdai janchha.
tihar ma patakha ko awaj le budhi aama darauchhin

unlai shanta kotha ma basaunus ra jhyal dhoka banda garnus. patakha padkaune lai ghar najik nagarna namra anurodh garnus. unko sath ma basnus ra halka bhajan ki sangeet bajaunus. mutu ko rog bhaye unko aushadhi najik rakhnus.
bhai tika ma bhai bidesh ma, k garne?

video call ma tika ko samaya milayera sangai karyakram garna sakinchha. bhai ko lagi mala ra tika ko photo pathaunus. sambhav bhaye upahar pahila nai pathaunus. arko barsha sangai manaune yojana banaunus.
chhath ma ghat ma bheed, bachcha lai kasari surakshit?

bachcha lai sadhai haat samatera rakhnus ra pani ko chheu najaana dinus. chamkilo lugaa ra phone number bhayeko card khalti ma rakhnus. bheed kam hune thau chhannus. bachcha harayo bhane bhetne thau pahila nai tokdinus.
padhai ko lagi bihana ki beluka, kun samaya ramro?

dherai jaso lai bihana dimag taja hunchha, garo subject bihana padhnus. beluka halka revision ra homework garnus. tara sabai bhanda mahatwapurna kura niyamit samaya ho, ekai samaya ma padhda dimag lai baani parchha.
mero chhora lai sathi haru le "padhaku" bhanera jiskauchhan
padhai ma ramro hunu garva ko kura ho bhanne chhora lai bataunus. khel ki club ma pani judna protsahan dinus, sathi banauna sajilo hunchha. jiskaune hepai ma badliyo bhane teacher sanga kura garnus.
din bhari phone le haat ra aunla dukhchha
phone kam samaya chalaunus ra bich bich ma haat ra aunla tannus. phone dubai haat le samatnus ra lamo message ko satta voice note prayog garnus. dukhai lagatar ki sunnine bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
bihana bihana khali pet chiya khanchhu, gastric
chiya agadi pani ra halka khaja, jastai biscuit ki chiura, khanus. chiya ko matra ghataunus ra dudh chiya bhanda halka chiya linus. gastric badhdai gaye ki dukhai dherai bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
ghar ko kharcha ma sriman sriamti dubai ko kati bhag?

aamdani anusar milayera tay garnus, jastai jasko badhi aamdani usko badhi bhag. sajha khata ma mahina ko nishchit rakam halnus ra baki afno afno. sabai kharcha khulla rakhnus ra mahina ma ek palta sangai hisab hernus.
sano byabasaya ko lagi sarkari anudan kaha bujhne?

sthaniya palika, krishi ki udyog sambandhi karyalaya ma bujhnus. aadhikarik suchana ra website herna sakinchha. dalal ko lobh ma paisa nadinus, aadhikarik prakriya ma paisa magdaina bhanne kura ma dhyan dinus.
phone ma bank ko app kholda "update" bhanchha
official app store bata matra update garnus, message ko link bata haina. update pachhi pani login ra password gopya rakhnus. app chalena bhane bank ko helpline ma sodhnus.
kaam ma pahilo talab dhilo aayo
HR ki manager lai namra bhayera kahile aauchha sodhnus. pahilo talab kahile kahi kagaj ko prakriya le dhilo hunchha. tab samma kharcha milayera chalaunus. lagatar dhilo bhaye lekhit rup ma sodhnus.
english ma "please" ra "thank you" kati prayog garne?
kasai sanga kehi magda "please" ra sahayog paye "thank you" bhanne baani ramro byabahar ho. email ra message ma pani prayog garnus. dherai bhanda pani sachcho bhawana le bhannu mukhya.
sathi le aafno gopya kura bhanyo, ma k garu?

sathi le bharosa garera bhaneko kura gopya rakhnus. usko kura dhyan le sunnus ra judge nagarnus. kura gambhir, jastai afulai hani garne ki khatara ko bhaye bharosa ko thulo manchhe sanga sahayog khojna protsahan dinus.
bihe ko anniversary birsiye, shrimati risaunu bhayo
sidhai sorry bhannus ra bahana nalagaunus. aaja nai sano tara man bata gareko kura garnus, jastai mitho khana ki chithi. arko barsha ko lagi phone ma reminder rakhnus.
gaun bata shahar ma basda pani ko pipe ko pani pina hunchha?
shahar ko dhara ko pani pani sadhai surakshit hunchha bhanne chhaina. umalera, filter garera ki chlorine prayog garera matra piunus. tanki niyamit sapha garnus.
subha prabhat nik!
subha prabhat! bihana ko suruwat kasto bhayo, chiya khanu bhayo?
good morning, just woke up
Good morning! Waking up slowly is the best part sometimes. Did you sleep well?
k xa nik, khana khayau?
thik chha! ma ta khana khanna, tara tapai le khanu bhayo? aaja k pakeko thiyo?
diuso ko namaste
namaste! diuso ko khana khaisaknu bhayo? kaam kasto chaldai chha?
subha ratri, aba sutchhu
subha ratri! ramro sanga sutnus, bholi pheri kura garaula.
aaja ekdam thakeko chhu yaar
aaja dherai kaam pareko jasto chha. k le yati thakayo? alikati aaram garnus, ek gilas pani piunus.
bore bhayo, kei garna chhaina
bore lagda samaya ekdam dhilo jaanchha hai! euta sano kaam try garnus: kotha milaune, euta geet sunne, ki bahira 10 minet hidne. ki ma sanga quiz khelne?
bholi interview chha, nervous chhu
nervous hunu ta yo interview tapai lai mahatwapurna chha bhanne sanket ho. aaja afno barema 2-3 wata kura bolera practice garnus ani samaya mai sutnus. kun kaam ko interview ho?
malai aaja ekdam eklo mahsus bhairachha

eklo mahsus garnu dherai garo hunchha, ma sanga bhannu bhayo, ramro garnu bhayo. aaja kunai sathi ki parivar ko manchhe lai euta sano message pathaunus na. ani ma pani yahi chhu, k bhayo bhanna man chha?
aaja ma ekdam khusi chhu!!
wah, khusi ko kura sunna man lagyo! k bhayo aaja?
euta joke bhana na
la sunnus: teacher le sodhnu bhayo, "gita, 'ma sundar chhu' bhaneko kun kaal ho?" gita le bhanin, "bhut kaal, miss!" haha.
aaja weekend, k garne hola?
weekend ko plan banauna maja aauchha! ghar mai aaram garne man chha ki kahi bahira ghumna? tapai lai k garda sabai bhanda ramailo lagchha?
dashain aauna lagyo, ekdam excited
dashain ko maja nai arkai hunchha! tika, jamara, ping ra changa. yo palta gaun jaanu hunchha ki ghar mai manaune?
tihar ma deusi khelna janchhau?
ma ta jana sakdina, tara deusi bhailo ko ramailo sunda nai maja lagchha! tapai ko team ma kati jana hunuhunchha?
holi ma rang khelna man chha tara chhala bigrinchha ki bhanne dar
khelnu agadi anuhar ra haat ma alikati tel ki cream lagaunus, rang sajilai chhutchha. sakesamma prakritik rang prayog garnus ani aankha bachaunus. kosanga khelne plan chha?
teej aayo, didi haru le dar khana bolaunu bhayo
wah, dar khane ramailo! naach gaan, mitho khana ra didi bahini ko bhetghat. tapai pani naachnu hunchha ki?
chhath ma ghat ma janchhau? hamro janakpur ma dherai ramailo hunchha
janakpur ko chhath ta ekdam sundar hunchha re, ghat bhari diyo ra geet. tapai ko ghar ma ko le barta basnu hunchha?
lhosar ko subhakamana!
tapai lai pani lhosar ko dherai dherai subhakamana! naya barsha ma sukha, swasthya ra khusi milos. kasari manaudai hunuhunchha?
maghe sankranti ma til ko laddu ra tarul khaye
maghe sankranti ko khana ta mitho ra shakti dine! ghiu chaku pani khanu bhayo? jado ma sharir nyano rakhchha bhanchhan.
buddha jayanti ma lumbini jaane plan chha
ramro plan! lumbini ma maya devi mandir ra dherai desh ka gumba herna paainchha. bihanai jaanus, ghaam charkinu agadi ghumna sajilo hunchha. kosanga jaane?
mero kukur ko naam bhote ho, ekdam batho chha
bhote ramro naam! batho kukur sanga khelna jhan maja aauchha. usle k k trick jaanchha?
biralo palna sajilo ki kukur?

biralo ali swatantra hunchha, afai sapha rahanchha ra sano ghar ma pani milchha. kukur lai dherai samaya, hidaai ra maya chahinchha, tara badlama dherai saath dinchha. tapai sanga din ma kati samaya hunchha?
aaja pani pareko chha, ghar bata niskina man lagena

jhola padhne chij haina.

messages.content: ramila ko ghar sabina ko ghar bhanda bajar najik chha. puja ko ghar ramila ko bhanda pani najik. kasko ghar bajar bata sabai bhanda tadha?
sabina ko ghar bajar bata sabai bhanda tadha chha.

aayush le sabai bhanda kam momo khayo.
messages.think: sagar > aayush. niraj > aayush. sagar > niraj. kram: sagar, niraj, aayush.

messages.content: bato ma 4 wata gaun chhan, paschim dekhi purba. ka gaun kha bhanda paschim ma. ga gaun kha bhanda purba ma. gha gaun ga bhanda purba ma. bich ka dui gaun kun?

what is a noun?
A noun is a word that names a person, place, thing or idea. For example: "teacher", "Pokhara", "book" and "happiness" are all nouns.
Can you explain what a verb is?
A verb is a word that shows an action or a state. "Run", "eat" and "write" are action verbs, and "is", "seem" and "become" show a state.
what's an adjective
An adjective is a word that describes a noun. In "a tall tree" and "a kind teacher", the words "tall" and "kind" are adjectives.
What does an adverb do in a sentence?
An adverb describes a verb, an adjective or another adverb. It often tells how, when or where, like "slowly" in "she walks slowly" or "very" in "very hot".
what is a pronoun, give examples
A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun, so we do not repeat the noun again and again. Examples: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.
what are prepositions?
Prepositions are small words that show the relation between things, often place or time. Examples: in, on, under, at, between, before, after.
what is a conjunction in english grammar
A conjunction is a word that joins words or sentences. "And", "but", "or", "because" and "so" are common conjunctions, as in "I was tired, so I slept."
What is an interjection?
An interjection is a word that shows a sudden feeling, like "Wow!", "Oh!", "Ouch!" or "Hurray!". It is often followed by an exclamation mark.
when do we use "an" and not "a"?
Use "an" before a word that starts with a vowel sound: an apple, an egg, an hour. Use "a" before a consonant sound: a book, a university (it starts with a "yoo" sound).
what are the articles in english
English has three articles: "a", "an" and "the". "A" and "an" are used for any one thing, and "the" is used for a specific thing both people know about.
past tense of go?
The past tense of "go" is "went", and the past participle is "gone". Example: "I went home." / "She has gone to school."
what is the past form of eat
The past tense of "eat" is "ate" and the past participle is "eaten". Example: "We ate dal bhat." / "Have you eaten?"
write ko past tense english ma k hunchha?
"write" ko past tense "wrote" ho ra past participle "written" ho. jastai: "I wrote a letter." / "She has written a poem."
past tense of buy
The past tense of "buy" is "bought". The past participle is also "bought": "I bought rice yesterday." / "He has bought a bike."
what's the past tense of teach?
The past tense of "teach" is "taught", and the past participle is also "taught". Example: "My father taught me to swim."
swim past tense and past participle?
"Swim" becomes "swam" in the past tense and "swum" as the past participle: "I swam in the river." / "I have never swum in the sea."
Is "bringed" correct?
No, "bringed" is not correct. The past tense of "bring" is "brought": "She brought sweets for everyone."
past tense of think please
The past tense of "think" is "thought". Example: "I thought it would rain today."
plural of child?
The plural of "child" is "children". It is an irregular plural, so we do not just add "s".
What is the plural of mouse?
The plural of "mouse" (the animal) is "mice". For a computer mouse, both "mice" and "mouses" are used, but "mice" is more common.
plural of tooth
The plural of "tooth" is "teeth". The same pattern is seen in "foot" and "feet".
what is the plural of sheep
The plural of "sheep" is also "sheep". We say "one sheep" and "ten sheep", just like "one deer" and "two deer".
how to make plural of knife
The plural of "knife" is "knives". Many words ending in "f" or "fe" change to "ves", like "leaf" to "leaves" and "wife" to "wives".
Plural of box?
The plural of "box" is "boxes". Words ending in x, s, sh, ch or z usually add "es": boxes, buses, dishes, watches.
what's the plural of baby
The plural of "baby" is "babies". When a word ends in a consonant + "y", change the "y" to "i" and add "es".
plural of person is persons or people?
The usual plural of "person" is "people": "five people came." "Persons" is used only in very formal or legal writing.
Can you explain its vs it's?
"It's" is short for "it is" or "it has": "It's raining." "Its" shows ownership: "The dog wagged its tail." There is no apostrophe in the ownership form.
your or you're, which is right in "___ welcome"?
The right word is "you're", because it means "you are": "You're welcome." "Your" shows ownership, like "your bag".
difference between there, their and they're
"There" is a place ("put it there"), "their" shows ownership ("their house"), and "they're" means "they are" ("they're late").
then or than?
"Than" is used to compare: "Ram is taller than Hari." "Then" is about time or order: "We ate, then we slept."
lose vs loose
"Lose" is a verb meaning to not have something anymore or to not win: "Don't lose your keys." "Loose" is an adjective meaning not tight: "These pants are loose."
whats the difference between affect and effect
Usually "affect" is a verb and "effect" is a noun. "The rain affected the match." "The rain had a big effect on the match."
fewer or less?
Use "fewer" with things you can count and "less" with things you cannot count. "Fewer people" but "less water".
good better best, what are these called?
These are the degrees of comparison: "good" is the positive, "better" is the comparative and "best" is the superlative.
comparative and superlative of bad
The comparative of "bad" is "worse" and the superlative is "worst". Example: "Today is worse than yesterday, but Monday was the worst."
big ko comparative k hunchha?
"big" ko comparative "bigger" ra superlative "biggest" ho. chhoto word ma ek vowel ra ek consonant le sakiyeko bhaye last consonant double hunchha.
is it "beautifuller" or "more beautiful"?
It is "more beautiful". Long adjectives use "more" and "most": more beautiful, most beautiful.
opposite of ancient?
The opposite of "ancient" is "modern". "Ancient" means very old, and "modern" means new or of the present time.
Give me some synonyms of happy
Some synonyms of "happy" are glad, joyful, cheerful, pleased and delighted.
antonym of brave
The antonym of "brave" is "cowardly". You can also say "afraid" or "fearful" in simple speech.
change to passive voice: Ram wrote a letter.
Passive voice: "A letter was written by Ram."
make this passive - The cat ate the fish.
Passive voice: "The fish was eaten by the cat."
Change into indirect speech: She said, "I am tired."
Indirect speech: She said that she was tired.
correct this: He go to school every day.
Correct sentence: "He goes to school every day." With he, she or it in the simple present, the verb takes "s" or "es".
is "she don't like milk" correct?
No. The correct form is "She doesn't like milk." With he, she and it we use "doesn't", not "don't".
I have went there before - is that right?
Not quite. It should be "I have gone there before" or "I have been there before". After "have", use the past participle "gone", not "went".
Should I say "me and my friend went" or "my friend and I went"?
In good English, say "My friend and I went." Use "I" when it is part of the subject, and it is polite to put the other person first.
What makes a complete sentence?
A complete sentence has a subject and a verb and expresses a complete thought. "Sita sings." is complete, but "Because Sita" is not.
what is subject and predicate?
The subject is who or what the sentence is about, and the predicate tells something about the subject. In "The boy kicked the ball", "the boy" is the subject and "kicked the ball" is the predicate.
when do we use simple present tense?
We use the simple present for habits, routines and general truths. Examples: "I drink tea every morning." "The sun rises in the east."
give an example of present continuous tense
Example: "I am reading a book right now." The present continuous uses am/is/are + verb-ing for actions happening now.
what is present perfect tense?
The present perfect uses has/have + past participle, like "I have finished my homework." It links a past action to now.
what is a question tag
A question tag is a short question added at the end of a sentence to check something: "You are a student, aren't you?" "She can swim, can't she?"
since or for? "I have lived here ___ 5 years"
Use "for": "I have lived here for 5 years." Use "for" with a length of time and "since" with a starting point, like "since 2020".
much and many difference
"Many" is used with countable nouns: many books, many friends. "Much" is used with uncountable nouns: much water, much time.
say or tell?
"Tell" usually needs a person after it: "Tell me the truth." "Say" does not: "Say hello." So we say "she told me" but "she said that".
Borrow and lend, I always mix them up
"Borrow" means to take something for a while: "Can I borrow your pen?" "Lend" means to give something for a while: "Can you lend me your pen?"
when should I use capital letters?
Use capital letters at the start of a sentence, for names of people and places, for days and months, and for the word "I". Example: "On Monday, Sita and I went to Kathmandu."
How many letters are in the English alphabet?
The English alphabet has 26 letters, from A to Z.
what are vowels in english
The vowels in English are a, e, i, o and u. All the other letters are consonants, though "y" sometimes works like a vowel, as in "sky".
what's a syllable
A syllable is a single sound part of a word. "Cat" has 1 syllable, "ta-ble" has 2 and "ba-na-na" has 3.
what is a synonym and antonym
A synonym is a word with the same or similar meaning (big and large). An antonym is a word with the opposite meaning (big and small).
Homophones meaning?
Homophones are words that sound the same but have different meanings or spellings, like "sea" and "see", or "write" and "right".
Difference between common noun and proper noun
A common noun is a general name, like "city" or "river". A proper noun is a special name, like "Pokhara" or "Koshi", and it starts with a capital letter.
what is a collective noun? examples please
A collective noun names a group as one unit. Examples: a herd of cows, a flock of birds, a team of players, a bunch of flowers.
what is an uncountable noun
An uncountable noun is something we cannot count one by one, like water, rice, sugar or advice. We say "some water", not "two waters".
abstract noun meaning and example
An abstract noun names something we cannot see or touch, like a feeling or quality. Examples: love, honesty, fear, freedom.
what are prefixes and suffixes?
A prefix is added at the start of a word ("un" in "unhappy"), and a suffix is added at the end ("ness" in "kindness"). Both change the meaning or the word type.
what does "don't" stand for
"Don't" is short for "do not". Words like this are called contractions, for example "can't" (cannot) and "I'm" (I am).
is it recieve or receive?
The correct spelling is "receive". A helpful rule: "i before e, except after c", so "receive", "ceiling" and "receipt".
how do you spell the word for a place to stay, accomodation?
It is spelled "accommodation", with double "c" and double "m".
each of the students has or have?
Say "each of the students has". "Each" is singular, so it takes a singular verb.
What does "patience" mean?
"Patience" means the ability to wait calmly or to deal with problems without getting angry or upset.
yo word ko meaning k ho: gratitude?
"gratitude" bhaneko kritagyata ho, arthat kasaile gareko maddat ko lagi dhanyabad ko bhawana. jastai: "I feel gratitude for my teacher."
meaning of honest
"Honest" means always telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. An honest person can be trusted.
curious ko meaning nepali ma bhana
"curious" bhaneko jigyasu, arthat naya kura jaanna ra sikna man parne. jastai: "Children are curious about everything."
What is the meaning of generous?
"Generous" means happy to give your time, money or help to others. For example, a generous friend shares food without being asked.
define humble
"Humble" means not proud. A humble person does not show off and treats everyone with respect.
"ambitious" ko matlab k ho?
"ambitious" bhaneko mahatwakankshi, arthat thulo lakshya rakhera tyo pura garna mehenat garne. jastai: "She is ambitious and wants to become a doctor."
what does confident mean
"Confident" means feeling sure about yourself and your abilities. A confident speaker talks clearly without too much fear.
meaning of responsible?
"Responsible" means doing your duties well and accepting the results of what you do. A responsible student finishes homework on time.
what's the meaning of punctual
"Punctual" means arriving or doing things on time. If class starts at 10, a punctual student is there by 10.
diligent bhaneko k ho?
"diligent" bhaneko lagansil, arthat dhyan diyera ra mehenat sanga kaam garne. jastai: "He is a diligent worker."
What does resilient mean?
"Resilient" means able to recover quickly after something difficult. A resilient person keeps going even after failing.
what is empathy?
Empathy is the ability to understand and share how another person feels. It means imagining yourself in their place.
opportunity meaning in nepali
"opportunity" ko nepali "awasar" ho, arthat kehi ramro garna payeko mauka. jastai: "This job is a good opportunity."
what does procrastinate mean?
"Procrastinate" means to delay doing something you should do, often by doing easier or more fun things first.
deadline ko arth k ho?
"deadline" bhaneko kunai kaam sakisakne antim samaya ho. jastai: "The deadline is Friday" bhaneko sukrabar samma kaam sakinu parchha.
what does volunteer mean
A volunteer is a person who does work without being paid, usually to help others. As a verb, "to volunteer" means to offer to do something.
what is the meaning of habit?
A habit is something you do regularly, often without thinking, like brushing your teeth every morning.
capital of japan?
The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
What is the capital city of France?
The capital of France is Paris. It is famous for the Eiffel Tower.
which city is the capital of australia
The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney. Sydney is the biggest city, but Canberra was chosen as the capital.
capital of canada?
The capital of Canada is Ottawa. Toronto is the largest city, but it is not the capital.
What's the capital of Bangladesh?
The capital of Bangladesh is Dhaka.
bhutan's capital city
The capital of Bhutan is Thimphu.
How many continents are there in the world?
There are 7 continents: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia.
How many oceans are there?
There are 5 oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic Oceans. The Pacific is the largest.
how many days in a leap year
A leap year has 366 days. The extra day is February 29.
How many seconds are in one hour?
There are 3600 seconds in one hour.
messages.think: 1 hour = 60 minutes, and 1 minute = 60 seconds. 60 x 60 = 3600.

messages.content: how many weeks in a year
A year has 52 weeks and 1 day (or 2 days in a leap year).
messages.think: 52 x 7 = 364, and a year has 365 days, so 1 day is left over.

messages.content: At what temperature does water boil?
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level. On high mountains it boils at a lower temperature because the air pressure is lower.
What temperature does water freeze at?
Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius, which is 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
which planet is the biggest?
Jupiter is the biggest planet in our solar system. More than 1000 Earths could fit inside it.
which planet is closest to the sun
Mercury is the planet closest to the sun. It is also the smallest planet.
who invented the telephone?
Alexander Graham Bell is credited with inventing the telephone. He received the patent in 1876.
Who was the first person to walk on the moon?
Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon, on 20 July 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission.
What is 15% of 240?
12 times 15?
12 times 15 is 180.
1000 minus 365 is how much?
divide 144 by 12
144 divided by 12 is 12.
A room is 8 m long and 5 m wide. What is its area?
The area of the room is 40 square meters.
perimeter of a square with side 7 cm?
The perimeter is 28 cm.
find the average of 10, 20 and 30
The average is 20.
How many meters are in 3 km?
3 km is 3000 meters.
how many minutes is 2.5 hours
2.5 hours is 150 minutes.
One pen costs 25 rupees. How much do 6 pens cost?
6 pens cost 150 rupees.
A jacket costs 1500 rupees and has a 20% discount. What is the new price?
The discount is 300 rupees, so the new price is 1200 rupees.
what is three quarters of 80?
Three quarters of 80 is 60.
add 1/2 and 1/3
what is 7 squared
7 squared is 49.
square root of 81?
The square root of 81 is 9.
A bus goes 120 km in 2 hours. What is its average speed?
The average speed is 60 km per hour.
Simple interest on 10000 rupees at 10% per year for 2 years?
The simple interest is 2000 rupees.
45 minutes plus 50 minutes, how many hours is that?
That is 95 minutes, which is 1 hour and 35 minutes.
convert 5 kg into grams
5 kg is 5000 grams.
what is 0.5 times 0.4
0.5 times 0.4 is 0.2.
what is 17 divided by 5?
17 divided by 5 is 3 with a remainder of 2, or 3.4 as a decimal.
How can I study better for exams?
Study in short sessions of 25 to 40 minutes with small breaks. Test yourself instead of only rereading, and solve old question papers. Start early and sleep well before the exam.
I can't sleep at night, any tips?
Try to sleep and wake at the same time every day. Keep your phone away 30 minutes before bed, and avoid tea or coffee in the evening. A short walk during the day also helps you sleep better.
how do I prepare for a job interview?

Learn about the company and the job first. Practise answers to common questions like "Tell me about yourself", and prepare 2 or 3 examples of your work. Dress neatly, reach early, and ask one good question at the end.
How can I save money from my salary?

Save first, spend later: put aside a fixed amount, like 10 to 20 percent, as soon as you get paid. Write down your spending for one month to see where money goes, and cut small daily costs you don't need.
how to improve my english speaking?

Speak a little every day, even to yourself. Watch simple English videos and repeat sentences aloud. Don't fear mistakes, because every mistake teaches you something. Practise with a friend if you can.
I feel very stressed about my board exams

That is a very normal feeling. Make a simple daily plan, take short breaks, and sleep at least 7 to 8 hours. Talk to someone you trust about how you feel. You don't have to be perfect, just keep going step by step.
I just moved to a new city. How do I make friends?

Start small: say hello to neighbours and coworkers, and join a group you enjoy, like a sports club, a class or volunteer work. Seeing the same people often makes friendship easier. Be patient, it takes some time.
How do I stop procrastinating?
Break the task into very small steps and start with just 5 minutes. Put your phone in another room while you work. Once you begin, it usually gets easier to continue.
tips to drink more water?
Keep a water bottle near you all day and take a few sips every hour. Drink a glass after you wake up and with every meal. If your urine is light yellow, you are drinking enough.
hi, how are you?
Hi! I'm doing well, thank you. How are you today?
good evening nik
Good evening! How was your day?
I passed my exam!!!
Congratulations! That's wonderful news. All your hard work paid off. How are you going to celebrate?
im so bored right now
Being bored is no fun! You could go for a short walk, listen to some music, or learn a new word today. Or we can play a quick quiz if you like.
tell me a joke in english
Why did the student eat his homework? Because the teacher said it was a piece of cake!
Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! I'm happy I could help. Ask me anytime.
I'm learning English. Can you help me practise?
Of course! Let's start simple. Tell me about your day in 2 or 3 sentences, and I'll help you correct any mistakes.
what should i cook for dinner tonight
How about simple dal bhat with a vegetable curry? If you want something quick, egg fried rice or vegetable noodles are easy too. What ingredients do you have at home?
"noun" bhaneko k ho? nepali ma bujhaunus na
"noun" bhaneko naam janaune shabda ho: manchhe, thau, chij wa bhawana ko naam. jastai "teacher", "Pokhara", "book" ra "love" sabai noun hun.
verb ko example deu na
"verb" kaam janaune shabda ho. jastai: "run" (daudanu), "eat" (khanu), "write" (lekhnu), "sleep" (sutnu).
"humble" ko arth k hunchha?
"humble" ko arth namra, arthat ghamanda nagarne. jastai: "He is rich but humble."
kindness lai nepali ma k bhanchha?
"kindness" lai nepali ma dayalupan ya karuna bhanchha. arthat arulai maya ra maddat garne swabhav.
"schedule" ko matlab k ho?
"schedule" bhaneko kaam garne samaya ko taalika ho, kun kaam kahile garne bhanne yojana. jastai: "My exam schedule starts on Monday."
"a" ra "an" kahile use garne?
vowel ko awaj (a, e, i, o, u) bata suru hune shabda agadi "an" lekhinchha: "an apple", "an hour". aru shabda agadi "a" lekhinchha: "a book", "a university".
since ra for ma k farak chha?
"for" samaya ko lambai sanga aauchha: "for 3 years". "since" suru bhayeko samaya sanga aauchha: "since 2020" ya "since Monday".
borrow ra lend ko farak bhana na
"borrow" bhaneko arko bata kehi samaya ko lagi linu ho: "Can I borrow your book?" "lend" bhaneko arko lai kehi samaya ko lagi dinu ho: "I can lend you my book."
"beautiful" ko spelling sahi lekhdinus
sahi spelling "beautiful" ho: b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l.
"freedom" kasto noun ho?
"freedom" abstract noun ho, kinabhane yo chhuna ya dekhna nasakine bhawana ya awastha ko naam ho.
what is a paragraph
A paragraph is a group of sentences about one main idea. A new paragraph starts on a new line when the idea changes.
can you tell me the difference between who and which
Use "who" for people and "which" for things or animals. "The girl who sings" but "the book which I read".
what's the opposite of "polite"?
The opposite of "polite" is "rude" (or "impolite").
Fill in the blank: She ___ (be) sick yesterday.
She was sick yesterday. "Yesterday" shows the past, so "be" becomes "was".
Fill in: I ___ (play) football every Saturday.
I play football every Saturday. "Every Saturday" shows a habit, so we use the simple present.
Use "although" in a sentence
"Although it was raining, we went to school." "Although" shows a contrast between two ideas.
make a sentence with "because"
"I stayed at home because I had a fever." The part after "because" gives the reason.
what is a full stop used for
A full stop (.) ends a sentence that is a statement, like "I live in Pokhara." Questions end with "?" and strong feelings with "!".
When do I use a comma?
Use a comma to separate items in a list ("rice, dal and curry"), after an introductory word ("Yes, I agree"), and before words like "but" or "so" when joining two sentences.
correct spelling: tommorow or tomorrow?
The correct spelling is "tomorrow", with one "m" and double "r".
is "informations" correct?
No. "Information" is uncountable, so we don't add "s". Say "some information" or "a piece of information".
Which is correct: "I am agree" or "I agree"?
"I agree" is correct. "Agree" is a verb, so we don't put "am" before it.
what is the difference between "a few" and "few"?
"A few" means some, a small but useful number: "I have a few friends here." "Few" means almost none: "Few people came", which sounds negative.
How many hours do I need to sleep as a teenager?
Teenagers need about 8 to 10 hours of sleep each night. Good sleep helps memory, mood and growth.
is it good to study late at night?

It can work for some people, but sleeping too little hurts memory and focus. If you study at night, keep a fixed bedtime and still get 7 to 9 hours of sleep. Most people learn better after a good rest.
how many legs does a spider have?
A spider has 8 legs. That is why spiders are not insects; insects have 6 legs.
what is the largest ocean?
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean. It is bigger than all the land on Earth put together.
which is the tallest mountain in the world
Mount Everest (Sagarmatha) is the tallest mountain in the world, at 8848.86 meters. It lies on the border of Nepal and China.
What is the national flower of Nepal?
The national flower of Nepal is the rhododendron, called "lali gurans" in Nepali. It blooms in spring in the hills.
what is photosynthesis in simple words
Photosynthesis is how plants make their own food. They use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make sugar, and they give out oxygen.
how many bones in the human body
An adult human has 206 bones. Babies are born with more, but some bones join together as they grow.
yo english sentence milayera dinus: "i is a student"
sahi vakya: "I am a student." "I" sanga sadhai "am" aauchha.
"i am go to market" sahi ho?
sahi chhaina. "I am going to the market" ya "I go to the market" lekhnus. "am" pachhi verb ma "-ing" chahinchha.
what does "break a leg" mean?
"Break a leg" is an idiom that means "good luck". People say it before a show, a performance or an exam.
meaning of the idiom "piece of cake"
"A piece of cake" means something very easy. Example: "The math test was a piece of cake."
what does "once in a blue moon" mean
"Once in a blue moon" means very rarely. Example: "My uncle visits us once in a blue moon."
explain "hit the books"
"Hit the books" means to start studying hard. Example: "Exams are next week, so I need to hit the books."
what's an idiom?
An idiom is a phrase whose meaning is different from the meanings of its single words. "It's raining cats and dogs" means it is raining very heavily.
is english a hard language to learn?
It can feel hard at first because spelling and pronunciation don't always match. But with daily practice, reading and speaking, most people improve steadily. Small steps every day work best.
what is 25% as a fraction
25% is 1/4 as a fraction.
Write 0.75 as a percent
double 375
Double 375 is 750.
half of 1250?
Half of 1250 is 625.
I have 500 rupees and spend 180. How much is left?
You have 320 rupees left.
if 4 notebooks cost 240 rupees, what does one cost?
One notebook costs 60 rupees.
how many centimeters in 2 meters?
2 meters is 200 centimeters.
what is 9 x 8?
what's 3 cubed
3 cubed is 27.
Round 4.67 to the nearest whole number.
4.67 rounded to the nearest whole number is 5, because the decimal part .67 is more than .5.
Is 51 a prime number?
No, 51 is not a prime number. It can be divided by 3 and 17, because 3 x 17 = 51.
what are the first five prime numbers?
The first five prime numbers are 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11. A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
is 0 an even number?
Yes, 0 is an even number. It can be divided by 2 with no remainder.
what is a right angle?
A right angle is an angle of exactly 90 degrees, like the corner of a page or a door frame.
how many sides does a hexagon have
A hexagon has 6 sides. Honeycomb cells made by bees are hexagons.
What is the sum of the angles of a triangle?
The angles of any triangle add up to 180 degrees.
When do we use the past continuous tense?
We use the past continuous (was/were + verb-ing) for an action that was going on at a time in the past. Example: "I was cooking when the phone rang."
what is past perfect, example?
The past perfect (had + past participle) shows an action that happened before another past action. Example: "The bus had left when we reached the stop."
explain future continuous tense
The future continuous (will be + verb-ing) shows an action that will be in progress at a future time. Example: "At 8 tomorrow, I will be travelling to Pokhara."
What are modal verbs?
Modal verbs are helping verbs that show ability, permission, possibility or duty. Examples: can, could, may, might, must, should, will, would.
can vs could
"Can" shows ability or permission now: "I can swim." "Could" is the past of "can" and is also a more polite way to ask: "Could you help me, please?"
must and should, what's the difference?
"Must" shows a strong duty or rule: "You must wear a helmet." "Should" gives advice: "You should drink more water."
what is the difference between may and might
Both show possibility. "May" sounds a little more likely or more formal, and "might" sounds less sure: "It may rain" vs "It might rain." In daily speech they are often used the same way.
what is a conditional sentence
A conditional sentence says what happens if something else happens. Example: "If it rains, we will stay home." The "if" part is the condition and the other part is the result.
complete: If I had money, I ___ buy a bike.
"If I had money, I would buy a bike." When the "if" part uses the past tense for an imaginary situation, the result uses "would".
what is a gerund
A gerund is a verb with "-ing" used as a noun. In "Swimming is fun", the word "swimming" is a gerund and the subject of the sentence.
what is an infinitive?
An infinitive is the basic form of a verb, usually with "to": to eat, to read, to go. Example: "I want to learn English."
What does "give up" mean?
"Give up" means to stop trying or to stop doing something. Example: "Don't give up, you are almost there." / "He gave up sugar."
meaning of look after
"Look after" means to take care of someone or something. Example: "My grandmother looks after my little brother."
"run out of" ko arth k ho?
"run out of" bhaneko kunai chij sakinu ho. jastai: "We ran out of milk" bhaneko ghar ma dudh sakiyo.
what's the meaning of "put off"?
"Put off" means to delay something to a later time. Example: "They put off the meeting until Friday."
what does pick up mean
"Pick up" has a few meanings: to lift something ("pick up the pen"), to collect someone ("I'll pick you up at 5") or to learn easily ("she picked up English quickly").
What is a phrasal verb?
A phrasal verb is a verb plus a small word like up, off, on or out that together make a new meaning. Examples: "turn on" the light, "find out" the truth, "get up" early.
in, on or at for time?
Use "at" for exact times (at 7 o'clock), "on" for days and dates (on Monday, on 5 May), and "in" for months, years and longer periods (in June, in 2020, in the morning).
"on the bus" or "in the bus"?
Say "on the bus". We use "on" for buses, trains and planes, but "in" for cars and taxis: "in a taxi".
some or any?

Use "some" in positive sentences ("I have some rice") and "any" in negatives and most questions ("I don't have any rice", "Do you have any rice?"). "Some" is also used in polite offers: "Would you like some tea?"
where does the apostrophe go in "the girls bags"?
If it is one girl, write "the girl's bags". If it is many girls, write "the girls' bags". The apostrophe shows who owns the bags.
how to change "Where do you live?" into reported speech
Reported speech: "He asked me where I lived." In reported questions, we use normal word order and no question mark.
is "where you are going?" correct?
No. In a question, the helping verb comes before the subject: "Where are you going?"
how to use "used to"?
"Used to" talks about past habits that are no longer true. Example: "I used to play cricket every day, but now I don't."
whats difference between "used to" and "be used to"
"Used to + verb" is a past habit: "I used to live in Dharan." "Be used to + noun or -ing" means familiar with something: "I am used to waking up early."
make or do - "___ homework"
We say "do homework". Generally "do" is for tasks and work (do the dishes, do an exam), and "make" is for creating something (make tea, make a plan, make a mistake).
rise or raise?
"Rise" means to go up by itself: "The sun rises." "Raise" means to lift something: "Raise your hand." "Raise" always needs an object.
bring vs take
"Bring" is movement towards the speaker: "Bring me a glass of water." "Take" is movement away: "Take this book to your teacher."
Advice or advise?
"Advice" is a noun: "She gave me good advice." "Advise" is a verb: "I advise you to rest."
between or among?
Use "between" for two people or things ("between Ram and Sita") and "among" for a group of three or more ("among the students").
stationery or stationary?
"Stationery" (with "e") means paper, pens and office supplies. "Stationary" (with "a") means not moving: "The bus was stationary."
principal or principle - which for the head of a school?
"Principal" is the head of a school. "Principle" means a basic rule or belief, like "honesty is my principle".
compliment vs complement
A "compliment" is a nice thing said about someone: "She gave me a compliment." "Complement" means something that completes or goes well with another thing: "Achar complements dal bhat."
accept or except?
"Accept" means to receive or agree: "I accept your invitation." "Except" means "but not": "Everyone came except Hari."
quiet or quite
"Quiet" means without noise: "The library is quiet." "Quite" means fairly or very: "The test was quite easy."
desert vs dessert
A "desert" is a dry, sandy place like the Sahara. A "dessert" is sweet food after a meal, like kheer. Tip: dessert has two "s" because you want seconds!
weather or whether?
"Weather" is about rain, sun and temperature: "The weather is cold." "Whether" means "if": "I don't know whether he will come."
what does anxious mean
"Anxious" means worried or nervous about something that might happen. Example: "She felt anxious before her exam result."
meaning of enormous
"Enormous" means very, very big. Example: "An elephant is an enormous animal."
what does fragile mean?
"Fragile" means easily broken or damaged. Glass and eggs are fragile, so we handle them carefully.
Explain the word "obvious".
"Obvious" means easy to see or understand. Example: "It was obvious that he was tired, because he kept yawning."
rare ko meaning?
"rare" bhaneko dherai kam paine ya kahilekahi matra hune. jastai: "Snow is rare in the terai" bhaneko terai ma hiu kahilekahi matra parchha.
what is the meaning of reliable
"Reliable" means you can trust or depend on it. A reliable friend keeps promises, and a reliable bus comes on time.
what does sincere mean
"Sincere" means honest and real in your feelings. A sincere apology means you truly feel sorry.
meaning of temporary
"Temporary" means lasting only for a short time, not forever. Example: "This is a temporary job for the summer."
what does vague mean
"Vague" means not clear or not detailed. Example: "His answer was vague, so I still don't know the time."
define eager
"Eager" means wanting to do something very much. Example: "The children were eager to open their gifts."
fluent bhaneko k ho?
"fluent" bhaneko kunai bhasa sajilai ra rokiyera nabolne gari bolna sakne. jastai: "She is fluent in English" bhaneko u english sajilai ra dhara pravah bolchhe.
What does frugal mean?
"Frugal" means careful with money and not wasting it. A frugal person buys only what they need.
grateful vs thankful

Both mean feeling thanks. "Thankful" is often used for a relief or a specific event ("thankful that it stopped raining"), while "grateful" is often used for kindness from people ("grateful for your help"). In daily use they are almost the same.
what does hesitate mean
"Hesitate" means to pause before doing or saying something, because you are unsure or nervous. Example: "Don't hesitate to ask questions."
meaning of nostalgic?
"Nostalgic" means feeling a bit sad but happy when remembering good times from the past. Example: "Old photos make me nostalgic."
optimistic and pessimistic meaning
"Optimistic" means expecting good things to happen. "Pessimistic" means expecting bad things. An optimist sees the glass half full; a pessimist sees it half empty.
what does persuade mean?
"Persuade" means to make someone agree or do something by giving good reasons. Example: "She persuaded her father to buy a new bicycle."
what is a rumour
A rumour is a story or piece of news that people pass around, but nobody knows if it is true. It is wise to check before believing a rumour.
What does sibling mean?
A sibling is a brother or sister. If you have one brother and one sister, you have two siblings.
what's a colleague
A colleague is a person you work with. For example, two teachers in the same school are colleagues.
landlord and tenant meaning
A landlord is the person who owns a house or room and rents it out. A tenant is the person who pays rent to live there.
what is a receipt
A receipt is a paper (or message) that proves you paid for something. It shows what you bought, the price and the date. Keep it if you might need a refund.
what does refund mean
A refund is money given back to you, for example when you return a broken product to a shop.
what is a warranty?
A warranty is a promise from the seller or maker to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a fixed time, like 1 year.
Why is the sky blue?
Sunlight is made of many colours. When it passes through the air, blue light is scattered much more than the other colours, so blue light reaches our eyes from every part of the sky.
can you explain the water cycle simply?

The sun heats water in rivers and seas, and it rises as vapour (evaporation). High up, the vapour cools and forms clouds (condensation). Then it falls as rain or snow (precipitation) and flows back to rivers and seas.
What is gravity?
Gravity is the force that pulls things towards each other. On Earth, it pulls everything towards the ground, which is why a dropped ball falls down.
what is an atom
An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element. It has a tiny centre called the nucleus (protons and neutrons), with electrons moving around it.
what makes an animal a mammal
Mammals are warm-blooded animals that have hair or fur and feed their babies with milk. Humans, cows, dogs and whales are mammals.
How many planets are in our solar system?
There are 8 planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
Is the sun a planet?
No, the sun is a star. It is a huge ball of hot gas that gives light and heat, and the planets move around it.
What causes seasons on Earth?
Seasons happen because Earth's axis is tilted. As Earth goes around the sun, each half gets more direct sunlight for part of the year (summer) and less for another part (winter).
what is a virus
A virus is a very tiny germ that can only grow inside living cells. Viruses cause illnesses like the common cold, flu and measles. Antibiotics do not work against viruses.
how does a vaccine work?
A vaccine trains your immune system to recognize a germ without making you really sick. Later, if the real germ comes, your body can fight it quickly.
capital of germany

what is the capital of italy?

Spain's capital?
The capital of Spain is Madrid.
capital city of russia
The capital of Russia is Moscow. Russia is the largest country in the world by area.
What's the capital of China?
The capital of China is Beijing.
What is the capital of India?
The capital of India is New Delhi.
capital of the usa?
The capital of the United States is Washington, D.C., not New York. New York is the biggest city.
what is the capital of the UK
The capital of the United Kingdom is London.
brazil capital city
The capital of Brazil is Brasilia. Many people guess Rio de Janeiro, but Brasilia has been the capital since 1960.
what is the capital of egypt
The capital of Egypt is Cairo. It is close to the famous pyramids of Giza.
capital of South Korea?
The capital of South Korea is Seoul.
thailand ko capital english ma bhana

capital of malaysia

what is the capital of qatar?

UAE capital is Dubai right?

capital of saudi arabia

What is Kenya's capital?
The capital of Kenya is Nairobi.
capital of mexico
The capital of Mexico is Mexico City.
argentina capital?
The capital of Argentina is Buenos Aires.
capital of new zealand
The capital of New Zealand is Wellington. Auckland is the largest city.
what's pakistan's capital
The capital of Pakistan is Islamabad.
what is the capital of sri lanka
Sri Lanka's official capital is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte, where the parliament is. Colombo, next to it, is the largest city and the business centre.
capital of maldives?
The capital of the Maldives is Male.
Afghanistan capital city
The capital of Afghanistan is Kabul.

Was 1900 a leap year?
No. 1900 was not a leap year. Years that end in 00 are leap years only if they can be divided by 400, so 2000 was a leap year but 1900 was not.
is 2024 a leap year

how do I start a leave application?

Start with the date, then "To" and the name or title of the person (for example "The Principal"). Write a subject line like "Leave application for 2 days", then "Respected Sir/Madam," and give the reason and dates in 2 or 3 short sentences. End with "Yours faithfully" and your name.
How should I start a formal email?
Start with a greeting like "Dear Mr. Sharma," or "Dear Sir/Madam,". In the first line, say why you are writing: "I am writing to ask about the job opening." Keep it short and polite.
how to end a formal letter?
End with a polite line like "Thank you for your time." Then write "Yours sincerely" if you know the person's name, or "Yours faithfully" if you don't, followed by your name.
tips for writing a good essay

Plan first: write your main idea and 3 points. Start with a short introduction, give one paragraph for each point with an example, and finish with a conclusion that repeats your main idea in new words. Read it again to fix mistakes.
write a short thank you note to my teacher
"Dear Sir, thank you for your patience and for always explaining things clearly. Your lessons made me love learning. I will always remember your kindness. With respect, [your name]."
I have a cold. what should I do?

Rest well, drink plenty of warm water and soups, and gargle with warm salt water for a sore throat. Most colds get better in about a week. If you have a high fever, trouble breathing, or it lasts long, see a doctor.
how can I avoid headaches?
Drink enough water, sleep 7 to 8 hours, and don't skip meals. Take short breaks from screens and keep good posture. If headaches are frequent or very strong, please see a doctor.
How can I make my phone battery last longer?

Lower the screen brightness, close apps you are not using, and turn off Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or location when you don't need them. Battery saver mode also helps. Try not to let the battery drop to 0% very often.
what is RAM in a computer
RAM is the computer's short-term memory. It holds the programs and files you are using right now, so the computer can work fast. When you switch off the computer, RAM is cleared.
how do I make a strong password?

Use at least 12 characters with a mix of words, numbers and symbols, like a short sentence only you know. Don't use your name or birthday, and don't use the same password everywhere. Never share it with anyone.
how to focus while studying
Keep your phone in another room or on silent. Study at the same place and time each day, and set a small goal for each session. Work for 25 minutes, rest for 5, then repeat.
I'm scared of public speaking. Help!

That fear is very common. Practise your talk out loud several times, maybe in front of a mirror or a friend. Start with a short, simple opening you know by heart. Breathe slowly, and look at a few friendly faces in the audience.
how can I manage my time better
Write a short to-do list each morning and do the most important task first. Give each task a time limit. Say no to things that are not important, and check your list at night to plan tomorrow.
give me a healthy breakfast idea
Try oats cooked in milk with a banana, or two boiled eggs with whole wheat roti. Chiura with yogurt and fruit is also a quick, filling choice. Add a glass of water too.
any plans for the weekend?

I'm a bit nervous about tomorrow
It's okay to feel nervous. What's happening tomorrow? Maybe we can plan it together so it feels easier.

good morning! starting my day with tea
Good morning! Tea is a lovely way to start the day. Do you have a busy day ahead?
"confused" ko meaning k ho?
"confused" bhaneko kura nabujhera alamal ma pareko awastha ho. jastai: "I am confused about this question" bhaneko yo prashna ma alamal bhayo.
"grateful" ra "thankful" ma k farak chha?
dubai ko arth dhanyabadi hunu ho. "grateful" dherai jaso arko le gareko maddat ko lagi ra "thankful" kunai ramro ghatana ko lagi bhaninchha, tara bolchal ma dubai jhandai uhi arth ma chalchhan.
homework countable noun ho ki uncountable?
"homework" uncountable noun ho. tyasaile "two homeworks" lekhdainan, "some homework" ya "two pieces of homework" lekhinchha.
"colleague" ko nepali arth
"colleague" bhaneko sahakarmi, arthat ekai thau ma sangai kaam garne manchhe.
reliable ko matlab bhana na
"reliable" bhaneko bharosa garna sakine. jastai: "He is a reliable friend" bhaneko u bharosa garna sakine sathi ho.
present perfect tense nepali ma bujhaideu
present perfect ma "has/have + verb ko third form" aauchha. yasle bhakhar sakiyeko kaam ko asar aile samma chha bhanchha: "I have eaten" bhaneko maile khaisake.
"used to" kasari prayog garne?
"used to" le pahile ko bani janauchha jun aile chhaina. jastai: "I used to live in Ilam" bhaneko ma pahile ilam basthe, aile basdina.
"make" ra "do" ko farak bhanidinus
kehi naya banaune kura ma "make" aauchha: "make tea", "make a plan". kaam ya jimmewari ma "do" aauchha: "do homework", "do the dishes".

"advice" noun ho: "Thank you for your advice." "advise" verb ho: "I advise you to rest." spelling ma "c" ra "s" ko matra farak chha, tara kaam farak chha.

thik ghadi ko samaya ma "at" (at 6 o'clock), bar ra miti ma "on" (on Sunday), mahina, barsha ra lamo samaya ma "in" (in March, in 2025) lagaune.

"temporary" bhaneko k ho?
