amala, kagati, suntala, amba (guava) ra golbheda ma vitamin C dherai hunchha. vitamin C le rog sanga ladne shakti badhauchha.
vitamin C ko kami le kun rog lagchha?
vitamin C ko lamo kami le scurvy rog lagchha, jasma gija bata ragat aauchha ra ghau chhito nikodaina. taja phalphul ra tarkari khada yo rog bata bachna sakinchha.
vitamin D kaha bata paainchha?
vitamin D ko mukhya srot ghaam ho, ghaam ma basda hamro chhala le yo banauchha. machha, anda ra dudh bata pani kehi vitamin D paainchha.
falam (iron) ko kami le k hunchha?
falam ko kami le ragat ko kami (anemia) hunchha, jasle thakai, kamjori ra anuhar pahelo banauchha. hariyo saag, gedagudi, masu ra anda falam ka ramra srot hun.
khana sangai chiya khanu ramro ho ki haina?
khana sangai dherai chiya piyo bhane khana ko falam (iron) sharir le kam sosna sakchha. ragat ko kami bhayeka manchhe le chiya khana bhanda ali agadi ya pachhi piunu ramro hunchha.
calcium kina jaruri chha?
calcium le haddi ra daat baliyo banauchha. dudh, dahi, paneer, hariyo saag ra saana machha calcium ka ramra srot hun.
iodine wala nun kina khanu parchha?
iodine ko kami le ghaanga (goitre) rog ra bachcha ko dimag ko bikas ma samasya huna sakchha. iodine mishrit nun khada yo kami sajilai rokna sakinchha.
resha (fibre) k ho ra kina chahinchha?
resha bhaneko khana ko tyo bhag ho jun pachdaina tara aandra lai sapha rakhna maddat garchha. yasle kabjiyat rokchha; phalphul, tarkari, gedagudi ra chokar sahitko pitho ma resha hunchha.
din ma kati pani piunu parchha?
dherai jaso thula manchhe lai din ma lagbhag 6 dekhi 8 gilas pani chahinchha. garmi, kaam ra khel anusar yo badhna sakchha; pisab halka pahelo bhaye pugeko sanket ho.
santulit bhojan bhaneko k ho?
santulit bhojan bhaneko sharir lai chahine sabai poshak tatva ucit matra ma dine khana ho. yasma anna, gedagudi, tarkari, phalphul ra dudh jasta kura milayera khanu parchha.
junk food kina naramro?
junk food ma dherai nun, chini ra chillo hunchha tara vitamin ra resha kam hunchha. dherai khaye mota pan, daat kirne ra mutu ko rog ko khatara badhchha.
dherai chini khanda k hunchha?
dherai chini khanda daat kirchha, tauil badhchha ra madhumeh (diabetes) ko khatara badhchha. mithai ra chiso peya kam khanu ramro hunchha.
dherai nun khanu kina ramro haina?
dherai nun khanda ragatchap (blood pressure) badhna sakchha, jasle mutu ra mirgaula lai haani garchha. achar, chips ra packet ko khana ma nun dherai hunchha.
bihana ko khana chhodnu thik ho?
bihana kehi pani nakhai lamo samaya basda thakai, tauko dukhne ra dhyan nalagne huna sakchha. bihana halka ra poshilo khana, jastai anda, roti ya dudh-chiura, khanu ramro hunchha.
khana khanu agadi haat kina dhunu parchha?
haat ma dekhna nasakine kitanu hunchhan, jun khana sangai pet ma pasera jhada-pakhala jasta rog lagauna sakchhan. saabun le 20 second samma ragadera dhoda dherai kitanu hatchhan.
saabun le haat kati samaya dhunu parchha?
saabun le kamti ma 20 second samma haat ragadera dhunu parchha. aunla ko bich, nang muni ra naadi samma dhunu parchha.
pani umalera kina piunu parchha?
pani umalda tyasma bhayeka kitanu marchhan. yasle jhada-pakhala, typhoid ra haija jasta pani bata sarne rog bata bachauchha.
jeevan jal kahile khanu parchha?
jhada-pakhala ya baanta laagda sharir bata pani ra nun gumchha, tyo pura garna jeevan jal khanu parchha. bachcha ko jhada pakhala ma jeevan jal sanga zinc chakki pani dina salah diinchha.
ghar mai jeevan jal kasari banaune?
1 liter umalera selayeko pani ma 6 chiya chamcha chini ra aadha chiya chamcha nun ramrari ghulaunus. dherai nun nahalnus, ra jhada pakhala badhyo ya ragat dekhiyo bhane doctor kaha jaanus.
typhoid kasari sarchha?
typhoid fohor pani ra khana bata sarne rog ho. sapha pani piune, haat dhune ra pakayeko khana khane gare typhoid bata bachna sakinchha.
haija rog kina laagchha?
haija (cholera) kitanu le dushit pani ya khana bata laagchha. yasma dherai patalo disa hunchha ra sharir ko pani chhito sakinchha, tyasaile turuntai jeevan jal ra upachar chahinchha.
daat din ma kati choti maajnu parchha?
daat din ma 2 choti, bihana ra raati sutnu agadi maajnu parchha. fluoride bhayeko manjan prayog garda daat kirna kam hunchha.
daat kina kirchha?
mukh ka kitanu le chini bata amla banauchhan, ra tyo amla le daat ko mathillo kada tah lai bistarai khiyauchha. chini kam khane ra daat sapha rakhne gare daat kirna rokinchha.
churot khanu kina haanikarak chha?
churot ko dhuwa ma dherai bishalu padartha hunchhan, jasle phokso ko cancer, mutu ko rog ra dam (asthma) jasta rog lagauchhan. churot nakhaneko manchhe le dhuwa sungda pani haani hunchha.
raksi le sharir ko kun ang lai badhi bigarchha?
dherai raksi piunda kalejo (liver) lai sabai bhanda badhi haani hunchha. yasle mutu, dimag ra pet lai pani bigarna sakchha.
sarpa le tokyo bhane k garne?
sarpa le tokda shanta rahanus ra tokeko ang lai nachalaunus. aunthi ra kasieko luga hataunus ani sakesamma chhito aspatal jaanus; ghau kaatne, chusne wa kasera baadhne nagarnus.
kukur le tokyo bhane ke garne?

kukur le tokeko ghau lai saabun ra pani le 15 minet samma ramrari dhunus. tyas pachhi chhito swasthya chauki ya aspatal gaera rabies birudh ko khop linus, kinabhane rabies lagepachhi bachauna garo hunchha.
rabies kun janawar bata sarchha?
rabies dherai jaso rabies laageko kukur ko tokai bata sarchha. biralo, syal ra bandar jasta janawar bata pani sarna sakchha.
jworo aayo bhane k garne?
jworo aauda aaram garnus, dherai jhol ra pani piunus, ra halka luga lagaunus. jworo dherai uchcha bhayo, 2-3 din bhanda badhi rahyo, ya bachcha lai aayo bhane doctor sanga salah linus.
madhumeh bhaneko k ho?

madhumeh (diabetes) ragat ma chini ko matra badhi hune rog ho. sharir le insulin ramrari banauna ya prayog garna nasakda yo hunchha; santulit khana, byayam ra niyamit jaach le yaslai niyantran garna maddat garchha.
uchcha ragatchap kasari thaha hunchha?
uchcha ragatchap ko dherai jaso kunai lakshan dekhidaina, tyasaile machine le naapera matra thaha hunchha. 40 barsa pachhi niyamit rup ma ragatchap jaachnu ramro hunchha.
khop (vaccine) le kasari bachauchha?
khop le sharir lai rog ko kitanu chinne ra ladne tarika sikauchha. pachhi sacchai ko kitanu aaye sharir le chhitai ladera rog hune bata bachauchha.
BCG khop kun rog bata bachauchha?
BCG khop le bachcha lai kshayarog (TB) ko gambhir rup bata bachauchha. yo khop janma pachhi chhitai diinchha.
dadura kasto rog ho?
dadura (measles) bhaneko bhairas le garda hune chhito sarne rog ho, jasma jworo, khoki ra sharir bhari dana aauchhan. khop le dadura bata ramro surakshya dinchha.
lu lagyo bhane k garne?
lu (heat stroke) lagda tyo manchhe lai chhahari ma lagera luga khukulo garnus ra chiso pani le sharir puchhnus. hosh chha bhane pani piuna dinus ra chhito aspatal lagnus.
chiso ma sharir ko tapkram dherai ghatyo bhane k hunchha?
sharir ko tapkram dherai ghatda kaapne, bolna garo hune ra alamal hune hunchha, jaslai hypothermia bhaninchha. bhijeko luga fereura sukkha nyano luga lagaunus, kambal odhaunus ra taato peya dinus.
khana kina sadchha?
khana ma kitanu ra dhusi badhda khana sadchha. chiso thau ma ya fridge ma rakhda kitanu dhilo badhchhan, tyasaile khana dherai samaya ramro rahanchha.
dudh bata dahi kasari banchha?
manthatato dudh ma alikati dahi milauda tyasma bhayeka ramra kitanu (bacteria) dudh ko chini lai amla ma badlinchhan. tyo amla le dudh lai baklo ra amilo dahi banauchha.
mah chhito kina bigrindaina?
mah ma pani ko matra dherai kam ra chini dherai hunchha, ani yo ali amilo pani hunchha. yasto thau ma kitanu badhna sakdainan, tyasaile sapha bhaanda ma rakheko mah dherai samaya ramro rahanchha.
chamal pakauda kina phulchha?
chamal pakauda yasle pani sosera naram hunchha ra phulchha. tyasaile 1 kap chamal pakauda lagbhag 2-3 kap bhat banchha.
khana pakayera kina khanchhan?
khana pakauda dherai kitanu marchhan ra khana naram bhayera pachna sajilo hunchha. masu ra anda ramrari pakayera khanu parchha.
besar khana ma kina halchhan?
besar le khana lai pahelo rang ra ramro swad dinchha. nepali bhansa ma tarkari, dal ra masu ma besar halne chalan dherai purano chha.
nepal ma kun tel le dherai khana pakauchhan?
nepal ma tori ko tel le dherai khana pakaine chalan chha. yasko baas kadai hunchha ra achar banauna pani prayog hunchha.
phalphul ra tarkari khanu agadi kina dhunu parchha?
phalphul ra tarkari ma mato, kitanu ra kitnashak bisadi lagna sakchha. sapha pani le ramrari dhoyera khanda rog ko khatara kam hunchha.
jhingaa le kasari rog sarchha?
jhingaa fohor ra disa ma basera pachhi khana ma basda tyasko khutta ma tasieka kitanu khana ma chhodchha. tyasaile khana chhopera rakhnu parchha.
khana nachapai nilnu kina naramro?
khana ramrari chapauda pachaune kaam mukh mai suru hunchha ra pet lai sajilo hunchha. hatar ma nilda pet dukhne, gyas hune ra ghaanti ma adkine khatara hunchha.
chiya ma k hunchha jasle nidra bhagauchha?
chiya ra coffee ma caffeine hunchha, jasle dimag lai jagaa rakhchha. beluka dherai chiya piunda nidra lagna garo huna sakchha.
chini ra sakhar ma k farak chha?
chini ukhu ko ras lai dherai shuddha garera baneko seto daana ho. sakhar (chaku jasto) kam shuddha gariyeko hunchha ra yasma thorai khanij rahanchha, tara dubai ma chini nai dherai hunchha.
ghiu kasari banchha?
dahi ya dudh bata nikaleko nauni lai bistarai tatauda pani udera shuddha chillo baki rahanchha, tyahi ghiu ho. nepali bhojan ma ghiu lai shubha maninchha.
aduwa kun kaam ma aauchha?
aduwa khana ma swad ra baas dina prayog hunchha ra chiya ma pani halinchha. nepal aduwa utpadan garne thula desh madhye ek ho.
nepal ma kun thau ko chiya prasiddha chha?
nepal ma ilam ko chiya sabai bhanda prasiddha chha. dhankuta, panchthar ra jhapa ma pani chiya kheti hunchha.
nepal ma kaha coffee kheti hunchha?
nepal ma gulmi, palpa, syangja, kaski ra lalitpur jasta pahadi jilla ma coffee kheti hunchha. pahadi mausam ma falne nepali coffee lai bideshi le pani man parauchhan.
nepal ko mukhya anna bali kun ho?
nepal ko mukhya anna bali dhan ho. tyas pachhi makai ra gahu dherai lagaine anna hun.
aalu ko kun bhag khaine ho?
aalu ko jamin muni falne mota daanth (kanda) khaine bhag ho. yasma carbohydrate dherai hunchha, tara aalu ko hariyo bhag ra tusa khanu hudaina.
dal kun kun prakar ko hunchha?
nepal ma mas, musuro, rahar, mung, chana ra bodi ko dal dherai khaine gariinchha. sabai dal ma protein dherai hunchha.
golbheda phal ho ki tarkari?
bigyan anusar golbheda phal ho, kinabhane yasma biu hunchha ra yo phool bata banchha. tara bhansa ma yaslai tarkari jastai prayog garinchha.
kera ma kun tatva dherai hunchha?
kera ma potassium ra carbohydrate dherai hunchha. yasle chhito shakti dinchha, tyasaile khelaadi haru kera khana man parauchhan.
anda ma k k poshak tatva hunchha?
anda ma ramro protein, vitamin, falam ra chillo hunchha. ramrari umaleko anda sasto ra poshilo khana ho.
dudh lai kina umalera piune?
kachcha dudh ma kitanu huna sakchhan, umalda ti marchhan. pasteurize gareko packet ko dudh pani tataera piune chalan ramro hunchha.
byayam din ma kati garnu parchha?
thula manchhe le hapta ma kamti ma 150 minet madhyam byayam garnu ramro hunchha, jastai din ma 30 minet chhito hidne. bachcha lai din ma 1 ghanta jati khelkud chahinchha.
nidra kina jaruri chha?
sutda sharir le aafu lai marmat garchha ra dimag le din bhari sikeka kura sambhalchha. kam sutda dhyan, smaran shakti ra rog sanga ladne shakti ghatchha.
thulo manchhe lai kati ghanta nidra chahinchha?
dherai jaso thula manchhe lai raati 7 dekhi 9 ghanta nidra chahinchha. kishor kishori lai 8 dekhi 10 ghanta chahinchha.
aankha ko lagi kun khana ramro?
gajar, farsi, hariyo saag ra pahelo phal ma vitamin A hunchha, jun aankha ko lagi ramro ho. screen herda bich bich ma aankha aaram garaunu pani jaruri chha.
mobile dherai herda aankha lai k hunchha?
lamo samaya screen herda aankha sukkhine, thakne ra dhamilo dekhine hunchha. 20 minet ma ek choti 20 second tadha ko kura herne bani le aankha lai aaram dinchha.
ghaam ma dherai basda k hunchha?
dherai chhito ghaam ma basda chhala polne (sunburn) ra lamo samaya samma ta chhala ko rog ko khatara hunchha. tara thorai ghaam le vitamin D dinchha, tyasaile santulan chahinchha.
ghau ma ke lagaune?
sano ghau lai pahila sapha pani le dhunus, ani sapha kapda le thichera ragat rokna sakinchha. tyas pachhi antiseptic lagayera sapha patti le chhopnus; ghau gahiro chha bhane aspatal jaanus.
haddi bhachiyo jasto lagyo bhane k garne?
haddi bhachiye jasto lagda tyo ang lai nachalaunus ra kathko phalek ya kada chij le sidha rakhera baadhnus. tyas pachhi sakesamma chhito aspatal laijaanus.
kosaile behosh bhayo bhane k garne?
behosh bhayeko manchhe lai sidha sutaunus ra sas feriraheko chha ki herna paila jaachnus. sas chha bhane kokhaa tira farkaunus ra turuntai ambulance bolaunus.
ambulance ko number nepal ma kati ho?
nepal ma ambulance ko lagi 102 ma phone garna sakinchha. prahari ko lagi 100 ra damkal (fire) ko lagi 101 number chha.
aago lagda kun number ma phone garne?
nepal ma aago lagda damkal ko lagi 101 ma phone garnu parchha. aafu ra aru lai surakshit thau ma lagnu pahilo kaam ho.
prahari ko number k ho nepal ma?
nepal ma prahari lai 100 ma phone garna sakinchha. yo number nishulka chha.
tel ma aago lagyo bhane pani halne?
haina, taato tel ma aago lagda pani halnu hudaina, pani le aago jhan failauchha. gas band garera pakeko bhaado ko birko ya bhijeko bhari kapda le chhopnus.
gas chuhiyo jasto gandha aayo bhane k garne?
gas ko gandha aauda switch, lighter ya salai nachalaunus. regulator band garnus, jhyal dhoka kholnus ra bahira niskinus; pachhi jaankar lai bolaunus.
LPG gas ma gandha kina hunchha?
LPG gas aafai ma gandha hudaina, chuhida thaha paos bhanera yasma kadai gandha bhayeko padartha milaieko hunchha. gandha aaye gas chuhiyeko sanket ho.
khoki laagda k garne?
sadharan khoki ma manthatato pani, aduwa ra mah haleko chiya ramro hunchha. 3 hapta bhanda badhi khoki, ragat aaune khoki ya sas fulne bhaye doctor sanga jaanch garaunus.
kshayarog (TB) ko lakshan k k hun?
2 hapta bhanda lamo khoki, jworo, raati pasina aaune ra tauil ghatne TB ka mukhya lakshan hun. nepal ma TB ko jaanch ra upachar sarkari swasthya sanstha ma nishulka chha.
aulo (malaria) kasari sarchha?
aulo (malaria) anopheles laamkhutte ko tokai bata sarchha. jhul ma sutne ra laamkhutte bhagaune upaya garne le aulo bata bachauchha.
dengue kun laamkhutte le sarauchha?
dengue aedes jaat ko laamkhutte le sarauchha, jun dherai jaso diuso tokchha. ghar waripari jameko pani hataune sabai bhanda ramro bachau ho.
dengue lagyo bhane k garne?
dengue ma aaram garnus, dherai pani ra jhol piunus ra doctor sanga jaanch garaunus. doctor ko salah bina dukhai ko kehi aushadhi, jastai ibuprofen, nakhanus kinabhane ragat bagna sakchha.
dherai mota hunu kina khatara?
dherai mota hunda madhumeh, uchcha ragatchap, mutu ko rog ra jorni dukhne khatara badhchha. santulit khana ra niyamit byayam le tauil niyantran garna maddat garchha.
hiundo ma ruga khoki kina dherai lagchha?
hiundo ma manchhe dherai jaso band kotha ma najik basne bhayeko le bhairas ek arka ma chhito sarchha. chiso ra sukkha hawa le pani naak ra ghaanti lai kamjor banauchha.
antibiotic le ruga nikodachha?
nikodaina, ruga bhairas le garda hunchha ra antibiotic le bacteria matra marchha. bina karan antibiotic khanda bacteria le aushadhi lai haraune shakti bikas garna sakchha.
aushadhi ko pura course kina sakaunu parchha?
antibiotic jasta aushadhi bich mai chhodda kehi kitanu bachera feri rog badhna sakchha. doctor le bhaneko jati din pura khanu parchha, lakshan haraye pani.
sutkeri aama lai kun khana dinu parchha?
sutkeri aama lai poshilo ra pachna sajilo khana chahinchha: dal, bhat, haluwa, masu, anda, dudh ra hariyo saag. pani ra jhol pani dherai piunu parchha.
bachcha lai aama ko dudh kati mahina samma matra khuwaune?
bachcha lai pahila 6 mahina samma aama ko dudh matra khuwaunu ramro maninchha. tyas pachhi aru khana suru gare pani 2 barsa samma aama ko dudh dina salah diinchha.
bachcha ko pahilo bhat lai k bhanchhan?
bachcha lai pahilo choti bhat khuwaune sanskar lai pasni (annaprashan) bhaninchha. chhora lai 6 mahina ra chhori lai 5 mahina ma garne chalan chha.
chiso pani ra taato pani ko khana pachauna farak parchha?
khana sanga piune pani chiso ki taato bhanne kura le pachauna khasai farak pardaina. pani pugne gari piunu nai mukhya kura ho.
gahu ko pitho ra maida ma k farak?
gahu ko pitho (aata) ma gahu ko bokra (chokar) pani rahanchha, tyasaile resha dherai hunchha. maida bata chokar hatayeko hunchha, tyasaile yo naram ra seto tara kam poshilo hunchha.
kodo kina poshilo maninchha?
kodo ma resha, calcium ra falam jasta khanij ramro matra ma hunchhan. tyasaile kodo ko roti ra dhido lai poshilo khana maninchha.
fapar k ho?
fapar (buckwheat) himali ra pahadi kshetra ma falne anna jasto bali ho. fapar ko pitho bata roti ra dhido banainchha.
mula ko paat ko k banchha?
mula ko paat bata gundruk banchha ra yasko saag pani pakayera khanchhan. mula lai kuhayera sukayera sinki banainchha.
tama k bata banchha?
tama bans ko komal tusa lai kaatera amilo hune gari kuhayera banchha. aloo tama ma yahi tama halinchha.
kagati ko ras kina amilo hunchha?
kagati ma citric acid bhanne amla hunchha, jasle yaslai amilo banauchha. yasma vitamin C pani dherai hunchha.
amala kasto phal ho?
amala saano hariyo-pahelo, tito-amilo swad ko phal ho. yasma vitamin C dherai hunchha ra yaslai achar, mithai ra aushadhi ma prayog garinchha.
mah ko maha le kasari banauchhan bhanera nepali ma bhana
maha le phool ko mitho ras (makaranda) chusera ghar (gharaa) ma lyauchhan. pwankh le hawa lagayera tyasko pani sukayepachhi tyo ras baklo mah banchha.
nepal ma kun phal kaha dherai falchha?
jumla ra mustang ma syau, dhankuta ra sindhuli ma suntala, terai ma aanp ra lichi dherai falchha. mausam ra uchai anusar phal farak hunchha.
suntala kun mahina ma pakchha?
nepal ma suntala dherai jaso mangsir dekhi magh samma pakchha. sindhuli, dhankuta, syangja ra gorkha jasta pahadi jilla ko suntala prasiddha chha.
kafal kahile paainchha?
kafal baisakh-jestha tira pahad ko jangal ma pakne saano rato-kalo jangali phal ho. yasko swad guliyo-amilo hunchha.
kaju ra badam ma k paainchha?
kaju, okhar ra badam ma ramro chillo, protein ra khanij hunchha. dinma muthi bhari jati khanu ramro maninchha, dherai khaye tauil badhna sakchha.
nepali khana ma timur, jwano ra methi kina halchhan?
timur, jwano ra methi le khana lai baas ra swad dinchha. jwano lai pet ko gyas kam garna pani paramparik rup ma prayog garinchha.
what is gundruk
Gundruk is a Nepali food made from leafy greens, like mustard or radish leaves, that are fermented and then dried in the sun. It is used to make a sour soup or pickle.
which vitamin do we get from sunlight?
We get vitamin D from sunlight. Our skin makes it when sunlight falls on it, and it helps keep bones strong.
what does iron do in the body
Iron helps make haemoglobin, which carries oxygen in the blood. Without enough iron, a person can get anaemia and feel tired and weak.
what is dhido made of?
Dhido is made by cooking flour of millet, buckwheat or maize in boiling water while stirring until it becomes thick. It is a traditional food in the hills.
what is the emergency number for police in nepal
The police emergency number in Nepal is 100. For an ambulance call 102, and for fire call 101.
thulo manchhe ko sharir ma kati wata haddi hunchhan?
thulo manchhe ko sharir ma 206 wata haddi hunchhan. bachcha janmanda jhandai 300 jati haddi hunchhan, pachhi kehi haddi jodiyera sankhya ghatchha.
sharir ko sabai bhanda lamo haddi kun ho?
sharir ko sabai bhanda lamo haddi tighra ko haddi (femur) ho. yo sabai bhanda baliyo haddi pani ho.
sabai bhanda sano haddi kaha hunchha?
sharir ko sabai bhanda sano haddi kaan bhitra hunchha, jaslai stapes bhaninchha. yasle aawaj sunna maddat garchha.
khoppadi le k kaam garchha?
khoppadi (skull) le dimag lai chot lagna bata jogauchha. yo dherai haddi jodiyera baneko baliyo khol jasto hunchha.
karang ko haddi kina hunchha?
karang ko haddi le mutu ra phokso lai pinjada jasto gari jogauchha. manchhe ma 12 jodi, arthat 24 wata karang hunchhan.
merudanda bhaneko k ho?
merudanda (dhaad ko haddi) dherai saana haddi ek mathi arko milera baneko lamo khamba ho. yasle sharir lai sidha rakhchha ra bhitra ko meru rajju (spinal cord) lai jogauchha.
jorni bhaneko k ho?
jorni bhaneko duita haddi milne thau ho, jasle sharir lai modna ra chalna dinchha. ghuda dhoka ko kabja jasto ra kum bhanta jasto ghumne jorni ho.
hamro sharir ma kati wata mamsapeshi chhan?
hamro sharir ma 600 bhanda badhi mamsapeshi chhan. mamsapeshi le haddi lai tanera hamilai hidna, uthna ra bolna maddat garchha.
sabai bhanda thulo mamsapeshi kun ho?
sharir ko sabai bhanda thulo mamsapeshi chaak ko mamsapeshi (gluteus maximus) ho. yasle hamilai ubhinna, hidna ra sidhi chadhna maddat garchha.
mutu ma kati wata kotha hunchhan?
mutu ma 4 wata kotha hunchhan: mathi 2 atrium ra tala 2 ventricle. yi kotha haru le ragat lai sahi disha ma pathauchhan.
mutu ek minet ma kati choti dhadkinchha?
aaram ma baseko thulo manchhe ko mutu sadharan rup ma ek minet ma 60 dekhi 100 choti dhadkinchha. daudda ya dar laagda yo badhchha.
mutu kati thulo hunchha?
manchhe ko mutu lagbhag usko aafno mutthi jatti thulo hunchha. yo chhati ko bich ma, ali debre tira hunchha.
mutu ko debre bhag ra daahine bhag le k garchha?
mutu ko daahine bhag le sharir bata aayeko ragat phokso ma pathauchha. debre bhag le phokso bata oxygen bhayeko ragat lai sharir bhari pathauchha.
thulo manchhe ko sharir ma kati ragat hunchha?
thulo manchhe ko sharir ma lagbhag 5 liter ragat hunchha. yo sharir ko tauil anusar ali kam ya badhi huna sakchha.
rato ragat koshika ko kaam k ho?
rato ragat koshika le phokso bata oxygen lyayera sharir bhari puryauchha. yasma haemoglobin hunchha, jasle ragat lai rato banauchha.
seto ragat koshika le k garchha?
seto ragat koshika le sharir ma pasne kitanu sanga ladchha. yini sharir ka sipahi jastai hun.
platelet ko kaam bhana
platelet le ghau lagda ragat jamaera bagna rokchha. yasai le garda saano ghau ma ragat aafai rokinchha.
ragat samuha kati prakar ka hunchhan?
mukhya ragat samuha 4 prakar ka hunchhan: A, B, AB ra O. pratyek lai positive ra negative ma pani chhuttyainchha.
sabai lai ragat dina sakne ragat samuha kun?
O negative ragat samuha bhayeka manchhe lai "universal donor" bhaninchha, kinabhane unko rato ragat koshika jasto pani samuha lai dina sakinchha. aapatkal ma yo ragat dherai kaam aauchha.
sabai bata ragat lina sakne samuha kun ho?
AB positive ragat samuha bhayeka manchhe lai "universal recipient" bhaninchha. unle jun sukai samuha ko rato ragat koshika lina sakchhan.
dhamani ra shira ma k farak chha?
dhamani (artery) le mutu bata ragat sharir tira laijanchha. shira (vein) le sharir bata ragat feri mutu tira farkauchha.
nadi (pulse) kaha chhamera thaha paainchha?
naadi kalaai ma bud aunla tira ko bhag ma ra ghaanti ko chheu ma chhamera thaha paainchha. 1 minet samma gane bhane mutu kati choti dhadkiyo thaha hunchha.
phokso kati wata hunchhan?
manchhe ko 2 wata phokso hunchhan. daahine phokso ma 3 ra debre phokso ma 2 bhag (lobe) hunchhan, kinabhane debre tira mutu ko lagi thau chahinchha.
phokso ma oxygen kasari ragat ma pugchha?
phokso bhitra laakhau saana hawa ka thaili (alveoli) hunchhan, jasko patalo bhitta bata oxygen ragat ma ra carbon dioxide bahira jaanchha.
thulo manchhe ek minet ma kati choti sas ferchha?
aaram ma baseko thulo manchhe ek minet ma lagbhag 12 dekhi 20 choti sas ferchha. byayam garda yo sankhya badhchha.
diaphragm ko kaam k ho?
diaphragm phokso ko tala ko gumbaj aakar ko mamsapeshi ho. yo tala sarda phokso ma hawa pasdachha ra mathi aauda hawa bahira niskinchha.
dimag le k k niyantran garchha?
dimag le sochne, samjhane, bolne, hidne ra sharir ka dherai kaam niyantran garchha. yasle mutu dhadkine ra sas ferne jasta aafai hune kaam pani chalauchha.
dimag ko debre bhag le sharir ko kun bhag chalauchha?
dimag ko debre bhag le sharir ko daahine bhag ra daahine bhag le debre bhag lai niyantran garchha. tyasaile debre dimag ma chot lagda daahine haat-khutta kamjor huna sakchha.
snayu (nerve) le k garchha?
snayu le dimag ra sharir ka bhag ko bich sandesh bokchha. haat le taato chhuda snayu le dimag lai chhitai khabar dinchha ra haat hatinchha.
aankha ko nani (pupil) kina sano thulo hunchha?
ujyalo ma nani sano hunchha ra kam prakash bhitra pasdachha, andhyaro ma nani thulo bhayera badhi prakash bhitra lina sakchha. yasle aankha ko bhitri bhag lai jogauchha.
aankha ko rang kun bhag le dinchha?
aankha ko rang iris (nani ko waripari ko gol bhag) le dinchha. kaalo, khairo, niilo ya hariyo iris hunchha.
hamle kasari dekhchhau?
prakash aankha ko lens bata bhitra pasera pachhadi ko retina ma chitra banauchha. retina le snayu bata dimag lai sandesh pathauchha ra dimag le tyo chitra bujhchha.
hamle aankha kina jhimkauchhau?
aankha jhimkauda aansu le aankha lai bhijayera sapha rakhchha ra dhulo hatauchha. yasle aankha lai sukkhina dinna.
40 barsa pachhi padhna chashma kina chahinchha?
umer badhdai jaanda aankha ko lens kada hunchha ra najik ko kura ramrari dekhna garo hunchha. tyasaile dherai jaso manchhe lai 40 barsa pachhi padhne chashma chahinchha.
najik ko dekhne tara tadha ko nadekhne lai k bhanchhan?
najik ko ramrari dekhne tara tadha ko dhamilo dekhne samasya lai myopia (najar kamjor tadha ko) bhaninchha. yasko lagi concave lens bhayeko chashma lagainchha.
rang andhopan bhaneko k ho?
rang andhopan (colour blindness) ma kehi rang chhuttyauna garo hunchha, dherai jaso rato ra hariyo. yo mahila bhanda purush ma dherai dekhinchha.
kaan ka bhag kati hunchhan?
kaan ka 3 bhag hunchhan: bahiri, bichko ra bhitri kaan. bichko kaan ma 3 saana haddi hunchhan ra bhitri kaan le sunna ra santulan rakhna maddat garchha.
ghumda ghumda ringata kina lagchha?
bhitri kaan ma santulan rakhne tarala padartha hunchha. ghumna rokda pani tyo tarala ghumi rahanchha, tyasaile dimag alamal ma parera ringata lagchha.
hawaijahaj ma kaan kina bandaa jasto hunchha?
uchai badlinda bahira ko hawa ko chap chhitai badalinchha tara kaan bhitra ko chap tyati chhito milna sakdaina. nilne, haai garne ya chewing gum chapaune garda kaan khulchha.
kaan ma sinka halnu kina naramro?
kaan ma sinka ya cotton bud halda kaan ko mail jhan bhitra dhakelinchha ra kaan ko jaali (eardrum) futna sakchha. kaan ko mail aafai bahira aauchha, samasya bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
jibro le kati kisim ko swad thaha paauchha?
jibro le 5 mukhya swad thaha paauchha: guliyo, amilo, nunilo, tito ra umami (masu ra mushroom jasto swad). piro bhane swad haina, polne anubhav ho.
rugha lagda khana ko swad kina harauchha?
khana ko dherai swad hamle naak le sunghera thaha paauchhau. rugha lagda naak band hune bhayeko le baas aaudaina ra khana swad bina jasto lagchha.
naak ko raun ko kaam k ho?
naak bhitra ko raun ra singan le hawa ma bhayeko dhulo ra kitanu rokchha. yasle phokso ma sapha hawa pathauna maddat garchha.
chhala ko rang kina farak farak hunchha?
chhala ko rang melanin bhanne rang padartha le nirdharan garchha. dherai melanin bhaye chhala kalo ra kam bhaye gora hunchha.
chhala ko kaam k k ho?
chhala le sharir lai kitanu, chot ra ghaam bata jogauchha. pasina nikalera sharir chiso rakhchha ra chhune anubhav pani dinchha.
kapal ra nang k le baneko hunchha?
kapal ra nang keratin bhanne protein le baneko hunchha. yasma snayu nahune bhayeko le kapal ra nang katda dukhdaina.
kapal ek mahina ma kati badhchha?
kapal sadharan rup ma ek mahina ma lagbhag 1 cm badhchha. umer, swasthya ra khana anusar yo ali farak hunchha.
daat ka prakar kati hunchhan?
daat 4 prakar ka hunchhan: incisor (kaatne), canine (chyatne), premolar ra molar (chapaune). molar sabai bhanda pachhadi ka thula daat hun.
sharir ko sabai bhanda kada bhag kun ho?
sharir ko sabai bhanda kada padartha daat ko mathillo tah (enamel) ho. tara chini ra amla le yaslai bistarai khiyauna sakchha.
haar (saliva) ko kaam k ho?
haar le khana lai bhijauchha ra nilna sajilo banauchha. yasma bhayeko enzyme le bhat jasta khana pachauna mukh mai suru garchha.
pet ma khana kasari pachchha?
pet ma amla ra enzyme le khana lai tukra tukra banauchha. tyas pachhi saano aandra ma poshak tatva ragat ma sosinchhan.
saano aandra kati lamo hunchha?
thulo manchhe ko saano aandra lagbhag 6 dekhi 7 meter lamo hunchha. yo pet bhitra dherai ghumera mileko hunchha.
thulo aandra ko kaam k ho?
thulo aandra le khana ko baki bhag bata pani sosera disa banauchha. yasma dherai ramra bacteria pani hunchhan.
kalejo (liver) ko kaam k k ho?
kalejo le ragat ko bish chhanchha, pitta (bile) banauchha ra shakti sanchit garchha. yo sharir bhitra ko sabai bhanda thulo ang ho.
kalejo feri badhna sakchha?
sakchha, kalejo ko kehi bhag hataye pani baki bhag badhera feri thulo hune kshamata yasma hunchha. tara raksi ra bimari le yaslai lamo samaya bigaryo bhane marmat garna nasakne huna sakchha.
agnyashaya (pancreas) ko kaam k ho?
agnyashaya le khana pachaune ras ra insulin hormone banauchha. insulin le ragat ma chini ko matra niyantran garchha.
pittathaili ko kaam bhana
pittathaili (gallbladder) le kalejo le baneko pitta sanchit garchha. chillo khana aauda yasle pitta saano aandra ma pathaera chillo pachauna maddat garchha.
mirgaula le k garchha?
mirgaula le ragat chhanera fohor ra badhi pani bata pisab banauchha. manchhe ma 2 wata simi aakar ka mirgaula hunchhan.
ek ota mirgaula le bachna sakinchha?
sakinchha, ek ota swastha mirgaula le pani sharir ko kaam chalauna sakchha. tyasaile kati manchhe le aafno ek mirgaula dan pani garchhan.
pisab thaili ko kaam k ho?
pisab thaili (bladder) le mirgaula bata aayeko pisab jamma garchha. bhariyepachhi dimag lai sanket pugchha ra hamilai pisab garna man lagchha.
appendix bhaneko k ho?
appendix thulo aandra sanga jodiyeko saano aunla jasto thaili ho. yasma sujan aaye (appendicitis) pet ko daahine tala dukhchha ra prayah operation garnu parchha.
insulin kun ang le banauchha?
insulin agnyashaya (pancreas) le banauchha. yasle ragat ko chini lai koshika bhitra pasna dinchha.
adrenaline kahile badhchha?
dar laagda, rish uthda ya achanak khatara aauda adrenaline badhchha. yasle mutu chhito dhadkauchha ra sharir lai bhagna ya ladna tayar banauchha.
koshika bhaneko k ho?
koshika (cell) jiwan ko sabai bhanda saano ekai ho. hamro sharir kharbau koshika le baneko chha, jastai chhala, ragat ra snayu ka koshika.
DNA bhaneko k ho?
DNA bhaneko koshika bhitra rahane jiv ko bhanta (genetic) nirdesh ho. hamle aama ra buwa dubai bata aadha aadha DNA paauchhau, tyasaile unjasta dekhinchhau.
jumlyaha bachcha kasari hunchhan?
ek ota garbha ko anda dui bhag bhaye ekdam ustai dekhine (identical) jumlyaha hunchhan. duita alag anda bata bhaye ustai nadekhine (fraternal) jumlyaha hunchhan.
aunla ko chhaap sabai ko farak hunchha?
hunchha, harek manchhe ko aunla ko chhaap (fingerprint) farak hunchha, ekdam ustai jumlyaha ko pani. tyasaile pahichan ko lagi fingerprint prayog garinchha.
debre haat le lekhne manchhe kati hunchhan?
sansar ma lagbhag 10 pratishat manchhe debre haat le lekhchhan. dherai jaso manchhe daahine haat bata kaam garchhan.
hamle kina hachhyun garchhau?
naak bhitra dhulo, dhuwa ya kitanu pasda sharir le chhitai hawa le dhakelera bahira nikalna hachhyun garchha. hachhyun garda rumal ya kuhina le mukh chhopnu parchha.
khoki kina lagchha?
khoki le ghaanti ra sas nali ma bhayeko singan, dhulo ya kitanu bahira nikalchha. yo sharir ko bachau garne tarika ho.
hikka kina aauchha?
hikka (hiccup) diaphragm mamsapeshi achanak khumchida aauchha ra sangai ghaanti ko dwar banda bhayera "hik" aawaj aauchha. chhito khane ya ghutukka pine garda dherai aauchha.
jado ma raun kina thadinchha?
jado ya dar laagda raun ko jara ma bhayeka saana mamsapeshi khumchinchhan ra raun thadinchha. jaslai "kaanda umrinu" pani bhaninchha.
jado ma sharir kina kaapchha?
kaapda mamsapeshi chhito chhito chalchhan ra garmi banchha. yasari sharir le aafai lai nyano banauna khojchha.
pasina kina aauchha?
pasina sharir lai chiso banauna aauchha. pasina chhala bata bafa bhayera udda sangai garmi lagera jaanchha.
tirkha kina lagchha?
sharir ma pani kam hunda dimag le tirkha ko sanket dinchha. pasina aaune, garmi ra nunilo khana le tirkha badhauchha.
byayam garda mutu kina chhito dhadkinchha?
byayam garda mamsapeshi lai badhi oxygen ra shakti chahinchha. mutu chhito dhadkera badhi ragat pathauchha ra hami pani chhito sas ferchhau.
byayam pachhi mamsapeshi kina dukhchha?
naya ya kada byayam garda mamsapeshi ma saana saana chot lagchhan ra 1-2 din dukhna sakchha. aaram garda mamsapeshi marmat bhayera jhan baliyo hunchha.
chot lageko thau nilo kina hunchha?
chot lagda chhala muni ka saana ragat nali futera ragat jammaa hunchha, tyasaile niilo ya kalo dekhinchha. ragat bistarai tutdai jaanda rang pahelo-hariyo hudai harainchha.
ghau ma pakra (scab) kina banchha?
ghau ma platelet ra ragat ko protein le jaali banayera ragat jamauchha ra sukera pakra banchha. pakra le ghau lai kitanu bata jogauchha, tyasaile nakotyaunus.
oxygen kina chahinchha sharir lai?
sharir ka koshika le khana bata shakti nikalna oxygen prayog garchhan. oxygen bina dimag ka koshika kehi minet mai marna thalchhan.
hami din bhari kati choti aankha jhimkauchhau?
sadharan rup ma hamle ek minet ma lagbhag 15 dekhi 20 choti aankha jhimkauchhau. screen herda jhimkaune kam hunchha, tyasaile aankha sukkhina sakchha.
aansu kina aauchha?
aansu le aankha lai bhijauchha, sapha rakhchha ra kitanu bata jogauchha. dukha, khushi ya dhuwa le pani dherai aansu aauna sakchha.
ragat chap ko mathi ra tala ko number k ho?
ragat chap ko mathi ko number mutu dhadkinda ko chap ra tala ko number mutu aaram garda ko chap ho. thulo manchhe ko lagi lagbhag 120/80 lai sadharan maninchha.
sharir ko sadharan tapkram kati hunchha?
sharir ko sadharan tapkram lagbhag 37 degree celsius (98.6 degree fahrenheit) hunchha. din bhari yo thorai mathi tala hunchha.
sharir ma kati pratishat pani hunchha?
thulo manchhe ko sharir ko lagbhag 60 pratishat bhag pani hunchha. tyasaile pani pugne gari piunu dherai jaruri chha.
bachcha kahile badhi hurkinchha?
bachcha gahiro nidra ma huda sharir le badhi growth hormone chhodchha. tyasaile ramro nidra bachcha ko bikas ko lagi jaruri chha.
haddi baliyo banauna k garne?
haddi baliyo banauna calcium bhayeko khana (dudh, dahi, hariyo saag), vitamin D ko lagi ghaam ra niyamit byayam jaruri chha. hidne, daudne ra uffrine khel le haddi baliyo banauchha.
rog pratirodhak shakti bhaneko k ho?
rog pratirodhak shakti bhaneko sharir le kitanu sanga ladne kshamata ho. ramro khana, nidra, byayam ra khop le yo shakti badhauchha.
antibody bhaneko k ho?
antibody seto ragat koshika le banaune protein ho, jasle bishesh kitanu lai chinera nasta garna maddat garchha. khop le pani sharir lai antibody banauna sikauchha.
allergy kina hunchha?

allergy ma sharir ko rog pratirodhak pranali le dhulo, phool ko dhulo (pollen) ya kunai khana jasta haani nagarne kura lai kitanu jastai thanera badhi pratikriya dinchha. hachhyun, chilaune ya dana aaune yasko lakshan hun.
dam (asthma) bhaneko k ho?
dam bhaneko sas nali khumchiyera sas ferna garo hune rog ho. dhuwa, dhulo ra chiso le yo badhna sakchha, ra doctor le diyeko inhaler le niyantran garna maddat garchha.
aankha ko lagi raati padhda batti kina chahinchha?
kam ujyalo ma padhda aankha le dherai mehenat garnu parchha ra chhitai thakchha. ramro ujyalo ma padhda aankha lai aaram hunchha.
lamo samaya basera kaam garda k garnu parchha?
lamo samaya basda hareka 30-60 minet ma uthera ali hidnus ra sharir tannus. kursi ma dhaad sidha rakhera basnus ra screen aankha ko satah ma rakhnus.
man thik nabhaye k garne?

man dukhi, chinta ya tanab ma bhaye aafno bharosa ko manchhe sanga kura garnus. lamo samaya samma yasto bhayo bhane swasthya karmi ya manobid sanga salah linu ramro hunchha; man ko swasthya pani sharir jastai mahatwapurna chha.
pet dukhda kahile aspatal jane?
pet dherai dukhyo, jworo sangai aayo, ragat bhayeko disa ya baanta bhayo, ya dukhai badhdai gayo bhane chhito aspatal jaanus. pet ko daahine tala dherai dukhnu appendix ko lakshan huna sakchha.
haat le chhuna nahune aankha ma dhulo paryo bhane k garne?
aankha nakotyaunus, sapha pani le aankha bistarai pakhaalnus. dhulo nanikle ya aankha rato ra dukhne bhaye doctor kaha jaanus.
bachcha ko aankha ko jaanch kina garaunu parchha?
saana bachcha le aafno najar kamjor chha bhanera bhanna sakdainan. school jana suru garda ek choti aankha jaanch garaye padhai ma samasya hunu agadi nai thaha hunchha.
how many bones does an adult human have?
An adult human has 206 bones. Babies are born with about 300, and some of them join together as the body grows.
how many chambers does the human heart have
The human heart has 4 chambers: two atria at the top and two ventricles at the bottom.
what is the biggest organ inside the body?
The liver is the biggest organ inside the body. It cleans the blood, makes bile and stores energy.
What do kidneys do?
The kidneys clean the blood by removing waste and extra water, which leaves the body as urine. Most people have two kidneys.
What is the normal body temperature?
Normal body temperature is about 37 degrees Celsius, or 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit.
which blood group is the universal donor?
O negative is called the universal donor, because its red blood cells can be given to people of any blood group in an emergency.
what is the smallest bone in the body?
The smallest bone is the stapes, in the middle ear. It helps carry sound to the inner ear.
what are the five basic tastes?
The 5 basic tastes are sweet, sour, salty, bitter and umami. Spicy heat is a feeling of burning, not a basic taste.
aankha ma kun bhag le prakash lai focus garchha?
aankha ma lens le prakash lai focus garchha. lens le retina ma sapha chitra banauna maddat garchha.
dimag kati gahrungo hunchha?
thulo manchhe ko dimag lagbhag 1.3 dekhi 1.4 kilo gahrungo hunchha. sharir ko tulna ma saano bhaye pani yasle dherai shakti khanchha.
sharir ma sabai bhanda dherai shakti kun ang le khanchha?
aaram ma basda sharir le khane shakti ko lagbhag 20 pratishat dimag le prayog garchha. dimag sharir ko saano bhag bhaye pani dherai shakti chahine ang ho.
mamsapeshi kati prakar ka hunchhan?
mamsapeshi 3 prakar ka hunchhan: haddi sanga jodiyeka (chalaauna sakine), mutu ko mamsapeshi ra pet-aandra jasta bhitri ang ko mamsapeshi. mutu ko mamsapeshi kahilyai nathaki chaliraha hunchha.
ragat kina rato hunchha?
ragat ko rato rang rato ragat koshika ma bhayeko haemoglobin le dinchha. haemoglobin ma falam (iron) hunchha, jasle oxygen samatchha.
shira niilo dekhinchha, ke ragat niilo hunchha?
hudaina, manchhe ko ragat sadhai rato hunchha. shira chhala muni bata herda niilo dekhinchha kinabhane prakash chhala ma pasdaa rang farak dekhinchha.
haai kina aauchha?
haai kina aauchha bhanne kura bigyan ma ahile pani pura thaha chhaina. thakai, nidra ra arulai haai garda dekhda dherai aauchha bhanne chahi thaha chha.
prakash sanshleshan bhaneko k ho?
prakash sanshleshan bhaneko biruwa le ghaam ko prakash, pani ra carbon dioxide prayog garera aafno khana (glucose) banaune prakriya ho. yo kram ma biruwa le oxygen bahira chhodchha.
biruwa ko paat hariyo kina hunchha?
biruwa ko paat ma chlorophyll bhanne hariyo rang padartha hunchha. yasle ghaam ko prakash samatchha ra hariyo rang farkauchha, tyasaile paat hariyo dekhinchha.
biruwa ko jara le k kaam garchha?
jara le mato bata pani ra khanij tatva sosera biruwa lai dinchha. jara le biruwa lai jamin ma baliyo gari samatera pani rakhchha.
kaand (stem) ko kaam k ho?
kaand le biruwa lai thadho rakhchha ra jara bata aayeko pani paat samma puryauchha. paat ma baneko khana pani kaand hudai aru bhag ma jaanchha.
paat le k kaam garchha?
paat biruwa ko bhansa jastai ho, yaha ghaam ko prakash prayog garera khana banchha. paat ka saana pwal (stomata) bata hawa bhitra-bahira hunchha.
biruwa le pani kasari bahira falchha?
biruwa ko paat ka saana pwal bata pani bafa bhayera udchha, yaslai transpiration (wasperotsarjan) bhaninchha. yasle jara bata pani mathi tanna maddat garchha.
biu umrina k k chahinchha?
biu umrina pani, hawa (oxygen) ra uchit tapkram chahinchha. dherai biu lai suru ma ghaam chahindaina, tara biruwa umrepachhi prakash chahinchha.
parag sechan (pollination) bhaneko k ho?
parag sechan bhaneko phool ko parag (pollen) eutai ya arko phool ko strikesar ma pugne prakriya ho. maha, putali, charaa ra hawa le yo kaam garchhan, ani phal ra biu banchha.
phool rangin ra baasna aaune kina hunchhan?
rangin ra baasna aaune phool le maha ra putali jasta kira lai aakarshit garchhan. kira ras khana aauda parag ek phool bata arko ma puryauchhan.
biu kasari tadha samma pugchhan?
biu hawa (jastai kapas jasto halka biu), pani (jastai nariwal), janawar (phal khayera biu chhodne) ra aafai futera tadha pugchhan. yasari naya thau ma biruwa umrinchha.
bans rukh ho ki ghaans?
bans ghaans jaati ko biruwa ho, rukh haina. yo sansar ma sabai bhanda chhito badhne biruwa madhye ek ho.
cactus ma kada kina hunchha?
cactus ko kada wastav ma bigreko paat ho. sano kada le pani kam udna dinchha ra janawar lai khana dinna, ani cactus ko mota kaand le pani sanchit garchha.
kira khane biruwa pani hunchha?
hunchha, pitcher plant ra venus flytrap jasta biruwa le kira samatera khanchhan. yinle kam poshak bhayeko mato ma kira bata nitrogen pura garchhan.
sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo rukh kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo rukh america ko california ma paine redwood ho. sabai bhanda aglo redwood lagbhag 115 meter aglo chha.
mal ma NPK bhaneko k ho?
NPK bhaneko nitrogen, phosphorus ra potassium ho. nitrogen le paat hariyo banauchha, phosphorus le jara ra phool lai ra potassium le biruwa lai rog sanga ladna maddat garchha.
compost mal kasari banchha?
compost mal bhansa ko sabji ko bokra, paat, gobar ra ghaans jasta kuhine fohor lai khaldo ya bhando ma rakhera kuhayera banchha. yo mato ko lagi prakritik ra sasto mal ho.
gedagudi ko kheti le mato kasari mal dinchha?
gedagudi (dal, bhatmas, kerau) ko jara ma saana gaanth hunchhan jasma bacteria le hawa bata nitrogen linchhan. yasle mato ma nitrogen thapchha ra mato urbar banauchha.
bali chakra (crop rotation) kina garinchha?
ekai khet ma barsenu farak farak bali lagauda mato ko poshak tatva santulit rahanchha ra rog-kira kam lagchha. jastai dhan pachhi gahu ya gedagudi lagaune.
lajjawati ko paat kina band hunchha?
lajjawati ko paat chhuda paat ko jara najik ko koshika bata pani chhitai sarne bhayeko le paat khumchinchha. kehi samaya pachhi paat feri khulchha.
chyau (mushroom) biruwa ho?
haina, chyau biruwa haina, yo dhusi (fungi) samuha ma parchha. yasle prakash sanshleshan gardaina ra kuhine kura bata khana linchha.
jangal ko chyau khanu kina khatarnak?
kehi jangali chyau dherai bishalu hunchhan ra khane chyau sanga ustai dekhinchhan. chinna nasakeko jangali chyau kahilyai nakhanus, bajar ko kheti gareko chyau matra khanus.
rukh ko umer kasari thaha paaune?
rukh kaatda kaand ma gol gol ghero (barsik chakra) dekhinchha. dherai jaso harek barsa euta ghero thapinchha, tyasaile ghero gane rukh ko umer thaha hunchha.
sadabahar rukh bhaneko k ho?
sadabahar rukh bhaneko barsabhari hariyo paat rahane rukh ho, jastai sallo. jun rukh ko paat kunai ritu ma sabai jharchha, tyaslai patjhad rukh bhaninchha.
sallo ko paat kasto hunchha?
sallo ko paat lamo, patalo ra suiro jasto hunchha. yasle pani kam udna dinchha ra hiu pani chhitai chiplera jharchha.
rukh le hamilai k k dinchha?
rukh le oxygen, chhahari, phal, daura ra kath dinchha. rukh ko jara le mato samatera pahiro rokchha ra rukh janawar ko ghar pani ho.
nepal ma gahu kahile lagauchhan?
nepal ma gahu dherai jaso kartik-mangsir tira chhariinchha ra chaitra-baisakh tira kaatinchha. yo hiundo ko bali ho.
dhan ropain kahile hunchha?
nepal ma dhan ropain dherai jaso asar-shrawan ma hunchha, monsoon ko pani sangai. asar 15 lai rastriya dhan diwas pani bhaninchha.
tori ko kheti kahile hunchha?
terai ma tori dherai jaso hiundo ma lagainchha ra mangsir-poush tira khet pahelo phool le dhakinchha. tori bata tel nikalinchha.
tulsi ko biruwa ghar ma kina rakhchhan?
hindu dharma ma tulsi lai pavitra maninchha ra ghar ko aagan ma tulsi ko moth banaera puja garinchha. tulsi ko paat chiya ma pani halne chalan chha.
pipal ko rukh kina pavitra maninchha?
hindu ra bauddha dubai le pipal lai pavitra manchhan. buddha lai pipal ko rukh muni gyan prapta bhayeko thiyo, tyasaile yaslai bodhi briksha pani bhaninchha.
bar ra pipal chautari ma kina ropinchha?
bar ra pipal thula ra dherai chhahari dine rukh hun, ra lamo samaya samma bachchhan. tyasaile bato ko chautari ma baatoghatu lai aaram ko lagi yinlai ropinchha.
chiraito kina khanchhan?
chiraito nepal ko himali ra pahadi kshetra ma paine tito jadibuti ho. paramparik rup ma jworo ra pet ko samasya ma yasko pani piune chalan chha.
neem ko rukh kina prasiddha chha?
neem ko paat ra hango tito hunchha ra paramparik aushadhi ma prayog hunchha. pahile pahile neem ko hango le daat maajne chalan pani thiyo.
suryamukhi phool kina surya tira farkinchha?
saano suryamukhi biruwa ko tuppo din bhari ghaam lai pachhyaudai purba bata pashchim tira ghumchha. phool pura fulisakepachhi dherai jaso purba tira farkera rahanchha.
kun kun bali lai ghaans parivar bhanchhan?
dhan, gahu, makai, jau ra ukhu sabai ghaans parivar ka bali hun. sansar ka manchhe ko mukhya khana yahi parivar bata aauchha.
janawar lai kasari samuha ma baadinchha?
janawar lai dhaad ko haddi bhayeka (merudandi) ra nabhayeka (amerudandi) ma baadinchha. merudandi bhitra stanadhari, charaa, sarisrip, ubhayachar ra machha parchhan.
stanadhari janawar ka gun k k hun?
stanadhari janawar ko sharir ma raun hunchha, uniharu dherai jaso bachcha janmauchhan ra bachcha lai dudh khuwauchhan. manchhe, gai, kukur ra hatti stanadhari hun.
sarisrip (reptile) bhaneko k ho?
sarisrip bhaneko khata bhayeko chhala bhayeka, anda parne ra chiso ragat bhayeka janawar hun. sarpa, chhepaaro, gohi ra kachhuwa sarisrip hun.
ubhayachar bhaneko kun janawar?
ubhayachar bhaneko pani ra jamin dubai ma bachne janawar ho, jastai bhyaguto. yinko bachcha (bhyaguto ko bhyagute machha) pani ma janmanchha ra pachhi jamin ma pani aauna sakchha.
kira ko kati wata khutta hunchhan?
kira (insect) ko 6 wata khutta hunchhan ra sharir 3 bhag ma baadiyeko hunchha: tauko, chhati ra pet. maha, kamila ra putali kira hun.
makura kira ho?
haina, makura kira haina. makura ko 8 wata khutta hunchhan ra yo arachnid samuha ma parchha, jabaki kira ko 6 khutta hunchhan.
putali ko jiwan chakra kasto hunchha?
putali ko jiwan chakra ma 4 charan hunchhan: anda, larva (jhusil kira), pupa (kosh) ra wayaska putali. jhusil kira kosh bhitra badalinera putali banchha.
bhyaguto ko jiwan chakra bhana
bhyaguto pani ma anda parchha, anda bata puchhar bhayeko tadpole niskinchha. tadpole ko bistarai khutta aauchha, puchhar harauchha ra bhyaguto banchha.
laamkhutte ko kun le tokchha?
laamkhutte ko pothi le matra tokchha. anda banauna usle ragat ko protein chahinchha; bhale laamkhutte phool ko ras khanchha.
maha ko ghar ma ko ko hunchhan?
maha ko gharaa ma euta raani maha, dherai kaamdar maha (pothi) ra kehi bhale maha (drone) hunchhan. raani le anda parchhe ra kaamdar maha le ras jamma garne ra gharaa sapha garne kaam garchhan.
gadyaula lai kisan ko sathi kina bhanchhan?
gadyaula le mato bhitra khanne ra mato khayera chhodne mal le mato lai khukulo ra urbar banauchha. yasle mato ma hawa ra pani ramrari pasna dinchha.
charaa ko haddi kasto hunchha?
dherai charaa ko haddi bhitra khokro hunchha, tyasaile tiniharu halka hunchhan ra udna sajilo hunchha. yasko satta haddi bhitra hawa ka kotha hunchhan.
jado ma nepal ma kun charaa aauchhan?
jado ma uttar ka chiso desh bata dherai prawasi charaa nepal ka tal ra simsar ma aauchhan. koshi tappu ma jado ma hajarau prawasi charaa dekhinchhan.
ullu raati kasari dekhchha?
ullu ko aankha thulo hunchha ra kam ujyalo ma pani ramrari dekhchha. yasko kaan pani tikho hunchha ra yasle tauko lagbhag 270 degree samma ghumauna sakchha.
sugaa le kasari manchhe ko jasto bolchha?
sugaa le sunne aawaj ko nakkal garna sakchha. yasko ghaanti ra jibro ko banawat le shabda jasta aawaj nikalna maddat garchha, tara yasle shabda ko arth bujhdaina.
udna nasakne charaa kun kun hun?
shuturmurg (ostrich), penguin, emu ra kiwi udna nasakne charaa hun. shuturmurg chahi chhito daudna ra penguin pani ma paudina sipalu chhan.
sabai bhanda thulo charaa kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo charaa shuturmurg (ostrich) ho. yasko anda pani sabai charaa madhye sabai bhanda thulo hunchha.
sabai bhanda sano charaa kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda sano charaa cuba ko bee hummingbird ho. yo lagbhag 5 cm jati lamo hunchha.
nepal ma matra paine charaa kun ho?
nepal ma matra paine charaa kande bhyakur (spiny babbler) ho. yo pahadi jhadi ma basne saano khairo charaa ho.
nepal ma kati kisim ka charaa paainchhan?
nepal ma 800 bhanda badhi prajati ka charaa paainchhan. saano desh bhaye pani himal dekhi terai samma farak mausam bhayeko le yati dherai charaa chhan.
gidda kina ghatdai gayeka hun?

gidda (vulture) ghatnu ko thulo karan maru gai-bastu ko masu ma bhayeko diclofenac aushadhi thiyo, jun khada gidda marthe. aile yo aushadhi pashu ma prayog garna rokiyeko chha ra gidda sanrakshan ko kaam bhairahechha.
sharks machha ho ki stanadhari?
shark machha ho. yasle gills bata sas ferchha, jabaki whale ra dolphin stanadhari hun ra hawa ma sas ferchhan.
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo janawar kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo janawar blue whale ho. yo 30 meter jati lamo huna sakchha ra sansar ma aaja samma bacheka sabai janawar madhye sabai bhanda thulo ho.
jamin ma sabai bhanda thulo janawar?
jamin ma sabai bhanda thulo janawar africa ko hatti ho. hatti ko sundh le pani piune, khana tipne ra aawaj nikalne kaam garchha.
sabai bhanda aglo janawar kun?
sabai bhanda aglo janawar jiraf ho. yasko lamo ghaanti le aglo rukh ko paat khana sajilo banauchha.
sabai bhanda chhito daudne janawar kun ho?
sabai bhanda chhito daudne janawar cheetah ho. yasle chhoto doori ma 100 km prati ghanta bhanda badhi gati ma daudna sakchha.
sabai bhanda chhito udne charaa kun?
peregrine falcon (baaj) sabai bhanda chhito charaa ho. shikar samatna tala jhamtanda yasko gati 300 km prati ghanta bhanda badhi pugchha.
unt ko kubro ma pani hunchha?
hudaina, unt ko kubro ma pani haina, chillo (fat) sanchit hunchha. khana napaunda unt le yahi chillo bata shakti linchha.
kangaroo kaha paainchha?
kangaroo australia ma paainchha. pothi kangaroo le aafno bachcha lai pet ko thaili (pouch) ma rakhera hurkauchhe.
hiu bhaluko chhala kasto rang ko hunchha?
hiu bhalu (polar bear) ko raun seto dekhinchha tara chhala kalo hunchha. kalo chhala le ghaam ko garmi sosna maddat garchha.
baagh ko dharka sabai ko ustai hunchha?
hudaina, harek baagh ko dharka farak hunchha, manchhe ko aunla ko chhaap jastai. tyasaile camera ko photo bata baagh chinera ganna sakinchha.
sabai bhanda thulo biralo jaati ko janawar kun?
biralo parivar ko sabai bhanda thulo janawar baagh ho. sher (lion) yo bhanda ali saano hunchha.
sher jangal ma baschha?
sher lai "jangal ko raja" bhanchhan, tara sher dherai jaso africa ko ghaasebhumi (savanna) ma baschha, ghana jangal ma haina. sher samuha ma basne ekmatra biralo jaati ho.
gaida ko singh k le baneko hunchha?
gaida ko singh keratin le baneko hunchha, jun manchhe ko nang ra kapal ma pani hunchha. singh ko lagi gaida ko gaira kanuni shikar hunchha, tyasaile yasko sanrakshan jaruri chha.
sarpa ko aankha jhimkinchha?
sarpa ko aankha jhimkindaina, kinabhane sarpa ko aankha ma pallo (eyelid) hudaina. yasko aankha mathi paardarshi khol hunchha.
sarpa le jibro kina nikalchha?
sarpa le jibro nikalera hawa bata gandha ka kan samatchha ra mukh bhitra ko bishesh ang le gandha chinchha. yasari sarpa le shikar ra bato pattaa lagauchha.
nepal ma kun kun bishalu sarpa paainchhan?
nepal ma goman (cobra), karet (krait) ra russell's viper jasta bishalu sarpa paainchhan, khas gari terai ma. sarpa le tokda jhar-phuk ma samaya nafalnus, chhito aspatal jaanus.
sarpa ko kachuli kina fereinchha?
sarpa badhdai jaanda yasko purano chhala sano hunchha, tyasaile sarpa le samaya samaya ma pura chhala (kachuli) fereinchha. yasari naya chhala aauchha.
kachhuwa ra samudri kachhuwa ma farak?
jamin ma basne kachhuwa lai tortoise ra pani ma basne lai turtle bhaninchha. tortoise ko khutta mota hunchha bhane turtle ko khutta paudina milne chepto hunchha.
chamero le andhyaro ma kasari udchha?
chamero le aawaj nikalchha ra tyo aawaj kunai chij ma thokkiyera farkera aaune pratidhwani sunchha. yasari andhyaro ma pani bato ra kira pattaa lagauchha.
kukur ko naak kati tikho hunchha?
kukur ko sunghne shakti manchhe ko bhanda hajarau guna tikho hunchha. tyasaile prahari le apradhi ra aushadhi khojna kukur prayog garchha.
biralo ko junga ko kaam k ho?
biralo ko junga le waripari ko hawa ra chij chhuera thau ko andaaj lagauna maddat garchha. andhyaro ma saghuro thau bata nikalna sakchha ki sakdaina bhanera junga le bataunchha.
gai le jugali kina garchha?
gai ko pet ma 4 bhag hunchhan. gai le ghaans chhitai nilchha, pachhi tyo ghaans feri mukh ma lyayera chapauchha, yaslai jugali bhaninchha; yasle kada ghaans pachauna maddat garchha.
yak kasto thau ma baschha?
yak himal ko uchcha ra chiso thau ma baschha. yasko baklo lamo raun le chiso bata jogauchha ra yasle uchai ma pani gahrungo bhari bokna sakchha.
chauri bhaneko k ho?
chauri bhaneko yak ra gai ko misrit bachcha ho. yo yak bhanda kam uchai ma pani baschha ra dudh ra bhari bokna upayogi hunchha.
ghoda ubhiyera sutchha?
ghoda le khutta lock garera ubhiyera halka nidra lina sakchha. gahiro nidra ko lagi bhane ghoda pani bhui ma sutchha.
shitnidra (hibernation) bhaneko k ho?
shitnidra bhaneko kehi janawar le jado ma lamo samaya samma gahiro nidra jasto awastha ma bitaune ho. bhalu, sarpa ra bhyaguto jado ma khana napaune bela yasari shakti bachauchhan.
camouflage bhaneko k ho?
camouflage bhaneko janawar le aafno rang ya aakar le waripari mai lukne tarika ho. chameleon ko rang ferne ra baagh ko dharka yasko udaharan hun.
raati jagne janawar lai k bhanchhan?
diuso sutne ra raati shikar garne ya khana khojne janawar lai nishachar (nocturnal) bhaninchha. ullu, chamero ra chituwa nishachar janawar hun.
shakahari ra mansahari ko daat ma k farak hunchha?
shakahari janawar ko daat chepto ra thulo hunchha, jasle ghaans pisna maddat garchha. mansahari ko daat tikho ra lamo hunchha, jasle masu chyatna maddat garchha.
bighatak (decomposer) bhaneko k ho?
bighatak bhaneko marieka biruwa ra janawar lai kuhayera mato ma milaune jiv ho, jastai chyau, dhusi ra bacteria. yasle mato ma poshak tatva farkauchha.
dinosaur kahile lopa bhaye?
dherai jaso dinosaur lagbhag 6 crore 60 lakh barsa pahile lopa bhaye. tyo bela thulo ulka (asteroid) prithvi ma thokkiyeko thiyo bhanne manyata chha.
dodo charaa ko k bhayo?
dodo charaa mauritius tapu ma paine udna nasakne charaa thiyo. manchhe pugepachhi shikar ra aru janawar le garda 17 au shatabdi ma yo lopa bhayo.
nepal ma kun janawar lopa hune khatara ma chhan?
nepal ma baagh, ek singe gaida, habre, hiun chituwa, salak, ghadiyal gohi, sons ra gidda jasta janawar lopa hune khatara ma chhan. tyasaile yinko sanrakshan kanun le garinchha.
danfe kasto thau ma baschha?
danfe pahad ko mathillo bhag ra himal ko jangal ra ghaase maidan ma baschha. bhale danfe chamkilo rang ko ra pothi khairo rang ko hunchha.
kaag lai buddhimaan charaa kina bhanchhan?
kaag le samasya samadhan garna, auzar jasto chij prayog garna ra manchhe ko anuhar samjhana sakchha. tyasaile kaag lai buddhimaan charaa maninchha.
kamila kati baliyo hunchha?
kamila le aafno tauil bhanda dherai guna gahrungo chij bokna sakchha. kamila dherai thulo samuha (colony) ma milera kaam garchhan.
machha kasari sas ferchha bhana
machha le gills bata sas ferchha. pani mukh bata bhitra jaanchha ra gills le pani bata oxygen sosera ragat ma pathauchha.
machha sutchha?
machha pani aaram garchha, tara dherai machha ko aankha band hune pallo hudaina. aaram garda tiniharu shanta bhayera ek thau ma rahanchhan.
octopus ko kati mutu hunchha?
octopus ko 3 wata mutu hunchhan ra yasko ragat niilo hunchha. yasko 8 wata haat (tentacle) hunchhan.
hatti kati barsa samma bachchha?
hatti prakritik rup ma dherai jaso 60-70 barsa samma bachna sakchha. hatti ko smaran shakti ramro hunchha bhanne bhanai pani chha.
kun janawar le paani kahilyai nakhayi lamo samaya bachna sakchha?
unt le pani nakhayi dherai din samma bachna sakchha. yasle ek choti ma dherai pani piuna sakchha ra sharir le pani kam gumauchha.
kun janawar ko gharaa kun ho bhanera bhana: maha, kukur, ghoda
maha ko ghar gharaa (hive), kukur ko ghar kennel ya khor, ra ghoda ko ghar tabela (stable) ho.
jhingaa ko kati aankha hunchhan?
jhingaa ko 2 wata thula aankha hunchhan, tara harek aankha hajarau saana aankha milera baneko hunchha. tyasaile jhingaa le charai tira chhitai dekhchha.
jun kira raati ujyalo dinchha tyo kun ho?
raati ujyalo dine kira juna kiri (firefly) ho. yasko pet ma rasaayanik prakriya le chiso ujyalo banchha.
what is photosynthesis in nepali?
Photosynthesis lai nepali ma prakash sanshleshan bhaninchha. biruwa le ghaam ko prakash, pani ra carbon dioxide bata khana banaune ra oxygen chhodne prakriya ho.
How many legs does an insect have?
An insect has 6 legs and a body in three parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
What is the largest animal on Earth?
The blue whale is the largest animal on Earth. It can grow to about 30 meters long.
is a bat a bird?
No, a bat is a mammal, not a bird. It has fur and feeds its babies milk, and it is the only mammal that can truly fly.
what is the only bird found only in Nepal?
The spiny babbler is the only bird species found only in Nepal. It lives in the bushy hill areas.
Why are plants green?
Plants are green because their leaves contain chlorophyll. Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light for photosynthesis and reflects green light.
how do seeds spread
Seeds spread by wind, water, animals and by bursting pods. For example, light fluffy seeds fly with the wind, and birds drop seeds after eating fruits.
dhan ko biruwa pani ma kina lagauchhan?

dhan ko biruwa pani jameko khet ma ramro hunchha kinabhane pani le jhaar badhna dinna ra dhan lai chahine chiso-tato santulan dinchha. tara dhan aafai pani bina pani ugna sakchha, pani le matra kheti sajilo banauchha.
biruwa le raati oxygen dinchha?
raati ghaam nahune bhayeko le biruwa le prakash sanshleshan gardaina, tyasaile oxygen dindaina. raati biruwa pani hami jastai thorai oxygen linchha ra carbon dioxide chhodchha.
phal ra tarkari ma k farak?
bigyan anusar phal phool bata baneko ra biu bhayeko bhag ho, jastai aanp, golbheda ra farsi. tarkari bhaneko biruwa ka aru bhag pani huna sakchhan, jastai saag (paat), aalu (kanda) ra gajar (jara).
alainchi kaha dherai falchha?
nepal ma alainchi purbi pahad, khas gari taplejung, ilam, panchthar ra sankhuwasabha ma dherai falchha. nepal thulo alainchi utpadan garne pramukh desh madhye ek ho.
rudraksha k ho?
rudraksha ek kisim ko rukh ko biu ho, jaslai hindu haru pavitra manchhan ra mala banayera lagauchhan. nepal ko purbi pahad ma rudraksha ko kheti hunchha.
sal ko rukh kun kshetra ma hunchha?
sal ko rukh terai, chure ra bhitri madhesh ko jangal ma dherai hunchha. yasko kath baliyo ra tikau hunchha.
jhaar bhaneko k ho?
jhaar bhaneko khet ma aafai umrine ra bali sanga pani, mal ra ujyalo ko lagi pratispardha garne nachahine biruwa ho. jhaar ukhelda bali ramro hunchha.
kira nashak bisadi dherai halda k hunchha?
dherai bisadi halda khana ma bish rahana sakchha, maha jasta upayogi kira marchhan ra mato ra pani dushit hunchha. sahi matra ma ra sahi samaya ma matra prayog garnu parchha.
maha kina mahatwapurna chhan kheti ma?
maha le parag sechan garera dherai bali ra phal falna maddat garchhan. maha nabhaye syau, tori ra dherai phalphul ko utpadan ghatchha.
chilaune biruwa sisnu le kina pollchha?
sisnu ko paat ra kaand ma saana raun hunchhan jasma chilaune ras hunchha. chhuda raun le chhala ma ras halchha ra polchha.
kera ko rukh rukh nai ho?
kera ko "rukh" wastav ma kath nabhayeko thulo naram biruwa (herb) ho, kinabhane yasko kaand kath ko hudaina. yo paat ka khol ek mathi arko gudulkiyera baneko hunchha.
ek singe gaida ko bachcha kati barsa aama sanga baschha?
ek singe gaida ko bachcha dherai jaso 2-3 barsa samma aama sanga baschha. tyas pachhi u aafai bachna sikchha.
habre ko arko naam k ho?
habre lai angreji ma red panda bhaninchha. yo biralo jatti ko saano rato-khairo janawar ho ra bans ko paat khanchha.
baagh kati din sammaa nakhai basna sakchha?
yo kura ko pakka sankhya ma bhanna sakdina. baagh le ek choti ma dherai masu khanchha ra kehi din samma shikar nagari basna sakchha bhanne chahi thaha chha.
monkey ra ape ma k farak?
monkey (bandar) ko dherai jaso puchhar hunchha, tara ape (gorilla, chimpanzee, orangutan) ko puchhar hudaina. ape haru monkey bhanda thula ra buddhimaan hunchhan.
chimpanzee manchhe sanga kati milchha?
chimpanzee manchhe ko sabai bhanda najik ko nata bhayeka janawar madhye ek ho. manchhe ra chimpanzee ko DNA dherai thulo bhag ma milchha.
penguin kaha baschha?
dherai penguin prithvi ko dakshini golardha ma, khas gari antarctica ra tyas najik baschhan. penguin udna sakdaina tara pani ma ramro paudinchha.
dolphin kasari sas ferchha?
dolphin le tauko mathi ko pwal (blowhole) bata hawa ma sas ferchha. yo stanadhari ho, tyasaile pani bhitra sas ferna sakdaina ra bich bich ma satah ma aauchha.
jal chakra bhaneko k ho?

jal chakra bhaneko pani samudra, nadi ra jamin bata bafa bhayera mathi jaane, badal banne ra pheri pani ya hiu bhayera jharne nirantar chakra ho. yasle prithvi ma pani ko matra lagbhag ustai rakhchha.
jal chakra ka charan haru bhana
jal chakra ka mukhya charan: bashpikaran (pani bafa banne), sanghanan (bafa chiso bhayera badal banne), barsha (pani ya hiu jharne) ra sankalan (pani nadi, tal ra samudra ma jamma hune).
badal kasari banchha?
ghaam le tataeko pani bafa bhayera mathi jaanchha. mathi hawa chiso hune bhayeko le bafa saana pani ka thopa ma badlinchha ra tyo thopa haru jammaa bhayera badal banchha.
pani kina parchha?
badal ka saana thopa haru milera thula ra gahrungo bhaepachhi hawa le tiniharu lai thamna sakdaina. tyasaile tiniharu pani ko rup ma jamin ma jharchhan.
kalo badal kina kalo dekhinchha?
kalo badal ma pani ka thopa dherai ra baklo hunchhan, jasle ghaam ko prakash lai chhirna dindaina. tyasaile tala bata herda kalo dekhinchha ra pani parne sambhawana badhi hunchha.
indreni kasari banchha?
ghaam ko prakash pani ka thopa bhitra pasda dhalkinchha, bhitra farkinchha ra bahira niskanda rang rang ma chhuttinchha. indreni sadhai ghaam ko ulto disha ma dekhinchha.
indreni ma kati rang hunchhan?
indreni ma 7 rang hunchhan: rato, suntala, pahelo, hariyo, niilo, gadha niilo (indigo) ra baijani. yo rang sadhai yahi kram ma dekhinchhan.
bijuli chamkinu ra garjanu ma kun pahila thaha hunchha?
bijuli ko chamak pahila dekhinchha ra garjan pachhi sunninchha. prakash aawaj bhanda dherai chhito yatra garchha, tyasaile yasto hunchha.
garjan kina hunchha?
chatyang parda tyo bato ko hawa ekdam chhitai dherai tatchha ra phailinchha. yo achanak phailine kram le thulo aawaj (garjan) banauchha.
chatyang ko bela k garnu hudaina?
chatyang ko bela aglo rukh muni basnu, khulla khet ma ubhinnu ra pani ma basnu hudaina. sakesamma pakki ghar bhitra basnus ra bijuli ka saman ko plug nikalnus.
kuiro (fog) kasari lagchha?
kuiro bhaneko jamin najik baneko badal jastai ho. raati jamin chiso huda najik ko hawa ko bafa saana pani ka thopa ma badlinchha ra kuiro lagchha.
shit (dew) kasari parchha?
raati ghaans ra paat chiso hunchhan, ra hawa ko bafa tyasma chhoyera pani ka thopa banchha. bihana paat ma dekhine yahi thopa lai shit bhaninchha.
tusaro kina parchha?
dherai chiso raati jamin ko tapkram 0 degree bhanda tala jaanda shit ko thopa jamera seto barf jasto banchha, yaslai tusaro bhaninchha. tusaro le bali lai noksan garna sakchha.
asina kasari banchha?
aandhi-badal bhitra pani ka thopa lai hawa le dherai mathi chiso thau samma lagchha, tyaha jamera barf banchha. barf ka dalla gahrungo bhaepachhi asina bhayera jharchha.
himal ma kina hiu parchha tara terai ma pardaina?
uchai badhdai jaanda hawa chiso hunchha. himal ma tapkram dherai tala hune bhayeko le pani ko satta hiu parchha, tara terai ma tapkram ucho hune bhayeko le pani nai parchha.
uchai badhda tapkram kati ghatchha?
sadharan rup ma har 1000 meter uchai badhda tapkram lagbhag 6.5 degree celsius ghatchha. tyasaile kathmandu bhanda nagarkot ra nagarkot bhanda himal chiso hunchha.
hawa kina chalchha?
ghaam le jamin ra samudra lai baraabar tataudaina. taato hawa mathi uthchha ra tyasko thau linna chiso hawa sarchha, yasari hawa chalchha.
monsoon nepal ma kahile aauchha?
nepal ma monsoon dherai jaso jestha ko antya dekhi asoj samma (june dekhi september) rahanchha. yo bangal ko khadi bata aaune osilo hawa le lyaunchha.
monsoon pahila nepal ko kun bhag ma pasdachha?
monsoon pahila nepal ko purbi bhag ma pasdachha ra bistarai pashchim tira sardachha. tyasaile purba ma pashchim bhanda pani dherai parchha.
nepal ko sabai bhanda dherai pani parne thau kun?
nepal ma sabai bhanda dherai pani parne thau madhye pokhara kshetra ra kaski ko lumle prasiddha chhan. annapurna himal le osilo hawa rokda yaha dherai pani parchha.
mustang ma kina kam pani parchha?
mustang himal ko uttar tira parchha. monsoon ko osilo hawa le himal kata sakdaina ra dherai pani himal ko dakshin pattai jharchha, tyasaile mustang sukkha rahanchha.
ritu kina farak farak hunchhan?
prithvi ko aksh lagbhag 23.5 degree le dhalkieko chha. prithvi surya ko waripari ghumda kahile uttari golardha ma ghaam sidha parchha ra garmi hunchha, kahile tirchhe parchha ra jado hunchha.
surya najik hune bela garmi hunchha bhanne sahi ho?
sahi haina. ritu prithvi ko dhalkieko aksh le garda hunchha, surya bata ko doori le haina. wastav ma prithvi january tira surya ko najik hunchha, tara tyo bela nepal ma jado hunchha.
nepal ma garmi ko bela australia ma k hunchha?
nepal ma garmi huda australia ma jado hunchha. nepal uttari golardha ma ra australia dakshini golardha ma bhayeko le ritu ulto hunchha.
sabai bhanda lamo din kahile hunchha?
uttari golardha ma sabai bhanda lamo din june 21 tira hunchha, nepali patro ma asar ko suru tira. yo bela din lamo ra raat chhoto hunchha.
sabai bhanda chhoto din kahile?
uttari golardha ma sabai bhanda chhoto din december 21-22 tira hunchha, nepali patro ma poush ko suru tira. yo bela raat sabai bhanda lamo hunchha.
din ra raat barabar hune din kahile parchha?
march 20 ra september 22-23 tira din ra raat lagbhag barabar hunchhan, yaslai bishuwat (equinox) bhaninchha. yo bela surya thik bhumadhya rekha mathi hunchha.
hiundo ma din kina chhoto hunchha?
hiundo ma hamro golardha surya bata ali par dhalkieko hunchha, tyasaile surya akash ma hocho bata ghumchha ra chhitai astauchha. yasaile din chhoto ra raat lamo hunchha.
mausam ra jalvayu ma k farak?
mausam bhaneko kunai thau ko aaja ya kehi din ko tapkram, pani ra hawa ko awastha ho. jalvayu bhaneko lamo samaya (dherai barsa) ko ausat mausam ho.
jalvayu parivartan bhaneko k ho?
jalvayu parivartan bhaneko prithvi ko lamo samaya ko tapkram ra mausam ko dhanchaa badalinu ho. koila, petrol ra gas jalauda niskine gyas le garmi rokda prithvi tatdai gayeko chha.
harit griha prabhav (greenhouse effect) k ho?

harit griha prabhav ma carbon dioxide jasta gyas le surya ko garmi lai prithvi ko waripari kambal jastai rokchha. yo prabhav le prithvi lai basna yogya nyano rakhchha, tara gyas dherai bhaye prithvi jhan tatchha.
himal ko hiu kina pagliraheko chha?
prithvi ko ausat tapkram badhdai gayeko le himnadi ra hiu dherai pagliraheko chha. yasle himtal futne khatara badhauchha ra bhabishya ma nadi ko pani ma pani asar parna sakchha.
tapkram kun yantra le naapinchha?
tapkram thermometer le naapinchha. jworo naapne thermometer ra kotha ko tapkram naapne thermometer farak hunchhan.
pani kati paryo bhanera kasari naapinchha?
pani kati paryo bhanera barsha mapak (rain gauge) le naapinchha. yasma jameko pani lai millimeter ma lekhinchha.
hawa ko gati kun yantra le naapchha?
hawa ko gati anemometer le naapinchha. yasma saana kachaura jasta pankha hawa le ghumauchhan.
hawa ko chap kasle naapchha?
hawa ko chap barometer le naapinchha. chap chhitai ghatnu kharab mausam aauna lageko sanket huna sakchha.
surya k ho?
surya euta tara (star) ho, jun dherai taato gyas ko bishal golo ho. yasle prithvi lai prakash ra garmi dinchha.
surya prithvi bata kati tadha chha?
surya prithvi bata lagbhag 15 crore kilometer (150 million km) tadha chha. yati tadha bhaye pani yasko prakash ra garmi hamisamma aauchha.
surya ko prakash prithvi samma aauna kati samaya lagchha?
surya ko prakash prithvi samma aauna lagbhag 8 minet 20 second lagchha. tyasaile hamle herne surya 8 minet aghi ko surya ho.
surya k le baneko chha?
surya mukhya rup ma hydrogen ra helium gyas le baneko chha. yasko bhitra hydrogen milera helium banda dherai urja niskinchha, jasle surya lai chamkilo banauchha.
surya purba bata kina ulaauchha?
prithvi pashchim bata purba tira ghumchha. tyasaile hamilai surya purba bata ulaayera pashchim tira astaye jasto dekhinchha.
saurya mandal ma kati graha chhan?
saurya mandal ma 8 wata graha chhan: budh, shukra, prithvi, mangal, brihaspati, shani, arun (uranus) ra varun (neptune).
pluto graha ho?
pahile pluto lai 9 au graha manninthyo, tara 2006 ma bigyan haru le yaslai "bauna graha" (dwarf planet) ma rakhe. aile saurya mandal ma 8 graha matra ganinchhan.
sabai bhanda thulo graha kun ho?
saurya mandal ko sabai bhanda thulo graha brihaspati (jupiter) ho. yasma 1000 bhanda badhi prithvi atauna sakchhan.
sabai bhanda sano graha kun ho?
saurya mandal ko sabai bhanda sano graha budh (mercury) ho. yo surya ko sabai bhanda najik ko graha pani ho.
sabai bhanda taato graha kun ho?
sabai bhanda taato graha shukra (venus) ho, budh haina. shukra ko baklo carbon dioxide ko waayu mandal le garmi rokchha, tyasaile yaha budh bhanda pani garmi hunchha.
mangal graha lai rato graha kina bhanchhan?
mangal ko mato ra dhunga ma falam ko khiya (iron oxide) dherai hunchha. yasle mangal lai rato-khairo dekhauchha.
kun graha ko sundar ghero (ring) chha?
shani (saturn) ko sabai bhanda sundar ra spashta ghero chha, jun hiu ra dhunga ka tukra le baneko hunchha. brihaspati, arun ra varun ko pani patalo ghero chha, tara dekhna garo hunchha.
prithvi surya bata kati au graha ho?
prithvi surya bata tesro graha ho. budh ra shukra pachhi prithvi aauchha.
prithvi le ek choti surya ko parikrama garna kati din lagauchha?
prithvi le surya ko ek choti parikrama garna lagbhag 365 din 6 ghanta lagauchha. tyo 6 ghanta jodiyera 4 barsa ma 1 din banchha, tyasaile leap year ma february ma 29 din hunchha.
prithvi aafno aksh ma ek choti ghumna kati samaya lagauchha?
prithvi aafno aksh ma ek choti ghumna lagbhag 24 ghanta lagauchha. yasaile din ra raat hunchha.
jun (moon) prithvi bata kati tadha chha?
jun prithvi bata lagbhag 3 lakh 84 hajar kilometer (384400 km) tadha chha. yo prithvi ko ekmatra prakritik upagraha ho.
jun aafai chamkinchha?
chamkindaina, jun ko aafno prakash chhaina. jun le surya ko prakash farkauchha, tyasaile raati chamkilo dekhinchha.
jun ko aakar kina badalinchha?
jun le prithvi ko parikrama garda yasko surya le ujyaleko bhag hamle kahile thorai, kahile aadha ra kahile pura dekhchhau. yasaile jun ko aakar badaliye jasto dekhinchha.
aunsi ra purnima ko bich kati din hunchha?
aunsi dekhi purnima samma lagbhag 15 din lagchha. jun ko pura chakra (aunsi dekhi aunsi) lagbhag 29.5 din ko hunchha.
aunsi ma jun kina dekhidaina?
aunsi ma jun surya ra prithvi ko bich tira hunchha, ra jun ko ujyalo bhag surya tira farkeko hunchha. tyasaile prithvi bata jun ko andhyaro bhag matra parchha ra jun dekhidaina.
jun ko eutai bhag matra kina dekhinchha?
jun le aafno aksh ma ghumna ra prithvi ko parikrama garna lagbhag ustai samaya lagauchha. tyasaile jun ko eutai bhag sadhai prithvi tira farkeko hunchha.
samudra ma jwar bhata kina aauchha?
jun ra surya ko gurutwakarshan le samudra ko pani lai tanchha. jun najik hune bhayeko le yasko tanai badhi hunchha ra samudra ko pani din ma duita choti badhchha ra ghatchha.
jun ma gurutwakarshan kati hunchha?
jun ko gurutwakarshan prithvi ko lagbhag 1/6 bhag matra hunchha. tyasaile prithvi ma 60 kg ko manchhe jun ma 10 kg jati halka mahasus hunchha.
jun ma pahilo choti ko pugeka thiye?
jun ma pahilo choti neil armstrong pugeka thiye, 1969 july 20 ma apollo 11 mission bata. unko sathi buzz aldrin pani jun ma utreka thiye.
antariksha ma jane pahilo manchhe ko?
antariksha ma jane pahilo manchhe soviet sangh ka yuri gagarin hun. unle 1961 april 12 ma prithvi ko parikrama gare.
antariksha jane pahili mahila ko thiin?
antariksha jane pahili mahila soviet sangh ki valentina tereshkova hun. uni 1963 ma antariksha gaeki thiin.
surya grahan kahile lagchha?
surya grahan jun surya ra prithvi ko thik bich ma aauda lagchha. jun ko chhaya prithvi ma parchha, tyasaile yo aunsi ko din matra lagna sakchha.
chandra grahan kasari lagchha?
chandra grahan prithvi surya ra jun ko thik bich ma aauda lagchha. prithvi ko chhaya jun ma parchha, tyasaile yo purnima ko raati matra lagna sakchha.
surya grahan aankha le sidhai herna hunchha?
hudaina, surya grahan sidhai aankha le herda aankha ko retina jalna sakchha. surya herne bishesh chashma ya projector bidhi prayog garera matra hernus.
tara kina timtimaauchhan?
tara ko prakash prithvi ko waayu mandal bata aauda hawa ka tah haru le dhalkauchhan. hawa chalirahane bhayeko le prakash halliye jasto dekhinchha ra tara timtimaye jasto lagchha.
khasne tara (shooting star) k ho?
khasne tara wastav ma tara haina, antariksha bata aayeko saano dhunga ya dhulo ko tukra ho. yo prithvi ko waayu mandal ma ekdam chhito pasda jalera chamkinchha.
hamro akash ganga ko naam k ho?
hamro akash ganga (galaxy) ko naam milky way ho. yasma arbau tara chhan ra hamro surya pani tyasmadhye ek ho.
dhruva tara kun disha ma dekhinchha?
dhruva tara (pole star) uttar disha ma dekhinchha. yo akash ma lagbhag ek thau mai rahane bhayeko le pahila pahila yatri haru disha pattaa lagauna yasko prayog garthe.
bihani tara bhaneko kun ho?
bihani tara bhaneko wastav ma shukra graha ho. yo surya ulaunu agadi ya astae pachhi akash ma sabai bhanda chamkilo dekhinchha.
prakash ko gati kati chha?
prakash ko gati lagbhag 3 lakh kilometer prati second chha. yo sansar ma sabai bhanda chhito chalne kura ho.
prakash barsha (light year) bhaneko k ho?
prakash barsha bhaneko prakash le ek barsa ma yatra garne doori ho, samaya haina. yo lagbhag 9460 arab kilometer (9.46 trillion km) hunchha.
antariksha ma aawaj kina sunninna?
aawaj lai yatra garna hawa ya kunai madhyam chahinchha. antariksha ma hawa nahune bhayeko le aawaj sunna sakidaina.
antariksha yatri antariksha ma kina tairinchhan?
antariksha station ma pani gurutwakarshan hunchha, tara station ra yatri dubai sangai lagatar prithvi tira khasdai ghumirahechhan. yasaile yatri ra saman tairiye jasto dekhinchhan.
upagraha (satellite) k ho?
upagraha bhaneko kunai graha ko waripari ghumne kura ho. jun prakritik upagraha ho, ra manchhe le banayeka upagraha le TV, phone, mausam ra GPS ko kaam garchhan.
nepal ko pahilo upagraha kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo upagraha nepalisat-1 ho, jun 2019 ma antariksha ma pathaiyeko thiyo. yo nepali bigyan haru le japan ma banayeka thiye.
ulka ra dhumaketu ma k farak?
ulka (meteor) antariksha bata aayeko saano dhunga ho jun waayu mandal ma jalchha. dhumaketu (comet) hiu ra dhulo le baneko thulo kura ho, jun surya najik aauda lamo chamkilo puchhar dekhinchha.
prithvi ko waayu mandal ma k k gyas chhan?
prithvi ko hawa ma lagbhag 78 pratishat nitrogen, 21 pratishat oxygen ra baki 1 pratishat ma argon, carbon dioxide ra aru gyas chhan.
ozone tah ko kaam k ho?
ozone tah le surya bata aaune haanikarak ultraviolet kiran lai rokchha. yo tah nabhaye chhala ko cancer ra aankha ko rog badhna sakchha.
aakash niilo kina dekhinchha?
surya ko prakash ma sabai rang hunchhan. hawa ka saana kan le niilo prakash lai aru rang bhanda dherai charai tira chhariidinchhan, tyasaile aakash niilo dekhinchha.
surya astaauda aakash rato kina hunchha?
surya astaauda yasko prakash le hawa ko lamo bato pargarnu parchha. bato ma niilo prakash chhariera harauchha ra rato-suntala prakash matra hamisamma aauchha.
raati aakash kalo kina hunchha?
raati hamro bhag surya bata ulto tira farkeko hunchha, tyasaile surya ko prakash hawa ma chhariidaina. tyasaile aakash kalo dekhinchha ra tara haru dekhinchhan.
bhumadhya rekha najik kina garmi hunchha?
bhumadhya rekha najik barsabhari surya ko kiran lagbhag sidha parchha. sidha parne kiran le sano thau ma dherai garmi dinchha, tyasaile tyaha sadhai garmi hunchha.
dhruva ma kina dherai jado hunchha?
dhruva (pole) ma surya ko kiran dherai tirchhe parchha ra garmi thulo thau ma phailinchha. hiu le pani prakash farkaune bhayeko le tyaha ekdam jado hunchha.
hiundo ma bihana kuiro kina dherai lagchha terai ma?
hiundo ma terai ko jamin raati chhitai chiso hunchha ra najik ko hawa osilo hunchha. yasle bihana bakhlo kuiro banauchha, jaslai sitlahar ko bela jhan dherai mahasus garinchha.
sitlahar bhaneko k ho?
sitlahar bhaneko terai ma hiundo ma kaiyau din samma bakhlo kuiro lagera ghaam nalagne ra ekdam chiso hune awastha ho. yo bela garib, budha-budhi ra bachcha lai bishesh khyal garnu parchha.
lu (garmi ko hawa) kahile chalchha?
terai ma chaitra-jestha tira sukkha ra taato hawa (lu) chalchha. yo bela dherai pani piune ra diuso ko ghaam bata bachne garnu parchha.
aandhi-huri kina aauchha?
garmi ma jamin dherai tatda taato hawa chhitai mathi uthchha ra baklo badal banchha. yasto badal bata tej hawa, chatyang ra bhari pani sangai aauna sakchha, jaslai aandhi-huri bhaninchha.
bhumadhya rekha k ho?
bhumadhya rekha prithvi ko thik bich ma purba-pashchim taniyeko kalpanik rekha ho. yasle prithvi lai uttari ra dakshini golardha ma baadchha.
akshansh ra deshantar k ho?

akshansh (latitude) le bhumadhya rekha bata uttar ya dakshin kati tadha bhanne janauchha. deshantar (longitude) le greenwich bata purba ya pashchim kati tadha bhanne janauchha; yi dubai le kunai thau ko thegana bataunchhan.
GMT bhaneko k ho?

GMT bhaneko greenwich mean time ho, london ko greenwich bata naapine samaya. sansar ka arka samaya kshetra GMT bhanda kati aghi ya pachhi chhan bhanera bhaninchha, nepal GMT bhanda 5 ghanta 45 minet aghi chha.
earth kati purano chha?
bigyan anusar prithvi lagbhag 4 arab 54 crore barsa purano chha. surya ra saurya mandal pani lagbhag yahi samaya ma baneka hun.
prithvi gol chha bhanne kasari thaha bhayo?

antariksha bata khichiyeko photo ma prithvi gol dekhinchha. pahile pani manchhe le chandra grahan ma jun ma parne prithvi ko gol chhaya ra samudra ma tadha jaane jahaj ko pahila tala ko bhag harauda prithvi gol chha bhanera bujheka thiye.
prithvi ko bhitra k chha?
prithvi ko sabai bhanda bahira ko kada tah lai bhupatal (crust) bhaninchha. tyas muni taato pagleko jasto mantle ra bich ma falam-nickel le baneko dherai taato kendra (core) chha.
prithvi ma kati pratishat pani chha?
prithvi ko satah ko lagbhag 71 pratishat bhag pani le dhakeko chha. tara yo pani madhye dherai samudra ko nunilo pani ho, piune mitho pani thorai matra chha.
samudra ko pani nunilo kina hunchha?
nadi le chattan bata ghuleko nun ra khanij samudra samma lagchha. samudra bata pani bafa bhayera udda nun chahi tyahi rahanchha, tyasaile lakhau barsa ma samudra nunilo bhayo.
sansar ko piune pani kati thorai chha?
prithvi ko pani ko lagbhag 3 pratishat matra mitho pani ho, ra tyasko pani dherai bhag hiu ra himnadi ma jameko chha. tyasaile piune pani jogaunu dherai jaruri chha.
bhumigat jal bhaneko k ho?
bhumigat jal bhaneko jamin muni mato ra chattan ka pwal ma jameko pani ho. ina, tube well ra muhan bata hamle yahi pani nikalchhau.
pani ko muhan (spring) kasari banchha?
pani parda jamin bhitra pasera chattan ko bich bata bagchha, ra kunai thau ma tyo pani jamin bahira niskinchha. yahi thau lai muhan bhaninchha, jun pahad ma khanepani ko mukhya srot ho.
pani 100 degree ma umlinchha bhanne sadhai sahi ho?
samudri satah ma pani lagbhag 100 degree celsius ma umlinchha. tara uchcha thau ma hawa ko chap kam hune bhayeko le pani 100 degree bhanda kam ma umlinchha.
himal ma bhat pakna kina dhilo hunchha?
