himal ma hawa ko chap kam hunchha, tyasaile pani 100 degree bhanda tala nai umlinchha. kam tapkram ma bhat ra dal pakna dherai samaya lagchha, tyasaile pressure cooker prayog garinchha.
pressure cooker le khana kina chhitto pakauchha?
pressure cooker bhitra bafa thunida chap badhchha ra pani 100 degree bhanda badhi, lagbhag 120 degree samma pugna sakchha. badhi tapkram ma khana chhito pakchha.
hiu ra barf ma farak chha?
dubai jameko pani ho. hiu (snow) aakash bata jharne naram saana kristal ho, ra barf (ice) pani jamera baneko kada tukra ho.
pani jamda kina phailinchha?
pani jamda yasko kan haru ek arka bata tadha baserera kristal banauchhan, tyasaile jameko pani le badhi thau linchha. yahi karan le jado ma pani ko pipe futna sakchha.
hamle hawa dekhna sakdainau tara chha bhanne kasari thaha hunchha?
hawa dekhidaina tara rukh hallinchha, changa udchha ra hamro anuhar ma chhoyeko mahasus hunchha. balloon fulaunda pani hawa le thau linchha bhanne dekhinchha.
chhaya kina banchha?
prakash sidha bato ma yatra garchha. bich ma kunai bastu aauda prakash rokinchha ra tyo bastu ko pachhadi andhyaro bhag banchha, tyahi chhaya ho.
diuso chhaya kina chhoto hunchha?
diuso surya akash ma mathi hunchha ra prakash lagbhag mathi bata parchha, tyasaile chhaya chhoto hunchha. bihana ra beluka surya hocho hune bhayeko le chhaya lamo hunchha.
sabai bhanda chiso mahina nepal ma kun ho?
nepal ma dherai jaso poush ra magh (december-january) sabai bhanda chiso mahina hun. yo bela himal ra pahad ma hiu parna sakchha.
nepal ma sabai bhanda garmi mahina?
nepal ma dherai jaso jestha ra asar (may-june) sabai bhanda garmi mahina hun. monsoon suru hunu agadi terai ma dherai garmi hunchha.
basanta ritu kahile parchha?
nepali paramparama basanta ritu chaitra ra baisakh ma parchha. yo bela lali gurans fulchha ra mausam ramailo hunchha.
sharad ritu ma k bishesh hunchha?
sharad ritu (ashwin-kartik) ma monsoon sakiyera aakash sapha hunchha ra himal ramrari dekhinchha. dashain ra tihar pani yahi ritu ma parchhan.
barsha ritu kun mahina ho?
nepali paramparama barsha ritu shrawan ra bhadra ma parchha. yo bela sabai bhanda dherai pani parchha ra khet hariya hunchhan.
Why does it rain?
The sun heats water so it rises as vapour. High up, the vapour cools and forms tiny droplets in clouds. When the droplets join and get too heavy, they fall as rain.
How many planets are there in the solar system?
There are 8 planets in our solar system. Pluto was moved to the "dwarf planet" group in 2006.
Which planet is the hottest?
Venus is the hottest planet, even though Mercury is closer to the sun. Venus has a thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide that traps heat.
How long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
what causes a solar eclipse?
A solar eclipse happens when the moon passes between the sun and Earth, and the moon's shadow falls on Earth. It can only happen at new moon.
why do we have seasons?
We have seasons because Earth's axis is tilted by about 23.5 degrees. As Earth orbits the sun, different halves get more direct sunlight at different times of the year.
who was the first human in space?
Yuri Gagarin of the Soviet Union was the first human in space, on 12 April 1961.
what is the milky way?
The Milky Way is the galaxy we live in. It is a huge group of billions of stars, and our sun is one of them.
aakash ma kati tara chhan?
aakash ma kati tara chhan bhanne pakka gannu sambhab chhaina. hamro akash ganga mai arbau tara chhan, ra brahmanda ma arbau akash ganga chhan bhanera bigyan haru anuman garchhan.
kun graha ma jiwan chha?
aaja samma jiwan bhayeko thaha bhayeko ekmatra graha prithvi ho. bigyan haru mangal ra aru thau ma jiwan ka sanket khojdai chhan, tara pakka praman bhetieko chhaina.
mangal ma manchhe pugeka chhan?
chhainan, aaja samma mangal ma kunai manchhe pugeko chhaina. robot gadi (rover) haru bhane mangal ma pugera photo ra jaankari pathaudai chhan.
jun ma hawa chha?
jun ma sas ferna milne hawa chhaina. tyasaile antariksha yatri le jun ma oxygen bhayeko bishesh luga lagaunu parchha.
kun graha ma ek din sabai bhanda lamo hunchha?
shukra (venus) ma ek din sabai bhanda lamo hunchha. shukra aafno aksh ma dherai bistarai ghumchha, tyasaile yasko ek din yasko ek barsa bhanda pani lamo hunchha.
brihaspati ko kati jun chhan?
brihaspati ka dherai jun chhan, sankhya 90 bhanda badhi pugisakeko chha ra naya bhetinda badhdai chha. ganymede yasko sabai bhanda thulo jun ho, jun saurya mandal ko sabai bhanda thulo jun pani ho.
hamro saurya mandal ko kendra ma k chha?
hamro saurya mandal ko kendra ma surya chha. sabai graha surya ko gurutwakarshan le garda yasko waripari ghumchhan.
surya kati thulo chha?
surya prithvi bhanda dherai thulo chha, yasma lagbhag 13 lakh prithvi atauna sakchhan. tara aru tara haru ko tulna ma surya madhyam aakar ko tara ho.
barsha kina kahile dherai kahile kam parchha?
barsha samudra ko tapkram, hawa ko disha ra himal jasta kura ma bhar parchha. kunai barsa monsoon chadai ra baliyo aauchha bhane kunai barsa dhilo ra kamjor, tyasaile pani ko matra farak hunchha.
khaderi bhaneko k ho?
khaderi bhaneko lamo samaya samma pani naparera jamin ra nadi sukne awastha ho. khaderi ma bali bigrinchha ra piune pani ko samasya hunchha.
badhi kina aauchha?
thorai samaya ma dherai pani parda nadi ko kinar bhanda mathi pani bagchha ra badhi aauchha. jangal fadani, nadi kinar ma ghar banauna ra himtal futnu le pani badhi ko khatara badhauchha.
mausam ko purvanuman kasari garinchha?
mausam bigyan haru le upagraha ko photo, hawa ko chap, tapkram, hawa ko disha ra computer model prayog garera mausam ko anuman garchhan. nepal ma jal tatha mausam bigyan bibhag le yo kaam garchha.
bholi pani parchha ki nai bhana na
malai bholi ko mausam thaha chhaina, ma mausam ko jaankari herna sakdina. jal tatha mausam bigyan bibhag ko purvanuman, radio ya mausam app ma herda thaha hunchha.
bidyut pravah (electric current) bhaneko k ho?
bidyut pravah bhaneko taar bhitra electron ko bahav ho. yasko ekai ampere ho ra ammeter le naapinchha.
voltage bhaneko k ho?
voltage bhaneko bijuli lai taar bhitra dhakelne "chap" ho. yasko ekai volt ho, jastai nepal ko ghar ko bijuli 230 volt ko hunchha.
nepal ma ghar ko bijuli kati volt ko hunchha?
nepal ma ghar ko bijuli sadharan rup ma 230 volt ra 50 hertz ko hunchha. bideshi saman kinda yo milchha ki nai herna parchha.
bijuli ko bill ma 1 unit bhaneko k ho?
bijuli ko 1 unit bhaneko 1 kilowatt-ghanta (kWh) ho. jastai 1000 watt ko heater 1 ghanta chalauda 1 unit bijuli khapat hunchha.
100 watt ko bulb 10 ghanta balda kati unit lagchha?
100 watt ko bulb 10 ghanta balda 1 unit bijuli lagchha.
watt bhaneko k ho?
watt bijuli ko shakti (power) naapne ekai ho. jati dherai watt, tyati dherai bijuli ek ghanta ma khapat hunchha.
chalak ra kuchalak bhaneko k ho?
chalak (conductor) le bijuli sajilai bagna dinchha, jastai tama, aluminium ra falam. kuchalak (insulator) le bijuli rokchha, jastai rubber, plastic, kath ra kaanch.
bijuli ko taar tama ko kina banaunchhan?
tama ma bijuli dherai sajilai bagchha ra yo chaandi bhanda sasto pani chha. tyasaile ghar ko taar dherai jaso tama ko hunchha ra mathi plastic le chhopiyeko hunchha.
sabai bhanda ramro bijuli chalak dhatu kun ho?
sabai bhanda ramro bijuli chalak dhatu chaandi ho. tara mahango bhayeko le taar ma tama prayog garinchha.
bhijeko haat le switch kina chhunu hudaina?
pani ma ghuleko nun ra fohor le bijuli bagna dinchha, ra bhijeko chhala le bijuli sajilai bhitra pasna dinchha. tyasaile bhijeko haat le switch chhuda current lagne khatara badhchha.
current lagyo bhane k garne?
current lageko manchhe lai sidhai nachhunus. pahila main switch band garnus ya sukkha kath jasto kuchalak le bijuli ko taar hataunus, ani matra maddat garnus ra aspatal laijaanus.
fuse ra MCB ko kaam k ho?
fuse ra MCB le taar ma dherai current bagda bijuli aafai kaatidinchha. yasle taar tatera aago lagne ra saman bigrine bata jogauchha.
earthing kina garinchha?
earthing le saman ma chuhiyeko bijuli lai taar bata jamin samma lagchha. yasle saman chhunda current lagne khatara kam garchha.
AC ra DC bijuli ma k farak?
AC (alternating current) ma bijuli ko disha barambar badalinchha, ghar ko bijuli AC ho. DC (direct current) ma bijuli eutai disha ma bagchha, battery ko bijuli DC ho.
battery le bijuli kasari dinchha?
battery bhitra rasaayanik padartha hunchhan, jasko pratikriya le bijuli banchha. rasaayanik urja bijuli urja ma badalinchha.
circuit bhaneko k ho?
circuit bhaneko bijuli bagne pura bato ho: battery ya srot, taar ra bulb jasta saman. bato kahi tuteko bhaye (open circuit) bijuli bagdaina.
ghar ma saman haru parallel circuit ma kina jodinchhan?
parallel circuit ma harek saman le pura voltage paauchha ra eutai saman bigriye pani aru chaliraha hunchhan. tyasaile ghar ka bulb ra saman parallel ma jodinchhan.
ohm ko niyam k ho?
ohm ko niyam anusar voltage barabar current gunda resistance hunchha (V = I x R). resistance badhe current ghatchha.
resistance bhaneko k ho?
resistance bhaneko bijuli ko bahav lai rokne gun ho. yasko ekai ohm ho; patalo ra lamo taar ma resistance badhi hunchha.
LED bulb kina ramro?
LED bulb le purano bulb bhanda dherai kam bijuli khanchha ra dherai barsa chalchha. yasle garmi pani kam nikalchha.
bijuli ko bulb kasle banaye?
lamo samaya balne bijuli ko bulb thomas edison le 1879 ma banaye. unbhanda pahila pani kehi bigyan haru le bulb ma kaam gareka thiye.
static bijuli bhaneko k ho?
static bijuli bhaneko chij haru ragadda jamma hune bijuli ho. balloon lai kapal ma ragadda balloon le kapal tanchha, yo static bijuli ko udaharan ho.
chatyang pani bijuli nai ho?
ho, chatyang badal ma jamma bhayeko static bijuli ko ekdam thulo chingari ho. yo dherai shaktishali ra khatarnak hunchha.
solar panel le kasari bijuli banauchha?
solar panel ma bhayeka silicon ka koshika ma ghaam ko prakash pardaa electron chalchhan ra bijuli banchha. yasma dhuwa ra aawaj hudaina.
generator le kasari bijuli banauchha?
generator ma taar ko kundali chumbak ko bich ghumauda bijuli banchha. jalvidyut ma bagne pani le ra diesel generator ma engine le yo kundali ghumauchha.
chumbak le kun kun dhatu tanchha?
chumbak le falam, nickel ra cobalt jasta dhatu tanchha, ra falam bata baneko steel lai pani. tama, aluminium, kaagaj ra plastic lai tandaina.
chumbak ka kati dhruva hunchhan?
harek chumbak ka 2 dhruva hunchhan: uttari dhruva ra dakshini dhruva. ekai dhruva ek arka lai dhakelchhan ra farak dhruva tanchhan.
chumbak lai tukra parda k hunchha?
chumbak lai tukra parda harek tukra afai euta saano pura chumbak banchha, jasma uttari ra dakshini dubai dhruva hunchhan. eutai dhruva matra bhayeko chumbak banna sakdaina.
compass ko suiro kina uttar tira farkinchha?
prithvi aafai euta thulo chumbak jastai ho. compass ko saano chumbak ko suiro prithvi ko chumbakiya kshetra sanga milera uttar-dakshin disha ma rokinchha.
bidyut chumbak (electromagnet) bhaneko k ho?

falam ko dulo waripari taar berera bijuli pathauda baneko chumbak lai bidyut chumbak bhaninchha. bijuli band garda yasko chumbakatwa harauchha, tyasaile yaslai crane, ghanti ra motor ma prayog garinchha.
chumbak lai tatauda k hunchha?
chumbak lai dherai tatauda yasko chumbakiya shakti ghatchha ra harauna pani sakchha. chumbak lai pitne ya khasalne garda pani shakti kamjor hunchha.
gurutwakarshan bhaneko k ho?
gurutwakarshan bhaneko sabai bastu le ek arka lai tanne shakti ho. prithvi ko gurutwakarshan le garda hamle khasaleko chij tala khaschha.
newton ka gati ka niyam kati wata chhan?
newton ka gati ka 3 niyam chhan: (1) bahira bata bal nalage bastu ko awastha badaldaina, (2) bal = mass x acceleration, (3) harek kriya ko barabar ra ulto pratikriya hunchha.
bus achanak rokinda hami kina agadi dhalkinchhau?
bus rokinda pani hamro sharir le gati ma rahirahane gun (jadatwa) le agadi jana khojchha. tyasaile achanak brake lagauda hami agadi dhalkinchhau.
rocket kasari mathi jaanchha?
rocket le tala tira dherai chhito gyas phyakchha ra newton ko tesro niyam anusar gyas le rocket lai ulto disha, arthat mathi dhakelchha.
gharshan (friction) ko fayada k chha?
gharshan le hamilai chiplana bata jogauchha, jasle hidna ra gadi ko tyre lai bato samatna maddat garchha. brake le pani gharshan le nai gadi rokchha.
chiplo bhui ma kina lada chhitai hunchha?
chiplo bhui ma pani ya tel le gharshan ghataunchha. khutta le bhui lai ramrari samatna nasakda manchhe chiplera ladchha.
jahaj pani ma kina dubdaina?
jahaj ko aakar le dherai pani hataunchha, ra hataieko pani le mathi dhakelne bal (uplavan bal) dinchha. jahaj ko tauil yo bal bhanda kam bhaye jahaj tairinchha.
falam ko kaanti pani ma dubchha tara falam ko jahaj kina tairinchha?
kaanti saano ra thos hunchha, tyasaile kam pani hataunchha ra dubchha. jahaj bhitra khokro ra hawa le bhariyeko hunchha, tyasaile dherai pani hataayera tairinchha.
saral yantra kati wata chhan?
saral yantra 6 wata chhan: lever, pulley, wheel and axle, bhiralo satah (ramp), wedge ra screw. yinle kaam garna sajilo banauchhan.
lever ko udaharan deu
lever ko udaharan hun: dhiki-dhiki (see-saw), kainchi, nalchhuri ra dhunga uthauna prayog garne lamo dandi. yasma saano bal le thulo bhari uthauna sakinchha.
pulley kaha prayog hunchha?
pulley ina bata pani tanna, jhanda uthauna ra crane ma prayog hunchha. yasle bhari tala tanera mathi uthauna sajilo banauchha.
aawaj kasari yatra garchha?
aawaj kampan (vibration) ko rup ma hawa, pani ya thos bastu bata yatra garchha. madhyam bina aawaj jana sakdaina.
aawaj kun ma chhito jaanchha, hawa ki falam?
aawaj hawa bhanda pani ma chhito ra pani bhanda thos falam ma jhan chhito jaanchha. hawa ma aawaj lagbhag 340 meter prati second ko gati ma jaanchha.
pratidhwani (echo) kasari sunninchha?
aawaj kunai thulo kada satah, jastai pahad ya bhitta ma thokkiyera farkera aauda pratidhwani sunninchha. ghati ma karaauda yo spashta sunninchha.
prakash kun disha ma yatra garchha?
prakash sidha rekha ma yatra garchha. yasaile kunai bastu le prakash rokda chhaya banchha.
aina (mirror) le kasari chhabi dekhauchha?
aina ko chilo satah le prakash lai farkauchha (paravartan). farkeko prakash hamro aankha ma pugda aina ma hamro chhabi dekhinchha.
pani ma rakheko dandi bango kina dekhinchha?
prakash pani bata hawa ma niskanda yasko disha ali badalinchha, yaslai apavartan bhaninchha. tyasaile pani ma rakheko dandi bhaachiye jasto bango dekhinchha.
seto prakash ma kati rang hunchhan?
seto prakash ma 7 rang hunchhan. prism bata pathauda yo rato dekhi baijani samma ka rang ma chhuttinchha, yo kura newton le dekhayeka thiye.
garmi ma seto luga kina lagaune?
seto rang le ghaam ko dherai prakash farkauchha, kalo rang le dherai sosera tatchha. tyasaile garmi ma seto ya halka rang ko luga chiso lagchha.
tatauda dhatu kina phailinchha?
tatauda dhatu ka kan haru dherai halliyera ek arka bata tadha jaanchhan, tyasaile dhatu phailinchha. railway ko line ma yahi karan saano khali thau chhodinchha.
garmi kati tarika le sarchha?

garmi 3 tarika le sarchha: sanchalan (conduction), sanbahan (convection) ra bikiran (radiation). taato bhaado ko haandi ko dandi tatnu sanchalan, umaleko pani ghumnu sanbahan ra ghaam ko garmi hamisamma aaunu bikiran ho.
taato hawa kina mathi jaanchha?
taato hawa phailinchha ra chiso hawa bhanda halka (kam ghana) hunchha. halka bhayeko le taato hawa mathi uthchha, tyasaile hot air balloon udchha.
falam chhuda kath bhanda chiso kina lagchha?
ekai tapkram ma bhaye pani falam le hamro haat ko garmi chhitai tanchha, kath le dhilo tanchha. haat bata garmi chhito jaane bhayeko le falam chiso lagchha.
urja nasta hunchha?
urja nasta hudaina ra naya pani banna sakdaina, matra eutai rup bata arko rup ma badalinchha. jastai bulb ma bijuli urja prakash ra garmi ma badalinchha.
gati (speed) kasari nikalne?
gati nikalna dura lai samaya le bhag garnus. jastai 120 km 2 ghanta ma pugyo bhane gati 120 / 2 = 60 km prati ghanta hunchha.
dhar bhayeko chakku le kina sajilai kaatchha?
dhar bhayeko chakku ko dhar ko chhetrafal ekdam saano hunchha, tyasaile eutai bal le dherai chap (pressure) dinchha. chap badhi bhayeko le sajilai kaatchha.
bijuli ko taar ma basne charaa lai kina current lagdaina?
charaa le eutai taar matra chhoeko hunchha, tyasaile usko sharir bata bijuli bagne bato bandaina. duita taar ya taar ra jamin dubai chhoyo bhane current lagchha.
pani ko rasaayanik sutra k ho?
pani ko rasaayanik sutra H2O ho. yasma 2 wata hydrogen ra 1 wata oxygen ko anu hunchhan.
nun ko rasaayanik naam k ho?
khane nun ko rasaayanik naam sodium chloride (NaCl) ho. yo sodium ra chlorine milera baneko hunchha.
carbon dioxide ko sutra k ho?
carbon dioxide ko sutra CO2 ho, arthat 1 carbon ra 2 oxygen. hamle sas fera bahira falne gyas yahi ho.
tatva (element) bhaneko k ho?
tatva bhaneko eutai kisim ko parmanu le baneko shuddha padartha ho, jastai oxygen, sun ra falam. aaja samma 118 wata tatva thaha bhayeka chhan.
parmanu (atom) ma k k hunchha?
parmanu ko bich ma nucleus hunchha, jasma proton ra neutron hunchhan. nucleus ko waripari electron ghumchhan.
periodic table kasle banaye?
periodic table ko aadhar rusi bigyan dmitri mendeleev le 1869 ma banaye. unle tatva haru lai gun anusar kram ma milaye.
brahmanda ma sabai bhanda dherai paine tatva kun ho?
brahmanda ma sabai bhanda dherai paine tatva hydrogen ho. yo sabai bhanda halka tatva pani ho ra tara haru mukhya rup ma yahi le baneka hunchhan.
hawa ma sabai bhanda dherai kun gyas chha?
hawa ma sabai bhanda dherai nitrogen gyas chha, lagbhag 78 pratishat. oxygen lagbhag 21 pratishat matra chha.
pareko kotha ko taapkram ma tarala rahane dhatu kun ho?
kotha ko tapkram ma tarala rahane dhatu para (mercury) ho. pahile thermometer ma para prayog garinthyo, tara yo bishalu bhayeko le aajkal kam prayog hunchha.
hira ra pencil ko lead eutai kura bata baneko ho?
ho, hira ra pencil ko "lead" (graphite) dubai shuddha carbon bata baneka hun. carbon ka parmanu farak tarika le milda hira kada ra graphite naram hunchha.
pencil ma lead dhatu hunchha?
hudaina, pencil ma lead (shisa) dhatu hudaina. pencil ko kalo bhag graphite ra mato ko mishran ho.
falam ma khiya kina lagchha?
falam lai pani ra hawa ko oxygen sanga lamo samaya rakhda rasaayanik pratikriya bhayera khiya (iron oxide) banchha. rang lagaune, tel lagaune ra sukkha rakhne garda khiya rokinchha.
sun ma khiya kina lagdaina?
sun le hawa ra pani sanga sajilai pratikriya gardaina, tyasaile yasma khiya lagdaina ra chamak dherai samaya rahanchha. yahi karan sun lai bahumulya maninchha.
chaandi kina kalo hunchha?
chaandi hawa ma bhayeko sulphur ka gyas sanga pratikriya garera kalo tah banauchha. yo tah lai chaandi sapha garne mal le hatauna sakinchha.
amla ra kshar ma k farak chha?
amla (acid) ko swad amilo hunchha, jastai kagati ra sirka. kshar (base) ko swad tito ra chhuda chiplo hunchha, jastai saabun; dubai milda ek arka lai shanta (neutral) banauchha.
pH 7 bhaneko k ho?
pH 7 bhaneko neutral, arthat na amla na kshar. shuddha pani ko pH lagbhag 7 hunchha; 7 bhanda kam amla ra badhi kshar ho.
baking soda ra sirka milauda k hunchha?
baking soda (kshar) ra sirka (amla) milauda pratikriya bhayera carbon dioxide gyas ka fokaa niskinchhan. yo saral rasaayanik pratikriya ko ramro udaharan ho.
aago balna k k chahinchha?
aago balna 3 kura chahinchha: indhan (daura, gas), oxygen ra garmi. yi madhye eutai hatayo bhane aago nibhchha.
mainbatti lai gilas le chhopda kina nibhchha?
gilas le chhopda bhitra ko oxygen sakiyepachhi naya hawa aauna paudaina. oxygen bina aago balna sakdaina, tyasaile mainbatti nibhchha.
kapur kina harauchha?
kapur thos bata tarala nabhai sidhai gyas ma badalinchha, yaslai udatpatan (sublimation) bhaninchha. tyasaile khulla thau ma rakheko kapur bistarai harauchha.
chini pani ma kasari harauchha?
chini pani ma ghulda saana saana kan ma chhuttinchha ra pani ka kan bich phailinchha. chini nadekhine bhaye pani pani ko swad guliyo hunchha, tyasaile chini pani mai hunchha.
taato pani ma chini kina chhito ghulchha?
taato pani ka kan chhito chalchhan ra chini ka kan lai chhitai chhuttyauchhan. tyasaile chiso pani bhanda taato pani ma chini chhito ghulchha.
tel ra pani kina mildaina?
tel ra pani ka kan ko gun farak hunchha, pani ka kan ek arka lai badhi tanchhan ra tel lai bahira dhakelchhan. tel pani bhanda halka bhayeko le mathi tairinchha.
saabun le fohor kasari hataauchha?
saabun ko kan ko eutai tira pani sanga ra arko tira tel-chillo sanga milchha. saabun le chillo fohor lai gherera pani sanga bagaidinchha.
padartha ka awastha kati chhan?
padartha ka 3 mukhya awastha chhan: thos, tarala ra gyas. barf thos, pani tarala ra bafa gyas ho.
pani kati degree ma jamchha?
pani 0 degree celsius ma jamchha ra 100 degree celsius ma umlinchha, samudri satah ma. fahrenheit ma yo 32 ra 212 degree hunchha.
celsius lai fahrenheit ma kasari badalne?
celsius lai 9 le gunera 5 le bhag garnus ani 32 jodnus. jastai 25 degree celsius = 77 degree fahrenheit.
kelvin ra celsius ko sambandha k ho?
kelvin nikalna celsius ma 273.15 jodnus. jastai 0 degree celsius barabar 273.15 kelvin hunchha.
1 kilometer ma kati meter hunchha?
1 kilometer ma 1000 meter hunchha. 1 meter ma 100 centimeter ra 1 centimeter ma 10 millimeter hunchha.
1 kilo ma kati gram hunchha?
1 kilogram ma 1000 gram hunchha. 1000 kilogram barabar 1 tonne hunchha.
1 quintal kati kilo ho?
1 quintal barabar 100 kilogram ho. dhan ra gahu jasta anna ko kinbech ma quintal prayog hunchha.
1 liter ma kati milliliter?
1 liter ma 1000 milliliter hunchha. 1 ota saano chiya chamcha ma lagbhag 5 milliliter atauchha.
1 ropani ma kati aana hunchha?
1 ropani ma 16 aana hunchha. 1 aana ma 4 paisa ra 1 paisa ma 4 daam hunchha.
1 bigha ma kati kattha?
1 bigha ma 20 kattha hunchha ra 1 kattha ma 20 dhur hunchha. terai ma jagga yahi ekai ma naapinchha.
1 ropani kati square feet ho?
1 ropani barabar 5476 square feet hunchha, arthat 74 feet lamo ra 74 feet chaudai jagga. yo lagbhag 508.7 square meter ho.
1 aana kati square feet hunchha?
1 aana barabar 342.25 square feet hunchha.
1 kattha ma kati square feet?
1 kattha barabar 3645 square feet hunchha. 1 bigha ma 20 kattha bhayeko le 1 bigha 72900 square feet hunchha.
1 bigha ma kati ropani hunchha?
1 bigha lagbhag 13.3 ropani barabar hunchha.
messages.think: 1 bigha = 72900 square feet, 1 ropani = 5476 square feet. 72900 / 5476 is about 13.3.

messages.content: 1 muri ma kati pathi hunchha?
1 muri ma 20 pathi hunchha ra 1 pathi ma 8 mana hunchha. pahile anna naapna yahi ekai prayog hunthyo.
1 mana ma kati muthi?
1 mana ma 10 muthi hunchha. 8 mana barabar 1 pathi hunchha.
1 tola sun kati gram hunchha?
1 tola lagbhag 11.66 gram hunchha. nepal ma sun ra chaandi tola ma kinbech garinchha.
1 inch ma kati centimeter?
1 inch barabar 2.54 centimeter hunchha. 12 inch barabar 1 foot hunchha.
1 mile kati kilometer ho?
1 mile lagbhag 1.6 kilometer (1.609 km) hunchha. bharat ra nepal ma kilometer nai dherai chalchha.
1 dozen ma kati wata?
1 dozen ma 12 wata hunchhan. kera ra anda dherai jaso dozen ma kinchhan.
1 ghanta ma kati second hunchha?
1 ghanta ma 3600 second hunchha.
1 barsa ma kati hapta hunchhan?
1 barsa ma 52 hapta ra 1 din (leap year ma 2 din) hunchha.
messages.think: 52 x 7 = 364, ra barsa ma 365 din hunchha.

messages.content: leap year kati barsa ma aauchha?
leap year dherai jaso harek 4 barsa ma aauchha ra tyo barsa february ma 29 din hunchha. 100 le bhag jaane barsa bhane 400 le pani bhag gaye matra leap year hunchha.
SI ekai pranali ma length ko ekai k ho?
SI pranali ma lambai ko ekai meter, mass ko kilogram ra samaya ko second ho.
bal (force) ko ekai k ho?
bal ko ekai newton ho, jun isaac newton ko naam bata rakhiyeko ho.
urja ko ekai k ho?
urja ko ekai joule ho. khana ko urja dherai jaso calorie ma pani lekhinchha.
mass ra weight ma k farak?
mass bhaneko bastu ma bhayeko padartha ko matra ho, jun kahi gaye pani badaldaina. weight bhaneko gurutwakarshan le tanne bal ho, tyasaile jun ma weight ghatchha tara mass ustai rahanchha.
1 kilo kapas ra 1 kilo falam kun gahrungo?
dubai barabar gahrungo hunchhan, kinabhane dubai 1 kilo nai ho. falam saano dekhinchha ra kapas thulo, tara tauil ustai hunchha.
barf pagalda kati tapkram hunchha?
barf 0 degree celsius ma paglinchha. pagaldai garda pura barf pagalinjel tapkram 0 degree mai rahanchha.
nun le barf lai kina chhito paglauchha?
nun le pani jamne tapkram lai 0 degree bhanda tala jharauchha. tyasaile nun haleko barf 0 degree mai pani bhayera chhito paglinchha.
dudh umaldaa kina poke ra bahira aauchha?
dudh tatauda mathi protein ra chillo ko patalo tah (malai) banchha. tala baneko bafa tyo tah le roke pachhi fokaa thupriyera dudh bhaado bata bahira poikinchha.
kaatera rakheko syau kina khairo hunchha?
syau kaatda bhitra ko enzyme hawa ko oxygen sanga pratikriya garchha ra khairo rang banchha. kagati ko ras lagaye yo dhilo hunchha.
roti/pauroti kina phulchha?
pauroti ko pitho ma haleko yeast (khamir) le chini khayera carbon dioxide gyas banauchha. gyas ka fokaa pitho bhitra thunida pauroti phulera naram hunchha.
piyaj katda aankha bata kina aansu aauchha?
piyaj katda yasko koshika futera aankha lai polne gyas niskinchha. aankha le tyo gyas pakhalna aansu nikalchha.
pani ma nun ghulyo bhane kasari nikalne?
nun ghuleko pani lai tatayera bafa banayo bhane pani udchha ra nun bhaado ma rahanchha. samudra bata nun nikalne tarika pani yahi ho.
mishran ra yogik ma k farak?

mishran ma padartha haru matra misiyeka hunchhan ra sajilai chhuttyauna sakinchha, jastai nun-pani. yogik ma tatva haru rasaayanik rup le jodiyeka hunchhan, jastai pani (H2O), jun sadharan tarika le chhuttindaina.
LPG ma k gyas hunchha?
LPG ma mukhya rup ma propane ra butane gyas hunchha, jaslai chap dera tarala banaieko hunchha. cylinder bhitra tarala ra kholda gyas bhayera niskinchha.
CNG ra LPG ma farak k?
LPG propane-butane ho, jun ghar ko chulo ma dherai prayog hunchha. CNG (compressed natural gas) mukhya rup ma methane ho ra kati desh ma gadi chalauna prayog hunchha.
petrol k bata banchha?
petrol jamin muni bata nikaleko kachcha tel (crude oil) lai shuddha garera banainchha. yo sakine (non-renewable) indhan ho.
bijuli gadi kina pradushan kam garchha?
bijuli gadi le petrol jalaundaina, tyasaile bato ma dhuwa niskindaina. nepal ma bijuli dherai jaso jalvidyut bata aaune bhayeko le yasle hawa sapha rakhna jhan maddat garchha.
what is the chemical formula of water?
The chemical formula of water is H2O: 2 hydrogen atoms joined to 1 oxygen atom.
what voltage is household electricity in nepal
Household electricity in Nepal is about 230 volts at 50 hertz.
How many aana make one ropani?
16 aana make one ropani. Also, 1 aana = 4 paisa and 1 paisa = 4 daam.
What does a magnet attract?
A magnet attracts iron, nickel, cobalt and steel. It does not attract copper, aluminium, wood, paper or plastic.
Why does a ship float?
A ship floats because its shape pushes aside a lot of water. The water pushes back up with a force (buoyancy) equal to the weight of that water, which can hold the ship's weight.
what are the three states of matter in nepali?
The three states of matter are solid, liquid and gas, which in Nepali are thos, tarala and gyas.
what is 1 unit of electricity?
One unit of electricity is 1 kilowatt-hour (kWh). For example, a 1000 watt heater running for 1 hour uses 1 unit.
tama ra aluminium ko taar ma farak?
tama le aluminium bhanda ramro bijuli bagauchha, tara aluminium halka ra sasto hunchha. tyasaile ghar bhitra tama ko taar ra thula khamba ka line ma dherai jaso aluminium ko taar prayog hunchha.
bijuli bachauna k garne?
kotha bata niskanda batti ra pankha band garnus, LED bulb prayog garnus ra chalaunu napareko saman ko plug nikalnus. ghaam ko ujyalo dherai prayog garda bijuli ra paisa dubai bachchha.
induction chulo kasari khana pakauchha?
induction chulo ma bijuli ko chumbakiya kshetra le falam bhayeko bhaado lai sidhai tatauchha. chulo aafai kam tatchha, tyasaile tyasma induction milne bhaado chahinchha.
microwave le khana kasari tatauchha?
microwave le khana bhitra ko pani ka kan lai chhito halliyauna tarang (microwave) pathauchha. kan halliyera garmi banchha ra khana tatchha.
freeze ma khana kina bigrindaina chhitai?
chiso ma kitanu ra dhusi dherai dhilo badhchhan. tyasaile fridge ma rakheko khana dherai din samma ramro rahanchha, tara sadhai ko lagi haina.
thermos le pani kasari taato rakhchha?
thermos ko duita bhitta ko bich ma hawa nikaleko khali thau (vacuum) hunchha. garmi yo khali thau bata sajilai sardaina, tyasaile pani dherai samaya taato ya chiso rahanchha.
hawa ma oxygen kati pratishat hunchha?
hawa ma lagbhag 21 pratishat oxygen hunchha. baki dherai jaso nitrogen hunchha.
hamro sas bata kun gyas niskinchha?
hamle sas bahira falda carbon dioxide niskinchha, sangai nitrogen, alikati oxygen ra pani ko bafa pani hunchha. hamle sas lida oxygen bhitra lagchhau.
aawaj ko gati bhanda chhito kun chiz chalchha?
prakash aawaj bhanda dherai chhito chalchha. prakash ek second ma lagbhag 3 lakh km jaanchha bhane aawaj hawa ma lagbhag 340 meter matra.
chatyang parda 3 second pachhi garjan sunyo bhane kati tadha ho?
chatyang lagbhag 1020 meter, arthat 1 kilometer jati tadha pareko ho.
messages.think: aawaj 1 second ma lagbhag 340 meter jaanchha. 3 x 340 = 1020.

messages.content: sansar ma kati wata mahadesh chhan?
sansar ma 7 wata mahadesh chhan: asia, africa, uttar america, dakshin america, antarctica, europe ra australia.
sabai bhanda thulo mahadesh kun ho?
sabai bhanda thulo mahadesh asia ho. chhetrafal ra janasankhya dubai ma asia pahilo chha, ra nepal pani asia mai parchha.
sabai bhanda sano mahadesh kun?
sabai bhanda sano mahadesh australia ho. waripari ka tapu sahit yaslai oceania pani bhanchhan.
dosro thulo mahadesh kun ho?
dosro thulo mahadesh africa ho. sabai bhanda dherai desh (54 wata) bhayeko mahadesh pani africa nai ho.
antarctica ma manchhe baschhan?
antarctica ma sthayi rup ma manchhe basdainan. kehi bigyan haru anusandhan kendra ma kehi mahina samma basera kaam garchhan.
sabai bhanda chiso mahadesh kun?
sabai bhanda chiso mahadesh antarctica ho. yo lagbhag pura hiu le dhakieko chha.
mahasagar kati wata chhan?
sansar ma 5 wata mahasagar chhan: prashanta, atlantic, hind, dakshini (antarctic) ra arctic mahasagar.
sabai bhanda thulo mahasagar kun ho?
sabai bhanda thulo mahasagar prashanta (pacific) mahasagar ho. yo sabai bhanda gahiro mahasagar pani ho.
sabai bhanda sano mahasagar?
sabai bhanda sano mahasagar arctic mahasagar ho. yo uttari dhruva ko waripari chha ra dherai jaso hiu le dhakieko hunchha.
samudra ko sabai bhanda gahiro thau kun ho?
samudra ko sabai bhanda gahiro thau prashanta mahasagar ko mariana trench ho. yasko sabai bhanda gahiro bhag lagbhag 11 hajar meter gahiro chha.
nepal sanga najik ko samudra kun ho?
nepal sanga najik ko samudra bangal ko khadi ho, jun hind mahasagar ko bhag ho. nepal ko aafno samudri kinar chhaina.
chhetrafal ma sabai bhanda thulo desh kun?
chhetrafal ma sabai bhanda thulo desh russia ho. yo europe ra asia dubai mahadesh ma failiyeko chha.
dosro thulo desh kun ho area ma?
chhetrafal ma dosro thulo desh canada ho. yo uttar america ma parchha.
sabai bhanda dherai manchhe bhayeko desh?
aaja sabai bhanda dherai manchhe bhayeko desh bharat ho. 2023 ma bharat le china lai janasankhya ma uchhineko thiyo.
sabai bhanda sano desh kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda sano desh vatican city ho. yo italy ko rajdhani rome bhitra chha ra yaha pope baschhan.
nepal ko chhimeki desh kun kun hun?
nepal ko simana bharat ra china sanga matra jodinchha. bangladesh ra bhutan najik bhaye pani bich ma bharat ko bhubhag parchha.
bharat ko rajdhani kun ho?
bharat ko rajdhani naya dilli (new delhi) ho. mumbai bharat ko thulo byaparik sahar ho.
china ko rajdhani bhana
china ko rajdhani beijing ho. china ko sabai bhanda thulo sahar bhane shanghai ho.
japan ko rajdhani k ho?
japan ko rajdhani tokyo ho. japan dherai tapu milera baneko desh ho.
america ko rajdhani new york ho?
haina, america ko rajdhani washington DC ho. new york thulo ra prasiddha sahar ho tara rajdhani haina.
belayat ko rajdhani kun?
belayat (united kingdom) ko rajdhani london ho. thames nadi london bhaera bagchha.
france ko rajdhani kun sahar?
france ko rajdhani paris ho. paris ko eiffel tower sansar bhari prasiddha chha.
germany ko rajdhani?
germany ko rajdhani berlin ho.
russia ko rajdhani bhannus
russia ko rajdhani moscow ho.
australia ko rajdhani sydney ho ki canberra?
australia ko rajdhani canberra ho. sydney sabai bhanda thulo ra prasiddha sahar ho, tara rajdhani haina.
canada ko rajdhani k ho?
canada ko rajdhani ottawa ho. toronto canada ko sabai bhanda thulo sahar ho.
pakistan ko rajdhani kun ho?
pakistan ko rajdhani islamabad ho. karachi pakistan ko sabai bhanda thulo sahar ho.
bangladesh ko rajdhani?
bangladesh ko rajdhani dhaka ho. SAARC ko sthapana 1985 ma dhaka mai bhayeko thiyo.
bhutan ko rajdhani kun?
bhutan ko rajdhani thimphu ho. bhutan himali kshetra ko saano desh ho.
sri lanka ko rajdhani colombo ho?
sri lanka ko aadhikarik rajdhani sri jayawardenepura kotte ho, jaha sansad chha. colombo yasko najik ko sabai bhanda thulo ra byaparik sahar ho.
maldives ko rajdhani bhana na
maldives ko rajdhani male ho. maldives hind mahasagar ka dherai saana tapu milera baneko desh ho.
dakshin korea ko rajdhani?
dakshin korea ko rajdhani seoul ho. dherai nepali kaam garna dakshin korea jaanchhan.
uttar korea ko rajdhani k ho?
uttar korea ko rajdhani pyongyang ho.
malaysia ko rajdhani kun?
malaysia ko rajdhani kuala lumpur ho. yaha ko petronas tower prasiddha chha.
qatar ko rajdhani bhannus na
qatar ko rajdhani doha ho. dherai nepali kamdar qatar ma kaam garchhan.
saudi arab ko rajdhani k ho?
saudi arab ko rajdhani riyadh ho. makka ra madina saudi arab ka pavitra sahar hun.
UAE ko rajdhani?
UAE (sanyukta arab emirates) ko rajdhani abu dhabi ho. dubai sabai bhanda prasiddha sahar ho tara rajdhani haina.
egypt ko rajdhani kun ho?
egypt (misra) ko rajdhani cairo ho. giza ka prasiddha pyramid cairo najik chhan.
italy ko rajdhani?
italy ko rajdhani rome ho. rome ko colosseum purano ra prasiddha khelmaidan ho.
thailand ko rajdhani kun?
thailand ko rajdhani bangkok ho.
turkey ko rajdhani istanbul ho?
haina, turkey (turkiye) ko rajdhani ankara ho. istanbul sabai bhanda thulo sahar ho.
afghanistan ko rajdhani k ho?
afghanistan ko rajdhani kabul ho.
brazil ko rajdhani kun ho?
brazil ko rajdhani brasilia ho. rio de janeiro prasiddha sahar ho tara 1960 dekhi rajdhani brasilia ho.
eiffel tower kaha chha?
eiffel tower france ko paris ma chha. yo falam le baneko aglo tower ho ra 1889 ma banaieko thiyo.
taj mahal kasle banayeko ho?
taj mahal mughal samrat shah jahan le aafni patni mumtaz mahal ko samjhana ma banayeka hun. yo bharat ko agra ma chha.
china ko lamo parkhal antariksha bata dekhinchha?
china ko lamo parkhal (great wall) antariksha ya jun bata khali aankha le dekhinchha bhanne kura galat ho. yo lamo bhaye pani dherai patalo chha, tyasaile tyati tadha bata chhuttyauna sakidaina.
pyramid kaha chhan?
sabai bhanda prasiddha pyramid egypt ko giza ma chhan. yi hajarau barsa pahile raja (pharaoh) ko chihan ko rup ma banaiyeka thiye.
statue of liberty kaha chha?
statue of liberty america ko new york ma chha. yo france le america lai uphar diyeko murti ho.
sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo bhawan kun ho?
aaja samma sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo bhawan dubai ko burj khalifa ho, jasko uchai 828 meter chha.
angkor wat kaha chha?
angkor wat cambodia ma chha. yo sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo dharmik smarak madhye ek ho.
sabai bhanda aglo jharna kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo jharna venezuela ko angel falls ho. yasko pani lagbhag 979 meter mathi bata khaschha.
niagara jharna kaha parchha?
niagara jharna america ra canada ko simana ma parchha. yo dherai pani khasne thulo jharna ko lagi prasiddha chha.
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo tapu kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo tapu greenland ho. yo dherai jaso hiu le dhakieko chha.
sabai bhanda thulo tal kun ho sansar ko?
chhetrafal ma sabai bhanda thulo tal caspian sagar ho, jasko pani nunilo chha. mitho pani ko sabai bhanda gahiro tal russia ko baikal ho.
mrit sagar (dead sea) ma manchhe kina dubdaina?
mrit sagar ko pani ma dherai nun ghuleko hunchha, tyasaile pani bhaari ra baklo hunchha. yasle manchhe lai sajilai mathi tairaidinchha.
jamin ko sabai bhanda hocho thau kun ho?
jamin ko sabai bhanda hocho thau mrit sagar (dead sea) ko kinar ho, jun samudri satah bhanda lagbhag 430 meter tala chha.
sabai bhanda lamo nadi kun ho sansar ma?
africa ko nile nadi lai dherai jaso sansar ko sabai bhanda lamo nadi maninchha, lagbhag 6650 km. kati bigyan amazon pani ustai lamo huna sakchha bhanchhan.
sabai bhanda dherai pani bokne nadi kun?
sabai bhanda dherai pani bokne nadi dakshin america ko amazon ho. yasle sansar ka aru nadi bhanda dherai pani samudra ma puryauchha.
amazon jangal kaha chha?
amazon jangal dakshin america ma, dherai jaso brazil ma chha. yo sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo varsha van (rainforest) ho.
sahara marubhumi kaha chha?
sahara marubhumi uttar africa ma chha. yo sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo taato marubhumi ho.
sabai bhanda lamo parbat shrinkhala kun ho?
jamin mathi ko sabai bhanda lamo parbat shrinkhala dakshin america ko andes ho. himalaya bhane sabai bhanda aglo parbat shrinkhala ho.
africa ko sabai bhanda aglo himal kun?
africa ko sabai bhanda aglo himal tanzania ko kilimanjaro ho, jasko uchai lagbhag 5895 meter chha.
europe ko prasiddha himal kun ho?
europe ko alps parbat shrinkhala ko mont blanc dherai prasiddha chha. yo france ra italy ko simana ma parchha.
dakshin america ko sabai bhanda aglo himal?
dakshin america ko sabai bhanda aglo himal argentina ko aconcagua ho. yo andes shrinkhala ma parchha.
sanyukta rashtra sangh kahile baneko ho?
sanyukta rashtra sangh (UN) 1945 ma dosro bishwa yuddha pachhi baneko ho. yasko mukhyalaya america ko new york ma chha.
UN ma kati desh sadasya chhan?
sanyukta rashtra sangh ma 193 wata sadasya rashtra chhan. nepal 1955 ma sadasya bhayeko thiyo.
SAARC ma kati desh chhan?
SAARC ma 8 wata desh chhan: nepal, bharat, bangladesh, bhutan, pakistan, sri lanka, maldives ra afghanistan. yasko sachivalaya kathmandu ma chha.
red cross kasle suru gare?
red cross ko suru switzerland ka henry dunant le gareka hun. yasle yuddha ra bipad ma ghaite ra pidit lai maddat garchha.
UNICEF le k kaam garchha?
UNICEF sanyukta rashtra sangh ko sanstha ho, jasle sansar bhari ka balbalika ko swasthya, shiksha ra surakshya ko lagi kaam garchha.
UNESCO ko kaam k ho?
UNESCO le shiksha, bigyan ra sanskriti ko kshetra ma kaam garchha. yasle mahatwapurna thau lai bishwa sampada suchi ma rakhchha, jastai nepal ko lumbini.
olympic khel kati barsa ma hunchha?
olympic khel harek 4 barsa ma hunchha. aadhunik olympic ko suru 1896 ma greece ko athens ma bhayeko thiyo.
football world cup pahilo choti kahile bhayo?
fifa football world cup pahilo choti 1930 ma uruguay ma bhayeko thiyo. yo pani harek 4 barsa ma hunchha.
nobel puraskar kasko naam ma diinchha?
nobel puraskar sweden ka bigyan alfred nobel ko naam ma diinchha, jasle dynamite ko aabishkar gareka thiye. yo bigyan, sahitya ra shanti jasta kshetra ma diinchha.
telephone kasle banaye?
telephone ko aabishkar ko shreya alexander graham bell lai jaanchha. unle 1876 ma yasko patent paaeka thiye.
hawaijahaj kasle banaye?
pahilo safal hawaijahaj america ka wright daju-bhai (orville ra wilbur) le banaye. unle 1903 ma pahilo udaan gareka thiye.
chhapakhana (printing press) kasle banaye?
dhatu ka akshar bhayeko chhapakhana germany ka johannes gutenberg le lagbhag 1440 tira banaye. yasle kitab chhapna sajilo ra sasto banayo.
kagaj pahilo choti kaha baneko ho?
kagaj pahilo choti china ma baneko ho. lagbhag 2000 barsa pahile china ka cai lun le kagaj banaune tarika sudhareka thiye.
sunya (zero) ko awadharana kaha bata aayo?
sankhya ko rup ma sunya (0) ko prayog ra niyam prachin bharat ma bikas bhayeko maninchha. brahmagupta jasta ganitagya le sunya ko hisab ko niyam lekheka thiye.
penicillin kasle pattaa lagaye?
penicillin alexander fleming le 1928 ma pattaa lagaye. yo pahilo antibiotic aushadhi ho.
pahilo khop kasle banaye?
pahilo khop (bifar ko) edward jenner le 1796 ma banaye. bifar (smallpox) aaja sansar bata harai sakeko chha.
x-ray kasle pattaa lagaye?
x-ray germany ka wilhelm roentgen le 1895 ma pattaa lagaye. yasle sharir bhitra ko haddi herna maddat garchha.
computer ka pita kaslai bhaninchha?
belayat ka charles babbage lai computer ka pita bhaninchha. unle 19 au shatabdi ma hisab garne yantra (analytical engine) ko yojana banayeka thiye.
world wide web kasle banaye?
world wide web (www) tim berners-lee le 1989 ma banaye. internet pahile nai thiyo, tara web le website ra link chalaauna sajilo banayo.
dynamite kasle banaye?
dynamite alfred nobel le banaye. pachhi unle aafno sampatti bata nobel puraskar suru garne wasiyat chhode.
battery pahilo choti kasle banaye?
pahilo battery italy ka alessandro volta le 1800 ma banaye. bijuli ko ekai "volt" unkai naam bata rakhiyeko ho.
petrol ma chalne pahilo motor gadi kasle banaye?
petrol engine bhayeko pahilo motor gadi germany ka karl benz le 1885-86 tira banaye.
telescope le aakash herne pahila manchhe ko?
italy ka galileo galilei le 1609 tira telescope le aakash herera jun ka khalda ra brihaspati ka jun pattaa lagaye.
gurutwakarshan ko niyam kasle bataye?
gurutwakarshan ko niyam belayat ka isaac newton le bataye. rukh bata syau khaseko dekhera unle yo kura sochna thale bhanne katha prasiddha chha.
bikaswad (evolution) ko siddhanta kasko ho?
jiv haru bistarai badalinda naya prajati bane bhanne bikaswad ko siddhanta belayat ka charles darwin ko ho. unko pustak 1859 ma prakashit bhayeko thiyo.
dudh lai pasteurize garne tarika kasle pattaa lagaye?
dudh ra khana ko kitanu marna halka tataaune tarika france ka louis pasteur le pattaa lagaye, tyasaile yaslai pasteurization bhaninchha.
marie curie kina prasiddha chhin?
marie curie radioactivity ko adhyayan ko lagi prasiddha chhin. uni nobel puraskar jitne pahili mahila ra duita farak bigyan ma nobel jitne ekmatra manchhe hun.
mahatma gandhi ko hun?
mahatma gandhi bharat ko swatantrata andolan ka neta hun. unle ahimsa (hinsa nagarne) ra shantipurna andolan bata british shasan ko birodh gare; bharat 1947 ma swatantra bhayo.
nelson mandela ko thiye?
nelson mandela dakshin africa ka neta hun, jasle rangbhed (apartheid) ko birodh gare. 27 barsa jail basepachhi uni 1994 ma desh ka rashtrapati bhaye.
shakespeare ko hun?
william shakespeare belayat ka prasiddha natakkar ra kabi hun. "romeo and juliet" ra "hamlet" unka prasiddha natak hun.
mona lisa kasle banayeko chitra ho?
mona lisa italy ka leonardo da vinci le banayeko chitra ho. yo france ko paris ma louvre sangrahalaya ma rakhieko chha.
mother teresa kina prasiddha chhin?
mother teresa bharat ko kolkata ma garib ra birami ko seva garera prasiddha bhaein. unle 1979 ma nobel shanti puraskar paaein.
martin luther king ko ho?
martin luther king jr. america ma kalo manchhe ko barabar adhikar ko lagi shantipurna andolan garne neta hun. unko "i have a dream" bhashan dherai prasiddha chha.
america ko pahilo rashtrapati ko hun?
america ka pahila rashtrapati george washington hun. uni 1789 ma rashtrapati bhaye.
abraham lincoln kina prasiddha chhan?
abraham lincoln america ka 16 au rashtrapati hun. unle grihayuddha ko bela desh lai ekjut rakhe ra dasa pratha antya garna mahatwapurna bhumika khele.
rabindranath tagore kina prasiddha chhan?
rabindranath tagore bharat ka kabi hun, jasle 1913 ma sahitya ma nobel puraskar paaye. uni nobel paune pahila asiyali hun ra bharat ra bangladesh dubai ko rastriya gaan unle lekheka hun.
columbus le america kahile pugyo?
christopher columbus 1492 ma atlantic mahasagar tarera america najik ka tapu ma pugeka thiye. unle suru ma tyo bharat ho bhanne thane.
vasco da gama kina prasiddha chhan?
portugal ka vasco da gama 1498 ma samudri bato bata europe dekhi bharat pugne pahila manchhe hun. unle africa ko dakshin hudai yatra gareka thiye.
prithvi ko pahilo parikrama kasko team le garyo?
prithvi ko pahilo pura samudri parikrama ferdinand magellan ko abhiyan le 1519 dekhi 1522 samma garyo. magellan aafai bato mai mare, tara unka sathi farkera spain pugeka thiye.
nepal ra bharat bich ko samaya ma kati farak?
nepal ko samaya bharat bhanda 15 minet aghi chha. kathmandu ma 12:15 baje huda dilli ma 12 baje hunchha.
nepal ra china ko samaya farak kati?
china ko samaya (UTC+8) nepal (UTC+5:45) bhanda 2 ghanta 15 minet aghi chha. nepal ma 10 baje huda beijing ma 12:15 hunchha.
dubai ra nepal ko samaya ma kati antar?
nepal dubai bhanda 1 ghanta 45 minet aghi chha. dubai UTC+4 ma ra nepal UTC+5:45 ma parchha.
qatar ma kati baje hunchha nepal ma 5 baje huda?
nepal ma 5 baje huda qatar ma 2:15 baje hunchha.

messages.content: japan nepal bhanda kati aghi chha?
japan ko samaya nepal bhanda 3 ghanta 15 minet aghi chha. japan UTC+9 ma parchha.
bhumadhya rekha kun kun mahadesh bhaera jaanchha?
bhumadhya rekha dakshin america, africa ra asia (indonesia ka tapu) bhaera jaanchha. yo rekha najik ka thau sadhai garmi hunchhan.
greenwich rekha k ho?
greenwich rekha (prime meridian) 0 degree deshantar ho, jun london ko greenwich bhaera jaanchha. yahi rekha bata purba ra pashchim ko samaya ra deshantar ganinchha.
sansar ma kati desh chhan?
sanyukta rashtra sangh ka 193 sadasya rashtra chhan, ra vatican city tatha palestine jasta 2 paryavekshak pani chhan. tyasaile prayah sansar ma lagbhag 195 desh bhaninchha.
sansar ko janasankhya kati chha?
sansar ko janasankhya 8 arab bhanda badhi chha. 2022 ko antya tira yo 8 arab pugeko thiyo.
sabai bhanda dherai boline bhasa kun ho?
mula bhasa ko rup ma sabai bhanda dherai manchhe le mandarin chini bolchhan. dosro bhasa sahit gane bhane english sabai bhanda dherai manchhe le bolchhan.
english bhasa kun desh bata aayeko ho?
english bhasa ko suru england (belayat) bata bhayeko ho. aaja yo sansar bhari antarrashtriya sanchar ko mukhya bhasa banisakeko chha.
europe ma kati desh chhan?
europe ma lagbhag 44 desh chhan, ganana ko tarika anusar sankhya ali farak parna sakchha. russia ra turkey ko kehi bhag europe ma ra kehi asia ma parchha.
sabai bhanda dherai desh sanga simana jodine desh?
china ra russia dubai ko simana 14 wata desh sanga jodinchha. yo sansar ma sabai bhanda dherai ho.
bhuparbestit desh bhaneko k ho?
bhuparbestit desh bhaneko samudri kinar nabhayeko, charai tira jamin le gherieko desh ho. nepal, bhutan, afghanistan ra switzerland bhuparbestit desh hun.
kun desh lai ugdo surya ko desh bhanchhan?
japan lai "ugdo surya ko desh" bhaninchha. japan ko naam ko arth nai "surya ko utpatti" jasto hunchha.
kun desh lai seto hatti ko desh bhanchhan?
thailand lai "seto hatti ko desh" bhaninchha. thailand ma seto hatti lai pavitra ra rajkiya maninchha.
sabai bhanda thulo marubhumi kun? sahara?
taato marubhumi ma sahara sabai bhanda thulo ho. tara pani dherai kam parne chiso thau lai pani marubhumi ganda antarctica sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo marubhumi ho.
what is the largest island in the world?
Greenland is the largest island in the world. Most of it is covered by a thick ice sheet.
Where is the Taj Mahal?
The Taj Mahal is in Agra, India. Emperor Shah Jahan built it in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
which is the tallest building in the world?
The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the tallest building in the world, at 828 meters.
When was the United Nations formed?
The United Nations was formed in 1945, after the Second World War. Its headquarters is in New York.
who invented the airplane
The Wright brothers, Orville and Wilbur, flew the first successful powered airplane in 1903 in the USA.
how many members does SAARC have?
SAARC has 8 members: Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka. Its secretariat is in Kathmandu.
Which ocean is the deepest?
The Pacific Ocean is the deepest. The Mariana Trench in the Pacific is about 11000 meters deep at its deepest point.
what is the smallest country in the world
Vatican City is the smallest country in the world. It lies inside Rome, Italy.
dosro bishwa yuddha kahile bhayo?
dosro bishwa yuddha 1939 dekhi 1945 samma bhayo. yasma sansar ka dherai desh samlagna bhaye ra yuddha pachhi sanyukta rashtra sangh baneko thiyo.
pahilo bishwa yuddha kahile dekhi kahile samma?
pahilo bishwa yuddha 1914 dekhi 1918 samma bhayo. dherai nepali gorkha sainik pani yo yuddha ma ladeka thiye.
bharat kahile swatantra bhayo?
bharat 1947 august 15 ma british shasan bata swatantra bhayo. tyahi barsa pakistan pani chhuttai desh bhayo.
bangladesh kahile chhuttai desh bhayo?
bangladesh 1971 ma pakistan bata chhuttiyera swatantra desh bhayo. pahile yaslai purbi pakistan bhaninthyo.
berlin ko parkhal kahile dhalyo?
berlin ko parkhal 1989 ma dhalyo. tyas pachhi 1990 ma purbi ra pashchimi germany feri ek bhaye.
chandrama ma pugne pahilo desh kun?
chandrama ma manchhe pathaune pahilo desh america ho, 1969 ma apollo 11 mission bata. soviet sangh ko robot yan bhane tyo bhanda agadi nai chandrama ma pugisakeko thiyo.
sansar ko sabai bhanda bhid bhayeko sahar kun ho?

mahanagar kshetra ganda japan ko tokyo lamo samaya dekhi sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo sahari kshetra madhye ek maninchha. ganana ko tarika anusar dilli, shanghai jasta sahar pani najik chhan, tyasaile ek matra uttar pakka bhanna garo chha.
kun desh ma sabai bhanda dherai jwalamukhi chhan?
sakriya jwalamukhi ko sankhya ma indonesia sansar ko agrani desh maninchha. yo prashanta mahasagar ko "aago ko ghero" (ring of fire) ma parchha.
aago ko ghero (ring of fire) bhaneko k ho?
"ring of fire" bhaneko prashanta mahasagar ko kinar ma ghodako naal jasto failiyeko kshetra ho, jaha dherai jwalamukhi ra bhukampa aauchhan. japan, indonesia ra chile yahi kshetra ma parchhan.
sabai bhanda thulo varsha van kun ho?
sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo varsha van (tropical rainforest) amazon ho. yasle dherai oxygen dinchha ra lakhau prajati ka jiv ko ghar ho.
venice sahar kina prasiddha chha?
italy ko venice sahar ma sadak ko satta nahar (canal) chhan ra manchhe dunga chadhera aawatjawat garchhan. yo sundar purano sahar dherai paryatak ko man parne thau ho.
sydney opera house kaha chha?
sydney opera house australia ko sydney sahar ma chha. yasko chhana jahaj ko paal jasto aakar ko chha.
machu picchu kaha chha?
machu picchu dakshin america ko peru ma, andes parbat ma chha. yo inca sabhyata ko purano sahar ho.
christ the redeemer murti kaha chha?
christ the redeemer ko thulo murti brazil ko rio de janeiro ma dada mathi chha. yo sansar ko prasiddha murti madhye ek ho.
big ben kaha chha?
big ben belayat ko london ma sansad bhawan ko ghadi ghar ko thulo ghanti ho. dherai jaso manchhe pura ghadi ghar lai nai big ben bhanchhan.
colosseum kaha ho?
colosseum italy ko rome ma chha. yo lagbhag 2000 barsa purano roman khelmaidan ho.
petronas tower kun desh ma?
petronas twin tower malaysia ko kuala lumpur ma chhan. yi duita jumlyaha aagla bhawan hun.
victoria falls kaha chha?
victoria jharna africa ma zambia ra zimbabwe ko simana ma chha. yo sansar ko thulo jharna madhye ek ho.
loktantra bhaneko k ho?
loktantra bhaneko janata le aafno pratinidhi chunera shasan chalaune byabastha ho. yasma bolne swatantrata, chunab ra kanun ko shasan jasta kura hunchhan.
ganatantra ko arth k ho?
ganatantra bhaneko raja nabhayeko, rashtra pramukh janata ko pratinidhi le chuneko byabastha ho. nepal 2065 sal dekhi sangiya loktantrik ganatantra ho.
sambidhan bhaneko k ho?
sambidhan desh ko mul kanun ho. yasle sarkar kasari chalchha ra nagarik ka adhikar ra kartabya k hun bhanne kura lekhchha.
sansad ko kaam k ho?
sansad le kanun banauchha, sarkar ko kaam ko nigarani garchha ra budget pas garchha. nepal ko sangiya sansad ma pratinidhi sabha ra rashtriya sabha gari 2 sadan chhan.
pratinidhi sabha ma kati sadasya hunchhan?
nepal ko pratinidhi sabha ma 275 sadasya hunchhan. 165 jana pratyaksha chunab bata ra 110 jana samanupatik pranali bata aauchhan.
rashtriya sabha ma kati sadasya?
nepal ko rashtriya sabha ma 59 sadasya hunchhan. 7 pradesh bata 8 jana ka dar le 56 jana chunieka ra 3 jana manonit hunchhan.
nyayalaya ko kaam k ho?
nyayalaya le kanun anusar mudda herera nyaya dinchha. nepal ma sarbochcha adalat, uchcha adalat ra jilla adalat gari tin taha ka adalat chhan.
mataadhikar bhaneko k ho?
mataadhikar bhaneko chunab ma bhot halne adhikar ho. nepal ma 18 barsa pura bhayeka nagarik le bhot halna paauchhan.
sanghiyata bhaneko k ho?
sanghiyata bhaneko desh ko shasan lai sangh, pradesh ra sthaniya taha ma baadne byabastha ho. yasle sarkar lai janata ko najik lyauna maddat garchha.
nepal ma kati taha ko sarkar chha?
nepal ma 3 taha ko sarkar chha: sangiya sarkar, pradesh sarkar ra sthaniya sarkar (gaunpalika ra nagarpalika).
kar (tax) kina tirnu parchha?
kar bata sarkar le sadak, school, aspatal, suraksha jasta sarbajanik sewa chalauchha. tyasaile kar tirnu nagarik ko kartabya ho.
nepal ma VAT kati pratishat chha?
nepal ma mulya abhibriddhi kar (VAT) 13 pratishat chha. dherai saman ra sewa ko mulya ma yo kar jodiyeko hunchha.
budget bhaneko k ho?
budget bhaneko kunai samaya ko lagi kati aamdani hunchha ra kaha kati kharcha garne bhanne yojana ho. sarkar ko budget nepal ma jestha 15 gate sansad ma prastut garinchha.
byaj bhaneko k ho?
byaj bhaneko paisa saapat linda tirne ya bank ma bachat garda paine thap rakam ho. jastai 10000 rupiya ma 10 pratishat barsik byaj bhaye ek barsa ma 1000 rupiya byaj hunchha.
mudrasphiti bhaneko k ho?
mudrasphiti bhaneko samaya sangai saman ra sewa ko mulya badhdai jaanu ho. yasle garda ustai rakam le pahile bhanda kam saman kinna sakinchha.
berojgari bhaneko k ho?
berojgari bhaneko kaam garna sakne ra kaam khojirakheko manchhe le kaam napaunu ho. berojgari badhda dherai yuva kaam ko lagi bidesh jaanchhan.
remittance bhaneko k ho?
remittance bhaneko bidesh ma kaam garne manchhe le aafno desh ma pathaune paisa ho. nepal ko arthatantra ma remittance ko thulo yogdan chha.
niryat ra aayat ma k farak?
niryat bhaneko aafno desh bata arko desh lai saman bechnu ho. aayat bhaneko arko desh bata saman kinera lyaunu ho.
nepal le kun saman dherai niryat garchha?
nepal le alainchi, chiya, galaicha, pashmina, aduwa ra jadibuti jasta saman niryat garchha. tara nepal ko aayat niryat bhanda dherai badhi chha.
share bazar bhaneko k ho?
share bazar bhaneko company ko sanai sanai hissa (share) kinbech garne thau ho. nepal ma share kinbech NEPSE (nepal stock exchange) bata hunchha.
bima (insurance) bhaneko k ho?
bima bhaneko niyamit rakam (premium) tirera durghatana, rog ya noksan bhaye company bata kshatipurti paune samjhauta ho. jiwan bima, swasthya bima ra gadi bima yasko udaharan hun.
bachat kina garnu parchha?
bachat le achanak aaune kharcha, birami ra bhabishya ka yojana ko lagi paisa tayar rakhchha. thorai bhaye pani niyamit bachat garne bani ramro hunchha.
rin ra saapat ma farak chha?
rin ra saapat dubai pachhi tirne gari line paisa ho. sadharan bolchal ma saathi-bhai bata line lai saapat ra bank bata line lai rin bhanne chalan chha.
cheque bhaneko k ho?
cheque bhaneko bank khata bata kasailai paisa dina lekhine likhit aadesh ho. cheque ma rakam, naam ra hastakshar lekhinchha.
paryavaran bhaneko k ho?
paryavaran bhaneko hamro waripari ko hawa, pani, mato, biruwa, janawar ra manchhe sabai milera baneko wataran ho. swastha paryavaran bina jiwan sambhab chhaina.
pradushan kati kisim ko hunchha?
pradushan mukhya rup ma hawa, pani, mato ra dhwani (aawaj) gari 4 kisim ko hunchha. kathmandu ma hawa ra dhwani pradushan thulo samasya ho.
dhwani pradushan bhaneko k ho?
dhwani pradushan bhaneko dherai charko ra lagatar aawaj le manchhe ra janawar lai haani garnu ho. gadi ko horn, kalkarkhana ra charko baja yasko karan hun.
pani pradushan kasari hunchha?
kalkarkhana ko fohor pani, dhal, plastic ra kheti ko bisadi nadi ma misinda pani pradushan hunchha. kathmandu ko bagmati nadi yasko dukhad udaharan ho.
punarprayog (recycling) bhaneko k ho?
punarprayog bhaneko prayog gariyeka kagaj, plastic, sisa ra dhatu lai feri prashodhan garera naya saman banaunu ho. yasle fohor ra srot ko kharcha ghatauchha.
3R bhaneko k ho?
3R bhaneko reduce (kam prayog), reuse (feri prayog) ra recycle (punarprayog) ho. fohor ghatauna yi tin kura sabai le garna sakchhan.
jaivik bividhata bhaneko k ho?
jaivik bividhata bhaneko kunai thau ma paine dherai kisim ka biruwa, janawar ra jiv haru ho. nepal saano bhaye pani himal dekhi terai samma dherai jaivik bividhata bhayeko desh ho.
simsar kshetra bhaneko k ho?
simsar bhaneko barsabhari ya kehi samaya pani jameko jamin ho, jastai tal, pokhari ra daldal. yo charaa, machha ra dherai jiv ko ghar ho.
van fadani le k noksan garchha?
van fadani le pahiro, badhi ra mato bagne samasya badhauchha. janawar ko ghar nasta hunchha ra hawa ma carbon dioxide badhchha.
samudayik ban bhaneko k ho?
samudayik ban bhaneko sthaniya samudaya le aafai sanrakshan ra byabasthapan garne jangal ho. nepal ko samudayik ban karyakram sansar ma ramro udaharan maninchha.
manav adhikar bhaneko k ho?

manav adhikar bhaneko sabai manchhe lai manchhe bhaeko nate janmajaat paine adhikar ho, jastai bachne, swatantra rahane, shiksha ra samanata ko adhikar. nepal ma rashtriya manav adhikar aayog le yasko nigarani garchha.
bal adhikar ma k k parchha?
bal adhikar ma bachne, shiksha paune, swasthya sewa paune, khelne ra hinsa bata surakshit rahane adhikar parchhan. balbalika lai kaam ma lagaunu (bal shram) kanun le apradh ho.
nepal ma bibaha garne kanuni umer kati ho?
nepal ma bibaha garne kanuni umer keta ra keti dubai ko 20 barsa ho. tyo bhanda saano umer ma garne bibaha bal bibaha ho ra kanun le apradh ho.
chhuachhut nepal ma kanun le k bhanchha?
nepal ma jaat ko aadhar ma chhuachhut ra bhedbhav garnu kanun anusar dandaniya apradh ho. sambidhan le sabai nagarik barabar hun bhanchha.
dahej pratha kanuni ho?
haina, nepal ma dahej maagnu ra dahej ko lagi dabab dinu kanun le apradh ho. bibaha ma kasailai dahej ko lagi hinsa garnu gambhir apradh ho.
lingik samanata bhaneko k ho?
lingik samanata bhaneko mahila ra purush lai shiksha, kaam, jyala ra nirnay ma barabar awasar ra adhikar dinu ho. chhora ra chhori lai ustai byabahar garnu yasko suruwat ho.
ekal parivar ra sanyukta parivar ma k farak?
ekal parivar ma aama, buwa ra unka chhora chhori matra hunchhan. sanyukta parivar ma hajurbuwa-hajuraama, kaka-kaki jasta dherai pusta sangai baschhan.
sanskriti bhaneko k ho?
sanskriti bhaneko kunai samaj ko bhasa, dharma, chadparba, khana, poshak, kala ra jiwan shaili ko samuha ho. yo pusta pusta hudai saridaichha.
mahamari bhaneko k ho?
mahamari bhaneko kunai rog dherai thulo kshetra ma, dherai manchhe ma ek saath failinu ho. covid-19 lai WHO le 2020 march ma bishwabyapi mahamari ghoshana gareko thiyo.
sankraman bhaneko k ho?
sankraman bhaneko kitanu (bacteria, virus, dhusi) sharir bhitra pasera badhnu ra rog lagaunu ho. haat dhune, khop line ra sapha pani piune le sankraman ghataunchha.
krittim buddhi (AI) bhaneko k ho?

krittim buddhi (artificial intelligence) bhaneko computer lai sikne, bujhne ra nirnay garne jasta manchhe jasta kaam garna sikaune prabidhi ho. bhasa anuvad, photo chinne ra chatbot yasko udaharan hun.
internet bhaneko k ho nepali ma bhannus
internet bhaneko sansar bhari ka computer ra phone lai jodne thulo jaal (network) ho. yasle email, website, video ra sandesh pathauna sambhab banauchha.
itihas bhaneko k ho?
itihas bhaneko bitisakeka ghatana, manchhe ra samaj ko adhyayan ho. yasle hamilai hamro atit bujhna ra bhabishya ko lagi sikna maddat garchha.
bhugol le k padhauchha?
bhugol le prithvi ko jamin, pani, hawa, mausam ra manchhe kaha kasari baschhan bhanne kura padhauchha.
ghanatwa (density) bhaneko k ho?
ghanatwa bhaneko eutai aayatan (thau) ma kati padartha chha bhanne naap ho. falam ko ghanatwa kapas bhanda dherai hunchha, tyasaile saano tukra pani bhaari hunchha.
dabab (pressure) kasari nikalinchha?
dabab barabar bal lai chhetrafal le bhag gareko ho. eutai bal saano chhetrafal ma lagda dabab dherai hunchha, jastai suiro le sajilai chhedchha.
tarang (wave) bhaneko k ho?
tarang bhaneko urja ek thau bata arko thau samma sarne kampan ho. pokhari ma dhunga phyakda baneko gola gola lahar, aawaj ra prakash sabai tarang hun.
anu ra parmanu ma k farak?
parmanu kunai tatva ko sabai bhanda saano ekai ho. duita ya badhi parmanu jodiyera anu (molecule) banchha, jastai 2 hydrogen ra 1 oxygen parmanu milera pani ko anu banchha.
chhaya ma kina chiso lagchha?
chhaya ma ghaam ko kiran sidhai sharir ma pardaina, tyasaile sharir ra waripari ko jamin kam tatchha. tyasaile garmi ma chhaya ma basda chiso mahasus hunchha.
pankha le kotha chiso banauchha?
pankha le kotha ko hawa ko tapkram ghataudaina, hawa matra chalauchha. hawa chalda chhala ko pasina chhito bafa bhayera udchha ra hamilai chiso mahasus hunchha.
nuhayera niskanda kina jado lagchha?
nuhaye pachhi chhala ma bhayeko pani bafa bhayera udda sharir ko garmi lagera jaanchha. tyasaile chhitai rumal le puchhda kam jado lagchha.
garmi ma kukur kina jibro nikalchha?
kukur ko sharir ma manchhe ko jasto dherai pasina aaune granthi hudaina. jibro nikalera chhito sas ferda jibro ko osilo bafa bhayera udchha ra sharir chiso hunchha.
hawa chalda luga kina chhito sukchha?
hawa le luga najik ko osilo hawa lai tadha lagchha ra sukkha hawa lyauchha. yasle pani chhito bafa banna dinchha, tyasaile ghaam ra hawa dubai bhaye luga chhito sukchha.
kalo bhaado ma pani kina chhito tatchha?
kalo rang le garmi ra prakash dherai sosnchha, seto ya chamkilo rang le farkauchha. tyasaile kalo bhaado chhito tatchha.
chiso pani ko gilas ko bahira kina pani ka thopa dekhinchhan?
gilas chiso bhayeko le yasko chheu ko hawa chiso hunchha ra hawa ko bafa pani ka thopa ma badlinchha. yo pani gilas bhitra bata chuhiyeko haina, hawa bata aayeko ho.
nuhauda aina ma kina bafa jamchha?
taato pani bata niskeko bafa chiso aina ma chhoyera pani ka saana thopa ma badlinchha. tyasaile aina dhamilo dekhinchha.
jado ma sas ferda mukh bata dhuwa jasto kina niskinchha?
hamro sas ma taato pani ko bafa hunchha. jado ma tyo bafa chiso hawa ma chhoyera saana pani ka thopa banchha ra dhuwa jasto dekhinchha.
mainbatti jaldai jaanda kina chhoto hunchha?
mainbatti ko mom nai indhan ho. dhago le pagleko mom mathi tanchha ra tyo mom gyas bhayera jalchha, tyasaile mom sakindai jaanda mainbatti chhoto hunchha.
helium bhareko balloon kina mathi udchha?
helium gyas hawa bhanda dherai halka hunchha. tyasaile helium bhareko balloon lai waripari ko hawa le mathi dhakelchha.
hawaijahaj kasari udchha?

hawaijahaj ko pakhheta ko aakar le chhito chaleko hawa lai tala tira dhakelchha ra pakhheta lai mathi uthne bal (lift) milchha. engine le jahaj lai chhito agadi tanchha, ra gati pugepachhi jahaj udchha.
garmi ma bijuli ko taar kina jhundinchha?
garmi ma dhatu ko taar phailinchha ra lamo hunchha, tyasaile khamba ko bich ma ali badhi jhundinchha. jado ma taar khumchiyera ali tight hunchha.
pani bhareko bottle freezer ma kina futchha?
pani jamda phailinchha ra pahile bhanda badhi thau linchha. bottle ma thau nabhaye jameko barf le bottle lai dhakelera futaidinchha.
aago ma pani halda kina nibhchha?
pani le aago lai chiso banauchha ra bafa bhayera aago lai oxygen bata chhopchha. garmi ra oxygen dubai ghatepachhi aago nibhchha, tara tel ra bijuli ko aago ma pani halnu hudaina.
khursani kina piro hunchha?
khursani ma capsaicin bhanne padartha hunchha, jasle jibro ka snayu lai garmi lageko jasto sanket dinchha. tyasaile piro khanda mukh polchha ra pasina aauchha.
piro khada pani piunda kina kam hudaina?
khursani ko piro padartha pani ma ramrari ghuldaina, tyasaile pani le tyati kam garaudaina. dudh, dahi ya bhat le piro chhito shanta parna maddat garchha.
bachcha ko dudhe daat kina jharchha?
bachcha ko jaw (bangara) thulo hudai jaanda thula ra baliya sthayi daat ko lagi thau chahinchha. tyasaile 6 barsa tira dekhi dudhe daat jharna thalchhan ra naya daat aauchhan.
budheskal ma kapal kina seto hunchha?
kapal ko rang melanin le dinchha. umer badhdai jaanda kapal ko jara ma melanin banne koshika kam hunchhan, tyasaile kapal fusro ya seto hunchha.
samudra kina niilo dekhinchha?
pani le rato ra pahelo prakash sosnchha ra niilo prakash dherai farkauchha. gahiro samudra ma yo jhan dekhinchha, sangai niilo aakash ko chhaya pani parchha.
diuso tara kina dekhidainan?
diuso pani tara aakash mai hunchhan, tara surya ko prakash dherai chamkilo hune bhayeko le tara ko kamjor prakash dekhidaina.
himal kina seto dekhinchha?
himal ko hiu le surya ko prakash ko sabai rang lagbhag barabar farkauchha. sabai rang milda seto dekhinchha, tyasaile hiu le dhakieko himal seto dekhinchha.
laamkhutte le tokepachhi kina chilauchha?
laamkhutte le tokda yasko haar chhala bhitra pasdachha. hamro sharir le tyo haar lai bahiri padartha thanera histamine chhodchha, jasle sujan ra chilaai lyauchha.
kamila haru line ma kina hidchhan?
aghi ko kamila le bato ma gandha bhayeko rasaayan (pheromone) chhodchha. pachhadi ka kamila tyo gandha pachhyaudai hidda line ma hideko jasto dekhinchha.
charaa haru V aakar ma kina udchhan?
V aakar ma udda agadi ko charaa ko pakhheta le baneko hawa ko dhakka le pachhadi ka charaa lai udna sajilo hunchha. yasle lamo yatra ma shakti bachauchha, ra charaa haru palo palo agadi basnchhan.
nun le khana lai kasari bigrina dindaina?
nun le khana bata pani sosera nikalchha, ra pani bina kitanu badhna sakdainan. tyasaile nunilo masu, machha ra achar dherai din samma rakhna sakinchha.
dudh garmi ma chhitai kina phatchha?
taato mausam ma dudh ma bhayeka kitanu chhitai badhchhan ra amla banauchhan. amla le dudh lai phataidinchha, tyasaile dudh umalera ra chiso thau ma rakhnu parchha.
phone charge garda kina tatchha?
charge garda battery bhitra rasaayanik pratikriya hunchha ra kehi urja garmi ma badalinchha. phone lai sirani muni ya ghaam ma rakhera charge garnu hudaina, dherai tatyo bhane charge nikalnus.
himal ma mobile ko network kina kamjor hunchha?
himal ma mobile tower tadha tadha hunchhan ra thula pahad le signal rokchhan. tyasaile uchai ra durgam thau ma network kamjor ya nabhayeko huna sakchha.
cycle chalaunda kina ladindaina tara rokda ladchha?
cycle chalirahada hamle handle ra sharir le santulan milauna sakchhau, ra ghumne pangra le pani sthir rahana maddat garchha. rokepachhi santulan milaune gati nahune bhayeko le cycle dhalkinchha.
sabun ko fokaa ma kina rang dekhinchha?
sabun ko fokaa ko patalo bhitta bata farkeko prakash ek arka sanga milda kehi rang badhi dekhinchhan. bhitta ko motai thau anusar farak hune bhayeko le indreni jasto rang dekhinchha.
aankha ma prakash pardaa kina chhikna man lagchha kahile kahi?
kati manchhe lai achanak tikho ujyalo dekhda hachhyun aauchha. yo kina hunchha bhanne bigyan ma ahile pani pura spashta chhaina, tara yo dherai manchhe ma dekhine sadharan kura ho.
hami kina sapna dekhchhau?

sapna kina dekhinchha bhanne kura bigyan ma ahile pani pura thaha chhaina. dherai sapna gahiro nidra ko REM bhanne charan ma aauchha, ra dimag le smaran ra bhawana milauna yasle maddat garchha bhanne anuman chha.
kun kura le pani lai shuddha banauchha?
pani lai umalne, filter garne, chlorine ko thopa halne ra ghaam ma SODIS bidhi le rakhne jasta tarika le shuddha banauna sakinchha. umalnu sabai bhanda bharosa layak gharelu tarika ho.
SODIS bidhi bhaneko k ho?
SODIS bidhi ma sapha plastic ko paardarshi bottle ma pani bharera kamti ma 6 ghanta ghaam ma rakhinchha. ghaam ko kiran le pani ka dherai kitanu marchhan.
dhuwa le aankha kina polchha?
dhuwa ma saana kan ra rasaayan hunchhan jasle aankha ko osilo bhag lai jalan garauchha. aankha le tyo hatauna aansu nikalchha.
bhaado ma khana lagyo bhane kina dhilo pakaunu parchha?
dherai aago ma pakauda bhaado ko tala bhag chhito tatchha tara khana ko bhitra samma garmi pugna samaya lagchha. tyasaile madhyam aago ma chalaudai pakauda khana nalagi ramrari pakchha.
kina bhijeko kath ramro jaldaina?
bhijeko kath jalaunu agadi tyasko pani bafa banaunu parchha, jasma dherai garmi kharcha hunchha. tyasaile bhijeko kath le dherai dhuwa dinchha ra ramro jaldaina.
kina samudra ko kinar ma hawa diuso samudra bata aauchha?
diuso jamin samudra bhanda chhito tatchha ra jamin mathi ko hawa uthchha. tyasko thau linna samudra bata chiso hawa jamin tira aauchha, raati yo ulto hunchha.
hiundo ma pahad ma kina ghaam pyaro lagchha?
hiundo ma hawa chiso hunchha, ra ghaam ko kiran le sharir lai sidhai tataidinchha. tyasaile chiso bela ghaam taapda ramro lagchha.
kina kotha ko mathillo tala tallo tala bhanda taato hunchha garmi ma?
taato hawa halka hunchha ra mathi uthchha, ani chhana le pani ghaam ko garmi sidhai sosnchha. tyasaile garmi ma mathillo tala ko kotha badhi taato hunchha.
kina pahiro barsha ma matra dherai jaanchha?
barsha ma dherai pani mato bhitra pasda mato gahrungo ra chiplo hunchha ra mato ko kan ek arka lai kam samatchhan. tyasaile bhiralo thau ko mato tala khaschha.
kina terai ma badhi dherai aauchha?
pahad ra himal bata aaune nadi terai ko samthar jamin ma aaipugda dhilo bagchhan ra phailinchhan. dherai pani parda nadi le kinar nanghera khet ra gaun dubauchha.
kina rukh ropnu jaruri chha?
rukh le oxygen dinchha, mato samatera pahiro rokchha, chhahari dinchha ra pani ko srot jogauchha. rukh le carbon dioxide sosera jalvayu parivartan ghatauna pani maddat garchha.
kina plastic jalaunu hudaina?
plastic jalauda bishalu dhuwa niskinchha, jasle phokso ra mutu ko rog lagauna sakchha. plastic lai chhutyaera punarprayog garne thau ma dinu ramro hunchha.
plastic kati barsa ma kuhinchha?
plastic sajilai kuhindaina; dherai kisim ko plastic saya barsa bhanda badhi samaya samma rahana sakchha. tyasaile plastic ko jhola kam prayog garnu ra kapda ko jhola bokne bani ramro ho.
kina dherai horn bajaunu naramro ho?
dherai horn le dhwani pradushan badhauchha, jasle tanab, tauko dukhne ra sunne shakti ma haani garchha. kathmandu ma bina karan horn bajauna rok lagaieko chha.
kina sadak ma daayaa-baayaa herera matra katnu parchha?

sadak katda gadi kun tira bata aaudai chha bhanera ramrari herena bhane durghatana huna sakchha. nepal ma gadi baayaa tira chalchhan, tyasaile pahila daayaa, ani baayaa, ani feri daayaa herera zebra crossing bata katnus.
nepal ma gadi bato ko kun tira chalchhan?
nepal ma gadi bato ko baayaa (debre) tira chalchhan. bharat, japan ra belayat ma pani gadi baayaa tira nai chalchhan.
helmet kina lagaunu parchha?
motorcycle durghatana ma tauko ma lageko chot sabai bhanda khatarnak hunchha. helmet le tauko lai jogauchha ra jiwan bachauna sakchha, tyasaile chalak ra pachhadi basne dubai le lagaunu parchha.
seat belt le kasari bachauchha?
gadi achanak rokinda sharir agadi phyaakinchha. seat belt le sharir lai seat mai samatera agadi ko sisa ya steering ma thokkina bata jogauchha.
zebra crossing kina hunchha?
zebra crossing paidal yatri ko lagi sadak katne surakshit thau ho. yaha gadi le rokera paidal lai bato dinu parchha.
traffic batti ma rato, pahelo ra hariyo ko arth k ho?
rato bhaneko roknu, pahelo bhaneko tayar hunu ya rokna tayar bas, ra hariyo bhaneko janu ho. yo niyam palana garda durghatana ghatchha.
what is democracy in simple nepali?
Democracy lai nepali ma loktantra bhaninchha. yasma janata le bhot halera aafno neta chunchhan ra sabai lai bolne swatantrata hunchha.
what is inflation?
Inflation is when prices of goods and services rise over time. It means the same money buys less than before.
what is remittance
Remittance is money that people working abroad send back to their families in their home country. It is very important for Nepal's economy.
Why does a fan make us feel cool?
A fan does not cool the air. It moves air over your skin, which helps sweat evaporate faster, and evaporation takes heat away from your body.
why do we see our breath on cold mornings?
Your breath has warm water vapour in it. In cold air, the vapour quickly cools into tiny water droplets, which look like smoke or mist.
why are chillies hot?
Chillies contain capsaicin, a substance that makes the nerves in your mouth feel a burning heat, even though nothing is really hot.
What is the legal marriage age in Nepal?
The legal marriage age in Nepal is 20 years for both men and women. Marriage below that age is child marriage and is a crime.
how many members are in Nepal's House of Representatives?
Nepal's House of Representatives has 275 members: 165 elected directly and 110 through proportional representation.
which side of the road do vehicles drive on in Nepal?
In Nepal, vehicles drive on the left side of the road, like in India, Japan and the UK.
sarbochcha adalat kaha chha?
nepal ko sarbochcha adalat kathmandu ko ramshahpath ma chha. yo nepal ko sabai bhanda mathillo adalat ho.
nepal ma kati wata uchcha adalat chhan?
nepal ma harek pradesh ma ek gari 7 wata uchcha adalat chhan. tyasko tala harek jilla ma jilla adalat chhan.
pradhanmantri kasari chuninchha?
nepal ma pratinidhi sabha ma bahumat paune dal ya dal haru ko gathbandhan ko neta pradhanmantri bannchha. rashtrapati le pradhanmantri niyukta garchhan.
rashtrapati kasari chunieka hunchhan?
nepal ka rashtrapati sangiya sansad ra pradesh sabha ka sadasya le milera chunchhan. rashtrapati ko karyakal 5 barsa ko hunchha.
sthaniya chunab kati barsa ma hunchha?
nepal ma sthaniya taha ko chunab sadharan rup ma 5 barsa ma hunchha. yasma meyor, upameyor, adhyaksha ra wada adhyaksha chuninchhan.
wada bhaneko k ho?
wada bhaneko gaunpalika ya nagarpalika ko sabai bhanda saano prashasanik ekai ho. nagarik le sifaris, panjikaran jasta dherai kaam wada karyalaya ma garchhan.
nagarikta kina chahinchha?
nagarikta le tapai kun desh ko nagarik ho bhanne pramanit garchha. nepal ma bhot halna, passport banauna, jagga kinna ra sarkari jagir ko lagi nagarikta chahinchha.
passport bhaneko k ho?
passport bhaneko bidesh yatra garna sarkar le dine pahichan patra ho. yasma tapai ko naam, photo, janma miti ra nagarikta lekhieko hunchha.
visa ra passport ma k farak?
passport aafno desh ko sarkar le dine pahichan patra ho. visa bhaneko arko desh le tapai lai aafno desh ma pasna ra basna dine anumati ho.
janma darta kina garnu parchha?
janma darta le bachcha ko kanuni pahichan dinchha. school bharna, nagarikta ra aru sarkari kaam ma janma darta ko pramanpatra chahinchha, ra yo wada karyalaya ma garinchha.
annapurna circuit ko sabai bhanda uchcha bhanjyang kun ho?
annapurna circuit ko sabai bhanda uchcha bhanjyang thorong la ho, jasko uchai lagbhag 5416 meter chha. yo manang ra mustang (muktinath) ko bich ma parchha.
poon hill kaha parchha?
poon hill myagdi jilla ko ghorepani najik parchha. lagbhag 3210 meter ko yo dada bata bihana annapurna ra dhaulagiri ko sundar drishya dekhinchha.
everest base camp trek kaha bata suru hunchha?
dherai jaso everest base camp trek lukla bata suru hunchha. phakding, namche bazar, tengboche ra dingboche hudai base camp pugninchha.
tengboche gumba kina prasiddha chha?
tengboche gumba khumbu kshetra ko sabai bhanda prasiddha bauddha gumba ho. yaha bata ama dablam ra sagarmatha ko sundar drishya dekhinchha.
kala patthar k ho?
kala patthar sagarmatha base camp najik ko kalo chattan ko dada ho. yaha bata sagarmatha najik bata ramrari dekhine bhayeko le trekker haru yaha chadhchhan.
gokyo tal kaha chha?
gokyo tal solukhumbu jilla ko sagarmatha rastriya nikunja bhitra chha. yo himtal haru ko samuha ho ra ramsar suchi ma pareko simsar ho.
annapurna base camp kati uchai ma chha?
annapurna base camp lagbhag 4130 meter ko uchai ma chha. yaha annapurna, machhapuchhre ra himchuli le gherieko sundar thau chha.
langtang trek kun jilla ma parchha?
langtang trek rasuwa jilla ma parchha. kathmandu bata najik hune bhayeko le yo chhoto samaya ma garna sakine himali trek ho.
manaslu circuit ma kun bhanjyang parchha?
manaslu circuit ko sabai bhanda uchcha bhanjyang larke la ho. yo trek gorkha jilla ma manaslu himal ko waripari ghumchha.
mathillo mustang jana kina bishesh anumati chahinchha?
mathillo mustang sanrakshit kshetra ho ra yaha ko sanskriti ra wataran jogauna sarkar le bishesh anumati (permit) anivarya gareko chha. lo manthang yahi kshetra ma chha.
pokhara ma paragliding kaha bata hunchha?
pokhara ma paragliding dherai jaso sarangkot dada bata hunchha. udda phewa tal ra annapurna himal ko drishya dekhinchha.
chitwan ma hatti ko prajanan kendra kaha chha?
chitwan ko hatti prajanan kendra sauraha najik ko khorsor ma chha. yaha hatti ka bachcha hurkaine ra herna paaine garinchha.
bhaktapur durbar kshetra ma k k herna paainchha?
bhaktapur durbar kshetra ma 55 jhyale durbar, sun dhoka (golden gate) ra dherai mandir herna paainchha. najik ko taumadhi ma nyatapola mandir chha.
patan ko swarna mandir kun ho?
patan ko swarna mandir (golden temple) lai hiranya varna mahavihar bhaninchha. yo sun le jalayeko chhana bhayeko bauddha vihar ho.
budhanilkantha ma k chha?
budhanilkantha ma pani ko kunda bhitra sutirahanu bhayeka bhagwan vishnu ko thulo dhunga ko murti chha. yo kathmandu ko uttari bhag ma parchha.
dakshinkali mandir kaha chha?
dakshinkali mandir kathmandu ko dakshin tira pharping najik chha. yo kali devi ko mandir ho ra shanibar ra mangalbar dherai bhakta jaanchhan.
bindhyabasini mandir kaha ho?
bindhyabasini mandir pokhara ma chha. yo bhagawati ko prasiddha mandir ho ra sahar ko purano bhag ma sano dada mathi chha.
barahakshetra kaha parchha?
barahakshetra sunsari jilla ma koshi nadi ko kinar ma chha. yo bhagwan vishnu ko barah rup ko mandir ra prasiddha tirtha sthal ho.
pindeshwor mandir kaha chha?
pindeshwor mandir sunsari jilla ko dharan ma chha. shrawan mahina ma bol bam bhakta haru koshi bata jal lyayera yaha chadhauchhan.
rani pokhari kasle banaye?
kathmandu ko rani pokhari malla raja pratap malla le 1670 tira aafno chhora ko mrityu pachhi rani ko man shanta parna banaye. pokhari ko bich ma shiva ko mandir chha.
singha durbar kasle banaye?
singha durbar rana pradhanmantri chandra shumsher le 1908 ma banaye. aaja yaha nepal sarkar ka dherai mantralaya chhan.
nepal ko pahilo bishwabidyalaya kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo bishwabidyalaya tribhuvan bishwabidyalaya ho, jun 2016 sal (1959) ma sthapana bhayo. yasko mukhya kshetra kirtipur ma chha.
nepal ko pahilo aspatal kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo aadhunik aspatal bir aspatal ho, jun 1889 (1946 sal) ma kathmandu ma sthapana bhayeko thiyo. yo aaja pani thulo sarkari aspatal ho.
nepal ko pahilo school kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo aadhunik school durbar high school ho, jun jung bahadur rana le 1854 (1910 sal) ma kholeka thiye. suru ma yo rana parivar ko lagi matra thiyo.
nepal ko pahilo patrika kun ho?
nepal ko pahilo patrika gorkhapatra ho, jun 1901 (1958 sal) ma suru bhayo. yo aaja pani prakashit hune sarkari patrika ho.
radio nepal kahile suru bhayo?
radio nepal 2007 sal chaitra (1951) ma suru bhayo. yo nepal ko pahilo radio ho.
nepal television kahile khulyo?
nepal television 2041 sal (1985) ma suru bhayo. yo nepal ko pahilo television station ho.
nepal ma pahilo rail kahile chalyo?
nepal ma pahilo rail 1927 ma raxaul dekhi amlekhganj samma chaleko thiyo. aaja janakpur-jaynagar rail nepal ko chalti ma rahe ko mukhya rail sewa ho.
bhrikuti ko thiin?
bhrikuti lichhavi kaal ki rajkumari hun, jasko bibaha tibbat ka raja songtsen gampo sanga bhayeko thiyo. unle tibbat ma bauddha dharma failauna maddat gareko manninchha.
lichhavi kaal ko prasiddha raja ko ko hun?
lichhavi kaal ka prasiddha raja ma mandev ra amshuverma parchhan. mandev ko pala ko changunarayan abhilekh nepal ko purano mitiyukta abhilekh ho.
malla kaal ma kathmandu upatyaka kati rajya ma baadiyeko thiyo?
malla kaal ko pachhillo samaya ma kathmandu upatyaka 3 rajya ma baadiyeko thiyo: kantipur (kathmandu), lalitpur (patan) ra bhaktapur. tyo bela dherai sundar mandir ra durbar bane.
jayasthiti malla kina prasiddha chhan?
jayasthiti malla le samaj lai byabasthit garna niyam ra jaat ko byabastha banayeka thiye bhanne itihas ma ullekh chha. uni malla kaal ka prasiddha raja hun.
kasthamandap k ho?
kasthamandap kathmandu durbar kshetra najik ko kath le baneko purano sattal ho. kathmandu ko naam yahi kasthamandap bata aayeko bhanne bishwas chha.
tundikhel k ho?
tundikhel kathmandu ko bich ma bhayeko thulo khulla maidan ho. yaha ghode jatra jasta rastriya karyakram hunchhan.
dharahara kati tala ko chha?
purano dharahara 9 tala ko thiyo ra 2072 ko bhukampa ma dhalyo. aaja yasko chheu ma naya dharahara banaieko chha.
garden of dreams kaha chha?
