pahila subject ma k kura ho lekhnus, pachhi 3-4 line ma kura bhannus. antim ma "dhanyabad" ra naam. badhi lamba email padhdainan, chhoto ra saaf lekhnus.
boss le naramro khabar kasari dine
pahila kura siddhai bhannus, pachhi karan ra upaya. "yo kaam bholi samma sakidaina, tara arkai din ma sakchhu" jasto bhannus. lamba bhumika nabhanus.
kaam ma galti bhayepachhi kasari sudharnu
galti lukaunu hunna, turuntai bhannus ra sudharne upaya sangai bhannus. kun thau ma galti bhayo lekhnus, aglo palta na dohoryaunus. sachho bhanne manchhe lai biswas garchhan.
naya kaam ma sikna garo lagchha
pahilo mahina ma dherai sodhnus, notes banaunus. ek din ma 2-3 kura siknus, sabai ekai din ma haina. sathi lai "yo kasari garchha" sodhda lajja nalagnus.
kaam ma sadhai eklai kaam garchhu, team ma man lagdaina
break ma sangai basnus ra sano kura garnus. team ko kaam ma sahayog garnus. bistarai team sanga milchha, kaam pani sajilo hunchha.
ghar bata kaam garchhu, dhyan basdaina
kaam ko samaya tay garnus ra tyo bela ghar ko kaam na garnus. euta thau ma laptop rakhnus, tyo thau kaam ko matra ho. 25 minet ma 5 minet break garnus.
bidesh kaam ko interview video call ma chha
camera ko agadi ramro ujyalo rakhnus, anuhar dekhine banaunus. background safa rakhnus. internet ramro chha ki agadi jaanch garnus ra 10 minet agadi taaiyar basnus.
bidesh kaam ko lagi consultancy ramro chha ki nai
consultancy ko kura matra na biswas garaunus. kun desh, kaam, salary ra kharcha likhit ma linus. paisa ekai palta na bujhaunus, kagaj ra receipt rakhnus.
driver ko kaam garchhu, din bhari basera kammar dukhchha
gaadi rokiyepachhi uthnus ra 2 minet hidnus. seat ko pachhi ma sano takiya rakhnus. beluka ghar pugera kammar ra khutta aaram dinus.
pasal ma kaam garne, grahak le jhagada garyo
tapai shanta basnus ra grahak ko kura sunnus. saman ko kura ho bhane bill dekhaunus. dherai badhi bhaye manager ki tole ka manchhe lai bolayera milaunus.
mero kaam ko salary samaya ma aaudaina
pahila shanti sanga sodhnus: salary kahile aauchha. jawaf na aaye likhit ma magnus ra receipt rakhnus. mahina ma 2 palta yestai bhaye shram adhikari ki union sanga kura garnus.
kaam ma chhutti lina garo hunchha
chhutti ko kura 1 hapta agadi bhannus ra kaam sakera bujhaunus. sano note ma kaam ko kura lekhnus, pachhi farkida sajilo hunchha. barsha ma kati din chhutti paainchha tyo niyam padhnus.
kaam ma mero sathi lai rakhna bhaneko chha
sathi lai rakhda afno jimma thap hunchha. sathi le kaam ramro garyo bhane ramro, na gare bhannus. sathi ra kaam ko kura chhuttai rakhnus.
kaam ma mero idea kasai le man pareko chhaina
idea email ma pathaunus, tyo lekhiyeko rahanchha. pachhi kaam ma lagyo bhane sabai le samjhinchhan. karaunu bhanda kaam le dekhaunus.
office ma mero chhimeki ko chhora le kaam khojdai chha
usko CV herera sano sudhar bhanidinus. company ma bhitra ka khabar hernus, vacancy chha ki. reference dinu bhaye afno naam ma jhuto kura na lekhnus.
bihana bhat kasari ramro banaune
chamal ramro sanga dhunus, 2-3 palta pani ferera. pani 1 inch mathi rakhnus, uamleko pachhi aago sano garnus. dhakera pakaunus, 15-20 minet ma hunchha. pakaera 5 minet rakhera matra kholnus.
dal ramro sanga pakdaina, daal kada hunchha
dal pahila 4-6 ghanta bhijaaunus, chhito pakchha. uamleko pachhi jhaag hataunus ra aago sano garnus. nun ant ma halnus, pahila halda dal chhito pakdaina.
tarkari ma tel dherai jasto lagchha
tel tato bhaye pachhi masala halnus, tel kam lagchha. tarkari pakauda dhakera rakhnus, pani chahinchha bhane thorai halnus. tel dherai bhayo bhane tarkari chhito bigrinchha.
masu ramro sanga pakdaina, kada hunchha
masu lai pressure cooker ma pakaunus, chhito pakchha. ki uamleko pachhi aago sano garera 30-40 minet rakhnus. nun ant ma halnus.
khana ma nun kati halne thaha hunchhaina
pahila thorai halnus ra chakhnus, pachhi thapnus. 4 jana ko khana ma 1 chammach jati hunchha. achar ra masu ma nun pani hunchha, tyo pani hisab garnus.
roti kasari gol ra naramro naparne banaune
ata ramro sanga malnus ra 20 minet rakhnus. sano loi banaera bistarai belnus, dherai na thelnus. tawa ramro tato bhaye matra roti rakhnus.
chiya kalo ra kada hunchha
pani uamleko pachhi chiya patta halnus ra aago sano garnus. 2-3 minet ma chhanera dudh halnus. dudh dherai uamlauda chiya kada hunchha.
dahi banayeko ramro hunchhaina, amilo hunchha
dudh uamleko pachhi ali chiso garera matra dahi ko biu halnus. biu thorai halnus ra chiso thau ma rakhnus. garmi ma 6-8 ghanta ma hunchha.
ghiu banauda jalchha
aago sano rakhnus ra bich bich ma chalaunus. makhan bata pani sakiyepachhi matra ghiu hunchha. jaleko ghiu ko gandha naramro hunchha, tyo nakhanus.
khana pakauda tel chharchin chha, aankha polchha
tel haldai aago sano garnus ra dhaknus. khana dhakera pakauda tel chharchin kam hunchha. aankha polchha bhane bahira niskiye saas linus.
bhat pakauda tala tasyo, jalyo
aago turuntai banda garnus ra bhat mathi ko na chalaunus. pachhi tala tasyeko bhat hataunus. arko palta sano aago ma dhakera pakaunus.
aloo chhito pakne tarika
aloo sano sano katnus ra uamleko pani ma nun halera pakaunus. 10-15 minet ma hunchha. chhala kholna sajilo hunchha bhane pakyo.
saag kasari pakaune, ramro hunchhaina
saag ramro sanga dhunus ra sano katnus. tel ma lasun ra pyaj tataunus, pachhi saag halnus. dhakera 5-10 minet pakaunus, dherai na pakaunus.
khana banauna samaya lagchha, chhito k garne
pahila sabai saman katnus ra tayar rakhnus. ekai bela bhat, dal ra tarkari pakaunus. hapta ma ek din dherai banaera fridge ma rakhnus.
fridge ma khana kati din rakhne
pakaeko khana fridge ma 2-3 din rakhnus. kachcho masu 1-2 din ma khanus. gandha aayo ki rang badlyo bhane nakhanus.
bachiyeko bhat bholi khanu hunchha ki nai
bholi khanu hunchha, tara fridge ma rakhnus ra khadai agadi ramro sanga umalnus. gandha aayo bhane nakhanus. garmi ma bholi khanu bhanda aaja nai khanus.
khana ma masala kati halne
pahila thorai halnus ra chakhnus. masala dherai halda khana bigrinchha. ghar ma banaeko masala taaja hunchha ra thorai ma pugchha.
garmi ma dahi banayera kati din rakhne
garmi ma dahi 2 din ma khanus. chiso thau ma rakhnus. amilo bhayo ki pani chhutyo bhane nakhanus.
khana pakauda nun ra chini ko bhand milaunus
dui wata bhand eutai dekhine bhane chinha lagaunus: ek ma tape ki lekhnus. chini ra nun milayera khana bigrinchha. sano bhand ma rakhnus.
kitchen ma safa kasari rakhne
khana pakaunepachhi siddhai mej puchhnus. bhada din din majhnus, thupriyera rakhda jhan garo hunchha. hapta ma ek din fridge ra daraj safa garnus.
dudh uamlauda mathi aaudai chha
aago sano garnus ra dudh ma sano chammach rakhnus. uamleko dudh turuntai hataunus. dudh uamleko pachhi aago banda garera dhaknus.
achar banayo piro bhayo
piro bhaye dahi ki kagati ko sano thop halnus. arko palta khursani kam garnus ra timur ali badhi halnus. piro achar sanga chiura ramro hunchha.
masu pakauda tel dherai bhayo, ke garne
tel mathi bata hataunus, sano chammach le. jhol ma aloo ki pyaj halera tel sokna dinus. arko palta tel kam halnus.
tarkari ma masala ramro sanga nabhasyo
masala pahila tel ma ramro sanga bhutnus. pachhi tarkari halnus. dhakera 10 minet pakaunus, masala ramro baschha.
pakauda ramro naparne, tel sokchha
pitho ali kada banaunus ra tel ramro tato huna dinus. halo haldai tato tel ma rakhnus. pakauda pakaudai tel tato rahanu parchha.
khana pakauda aago badhi bhayo
aago turuntai sano garnus ra bhand sarnus. jaleko khana kehi hunchha bhane dhakera aago banda garera rakhnus. pakauda najalne gari bich bich ma hernus.
bachcha ko khana kasari pakaune, piro nabhaune
bachcha ko khana ma khursani na halnus. sano katauno tarkari, dal ra bhat ramro hunchha. nun thorai halnus.
bhat ko bhand ma osilo lagyo
osilo lagyo bhane bhand ramro sukhaunus ra dhakera rakhnus. bhijeko bhand ma bhat rakhda bigrinchha.
kitchen ma bhada dhune tarika
pahila tel lageko bhada alag rakhnus ra tato pani ma bhijaaunus. pachhi sabun le majhnus ra safa pani le pakhalnus. din din garnus, thupriyera rakhda garo hunchha.
kathmandu bata pokhara jane ramro tarika k ho
bihana ko tourist bus ramro hunchha, 6-7 ghanta lagchha. ticket online ki pasal bata agadi kinera rakhnus. bato ma khana ra pani lagnus, tarkari ko lagi bich ma rokinchha.
pokhara ma 2 din ma ke ke ghumna sakinchha
ek din phewa taal ra lakeside, arko din sarangkot ko suryoday ra durbarn square. bihana chhito niskiye ghumna ramro hunchha. taxi ki bike bata jaanu sajilo hunchha.
barsha ko mausam ma yatra garnu parchha, k dhyan dine
barsha ma pahiro ra bato bigrine dar hunchha, bato bibhag ko khabar hernus. raati ko yatra na garnus. chhata, jacket ra sano khana lagnus.
trek ma pahilo din nai thakai lagyo
pahilo din josh ma dherai hidnu hunchha, tyasaile thakai lagchha. bistarai hidnus ra bich ma aaram garnus. pani piunus ra namkeen khaja lagnus.
trek ma khutta phutyo, ke garne
phuteko thau ma bandage lagaunus ra sukha rakhnus. bholi bistarai hidnus, dherai bhari naboknus. ghau ma maila lagaunus haina.
trek ma leech lagyo
leech lage nun ki nimbu ko ras le hataunus, tanera nahataunus. pachhi ghau safa garnus. bato ma moja ra lugaa ramro lagnus.
trek ma saas ferna garo hunchha, mathi chadhdai
bistarai chadhnus ra bich bich ma aaram garnus. pani piunus ra dherai mathi jada ek raat basera jaanus. saas ferna dherai garo bhaye tallo thau ma jharnus.
pahad ma khana mahango hunchha, k garne
pahad ma khana mahango hunchha, tyo normal ho. chiura, biscuit ra chocolate lagnus. teahouse ma dal bhat khadai sasto hunchha.
trek ko lagi jhola kasari banaune
8-10 kg bhanda badhi naboknus. lugaa 2 set, jacket, raincoat, pani ra sano khaja lagnus. aushadhi pani lagnus, tara doctor le bhaneko matra.

2 ghanta agadi airport ma pugnus. luggage ko weight hernus ra hand carry ma tarbuja jasto saman na lagnus. kaan dukhe bhane chabaiye khanus.
jahaj ma bachcha sangai jada k garne
bachcha lai kaan dukhe bhane dudh ki jusa khuwaunus. jahaj uthne bela bachcha lai jagayera rakhnus. khana ra khelauna lagnus.
raati bus ma yatra garda jhola kaha rakhne
jhola khutta ma rakhnus ki mathi ko rack ma, tara paisa ra phone jhole bhitra rakhnus. sutna agadi seat number samjhin. bich ma bus rokiyepachhi saman hernus.
yatra ma bato ma gadi bigriyo
gadi kinar ma park garera hazard batti balnus. mistri lai phone garnus ra insurance ko kagaj hernus. bato ma eklai na basnus.
yatra ma jhola harayo

naya thau ma ghumna jada kheri kaha basne
manchhe dherai hune thau ma basnus ra ghumne thau ko naksha hernus. sathi sanga basnus, eklai najaanus. gharbeti lai bhannus, tapai kahile farkine.
gaun ma pahuna jada ke lagnus
sano upahar lagnus: mithai, phal ki chiya ko packet. ghar ko lugaa saaf lagnus. pahuna ko ghar ma dherai ber na basnus, uniharu thakchhan.

man paraunus ra thorai khanus. "dherai bhayo, dhanyabad" bhanera hasi sanga bhanus. pura na khaera chhodnu bhanda thorai khadai ramro.

kharcha ko list banaunus: bhada, khana, bato. ghar mai pakaunus, bahira khana mahango parchha. bus ki cycle bata jaanus, taxi bhanda sasto hunchha.

sathi banaunus ra hapta ma ek din ghumna jaanus. gaun ma niyamit phone garnus. eklo lagnu swabhabik ho, samaya le halka hunchha.
ghar bata kaam garna thau chhaina, shahar ma
sano kotha ma euta kuna rojnus ra mej rakhnus. library ma pani kaam garna sakinchha. kaan ma plug lagaunus.

2 barsha ko bachcha sabai kura ma "na" bhanchha
2-3 barsha ma "na" bhanne samaya hunchha, tyo swabhabik ho. dherai kura ma rojne mauka dinus: "yo ki tyo?" bachcha le afai rojda mannichha.

chhora school ma jhagada garchha
pahila chhora sanga shanti sanga kura garnus, k bhayo bhanera. teacher sanga pani bhetnus. ghar ma "haat chalaune haina, kura garne" sikaunus.
chhori school jaana runchhe, pahilo hapta
pahilo hapta ma runna swabhabik ho. chhoto samaya school ma basna dinus ra teacher lai bhannus. ghar bata khusi banayera pathaunus.
bachcha ko homework ma dherai madat garchhu
madat garnu bhanda agadi afai try garnus bhannus. galti gare pani chhodnus, tyo bata sikchha. dherai madat garda bachcha afai garna sakdaina.
bachcha lai kitab padhne bani kasari banaune

mobile matra herne bani lagyo, kasari ghataune
mobile ko samaya tay garnus, din ma 1 ghanta. khana khandaa ra sutna agadi mobile banda garnus. baire khel ra kitab ma samaya bitaunus.

bachcha sanga kura garnus ra teacher lai bhannus. bachcha lai "timi ramro chhau" bhanera himmat dinus. school ma sathi banauna sahayog garnus.

nuhaune samaya khel jastai banaunus, khelauna rakhnus. tato pani ra sano balti prayog garnus. bachcha roera pani nuhaunu parchhaina, bholi feri try garnus.

naach ra music ma uslai pathaunus, ramro hunchha. din ma 15 minet abhyas pugchha. khel jastai sikaunus, dabab nagarnus.
bachcha lai pocket money kahile dina thalne

juwa bhaneko k ho?
juwa dui goru ko kaandh mathi rakhne lamo kath ho. yasle dui goru lai sangai jodchha, ani juwa ma bandheko halo ya gada tanna sajilo hunchha.

pahad ma jamin lai sidhi jasto gara gara banayera kina kheti garchhan?

bhakari ma k rakhinchha?
bhakari ma dhan, makai jasta sukaeko anna rakhinchha. yo bans ko choya le buneko thulo bhando ho, jaslai mato ra gobar le lipera musa ra osh bata jogainchha.
nanglo kina chalainchha?

doko pith ma bokne bans ko basket ho ra namlo tyas ma bandhine baliyo patta ho. namlo nidhar ma adkayera pahad ko ukalo orallo ma doko bokinchha.
mandro kun kaam ma aauchha?
mandro bans ko choya le buneko thulo chatai ho. dhan, makai, kodo jasta anna ghaam ma sukauna yasmathi failainchha.
gundri k le buninchha?
gundri paral le buninchha. gaun ma bhui ma basna, sutna ra anna sukauna gundri bichhyaune chalan chha.
theki ra madani bhaneko ke ho?
theki dahi rakhne ra mathne kath ko bhando ho, ra madani tyas bhitra ghumaune kath ko dandi ho. madani le dahi mathda nauni mathi aauchha ra baki mohi rahanchha.
gagri ma k garinchha?
gagri pani bokne ra rakhne gol bhando ho, jun tama, pital ya aluminium ko hunchha. pahile dhara ra kuwa bata gagri ma pani bokera ghar lyaune chalan thiyo.
goth bhaneko k ho?
goth bhaneko gai, bhaisi, bakhra jasta pashu rakhne ghar ho. ramro goth ma hawa ra ujyalo pasne ra bhui sukkha hune hunu parchha.
kodalo ra kuto ma k farak chha?
kodalo thulo saadhan ho, jasle mato khanna ra palta garna sakinchha. kuto saano hunchha, jasle tarkari bari ma godmel garna ra jhaar ukhelna sajilo hunchha.
hasiya le k k katinchha?
hasiya le ghans ra dhan, gahu, kodo jasta bali katinchha. yasko bango dhaar dherai tikho hunchha, tyasaile chalauda arko haat jogaunu parchha.
dhan ko daai garnu bhaneko k ho?
daai bhaneko kateko dhan lai khala ma failayera goru ghumaudai kulchaune kaam ho. goru ko khutta le kulchanda daana paral bata chhuttinchha.
bheda bata k k paainchha?
bheda bata un, masu ra mal paainchha. un bata radi, pakhi ra swetar jasta nyano saman banchhan.
bhaisi ko dudh gai ko dudh bhanda kina gadha hunchha?
bhaisi ko dudh ma gai ko dudh bhanda dherai chillo (fat) hunchha. tyasaile yo gadha hunchha ra yasbata ghiu ra dahi pani dherai niskinchha.
khachchar kasto janawar ho?
khachchar gadha (bhale) ra ghodi ko bachcha ho. yo baliyo ra bhari sahane bhayeko le himali ra pahadi bato ma saman bokna dherai prayog hunchha.
Why do many farmers in the hills keep goats?
Goats give meat and milk, and their droppings make good manure for the fields. They are easy to keep because they eat grass, leaves and shrubs.
kukhura palan kina dherai garchhan?
kukhura bata anda ra masu dubai paainchha ra thorai thau ma pani palna sakinchha. kukhura chhito hurkine bhayeko le kisan lai chhitai aamdani hunchha.
mahuri palan ko fayada bhannus na
mahuri bata mah ra main (mom) paainchha. mahuri le phool ko parag sarne bhayeko le najik ka tori, phalphul ra tarkari pani ramro falchhan.
resham kira le k khanchha?
resham kira le kimbu (mulberry) ko paat khanchha. kira le aafno koya banauda niskeko masino dhago bata resham kapada banchha.
tori bata tel nikalepachhi baki rahane chij lai k bhanchhan?
tyaslai pina bhanchhan. pina gai bhaisi lai khuwauna ra bari ma mal ko rup ma halna kaam lagchha.
sakhar kasari banchha?
ukhu pelera niskeko ras lai thulo karahi ma lamo samaya umalda pani udera baklo guliyo bhag matra bachchha. tyo chiso bhaepachhi jamera khairo sakhar banchha.
chiya bari ma chiya ko kun bhag tipinchha?
chiya ko bot ko tuppa ma bhayeko dui wata komal paat ra euta kopila tipinchha. yahi naram bhag bata ramro chiya patti banchha.
coffee chai bot ko kun bhag bata banchha?
coffee ko bot ma falne rato saano phal bhitra ko biu bata coffee banchha. biu lai sukaera bhutepachhi pisda coffee ko dhulo tayar hunchha.
What is the silk on a corn cob for?
Each strand of silk catches pollen for one kernel of corn. If pollen does not reach a strand, that kernel does not form, so the cob ends up with gaps.
makai ko bot ma bhale phool ra pothi phool kaha hunchhan?
makai ko bhale phool bot ko tuppa ma jhuppa jasto hunchha, ra pothi phool bot ko bich ma lagne ghoga ho. tuppa bata jhareko parag hawa le ghoga ko kesh samma puryauchha.
aalu kasari ropinchha?
aalu ropna saano aalu ya aankha bhayeko aalu ko tukra mato ma gadinchha. tyo aankha bata naya tusa ra bot umrinchha, tyasaile kisan le daana biu haina, aalu nai ropchhan.
jau bata k k banchha?
jau bata pitho, satu ra tsampa banchha. himali kshetra ma bhuteko jau ko pitho (tsampa) chiya ya dudh ma mudera khane chalan chha.
What is butter tea?
Butter tea is tea churned with butter and salt. People in the high Himalaya drink it because it is warm and gives a lot of energy in the cold.
nagadi bali bhaneko k ho?
bechera paisa kamauna lagaine bali lai nagadi bali bhanchhan, jastai chiya, alaichi, ukhu, aduwa ra coffee. dhan, makai jasta anna bali bhane dherai jaso ghar ko khana ko lagi lagainchha.
gobar mal kina ramro maninchha?
gobar mal le mato ma jaivik padartha thapchha, jasle mato khukulo ra urbar hunchha. yasle mato ma pani ramrari rokina pani maddat garchha.
dhan ko byad bhaneko k ho?
byad bhaneko dhan ko biu umarera saana biruwa hurkaune saano khet ho. biruwa ali thulo bhaepachhi byad bata ukhelera thulo khet ma ropinchha.
parma bhaneko k ho? gaun ma bhanthe
parma bhaneko gaun ka manchhe palaipalo ek arka ko khet ma kaam gardine chalan ho. aaja ma tapai ko ropain ma kaam garchhu, bholi tapai mero ma garidinu hunchha; yesari paisa bina sahayog hunchha.
hiundo bali ra barshe bali ma farak k?
barshe bali barsha ma lagaine bali ho, jastai dhan. hiundo bali jado ma lagaine bali ho, jastai gahu, tori, jau ra chana.
What is threshing?
Threshing is separating the grain from the dry stalks after harvest. In villages it is done by beating the bundles or by letting oxen walk over the crop, and today machines also do it.
Which trees do hill farmers grow for animal fodder?
Hill farmers often grow trees such as khanyu, badahar and kutmiro on the edges of their terraces. The leaves are cut and fed to cattle and goats, especially in the dry season when grass is short.
What is a scarecrow for?
A scarecrow is a figure dressed like a person and put in a field to scare birds away. From a distance birds think a person is standing there, so they keep away from the seeds and ripe grain.
aanp kun mausam ma pakchha?
nepal ko terai ma aanp dherai jaso garmi ma, jestha-asar tira pakchha. aanp lai taato mausam chahine bhayeko le chiso pahad ma yo ramrari faldaina.
phal ko raja kaslai bhanchhan?
dakshin asia ma aanp lai phal ko raja bhanne chalan chha. mitho swad ra baasna ko karan yo dherai lokpriya chha.
bhogate kasto phal ho?
bhogate suntala jaati ko sabai bhanda thulo phal ho. kartik-mangsir tira yasma nun, khursani ra dahi milayera saandheko bhogate dherai khanchhan.
aiselu kaha paainchha?
aiselu pahad ka jangal, khola kinar ra bato chheu ko kaada bhayeko jhyang ma paainchha. yo pahelo rang ko saano, rasilo ra guliyo jangali phal ho.
chiuri ko rukh kina mahatwapurna chha?
chiuri ko biu bata ghiu nikalinchha ra yasko phool bata mahuri le mah banauchhan. chepang samudaya ko jiwan ma chiuri ko rukh dherai mahatwapurna chha.
koiralo ko phool khana milchha?
milchha, koiralo ko kopila ra phool bata achar ra tarkari banainchha. basanta ritu tira pahad ma koiralo fulchha.
kinema k ho?
kinema bhatmas lai umalera kuhaera (fermentation) baneko khana ho. purbi pahad ma, khas gari limbu ra rai samudaya ma yasko tarkari lokpriya chha.
How is paneer made?
Paneer is made by adding lemon juice or vinegar to hot milk so that it splits into soft white lumps and watery whey. The lumps are wrapped in cloth and pressed into a block.
uttis ko rukh le mato lai kasari fayada garchha?
uttis ko jara ma nitrogen jamma garne saana jiwanu baschhan, jasle mato lai mal dinchha. tyasaile pahad ma uttis lagaeko bari ma aru bali lai pani fayada hunchha.
bans kun kun kaam ma aauchha?
bans bata doko, nanglo, mandro, bhakari ra ghar ko chhana samma banchha. yasko komal tusa (tama) tarkari ko rup ma pani khainchha.
allo bata k banchha?
allo (himali sisnu) ko bokra ko resha bata dhago katera kapada, jhola ra dori banainchha. pahad ka dherai gaun ma allo ko kapada bunne paramparik sip chha.
gunyu cholo kahile lagaunchhan?
gunyu cholo nepali mahila ko paramparik poshak ho, jasma lamo gunyu (sari jasto) ra cholo hunchha. chhori lai pahilo choti gunyu cholo dine bidhi lai gunyu cholo samaroha bhanchhan.
chaubandi cholo ma chaubandi bhaneko k?
chaubandi cholo ma char thau ma dori (tunna) bandhinchha, tyasaile yaslai chaubandi bhaninchha. yo mahila le lagaune paramparik nepali cholo ho.
patuka kina bandhinchha?
patuka kammar ma bandhine lamo kapada ho. yasle kammar lai sahara dinchha ra pahile paisa ya saano saman rakhne thau ko kaam pani garthyo.
bakhu kun samudaya ko poshak ho?
bakhu sherpa ra himali kshetra ka aru samudaya le lagaune lamo, baklo ra nyano poshak ho. chiso himali hawa bata jogauna yo dherai kaam lagchha.
haku patasi k ho?
haku patasi newar mahila ko paramparik poshak ho. yo kalo rang ko sari jasto kapada ho, jasko kinar ma rato dharka hunchha.
bhadgaunle topi kasto hunchha?
bhadgaunle topi kalo rang ko nepali topi ho. pahile bhaktapur (bhadgaun) ma banne bhayeko le yasko naam bhadgaunle rahan gayeko ho.
damphu kasto baja ho?
damphu kath ko gol ghero ma ek tira matra chhala tanera baneko baja ho. tamang selo gauda damphu nai mukhya baja ho.
binayo k le banchha?
binayo bans ko patalo choya bata banchha. ek chheu ma bandheko dhago tanda bich ko patalo jibro kaampchha ra mukh ko hawa le madhur aawaj niskinchha.
murchunga kasari bajainchha?
murchunga falam ko saano baja ho. yaslai daat le halka chyapera bich ko patalo jibro aunla le hirkainchha, ra mukh le aawaj lai thulo-sano banainchha.
tungna kun kshetra ko baja ho?
tungna himali kshetra ko taar bhayeko baja ho, jun sarangi jastai tara aunla le bajainchha. sherpa, tamang ra aru himali samudaya ko geet ma tungna bajchha.
dhime kun samudaya ko baja?
dhime newar samudaya ko paramparik dhol ho. jatra ra parba ma dhime bajaudai hidne chalan kathmandu upatyaka ma dherai dekhinchha.
narsingha kasto baja ho?
narsingha tama ko lamo, bango ra singh jasto aakar ko phukne baja ho. yasko thulo aawaj panche baja ma ra bibaha ko jantama sunninchha.
bansuri ma kati pwal hunchhan?
bansuri ma dherai jaso mukh le phukne ek pwal ra aunla le chhopne 6 ota pwal hunchhan. aunla le pwal kholda ra chhopda sur badalinchha.
What is a sarangi made of?

A Nepali sarangi is carved from a single piece of wood, with skin stretched over the lower part. It is played with a bow, and its strings were once made of gut, though today metal or nylon strings are common.
maruni naach kahile naachinchha?
maruni naach dherai jaso tihar ko bela naachinchha. yasma purush le mahila ko luga lagayera naachne chalan chha, ra yo magar samudaya ma dherai lokpriya chha.
deuda geet kun kshetra ko ho?
deuda sudurpashchim ra karnali kshetra ko lok geet ra naach ho. manchhe ek arka ko haat samaera gol ghero banaudai sawal-jawaf garera gaunchhan.
tamang selo ma kun baja bajinchha?
tamang selo ma mukhya rup ma damphu bajinchha. yo tamang samudaya ko lok geet ho, jun damphu ko taal ma gaine ra naachine garinchha.
dhan naach kasle naachchhan?
dhan naach limbu samudaya ko paramparik naach ho. keta keti haat samaera gol ghero ma bistarai paila chalaudai palam gaudai naachchhan.
sakhiya naach k ho?
sakhiya tharu samudaya ko paramparik naach ho. dashain ko bela tharu gaun ma madal ko taal ma yo naach naachinchha.
jhijhiya naach ma k garinchha?
jhijhiya mithila kshetra ko naach ho, jun dashain ko bela mahila le naachchhan. pwal pareko maato ko ghaila bhitra diyo balera tauko ma rakhera naachne chalan chha.
Which script is used to write Nepali?
Nepali is written in the Devanagari script. Hindi, Marathi and Sanskrit use the same script.
newar haru ko aafnai lipi chha?
chha, nepal bhasa (newari) lekhna ranjana ra prachalit lipi prayog hunchhan. aajkal nepal bhasa devanagari ma pani lekhinchha.
limbu bhasa kun lipi ma lekhinchha?
limbu bhasa sirijunga lipi ma lekhinchha. yo lipi limbu samudaya ko aafnai lipi ho.
nepal ma nepali pachhi sabai bhanda dherai boline matribhasa kun ho?
nepal ma nepali pachhi sabai bhanda dherai manchhe ko matribhasa maithili ho. maithili mukhya rup ma madhesh pradesh ka purbi jilla ma bolinchha.
bagh chal khel kasari khelinchha?
bagh chal 5 x 5 rekha bhayeko patti ma 4 bagh ra 20 bakhra le khelinchha. bagh le bakhra lai naghera marchha, ra bakhra le bagh lai hidna nasakne gari gherera jitchha.
dandi biyo kasto khel ho?
dandi biyo ek lamo lauro (dandi) ra euta saano tikho kath (biyo) le kheline gaun ko khel ho. dandi le biyo uchhalera tadha samma hanne khelaadi le ank paauchha.
chungi kasari banauchhan?
chungi dherai rubber band ek aapas ma bandhera banaieko saano bal jasto chij ho. yaslai bhui ma nakhasaune gari khutta le pataka pataka uchhaldai khelinchha.
gatta khel ma k chahinchha?
gatta khelna 5 ota saana chillo dhunga chahinchha. euta dhunga uchhalera tyo naakhasda samma bhui bata aru dhunga tipne khel ho.
silauto lohoro ko kaam k ho?
silauto chepto dhunga ho ra lohoro tyasmathi chalaune gol dhunga ho. yi dui le khursani, lasun, aduwa ra achar ko masala pisinchha.
okhal ra musal le k garchhan?
okhal bhui ma gadeko ya dhunga ma khaneko khaldo ho, ra musal lamo gahrungo kath. okhal ma anna rakhera musal le kutda bokra chhuttinchha ra masala pani dhulo hunchha.
maato ko ghaila ma rakheko pani kina chiso hunchha?
maato ko ghaila ma saana saana pwal hunchhan, jasbata thorai pani bahira aaera bafinchha. pani bafinda garmi lagera jaanchha, tyasaile bhitra ko pani chiso rahanchha.
karuwa bhaneko k ho?
karuwa tuti bhayeko pani rakhne lota ho, jun dherai jaso pital ya tama ko hunchha. puja ma ra khana khanda pani rakhna karuwa prayog hunchha.
pital ra kaansa dubai ma tama hunchha?
hunchha. pital tama ra jasta milayera banchha, ra kaansa tama ra tin (ranga) milayera banchha. kaansa bata thal, kachaura ra ghanti banainchha.
thimi kun kura ko lagi chinchha?
thimi maato ka bhaada ra murti banaune kaam ko lagi chinchha. yaha ka kaligad le chakka ma maato ghumayera ghaila, diyo ra gamala banauchhan.
Which Nepali town is famous for pottery?
Bhaktapur is well known for pottery, and it has a square where potters work on their wheels and dry their pots in the sun. Thimi, next to it, is also famous for clay pots and masks.
patan lai kun kala ko lagi chinchha?
patan (lalitpur) dhatu ka murti ra kath ko kalakriti ko lagi prasiddha chha. yaha ka kaligad le moum ko murti banaera dhatu dhalne purano bidhi le murti banauchhan.
newari jhyal kina prasiddha chhan?
newari jhyal kath ma masinu butta katerera banainchha. kathmandu upatyaka ka purana ghar ra mandir ma yasta kalatmak jhyal dekhinchhan.
pahad ko purano ghar ko chhana k le banthyo?
pahad ma purana ghar ko chhana dherai jaso khar (ghans) ya chepto dhunga (slate) le banthyo. khar sasto ra sajilai paine thiyo, ra dhunga ko chhana lamo samaya tikchha.
hamro gaun ko ghar maato ra dhunga ko chha, jado ma nyano kina hunchha?
maato ra dhunga ko bakla bhitta le bahira ko chiso bhitra aauna dhilo garchha. diuso ghaam le tateko bhitta le raati bistarai taap chhodchha, tyasaile kotha nyano rahanchha.
chyangra bata k paainchha?
chyangra himali kshetra ko bakhra ho. yasko sharir ko masino nyano un bata pashmina banchha ra dashain ma yasko masu pani dherai khaine chalan chha.
kaguno, chino ra junelo k hun?

yi sabai saana daana bhayeko anna bali hun: kaguno (foxtail millet), chino (proso millet) ra junelo (sorghum). sukkha ra kam mal bhayeko jamin ma pani falne bhayeko le yi pahad ra karnali ma dherai lagainchha.
uwa bhaneko k ho?
uwa himali kshetra ma falne jau ko ek jaat ho, jasko daana ma bokra tasieko hudaina. mustang, dolpa, humla jasta thau ma uwa ko tsampa ra roti dherai khainchha.
What is the difference between rice paddy and rice?
Paddy is rice that still has its husk, straight from the field. Once the husk is removed at the mill, what is left is the rice we cook.
macha marna bansi ma k chahinchha?
bansi ma lamo lauro, dhago, balchhi (kaanta) ra khana (charo) chahinchha. charo ko lagi gadyaula ya pitho ko dallo balchhi ma lagaunchhan.
ochhyan ra sirak ma k farak?
ochhyan sutda muni bichhyaune chij ho, jastai gundri, radi ya dasna. sirak bhane mathi odhne kapas bhareko nyano kapada ho.
radi pakhi kaha banchhan?
radi ra pakhi bheda ko un bata buninchha, ra pahad tatha himali kshetra ma yo bunne parampara purano chha. radi bichhyauna ra pakhi odhna kaam lagchha.
gajar ra mula ko kun bhag khanchhau hami?
gajar ra mula ko jara khanchhau. biruwa le aafno khana yo moto jara ma jamma garchha, tyasaile yo mitho ra poshilo hunchha.
pyaj ra lasun biruwa ko kun bhag ho?
pyaj ra lasun ko khaine bhag mato muni ko gano (bulb) ho. pyaj ko gano moto paat ko tah le baneko hunchha, tyasaile katda tah tah dekhinchha; lasun ko gano bhitra saana saana poti hunchhan.
aduwa ra besar chai jara ho ki k ho?
aduwa ra besar jara haina, mato muni phailine kaand (rhizome) ho. yasma aankha jasta gaanth hunchhan jasbata naya tusa umrinchha.
cauli ko kun bhag khainchha?
cauli ko seto bhag dherai saana phool ko kopila jammaa bhaera baneko hunchha. tyasaile cauli khanda hami phool ko bhag khairaheka hunchhau.
Which part of the cinnamon plant is the spice?
Cinnamon is the dried inner bark of the cinnamon tree. Strips of bark are peeled off and dried, and they curl up into the rolls we buy.
lwang chai biruwa ko kun bhag ho?
lwang phool fulnu agadi tipera sukaeko kopila ho. sukepachhi yo kalo-khairo ra kada hunchha.
What part of a plant is black pepper?
Black pepper is the dried fruit of a climbing vine. The small green berries are picked and dried in the sun until they turn black and wrinkled.
karkalo ra pindalu eutai biruwa ho?
ho, eutai biruwa ho. pindalu yasko mato muni ko kanda ho, ra karkalo yasko paat ra danth ho, jasko tarkari banainchha.
iskus ko phal matra khaine ho?
haina, iskus ko phal sangai yasko komal tusa (munta) pani khainchha. iskus ko munta ko saag pahad ma dherai man parainchha.
Which part of the banana plant besides the fruit can we eat?
The banana flower, the large purple bud at the end of the bunch, is cooked as a vegetable. The soft inner core of the stem is also cooked in some places.
alaichi ko kun bhag lai masala bhanchhau?
alaichi ko phal (kosa) ra tyas bhitra ko biu nai masala ho. thulo alaichi nepal ko purbi pahad ma dherai falchha.
makai bhutda phutera fulka kina banchha?
makai ko daana bhitra thorai pani hunchha. tataunda tyo pani baph banchha ra bahira ko kada bokra futaera daana fulera seto fulka banchha.
khuwa kasari banchha?
khuwa dudh lai karahi ma lamo samaya umalera ra chalaudai baklo banauda banchha. pani udera gaepachhi baki rahane gadha dudh nai khuwa ho, jasbata peda ra barfi jasta mithai banchhan.
kukhura ko anda bata challa niklina kati din lagchha?
kukhura ko anda bata challa niklina lagbhag 21 din lagchha. tyo bela samma anda lai pothi ko nyano ya incubator ko taap chahinchha.
Why does a rooster crow in the morning?
A rooster has an inner body clock that tells it when morning is coming, so it crows around dawn. It also crows at other times to mark its area and call to other chickens.
bakhri ko pet ma pathapathi kati mahina rahanchha?
bakhri ko garbha lagbhag 5 mahina ko hunchha. gai ko garbha bhanda yo dherai chhoto ho, tyasaile bakhra palan ma chhitai bathaa badhchha.
Why do buffaloes like to lie in mud and water?
Buffaloes have few sweat glands, so they cannot cool down well by sweating. Lying in water or mud keeps them cool and also protects their skin from flies.
kukur lai chocolate kina khuwaunu hudaina?
chocolate ma theobromine bhanne padartha hunchha, jun kukur ko sharir le ramrari pachauna sakdaina. yasle kukur lai bisha jastai asar garna sakchha, tyasaile kukur lai chocolate nadinus.
kukhura le saana dhunga kina nilchha?
kukhura ko daat hudaina. yasle nileko saana dhunga pet ko gizzard bhanne thaili ma basera daana lai pisna maddat garchha.
Why does water roll off a duck's back?
A duck spreads oil from a gland near its tail over its feathers. The oily feathers keep water out, so the duck stays dry and warm while swimming.
rato kapada dekhera saando risauchha bhanchhan, sahi ho?
haina, saando le rato rang ramrari chhuttyauna sakdaina. kapada hallaune gati dekhera u jhamtinchha, rang le haina.
gai bhaisi lai nun kina chataunchhan?
nun ma pashu ko sharir lai chahine sodium jasta khanij hunchhan, jun ghans bata matra pugdaina. tyasaile gai bhaisi lai thorai nun dinu ramro maninchha.
kudo bhaneko k ho?
kudo bhaneko gai bhaisi lai khuwaune pakaeko khana ho. yasma dhuto, pitho, bhansa ko baki khana ra pani milayera umalinchha.
dhunge dhara lai newari ma k bhanchhan?
dhunge dhara lai newari ma hiti bhanchhan. kathmandu upatyaka ma dhunga ko tuti bata pani jharne yasta purana dhara dherai thau ma chhan.
pati ra pauwa bhaneko k ho?
pati ra pauwa bato chheu ma banaieko sarbajanik basne ghar ho. yatri le ghaam, pani ra raat bata bachna yaha aaram garchhan.
jholunge pul kasari adiyeko hunchha?
jholunge pul nadi ko dubai kinar ma baliyo gari gadeko falam ko dori (cable) ma jhundieko hunchha. bich ma kunai khamba hudaina, tyasaile hidda pul ali jholinchha.
tuin bhaneko k ho?
tuin bhaneko nadi waripari tanieko dori ma jhundiera aafulai tanda tarne tarika ho. pul nabhayeko thau ma yo prayog hunthyo, tara dherai khatarnak hunchha.
asare geet kahile gainchha?
asare geet asar mahina ma dhan ropda gainchha. hilo khet ma ropain garda thakai bisaauna ra ramailo garna yo geet gaine chalan chha.
malashri dhun kun parba sanga jodiyeko chha?
malashri dhun dashain sanga jodiyeko chha. dashain aaune bela radio ra gaun ma malashri bajda chadparba ko mahol banchha.
ratauli k ho?
ratauli bibaha ma janti gaeko raat beula ko ghar ma baseka mahila haru le garne naach-gaan ho. ghar ma raheka mahila raat bhari gaudai naachchhan.
chyabrung kun samudaya ko baja ho?
chyabrung limbu samudaya ko dui tira chhala bhayeko dhol ho. yasko taal ma limbu haru chyabrung naach naachchhan.
hudko kun kshetra ma bajinchha?
hudko karnali ra sudurpashchim kshetra ma bajine saano baja ho, jasko bich ko bhag patalo hunchha. hudko bajaudai gaine-naachne lai hudke naach bhanchhan.
nepali bhasa lai pahile k bhaninthyo?
nepali bhasa lai pahile khas kura, gorkhali ra parbatiya bhaninthyo. pachhi yaslai nepali bhasa bhanna thaliyo.
sudhariyeko chulo ko fayada k ho?
sudhariyeko chulo ma aago chulo bhitrai rahanchha ra dhuwa chimney bata bahira jaanchha. yasle kam daaura ma khana pakchha ra kotha ma dhuwa kam hune bhayeko le aankha ra phokso joginchhan.
hiundo ma tusaro le tarkari kina marchha?
tusaro parda biruwa ko paat bhitra ko pani jamchha ra barf ko daana le koshika futaidinchha. tyasaile bihana tusaro pareko tarkari ko paat oilaera kalo hunchha.
How do farmers protect seedlings from frost?
Farmers cover young plants with straw, plastic or dry leaves on cold nights. The cover keeps the warmth of the soil around the plants, so ice does not form on the leaves.
chiya ko bot lai kina chhoto katchhan?
chiya ko bot lai chhoto katda (pruning) dherai naya komal munta aauchhan. tipne manchhe ko haat pugne uchai ma bot rahanchha, tyasaile tipna pani sajilo hunchha.
What is terrace farming?
Terrace farming is growing crops on flat steps cut into a hillside. The steps slow down rainwater, stop the soil from washing away and make the land easier to plough.
Why do farmers leave a field empty for a season sometimes?
Leaving a field to rest, called fallowing, lets the soil recover some of its nutrients and moisture. Weeds and pests that depend on the crop also become fewer.
What is the difference between a tractor and a power tiller?
A tractor is a large four-wheeled machine that pulls heavy ploughs and trailers. A power tiller is a smaller two-wheeled machine that a person walks behind, which suits small terraced fields.
barsat ma bari ko mato kina bagchha?
thulo pani parda pani le mato ko mathillo tah bagaidinchha, khas gari bhiralo ra nango jamin ma. ghans, rukh ra gara le pani ko gati dhilo bhaera mato jogainchha.
What is mulching?
Mulching is covering the soil around plants with straw, dry leaves or grass. It keeps the soil moist, stops weeds from growing and protects the soil from heavy rain.
What is a greenhouse used for in farming?
A farm greenhouse is a frame covered with clear plastic or glass that traps the sun's warmth. Farmers in cold places use it to grow tomatoes and vegetables earlier and longer in the year.
plastic ghar (tunnel) ma tarkari kina chhito hurkinchha?
plastic ghar bhitra ghaam ko taap bhitrai thunninchha ra bahira bhanda nyano hunchha. tusaro ra thulo pani bata pani biruwa jogiyera chhito hurkinchha.
What is grafting in fruit trees?

Grafting is joining a cut shoot from a good fruit tree onto the stem and roots of another plant so they grow as one. In Nepali a grafted plant is called "kalami", and oranges and apples are often grown this way.
dhan ko khet ma machha palna milchha?
milchha, dhan khet ma pani jamne bhayeko le kati kisan le dhan sangai machha palchhan. machha le jhaar ra kira khanchhan ra tiniharu ko mal le dhan lai fayada garchha.
Why do potatoes turn green, and can we eat the green part?

Potatoes kept in light make green chlorophyll, and at the same time a bitter natural poison builds up in the green part. Cut the green part and any sprouts away before cooking, and store potatoes in a dark place.
What does a honeybee's dance in the hive mean?
A bee that finds good flowers does a "waggle dance" when it returns to the hive. The direction and length of the dance tell the other bees which way and how far to fly to reach the food.
mah kina jamera daanaa daanaa hunchha?
mah ma dherai guliyo hunchha, ra chiso ma tyo guliyo saana daana (crystal) ma jamna thalchha. yo bigreko haina; mah lai halka nyano pani ma rakhda pheri patalo hunchha.
kisan le bari ma kharani kina chharchhan?
kaath ko kharani ma potash (potassium) ra calcium jasta tatva hunchhan, jun biruwa lai chahinchha. yasle amilo mato ko amilopan pani ghataidinchha.
Why must kidney beans be cooked fully?
Raw or undercooked kidney beans (rajma) contain a natural toxin that can cause stomach pain and vomiting. Soaking them and then boiling them well until soft destroys it.
What is organic farming?
Organic farming grows crops without factory-made fertilizers and pesticides. Farmers use compost, animal manure, crop rotation and natural ways of controlling pests instead.
Why are many old village houses in the hills painted with red mud and white clay?

Village houses are often plastered with red clay on the lower part and white clay above. The mud plaster protects the walls from rain and dust, and freshly plastering the house is a common way to make it look clean for festivals like Dashain and Tihar.
maato le ghar ko bhui lipda k fayada hunchha?
maato ra gobar le lipeko bhui chiplo hudaina ra dhulo kam udchha. pahile gaun ma yo nai bhui safa ra samtal rakhne sajilo upaya thiyo.
What is a bullock cart?
A bullock cart is a two-wheeled wooden cart pulled by a pair of oxen. In some Terai villages it is still used to carry harvests, firewood and goods along farm roads.
Why do some farmers keep ducks in their rice fields?
Ducks swim between the rice plants and eat insects, snails and small weeds. Their droppings also feed the soil, so the farmer needs fewer chemicals.
How do farmers know rice is ready to harvest?
Rice is ready when most of the grains on the heads have turned golden and hard and the heads bend down with their weight. If it is cut too late, many grains fall off in the field.
What is the difference between a sheep and a goat?
Sheep usually have thick wool and graze on grass close to the ground, and their tails hang down. Goats have hair instead of wool, like to nibble leaves and bushes, and their tails usually point up.
Why does a cow give milk only after having a calf?
Like all mammals, a cow makes milk to feed her young, so milk starts after she gives birth. She keeps giving milk for several months, and the amount slowly drops over time.
Can a hen lay eggs without a rooster?
Yes. A hen lays eggs whether or not there is a rooster, but those eggs are not fertilized and will never hatch into chicks.
What do bees collect from flowers besides nectar?
Bees also collect pollen, which they carry on their back legs. Pollen is protein food for the young bees, while nectar becomes honey.
Why are the cells in a honeycomb six-sided?
Six-sided cells fit together with no gaps between them. This shape stores the most honey while using the least wax, and it makes the comb strong.
Why do farmers dry grain in the sun before storing it?
Damp grain gets mouldy, starts to rot and attracts insects. Drying it well in the sun lets it be stored safely for many months.
Why do hill farmers hang maize cobs under the roof?
Hanging the cobs in bundles under the roof lets them dry in the air while keeping them out of the rain and off the damp ground. It also makes it harder for rats to reach them.
ghoral kasto janawar ho?
ghoral bakhra ra mriga jasto dekhine khairo-kharani rang ko janawar ho. yo pahad ka bhiralo bhir ra chattan ma sajilai uklina ra orlina sakchha.
rato bandar ra langur ma k farak chha?
rato bandar ko mukh rato-gulabi ra puchhar chhoto hunchha. langur ko mukh kalo, jiu kharani-seto ra puchhar dherai lamo hunchha.
kalo bhalu lai kasari chinne?
himali kalo bhalu ko sharir kalo hunchha ra chhati ma seto "V" aakar ko chinha hunchha. yo pahad ka jangal ma baschha ra phal, makai, mah ra kira dherai khanchha.
terai ko bhalu le k khanchha?
terai ko jangal ma paine sloth bhalu le dhamiro (termite), kamila, phal ra mah dherai khanchha. lamo nangra le dhamiro ko gauda khanera ota le sohorera dhamiro khanchha.
chituwa ra bagh ma farak k?
bagh thulo hunchha ra yasko jiu ma kalo dharka hunchha. chituwa sano hunchha, yasko jiu ma gol gol thopla (rosette) hunchha ra yo rukh ma sajilai chadhchha.
chituwa le shikar lai rukh ma kina lagchha?
chituwa le mareko shikar lai rukh ma tanera lagchha taki bagh, syal jasta aru janawar le khosna nasakun. tyaha rakhera dherai din samma bistarai khanchha.
syal raati kina karauchha?
syal le raati karaera aafno samuha ka sathi sanga kura garchha ra aafno ilaka janauchha. ek jana karaun thalepachhi aru pani sangai karauchhan.
dumsi le aafno kaada hanera tadha samma phalna sakchha?
sakdaina, yo galat dharana ho. dumsi le kaada uthaera ulto hiddai shatru lai ghochchha, ra chhoyeko kaada sajilai chhutera shatru ko jiu ma gadchha.
bandel le khet ma kasto noksan garchha?
bandel le ota (thuto) le mato khanera jara, aalu ra pindalu khanchha. raati samuha ma aaera makai, dhan jasta bali kulchera ra khayera dherai noksan garchha.
ratuwa lai kina ratuwa bhanchhan?
ratuwa ko jiu rato-khairo hunchha. darauda yo kukur le bhukeko jasto aawaj nikalchha, tyasaile yaslai english ma barking deer bhaninchha.
chittal mriga ko pahichan k ho?
chittal ko khairo jiu ma seto seto thopla hunchhan. terai ka jangal ra ghanse maidan ma yo samuha ma dherai dekhinchha.
chittal ra langur sangai kina dekhinchhan?
langur rukh mathi basera phal ra paat jharaidinchhan, jun tala chittal le khanchhan. langur le mathi bata bagh ya chituwa dekhda karauchha, ra tyo sunera chittal pani sachet hunchhan.
gauri gai kun janawar ho?
gauri gai (gaur) sansar ko sabai bhanda thulo jangali gai jaati ko janawar ho. nepal ma yo chitwan ra parsa ka jangal ma paainchha.
nilgai kasto janawar ho?
nilgai asia ko sabai bhanda thulo mriga jaati (antelope) ho. bhale ko jiu nilo-kharani hunchha, ra yo nepal ko terai ka khula jangal ra kheti najik dekhinchha.
majur ko lamo puchhar bhale ko hunchha ki pothi ko?
lamo, rangin puchhar bhale majur ko hunchha. pothi majur ko rang khairo ra sadharan hunchha; bhale le puchhar phailaera pothi lai aakarshit garchha.
dhanesh charaa ko bishesh bani k ho?
dhanesh (hornbill) ko thulo chuchcho mathi topi jasto bhag hunchha. guntaa basda pothi rukh ko dulo bhitra pasera muhan mato le thunchhe, ra bhale le saano pwal bata usko khana lyaidinchha.
koili le aafno anda kaha paarchhe?
koili le aafno guntaa banaudina; usle kaag ko guntaa ma anda paarchhe. kaag le nai tyo anda ma othaaro basera bachcha hurkauchha.
matikore le machha kasari samatchha?
matikore (kingfisher) pani mathi ko haanga ma basera machha herchha. machha dekhne bittikai pani ma jhamtera chuchcho le samatchha.
kathfor le rukh ma kina thokchha?
kathfor (woodpecker) le rukh ko bokra bhitra lukeka kira khojna ra guntaa ko lagi dulo banauna chuchcho le thokchha. yasko khappar baliyo hunchha, tyasaile tauko lai chot lagdaina.
sarus charaa kaha dekhinchha?
sarus nepal ko lumbini kshetra, khas gari rupandehi ra kapilvastu ka khet ra simsar ma dekhinchha. yo sansar ko sabai bhanda aglo udne charaa ho.
sarus ko jodi lai kina prem ko pratik manchhan?
sarus ko bhale ra pothi dherai jaso jiwan bhari sangai baschhan. tyasaile manchhe le yaslai saacho maya ko pratik manchhan.
ullu le aankha haina tauko kina ghumauchha?
ullu ko aankha khappar ma kasieko hunchha ra manchhe ko jastai ghumdaina. tyasaile ullu le arko tira herna pura tauko ghumauchha, ra yo dherai tadha samma ghumauna sakchha.
ullu le kina haddi ra raun ko dallo ulti garchha?
ullu le saana musa ra charaa lai purai nilchha. pachna nasakne haddi, raun ra pwankh pet ma dallo banchha ra pachhi mukh bata bahira falchha.
ullu udda kina aawaj aaudaina?
ullu ko pwankh ko kinar naram ra jhuppa jasto hunchha, jasle hawa katda aawaj ghataidinchha. tyasaile ullu chup chaap udera shikar samatna sakchha.
dhamiro le kath kasari khanchha?
dhamiro ko pet ma saana jiwanu hunchhan, jasle kath ko kada bhag pachauna maddat garchha. tyasaile dhamiro le ghar ko kath, kitab ra rukh ko kath khana sakchha.
jukaa le ragat chusda kina dukhdaina?
jukaa ko thuk ma dukhai thaha nadine ra ragat najamne padartha hunchha. tyasaile jukaa chhutepachhi pani ghau bata ali ber ragat bagirahanchha.
jukaa lagyo bhane kasari hataaune?
jukaa lai jabarjasti natannus. jukaa ko muhan bhayeko chheu nira nangra le bistarai chhutyaunus, ani ghau lai sabun-pani le dhoera safa rakhnus.
ajingar bishalu sarpa ho?
haina, ajingar (python) bishalu hudaina. yasle shikar lai jiu le bertera kasera marchha ani purai nilchha.
naag (king cobra) ko bishesh kura k ho?
king cobra sansar ko sabai bhanda lamo bishalu sarpa ho. pothi le paat ra jhaar jammaa garera anda ko lagi guntaa banauchhe, jun sarpa ma dherai kam dekhine bani ho.
sarpa ko kaan hudaina bhanchhan, sunchha ta?
sarpa ko bahira dekhine kaan hudaina. u le jamin ko kampan (vibration) jiu ra bangara bata thaha paauchha, ra bhitri kaan le kehi aawaj pani sunchha.
sapera le bin bajauda sarpa sangeet sunera naachchha?
haina, sarpa le bin ko sangeet ramrari sundaina. sapera le bin hallaudai garda tyo chaliraheko chij lai khatara thanera sarpa pani sangai hallinchha.
sarpa le dudh piunchha bhanchhan, sahi ho?
sarpa le dudh piune bani hudaina. sarpa mansahari ho; yasle musa, bhyaguto, charaa ra anda khanchha.
sarpa le aafno muhan bhanda thulo shikar kasari nilchha?
sarpa ko bangara ko tallo ra mathillo bhag lachilo nasa le jodieko hunchha, tyasaile muhan dherai thulo khulchha. ani bistarai shikar lai purai nilchha.
garmi ra barsat ma sarpa kina dherai dekhinchhan?
sarpa chiso ragat bhayeko janawar ho, jado ma lukera sust baschha ra garmi ma sakriya hunchha. barsat ma dulo ma pani pasepachhi bahira niskanchha, tyasaile yo bela dherai dekhinchha.
magar gohi ra ghadiyal ma chinne tarika k?
magar gohi ko thuto chaudaa ra baliyo hunchha ra yasle machha dekhi janawar samma khanchha. ghadiyal ko thuto lamo ra patalo hunchha, jun machha samatna milne hunchha.
bhyaguto le kasari sas ferchha?
thulo bhyaguto le phokso bata sas ferchha, tara yasko patalo osilo chhala bata pani hawa bhitra pasna sakchha. tyasaile bhyaguto ko chhala sadhai osilo rahanu parchha.
barsat ma bhyaguto kina dherai karaunchha?
barsat bhyaguto ko prajanan garne bela ho. bhale bhyaguto le karaera pothi lai bolauchha, tyasaile barsat ko raat ma khet ra pokhari bata dherai aawaj aauchha.
What is the difference between a frog and a toad?
Frogs usually have smooth, wet skin and long legs for jumping, and they stay near water. Toads have dry, bumpy skin and shorter legs, and they can live farther from water.
How does a frog catch insects?
A frog shoots out its long, sticky tongue, which is attached at the front of its mouth. The insect sticks to it and the frog pulls it back in, all in a fraction of a second.
Why does a lizard's tail come off?
Many lizards can drop their tail when a predator grabs it. The tail keeps wriggling to distract the attacker while the lizard runs away, and a new, shorter tail slowly grows back.
How can a gecko walk on walls and ceilings?
A gecko's toe pads are covered with millions of tiny hairs. They touch the wall so closely that a weak pull between them and the surface holds the gecko up, even upside down.
Why do chameleons change colour?
Chameleons change colour mostly to show their mood to other chameleons and to warm up or cool down. Special skin cells change the way they reflect light, which shifts the colour.
Why do lizards and snakes lie in the sun?
Reptiles are cold-blooded, which means their body heat comes from their surroundings. They lie in the sun to warm up so they can move and digest food, and they hide in the shade when it gets too hot.
What does warm-blooded mean?
A warm-blooded animal keeps its body temperature steady using heat from its own food, whether the weather is hot or cold. Mammals and birds are warm-blooded; fish, frogs and reptiles are not.
machha ko jiu chiplo kina hunchha?
machha ko jiu ma patalo chiplo tah (mucus) hunchha. yasle machha lai rog ra kira bata jogauchha ra pani ma chhito paudina sajilo banauchha.
machha ko kati umer bhayo bhanera kasari thaha hunchha?
machha ko kat (scale) ma rukh ko jastai ghero (ring) banchha. bigyan haru le yi ghero ganera machha ko umer anuman garchhan.
asala machha kasto pani ma paainchha?
asala himal bata aaune chiso ra safa pani bhayeko pahadi nadi ma paainchha. yasko jiu ma saana kat hunchhan ra yo nepal ko pahad ma dherai man parine machha ho.
Why do salmon swim up rivers?
Salmon hatch in rivers, grow up in the sea and then swim back up the river where they were born to lay their eggs. They leap up small waterfalls on the way.
Which animal father carries the babies before they are born?
In seahorses, the male carries the eggs in a pouch on his belly until the babies hatch. Then tiny seahorses come out of the pouch into the water.
Is a starfish really a fish?
No. A starfish, better called a sea star, has no backbone, no fins and no gills like a fish. If it loses an arm, it can grow a new one.
Is a jellyfish a fish?
No, a jellyfish is not a fish. It has no bones, no brain and no heart, and it is made mostly of water; it stings small animals with its tentacles to catch them.
Is coral a plant or an animal?
Coral is an animal. Each coral is made of tiny creatures that build hard limestone homes, and over many years these homes form huge reefs where many fish live.
Why does a crab walk sideways?
A crab's legs are on the sides of its body and bend sideways at the joints. Walking sideways is the fastest and easiest way for it to move, though some crabs can walk forwards too.
Why does an octopus squirt ink?
When an octopus is in danger it squirts a cloud of dark ink into the water. The cloud hides it and confuses the attacker while the octopus escapes.
Do sharks run out of teeth?
No. Sharks lose teeth often, but new teeth keep moving forward from rows behind them to replace the lost ones throughout their lives.
Which mammals lay eggs?
The platypus and the echidna, both from Australia, are mammals that lay eggs. After the babies hatch, the mothers feed them milk like other mammals.
putali ra pataango (moth) ma kasari chhuttyaune?

putali dherai jaso diuso udchha ra basda pwankh mathi jodera thadho rakhchha. pataango dherai jaso raati udchha ra basda pwankh chepto phailaera rakhchha; yasko sinka (antenna) pani prayah jhuppa jasto hunchha.
putali le khutta le swad thaha paauchha bhanchhan, sahi ho?
sahi ho. putali ko khutta ma swad thaha paaune ang hunchha, tyasaile paat ma basda nai tyo paat ma anda paarne ki naparne thaha paauchha.
kira ko ragat ko rang kasto hunchha?
kira ko ragat rato hudaina, dherai jaso patalo, pahelo ya hariyo jasto hunchha. hamro ragat lai rato banaune hemoglobin dherai kira ko ragat ma hudaina.
kira le naak bina kasari sas ferchha?
kira ko jiu ko chheu ma saana saana pwal hunchhan, jaslai spiracle bhanchhan. yinai pwal bata hawa bhitra nali haru hudai jiu bhari pugchha.
lady bird (sano rato kira thopla bhayeko) lai kisan ko sathi kina bhanchhan?
lady bird ra yasko larva le aphid (lahi) jasta saana kira khanchhan, jasle biruwa ko ras chusera noksan garchhan. tyasaile yo kira bari ma huda bali joginchha.
Where are a grasshopper's ears?
A grasshopper's ears are on the sides of its body, near the base of its back legs. Crickets, its cousins, have their ears on their front legs.
How do cicadas make such a loud sound?
Male cicadas have special drum-like plates on their bodies that click very fast when muscles pull them. Their hollow bodies make the sound louder, and they call like this to attract females.
Why does a honeybee die after stinging?

A honeybee's sting has tiny backward hooks, so it gets stuck in our skin. When the bee flies away, part of its body tears off with the sting, and the bee dies; wasps have smooth stings and can sting again.
Can bees see colours?
Yes, and they can even see ultraviolet light, which we cannot see. Many flowers have ultraviolet patterns that guide bees to the nectar, though bees cannot see red well.
makura aafnai jaal ma kina tasindaina?
makura ko jaal ka sabai dhago tasine hudainan. makura le tasine dhago bata bachera hidchha, ra yasko khutta ko banot le pani jaal ma tasina dinna.
sabai makura le jaal banauchhan?
banaudainan. jumping spider jasta makura le jaal nabanai shikar lai chhopera ya jhamtera samatchhan, jaba ki dherai makura jaal banayera shikar parkhanchhan.
ghungi (snail) le aafno ghar kina bokchha?
ghungi ko kada khol nai yasko ghar ho, jun yasko sharir sangai badhchha. khatara ya sukkha mausam ma ghungi khol bhitra lukchha ra osilo bhaepachhi bahira niskanchha.
What is the slime that snails leave behind?
Snails make slime to glide smoothly over the ground and to protect their soft bodies from sharp surfaces and drying out. That is why a shiny trail is left where a snail has moved.
hatti le kaan kina hallauchha?
hatti ko thulo kaan ma dherai saana ragat ko nali hunchhan. kaan hallauda hawa lagera tyo ragat chiso hunchha, ra yasari hatti le aafno jiu chiso rakhchha.
hatti ko sund le k k kaam garchha?
hatti ko sund naak ra mathillo oth milera baneko ho. yasle sas ferchha, gandha thaha paauchha, pani tanera mukh ma halchha ra rukh ko haanga samma tipchha.
asia ko hatti ra africa ko hatti ma k farak?
africa ko hatti thulo hunchha ra yasko kaan pani dherai thulo hunchha. asia ko hatti ko kaan saano hunchha ra yasma prayah bhale ko matra hatti-daat (tusk) hunchha.
hatti uphrina sakchha?
thulo hatti uphrina sakdaina. yasko jiu dherai gahrungo hunchha ra khutta ko banot le charai khutta ek saath bhui bata uthauna mildaina.
jiraf le tala bhui ko pani kasari piunchha?
jiraf ko ghaanti lamo bhae pani khutta jhan aglo hunchha. tyasaile pani piuna yasle agadi ka dui khutta phailaera ya ghuda khumchyaera tauko tala jhukauchha.
jebra ko dharka sabai ko eutai hunchha?
hudaina, harek jebra ko dharka ko banot farak hunchha, manchhe ko aunla ko chhaap jastai. tadha bata ustai dekhine bhae pani najik bata herda farak chhuttinchha.
Why do hippos stay in water all day?
Hippos have thin skin that dries out and burns easily in the sun, so they stay in rivers and lakes during the day to keep cool. At night they come out to eat grass on land.
What is the spray that comes out of a whale's head?
A whale breathes air through a blowhole on top of its head. When it comes up and breathes out, the warm, wet air shoots out and turns into a cloud of spray.
Why does a koala sleep so much?
Koalas eat almost only eucalyptus leaves, which give very little energy and are hard to digest. Sleeping most of the day saves energy.
Is the red panda a kind of bear?
No. The giant panda of China is a bear, but the red panda of Nepal is not; it belongs to its own small family. Both of them eat a lot of bamboo.
Do chimpanzees use tools?
Yes. Chimpanzees push thin sticks into termite mounds and pull them out covered with termites to eat, and they crack nuts with stones.
Which is the largest ape?
The gorilla is the largest ape and the largest living primate. Gorillas live in family groups in the forests of central Africa and eat mostly plants.
Where do orangutans live?
Orangutans live in rainforests on the islands of Borneo and Sumatra in Southeast Asia. They have reddish hair and spend most of their lives in the trees.
Why do wolves howl?
Wolves howl to call the other members of their pack, to find each other over long distances and to warn other wolves to keep out of their area.
How does a cat land on its feet?
When a cat falls, it quickly turns its head first and then twists the rest of its flexible body to face the ground. It then spreads its legs to soften the landing.
raati gadi ko batti parda janawar ko aankha kina chamkinchha?

dherai janawar ko aankha bhitra aaina jasto tah hunchha, jasle bhitra paseko prakash pheri farkauchha. yasle u haru lai andhyaro ma ramro dekhna maddat garchha, ra batti parda aankha chamkeko dekhinchha.
mriga ko singh harek barsha jharchha bhanchhan, sahi ho?
sahi ho, dherai mriga (bhale) ko singh jasto haddi (antler) harek barsha jharchha ra pheri naya umrinchha. gai, bakhra ko sing bhane jiwan bhari rahanchha ra jhardaina.
bagh samuha ma shikar garchha ki eklai?
bagh dherai jaso eklai shikar garchha, khas gari bihana ra saanjh ko andhyaro ma. sher (lion) bhane samuha ma baschhan ra pothi haru milera shikar garchhan.
bagh paudina sakchha?
sakchha, bagh lai pani man parchha ra yo ramro paudine janawar ho. garmi ma bagh dherai ber pani ma basera jiu chiso rakhchha.
gai bakhra le ghans pachauna sakchhan tara manchhe le kina sakdaina?
ghans ma cellulose bhanne kada tatva hunchha. gai bakhra ko pet ma yo tatva todne saana jiwanu baschhan, tara hamro pet ma tyasta jiwanu nabhayeko le hami ghans pachauna sakdainau.
bihana charaa haru kina dherai karaunchhan?
bihana ko suru ma bhale charaa le aafno ilaka janauna ra jodi khojna gaunchhan. bihana hawa shanta hune bhayeko le aawaj tadha samma pugchha.
charaa le anda mathi kina baschha?
charaa le aafno jiu ko nyano le anda lai tatai rakhchha. nyano bina bhitra ko bachcha bikas hudaina. kati charaa ma pothi le matra, kati ma bhale ra pothi palaipalo anda mathi baschhan.
Why are flamingos pink?
Flamingos get their pink colour from their food. The tiny shrimp and algae they eat contain pink and orange colours that build up in their feathers; without that food they slowly turn pale.
How do pigeons find their way home?
Pigeons seem to use the position of the sun and the Earth's magnetism like a compass, and they also remember landmarks near home. That is why trained pigeons were once used to carry messages.
How does a weaver bird build its nest?
The male weaver bird tears long strips from grass and palm leaves and ties them together with knots, weaving a hanging nest with its beak. The female then checks it and chooses the nest she likes.
How can a mongoose fight a cobra?

A mongoose is very quick and jumps away from the snake's strikes, and its thick fur makes bites harder. It also has some resistance to snake venom, so a bite is less dangerous for it than for other animals.
fishing cat kasto biralo ho?
fishing cat ghar ko biralo bhanda ali thulo jangali biralo ho. yo nepal ko terai ka simsar ra nadi kinar ma baschha ra pani ma pasera machha samatchha.
khet ko euta khadya shrinkhala (food chain) ko udaharan deu
dhan -> musa -> sarpa -> chil. dhan ko daana musa le khanchha, musa lai sarpa le khanchha, ra sarpa lai chil jasto shikari charaa le samatchha.
dherai janawar samuha ma kina baschhan?
samuha ma basda shikari aaeko chhitai thaha hunchha ra ek arka lai jogauna sajilo hunchha. kehi janawar milera shikar garchhan ra bachcha lai pani sangai hurkauchhan.
Why do rainforests have so many kinds of animals?
Rainforests are warm and wet all year, so plants grow thickly and there is food everywhere. The many layers, from the ground to the treetops, give homes to a huge number of different animals.
How do desert animals survive the heat?
Many desert animals rest in burrows or shade during the hot day and come out at night when it is cool. Some get most of their water from their food and lose very little in their droppings.
How do animals in very cold places keep warm?
Polar animals have thick fur or feathers and a layer of fat under the skin called blubber that holds in body heat. Many also have small ears and short tails, so less heat escapes.
Can dogs hear sounds that people cannot?
Yes. Dogs can hear much higher sounds than humans, which is why a special dog whistle that we cannot hear still makes a dog turn its head.
How do elephants talk to each other over long distances?
Elephants make very deep rumbling sounds, some too low for people to hear. These low sounds travel far through the air and the ground, so other elephants can hear them from a long way off.
How do some snakes find prey in the dark?
Pythons and pit vipers have small pits on their faces that sense heat. They can feel the warmth of a mouse or bird nearby and strike at it even in complete darkness.
bhalu le k k khanchha?
bhalu sabbhakshi ho, arthat bot ra janawar dubai khanchha. phal, jara, mah, kira dekhi saana janawar samma bhalu ko khana ho.
kachhuwa kati lamo samaya bachna sakchha?
thula jaati ka kachhuwa dherai lamo samaya bachchhan ra kehi 100 barsha bhanda badhi bacheka chhan. bistarai chalne ra sust jiwan le uniharu ko umer lamo hunchha bhanne bigyan haru ko bichar chha.
Which is the largest reptile alive today?
The saltwater crocodile is the largest living reptile. Big males can grow longer than a car and live in rivers and coasts from India to Australia.
Which snake is the longest in the world?
The reticulated python of Southeast Asia is the longest snake. The green anaconda of South America is shorter but heavier.
How do bats sleep?
Bats sleep hanging upside down by their feet in caves, trees or roofs. Their feet lock in place when they rest, so they do not fall, and from that position they can drop and fly off quickly.
Why do some animals play dead?
Many predators only eat prey that is moving or freshly killed. Animals like the opossum and some snakes and beetles lie still as if dead, and the attacker often loses interest and leaves.
How do camels walk on hot sand?
Camels have wide, flat feet with thick, tough pads that spread out on the sand so they do not sink. The pads also protect their feet from the hot ground.
Why do giraffes have such long necks?
A long neck lets a giraffe reach leaves high in the trees that other animals cannot reach. Male giraffes also swing their necks at each other when they fight.
How do polar bears hunt?
Polar bears mostly hunt seals on the sea ice. A bear waits beside a hole in the ice where seals come up to breathe and grabs one when it appears.
Why do squirrels bury nuts?
Many squirrels bury nuts and seeds in autumn to eat later when food is scarce. They forget some of them, and those seeds can grow into new trees.
kukur ko naak kina chiso ra osilo hunchha?
kukur ko naak ma sadhai patalo osilo tah hunchha, jasma hawa ka gandha ka kan tasinchhan. yasle kukur lai gandha ramrari thaha paauna maddat garchha.
biralo le aafno jiu jibro le kina chatirahanchha?
biralo le jibro le chatera raun safa garchha ra khuskeka raun hataauchha. jibro ma bhayeko thuk sukda jiu ali chiso pani hunchha.
biralo ko jibro kina khasro hunchha?
biralo ko jibro ma pachhadi farkeko saana saana kaada jasta bhag hunchhan. yasle raun korna ra haddi bata masu khurkera khana sajilo banauchha.
musa le jhola, kaath sabai kina kutchha?
musa ko agadi ka daat jiwan bhari badhirahanchhan. kada chij kutda daat khiyera chhoto rahanchha, natra daat dherai lamo hunchha.
kharayo ko kaan kina lamo hunchha?
lamo kaan le kharayo lai tadha ko saano aawaj pani sunna maddat garchha, jasle shikari aaeko chhitai thaha hunchha. kaan ko patalo chhala bata jiu ko garmi pani bahira jaanchha.
ghoda ko khur ma naal kina thokchhan?
kada sadak ra dhunga ma hiddda ghoda ko khur chhitai khiyinchha ra futchha. falam ko naal le khur jogauchha; khur ma nasa nabhayeko bhag ma thokne bhayeko le ghoda lai dukhdaina.
jhingaa le aafno khutta kina malirahanchha?
jhingaa le khutta malera khutta ma laagne dhulo ra fohor safa garchha. jhingaa ko khutta ma swad thaha paaune ang pani hunchha, tyasaile safa khutta le khana chinna sajilo hunchha.
putali ko pwankh chhuda haat ma dhulo jasto kina lagchha?
putali ko pwankh hajarau saana saana kat (scale) le dhakieko hunchha. chhuda yo kat haat ma laagchhan, ra pwankh ko rang pani yahi kat bata aauchha, tyasaile putali ko pwankh nachhunu ramro.
jado ma bhyaguto kaha jaanchha?
dherai bhyaguto jado ma hilo, mato ya dhunga muni lukera lamo nidra (hibernation) ma baschhan. garmi suru bhaepachhi pheri bahira niskinchhan.
charaa le guntaa sutna banauchha?
dherai charaa le guntaa sutna haina, anda paarna ra bachcha hurkauna banauchhan. bachcha udna sikepachhi prayah guntaa chhodidinchhan ra rukh ko haanga mai sutchhan.
sutda pani charaa haanga bata kina khasdaina?
charaa haanga ma basda yasko khutta ko nasa le aunla aafai kasera haanga samatchha. tyasaile nidaauda pani pakad khukulo hudaina ra charaa khasdaina.
charaa ko pwankh kina jharchha?
purana ra tuteka pwankh harek barsha jhardai jaanchhan ra tyasko thau ma naya pwankh aauchhan. yo charaa ko sadharan prakriya ho, rog haina.
hiun chituwa ko puchhar kina lamo ra moto hunchha?
hiun chituwa ko lamo puchhar le bhir ma uphrinda ra daudda jiu ko santulan milauchha. sutda yasle puchhar le mukh ra naak bertera chiso bata jogauchha.
gaida hilo ma kina lotchha?
gaida hilo ma lotera jiu chiso rakhchha. jiu ma lageko hilo sukepachhi chhala lai ghaam ra kira ko tokai bata pani jogauchha.
hatti ko daat (tusk) k ho?
hatti ko lamo daat bhaneko mukh ko agadi ka daat (incisor) badhera baneko ho. hatti le yasle mato khanna, bokra ukhelna ra ladna prayog garchha.
jhinge machha sachchi machha ho?
haina, jhinge machha (prawn) machha haina. yo gangata jastai kada khol ra dherai khutta bhayeko pani ko jiw ho.
sipi bhitra moti kasari banchha?
sipi bhitra baluwa ko kan jasto saano chij pasyo bhane sipi le tyaslai chiplo chamkilo padartha ko tah le dhakdai jaanchha. barshau samma tah thapiyera gol moti banchha.
sankha k ho?
sankha samudra ma paine thulo shankhe (sea snail) ko kada khol ho. bhitra ko jiw marepachhi rahane yo khol lai puja ra baja ko rup ma phukne chalan chha.
kauda bhaneko k ho?
kauda samudra ko saano shankhe ko chamkilo khol ho. dherai purano samaya ma kauda lai paisa ko rup ma pani prayog garinthyo.
bichhi kira ho?
haina, bichhi kira haina. makura jastai yasko 8 khutta hunchhan ra yo makura ko parivar ko najik ko jiw ho; puchhar ko tuppa ma bish bhayeko kaada hunchha.
centipede shabda ko arth sau khutta ho, tara sachchai 100 khutta hunchha?
hudaina, centipede ko khutta ko jodi sadhai bijor sankhya (odd number) ma hunchha. tyasaile khutta thik 100 kahile hudaina; jaat anusar thorai ya dherai hunchhan.
kachhuwa aafno khol bata bahira niskana sakchha?
sakdaina. kachhuwa ko khol yasko haddi ra karang sanga jodieko hunchha, tyasaile yo khol yasko sharir kai bhag ho.
kamila ko samuha ma rani ko kaam k ho?
kamila ko samuha ma anda paarne kaam rani ko matra ho, ra dherai jaso samuha ka kamila usaika bachcha hun. kaamdar kamila le khana lyaune, bachcha herne ra guntaa banaune kaam garchhan.
laamkhutte le hamilai kasari khojchha?
laamkhutte le hamro sas bata niskane carbon dioxide, jiu ko nyano ra pasina ko gandha bata manchhe khojchha. tyasaile pasina aaeko ra sas jod le fereko manchhe lai badhi tokchha.
jun kira (firefly) jasto ujyalo dine machha pani hunchha?
hunchha, gahiro samudra ma aafai ujyalo dine dherai machha ra jiw hunchhan. andhyaro pani ma shikar lobhyauna ra sathi chinna uniharu le yo ujyalo prayog garchhan.
shakahari janawar ko aankha ra mansahari ko aankha ma farak hunchha?

hunchha. gai, mriga jasta shakahari ko aankha tauko ko chheu tira hunchha, jasle charai tira herera shikari chhitai dekhchhan. bagh, biralo jasta shikari ko aankha agadi tira hunchha, jasle shikar sammako duri thik naapna maddat garchha.
hamro desh ko jangal ma kati kisim ka janawar paainchhan bhanera ekdam thik sankhya bhanna sakinchha?

ekdam thik sankhya bhanna sakindaina, kinabhane naya jaat pattaa laagirahanchhan ra kati thau ko adhyayan baki chha. tara nepal saano desh bhae pani terai dekhi himal samma ko farak mausam ko karan dherai kisim ka janawar ra charaa paainchhan.
kun janawar le aafno bachcha thaili ma bokchha?
kangaroo, koala jasta janawar le aafno saano bachcha pet ko thaili ma bokchhan. yinlai marsupial bhaninchha ra yi dherai jaso australia ma paainchhan.
chheparo jasta janawar le aafno anda kaha paarchhan?
dherai chheparo, sarpa ra kachhuwa le anda mato, baluwa ya sadeko paat bhitra paarchhan. ghaam ra mato ko nyano le anda tatai rahanchha ra samaya pugepachhi bachcha aafai niskanchhan.
stanadhari janawar madhye kasle sabai bhanda lamo samaya pet ma bachcha bokchha?
stanadhari madhye hatti le sabai bhanda lamo samaya, lagbhag 22 mahina (2 barsha jati), bachcha pet ma bokchha. tyasaile hatti ko sankhya dherai bistarai badhchha.
dolphin le kasari nidauchha? pani bhitra dubdaina?
dolphin le sutda dimag ko eutai aadha bhag matra aaram garaunchha ra arko aadha bhag jaagai rahanchha. yasari u sas ferna pani ko satah ma aauna birsadaina.
magar gohi le kina mukh khulai rakhera ghaam taapchha?
gohi le mukh khulai rakhda mukh bata garmi bahira jaanchha ra jiu dherai tatdaina. yo yasko jiu ko tapkram milaune tarika ho.
penguin le anda kasari nyano rakhchha?
emperor penguin ma bhale le anda lai aafno khutta mathi rakhera pet ko naram chhala le chhopchha. yasari hiu ma pani anda nyano rahanchha.
parewa le pani piuda tauko kina uthaudaina?
dherai charaa le chuchcho ma pani bharera tauko uthaera nilchhan. parewa bhane chuchcho pani ma dubaera straw jastai pani tanera piuna sakchha, tyasaile tauko uthaunu pardaina.
chil ra giddha pakheta nachalai aakash ma gol gol kasari ghumchhan?
ghaam le tateko jamin bata taato hawa mathi uthchha. chil ra giddha tyo uthne hawa ma pakheta phailaera tairinchhan, tyasaile dherai shakti kharcha nagari mathi mathi ghumna sakchhan.
machha ko pakheta (fin) le k kaam garchha?
machha ko puchhar le agadi dhakelchha, ra jiu ka aru pakheta le disha modna, santulan milauna ra rokna maddat garchha.
machha pani ma eutai gahirai ma kasari rokinchha?
dherai machha ko pet bhitra hawa bhareko thaili (swim bladder) hunchha. thaili ma hawa badhauda machha mathi uthchha ra ghataunda tala jaanchha.
phal khane chamero le jangal lai kasari fayada garchha?
phal khane chamero le phal khaera biu tadha tadha samma lagera khasaldinchha. kehi chamero le phool ko ras khanda parag pani sarchhan, tyasaile naya rukh umrina maddat hunchha.
raati batti tira kira kina jhumminchhan?
dherai kira le raati jun ra tara ko ujyalo herera disha milauchhan bhanne bigyan haru ko bichar chha. najik ko batti le tiniharu lai alamal parchha ra batti waripari ghumirahanchhan.
hatti le aafno jiu ma dhulo kina chharchha?
hatti le sund le dhulo ra hilo jiu ma chharchha. yo tah le chhala lai charko ghaam ra kira ko tokai bata jogauchha.
challa le anda ko kada khol kasari futauchha?
challa ko chuchcho ko tuppa ma saano kada daat jasto bhag (egg tooth) hunchha. yasle bhitra bata khol lai thokdai futauchha, ra niskeko kehi din pachhi yo bhag jharchha.
bakhra ko aankha ko nani kina chepto ayat jasto hunchha?
bakhra ko aankha ko chepto nani le yaslai charai tira chaudaa dekhna maddat garchha. charda pani shikari aaeko chhitai thaha paaera bhagna sakchha.
How do birds know when to migrate?
Birds notice the days getting shorter or longer and the weather changing, which tells their bodies it is time to move. Many young birds also follow older birds on their first journey.
Do fish drink water?

Sea fish do drink seawater, and they get rid of the extra salt through their gills. River and lake fish hardly drink at all, because water keeps soaking into their bodies through their skin and gills.
How do eagles see prey from so high up?
Eagles have much sharper eyesight than people, with far more light-sensing cells packed into the back of the eye. From high in the sky they can spot a small animal moving in the grass.
Why do mosquitoes make a buzzing sound?
The buzz is the sound of a mosquito's wings beating hundreds of times every second. Male and female mosquitoes even buzz at different pitches.
bandar ko bachcha aama ko pet ma kina tasinchha?
bandar ko saano bachcha aafai hidna ra rukh chadhna sakdaina. aama ko pet ra pith ma tasiyera u surakshit rahanchha ra aama le jaha jaanchhe, sangai jaana sakchha.
charaa ko chuchcho ko aakar kina farak farak hunchha?
charaa ko chuchcho uniharu ko khana anusar banieko hunchha. daana fodne charaa ko chuchcho chhoto ra baliyo, machha khane ko lamo ra tikho, ra masu khane chil ko bango ra dhaar bhayeko hunchha.
bhat lai dherai ber chapaudai garda guliyo kina lagchha?
hamro thuk ma amylase bhanne padartha hunchha, jasle bhat ko starch lai bistarai guliyo (chini) ma badalchha. tyasaile dherai ber chapauda mukh mai guliyo swad aauna thalchha.
khana nilepachhi pet samma kasari pugchha?
ghaanti dekhi pet samma ko khana nali (oesophagus) ko mamsapeshi lahar jastai khumchidai ra phailidai khana lai tala dhakelchha. tyasaile ulto bhaera nilda pani khana pet tira nai jaanchha.
khana khanda kahile kahi "arko nali ma gayo" bhanchhan, tyo k ho?

ghaanti ma khana nali ra sas nali dubai chhan. nilda epiglottis bhanne saano dhakkan le sas nali chhopchha, tara hatar ma bolda ya haasda khana sas nali tira gayo bhane sharir le jod le khokera tyo bahira falchha.
pet ko amla (acid) le pet aafai kina pachaudaina?
pet ko bhitta ma baklo chiplo tah (mucus) hunchha, jasle amla lai bhitta samma pugna dinna. pet ko bhitri tah ko koshika pani chhito chhito naya bandai rahanchhan.
saano aandra le khana ko poshak tatva kasari soschha?
saano aandra ko bhitri bhitta ma dherai saana aunla jasta bhag (villi) hunchhan. yasle sosne satah dherai thulo banauchha ra pacheko khana ka tatva ragat ma sajilai pugchhan.
hami dakar kina garchhau?
khana khanda, pani piunda ra bolda hami thorai hawa pani nilchhau. tyo hawa pet ma jammaa bhaepachhi mukh bata bahira niskanchha, tyaslai dakar bhanchhan.
chhito chhito khanda kina dherai khaiyo jasto hunchha?
pet bharieko sanket dimag samma pugna kehi ber lagchha. chhito khanda tyo sanket aaunu agadi nai dherai khaisakinchha, tyasaile bistarai chapaera khanda thik matra khana sajilo hunchha.
kabjiyat (pet sapha nahune) kina hunchha?
pani kam piunda, resha (fibre) bhayeko tarkari ra phal kam khanda ra kam hiddda disa kada bhaera kabjiyat hunchha. lamo samaya rahiraheko chha bhane doctor sanga salah linus.
naak le sas ferda ra mukh le sas ferda k farak parchha?
naak bhitra ko raun ra osilo tah le hawa ko dhulo chhanchha, ani hawa lai nyano ra osilo banauchha. mukh le yo kaam ramrari gardaina, tyasaile naak le sas ferna ramro ho.
sas nali (trachea) kina thichindaina?
sas nali ma kurkure haddi (cartilage) ka gol ghera hunchhan. yi ghera le nali lai sadhai khulai rakhchhan, tyasaile ghaanti modda pani hawa aauna jaana rokindaina.
hami kati ber samma sas rokna sakchhau? sas rokera marna sakinchha?

sas rokda ragat ma carbon dioxide badhchha ra dimag le sas ferna jabarjasti garauchha. dherai ber rokna khojda manchhe behosh hunchha ra sharir aafai sas ferna thalchha, tyasaile kasaile pani pani bahira sas rokera marna sakdaina.
keta haru ko aawaj thulo bhaepachhi kina moto hunchha?

kishor awastha ma keta haru ko swar yantra (larynx) ra tyas bhitra ko swar tantu lamo ra moto hunchha. moto tantu bistarai kaampchha, tyasaile aawaj moto hunchha ra ghaanti ma ubhieko gaanth (Adam's apple) dekhina thalchha.
hami kasari bolchhau?
phokso bata aaeko hawa swar yantra ko swar tantu (vocal cords) bich bata janda tantu kaampchhan ra aawaj banchha. jibro, oth ra daat le tyo aawaj lai shabda ma badalchhan.
mutu ko dhadkan "dhuk-dhuk" kina sunninchha?
mutu bhitra ragat ulto nabagos bhanera dhoka jasta valve hunchhan. ragat agadi dhakelepachhi yi valve band hunda "dhuk-dhuk" ko aawaj aauchha, jun doctor le stethoscope le sunchhan.
ragat sharir bhari ghumchha bhanne kura kasle pattaa lagaye?
angreji doctor william harvey le mutu le ragat lai sharir bhari ghumaera pheri mutu mai farkauchha bhanne kura pramanit gare. uni bhanda pahile dherai manchhe ragat ghumdaina bhanthe.
ragat sharir ko kun bhag ma banchha?
rato ragat koshika mukhya rup ma haddi bhitra ko naram bhag, majja (bone marrow), ma banchhan. purana koshika marda majja le naya koshika banairahanchha.
pilhaa (spleen) le k kaam garchha?
pilhaa pet ko debre tira mathi hunchha. yasle ragat chhanchha, purana rato ragat koshika hataauchha ra rog sanga ladne kaam ma maddat garchha.
ghaanti dukhda ghaanti ko chheu ma saana gaanth kina phulchhan?

ti gaanth lasika granthi (lymph node) hun, jun rog sanga ladne seto ragat koshika ko kendra jasto ho. sankraman bhaeko bela yi kaam ma lagda ali phulchhan ra rog niko bhaepachhi saano hunchhan; dherai din samma phuliraheko bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
saano bachcha ko tauko ma naram thau kina hunchha?

janmanda bachcha ko khappar ka haddi pura jodieka hudainan, tyasaile tauko ma naram thau (fontanelle) hunchha. yasle janmanda tauko lai ali khumchina dinchha ra dimag badhna thau dinchha; dui barsha jati bhitra yo thau band hunchha.
bachcha janmanda thulo manchhe bhanda dherai haddi hunchha?
hunchha, bachcha janmanda dherai saana haddi hunchhan. hurkidai jaanda kati haddi ek aapas ma judera thulo manchhe ma 206 wata matra rahanchhan.
naak ra kaan ko bahira ko bhag haddi ho?
haina, naak ko tuppa ra kaan ko bahira ko bhag kurkure haddi (cartilage) le baneko hunchha. yo haddi bhanda naram ra lachilo hunchha, tyasaile kaan modda bhachchindaina.
nasa (tendon) ra ligament ma k farak chha?
tendon le mamsapeshi lai haddi sanga jodchha, ra ligament le euta haddi lai arko haddi sanga jodchha. dubai baliya ra dori jasta hunchhan.
kurkuchha mathi ko moto nasa ko naam k ho?
tyo achilles tendon ho, jun sharir ko sabai bhanda baliyo ra moto tendon ho. yasle pindaula ko mamsapeshi lai kurkuchha ko haddi sanga jodchha ra hidda, daudda ra uphrinda kaam lagchha.
mamsapeshi le dhakelna sakchha ki tanna matra?

mamsapeshi le tanna matra sakchha, dhakelna sakdaina. tyasaile mamsapeshi jodi ma kaam garchhan: haat khumchyauda bahu ko agadi ko mamsapeshi (biceps) tanchha, ra sidha pharda pachhadi ko mamsapeshi (triceps) tanchha.
kuhino ko kunai thau ma thokinda bijuli lageko jasto jhanjhanaunchha, kina?
kuhino ko tyo thau ma ulnar nasa (nerve) chhala ko dherai najik hunchha ra mathi haddi ko jogaune tah hudaina. tyaha thokinda nasa thichinchha ra haat ko kanchi aunla samma jhanjhanaunchha.
bihana uthda hami ali aglo hunchhau bhanchhan, sahi ho?
