sahi ho, bihana hami thorai aglo hunchhau. din bhari ubhida merudanda ka haddi bich ka naram gadda (disc) thichinchhan, ra raati sutda tiniharu pheri phulchhan.
manchhe ko uchai kahile samma badhchha?
haddi ko chheu ma badhne bhag (growth plate) hunchha. kishor awastha sakiepachhi yo bhag kada haddi ma badalinchha, ani uchai badhna rokinchha.
bhachieko haddi aafai kasari jodinchha?
haddi jiwit tantu ho. bhachiepachhi tyaha naya koshika banera haddi jodinchha, tara sidha jodina plaster ya doctor ko upachar chahinchha.
jibro mamsapeshi ho?
ho, jibro dherai mamsapeshi milera baneko ang ho. tyasaile jibro le khana mukh bhitra palta garna, nilna ra bolna sakchha.
jibro ko kun bhag le guliyo, kun le amilo thaha paauchha bhanne naksa sahi ho?
sahi haina. jibro ka sabai bhag ma bhayeka swad koshika le sabai swad thaha paauna sakchhan; "guliyo agadi, tito pachhadi" bhanne naksa purano galat dharana ho.
aankha ko andho bindu (blind spot) bhaneko k ho?

aankha ko pachhadi jaha nasa dimag tira jaanchha, tyaha prakash thaha paaune koshika hudainan. tyo thau ma pareko chhabi dekhidaina, tara dimag le waripari ko drishya le khali thau bharidinchha, tyasaile hami thaha paudainau.
aankha ma chhabi ulto banchha bhanchhan, tara hami sidha kasari dekhchhau?
aankha ko lens le aankha ko pachhadi (retina) ma chhabi ulto banauchha. dimag le tyo sanket lai sidha bujhna sikeko hunchha, tyasaile hami sansar sidhai dekhchhau.
andhyaro ma rang kina chhuttinna?

aankha ma dui kisim ka koshika hunchhan: rang chinne koshika lai dherai ujyalo chahinchha, ra madhuro ujyalo ma kaam garne koshika le rang chhuttyaudainan. tyasaile raati sabai kura kharani jasto dekhinchha.
aunla ko tuppa kina dherai samvedanshil hunchha?
aunla ko tuppa ma chhuna thaha paaune nasa ka tuppa dherai najik najik hunchhan. tyasaile aunla le saano dharsa ra masino kapada samma chhuttyauna sakchha.
dimag aafai dukhna sakchha?
dimag ko tantu ma dukhai thaha paaune nasa hudainan. tauko dukhne bela dimag waripari ka tah, mamsapeshi ra ragat nali bata dukhai aauchha.
taato chij chhuda haat dukhai thaha hunu bhanda pahile nai kina hatchha?
yo pratibimba kriya (reflex) ho. sanket dimag samma pugnu agadi merudanda ko nasa le nai mamsapeshi lai haat tannu bhanchha, ani matra dimag le dukhai thaha paauchha.
aafai aafulai kutkuti lagauda kina hasso uthdaina?
aafno haat kaha chhunchha bhanne kura dimag le pahile nai thaha paauchha, tyasaile achanak ko anubhav hudaina. arko manchhe le chhuda achanak hune bhayeko le kutkuti lagchha.
sutda pani hami sas kasari ferchhau?
sas ferne kaam dimag ko tallo bhag (brainstem) le aafai chalauchha. tyasaile sutda, behosh huda pani hamle sochnu napari sas chaliraheko hunchha.
sano dimag (cerebellum) ko kaam k ho?
sano dimag dimag ko pachhadi tala hunchha. yasle sharir ko santulan ra mamsapeshi ko chalai milauchha, jasle garda hami hidna, cycle chadhna ra lekhna sakchhau.
nangra ra kapal katda kina dukhdaina?
nangra ra kapal ko bahira dekhine bhag mareka koshika le baneko hunchha ra tyasma nasa hudaina. tara nangra ko jara ra kapal ko jara jiwit hunchhan, tyasaile kapal tanda dukhchha.
kodalo chalaunda haat ko chhala kina bakla ra kada hunchha?
eutai thau ma pataka pataka ragadai ra thichai garda chhala le aafulai jogauna tyo thau ma bakla tah banauchha. yo kada chhala le pachhi phoka ra ghau hune kam garchha.
juta le ragadda khutta ma phoka kina aauchha?
chhala ragadinda bhitri ra bahiri tah bich pani jasto tarala jammaa bhaera phoka banchha. yo tarala le tala ko ghau lai jogauchha, tyasaile phoka lai jabarjasti nafutaunu ramro.
pasina aafai ganaauchha?
naya pasina ma prayah gandha hudaina. chhala ma baseka jiwanu le pasina ka tatva todda gandha aauchha, tyasaile niyamit nuhaunu ra safa luga lagaunu le gandha ghataunchha.
oth kina rato dekhinchha?
oth ko chhala sharir ko aru bhag bhanda dherai patalo hunchha. tala ka saana ragat nali najik dekhine bhayeko le oth rato ya gulabi dekhinchha.
daat ko enamel bigriyo bhane pheri aafai banchha?

bandaina, daat ko bahira ko kada tah (enamel) ek choti bigriye sharir le pheri banauna sakdaina. tyasaile daat ko hairchah garnu, guliyo kam khanu ra kirna thalda chhitai daat ko doctor lai dekhaunu jaruri chha.
akkal daat (wisdom teeth) kahile aauchha?
akkal daat dherai jaso kishor awastha ko antya dekhi yuwa awastha samma aauchha, aru daat bhanda dherai pachhi. kasaiko bangara ma thau nahuda yo bango aaune ya aadhai matra niskane pani hunchha.
gija bata ragat kina aauchha?
daat ra gija bich fohor jammaa bhaera gija sunninda ragat aauna sakchha. ramrari ra naram brush le daat maajnu le dherai jaso sudhrinchha, natra daat ko doctor sanga salah linus.
raati kina nidra lagchha?
hamro sharir ma bhitri ghadi (body clock) hunchha. andhyaro bhaepachhi dimag le melatonin bhanne hormone badhauchha, jasle sharir lai sutne bela bhayo bhanne sanket dinchha.
jet lag bhaneko k ho?

hawaijahaj ma dherai samaya kshetra par garepachhi sharir ko bhitri ghadi naya thau ko samaya sanga nimilda jet lag hunchha. diuso nidra lagne ra raati nidra naparne hunchha, ra kehi din ma sharir milchha.
saana bachcha thulo manchhe bhanda dherai kina sutchhan?
saana bachcha ko sharir ra dimag chhito badhdai hunchha. sutda nai sharir le dherai badhne ra sikeka kura dimag ma jamaune kaam garchha, tyasaile bachcha lai dherai nidra chahinchha.
pisab ko rang pahelo kina hunchha?
purana rato ragat koshika todda baneko pahelo rang ko padartha pisab bata niskanchha. pani kam piyo bhane pisab gadha pahelo hunchha ra prashasta pani piunda halka hunchha.
pituitary granthi lai "master gland" kina bhanchhan?
pituitary granthi dimag ko tala hunchha ra yasle aru dherai granthi lai kahile kati hormone banaune bhanne sanket dinchha. uchai badhne hormone pani yahi granthi bata aauchha.
sharir ko tapkram kasle milauchha?
dimag ko hypothalamus bhanne bhag le sharir ko tapkram milauchha. garmi huda pasina nikalchha, ra jado huda kaampera ra chhala ko ragat nali khumchaera taap jogauchha.
budhesakal ma manchhe ko uchai kina ghatchha?
umer badhdai jaanda merudanda ka haddi bich ka gadda (disc) patala hunchhan ra haddi kamjor hunchhan. dhaad ali jhukne pani bhayeko le budhesakal ma uchai thorai ghatchha.
Why do we feel thirsty after eating salty food?
Salt pulls water out of the cells, and the brain senses that the blood has become too salty. It makes us feel thirsty so we drink water and bring the balance back.
Why can't we see well right after coming in from bright sunlight?
In bright light the pupils shrink and the eyes adjust to a lot of light. Indoors it takes a little time for the pupils to open and the eyes to adjust again, so the room looks dark at first.
What do red blood cells look like?

Red blood cells are tiny round discs that are thinner in the middle, a bit like a doughnut without a hole. This shape gives them more surface to pick up oxygen and lets them bend through narrow blood vessels.
Why do we have eyebrows?
Eyebrows help keep sweat and rain from running into the eyes. They also move a lot when we show feelings, so they help us express ourselves.
Why do we have two eyes instead of one?
Each eye sees the world from a slightly different place. The brain combines the two pictures, which helps us judge how far away things are.
Why do we have two ears?
With two ears, a sound reaches one ear a tiny bit earlier and louder than the other. The brain uses this difference to tell which direction the sound came from.
What are taste buds?
Taste buds are tiny groups of cells, mostly on the tongue, that sense sweet, sour, salty, bitter and savoury tastes. They wear out and are replaced all the time.
Why do doctors tap below the knee with a small hammer?
Tapping the tendon below the kneecap stretches the thigh muscle, and a healthy nerve makes the leg kick out by itself. The doctor checks this reflex to see if the nerves are working well.
Why does sweating not cool us as well on a humid day?
Sweat cools us only when it evaporates. When the air is already full of moisture, sweat dries slowly and stays on the skin, so we feel hot and sticky.
Why is sweat salty?
Sweat is mostly water, but it carries some salt from the body. That is why we need to drink water and sometimes take a little salt after heavy sweating.
Which is the smallest muscle in the body?
The smallest muscle is in the middle ear. It is attached to the tiny stapes bone and helps protect the ear from very loud sounds.
What does the kneecap do?
The kneecap is a small flat bone in front of the knee joint. It protects the knee and helps the thigh muscles straighten the leg with less effort.
Why does my voice go rough after shouting a lot?
Shouting makes the vocal cords hit each other hard, and they become swollen and sore. Swollen cords cannot vibrate smoothly, so the voice sounds rough until they rest.
What is plaque on teeth?
Plaque is a soft, sticky layer of germs that builds up on teeth every day. The germs turn sugar into acid that damages teeth, and plaque that is not brushed away hardens into tartar.
Why should we not share a toothbrush?
A used toothbrush carries germs from the mouth and sometimes a little blood from the gums. Sharing it can pass those germs from one person to another.
What makes us feel hungry?
When the stomach is empty and the body needs energy, the stomach sends out a hormone that tells the brain it is time to eat. After a meal, other signals tell the brain we are full.
What is metabolism?
Metabolism is all the chemical work the body does to turn food into energy and building material. It goes on all the time, even when we sleep.
Why are some people taller than others?
Height depends mostly on the genes we get from our parents. Good food, enough sleep and good health during childhood also help a child reach the full height their genes allow.
Why do children look like their parents?
Children get half of their genes from the mother and half from the father. Genes carry the instructions for things like eye colour, hair and face shape, so children share features with both parents.
What is the difference between a cell, a tissue and an organ?
A cell is the smallest living unit. Many similar cells working together make a tissue, like muscle, and different tissues together make an organ, like the heart.
What does the skeleton do for the body?
The skeleton holds the body up and gives it shape. It protects soft organs like the brain, heart and lungs, works with muscles so we can move, and makes blood cells inside some bones.
Why should we warm up before exercise?
Gentle movement before exercise sends more blood to the muscles and makes them warmer and more flexible. Warm muscles work better and are less likely to get pulled or torn.
Why do we feel pain?
Pain is a warning signal. Nerves tell the brain that something is hurting the body, so we stop, pull away or take care of the injury before it gets worse.
Why do cuts inside the mouth heal so fast?
The inside of the mouth has a very good blood supply, and saliva keeps the area moist and contains substances that help healing. Small cuts there often heal in a few days.
Why do we have a belly button?
Before birth, a baby gets food and oxygen from its mother through a cord attached to its belly. After birth the cord is cut, and the small scar left behind is the belly button.
Why does the nose run when we cry?
Tears drain from the inner corner of each eye through tiny tubes into the nose. When we cry, there are so many tears that they come out through the nose too.
Do fingernails grow faster than toenails?
Yes, fingernails grow noticeably faster than toenails. Scientists think it is partly because we use our hands more and they get more blood flow.
What is a hormone?
A hormone is a chemical messenger made by a gland and carried in the blood. Hormones tell different parts of the body what to do, for example to grow, to feel hungry or to get ready for danger.
Why does skin peel after a sunburn?
Sunburn damages the top layer of skin cells. The body sheds those damaged cells, so the skin peels a few days later while new skin forms underneath.
dui haat ra dui khutta ma jamma kati haddi hunchhan?
dui haat ra dui khutta ma jamma 106 haddi hunchhan. yo sharir ka jamma 206 haddi ko aadha bhanda badhi ho.
messages.think: euta haat ma 27 haddi, euta khutta ma 26 haddi. 27 x 2 = 54, 26 x 2 = 52, 54 + 52 = 106.

messages.content: haat ko aunla ma kati wata haddi hunchhan?
budhi aunla ma 2 wata ra aru harek aunla ma 3 wata haddi hunchhan. tyasaile euta haat ka aunla ma jamma 14 haddi hunchhan.
ghuda ko jorni ra kaandh ko jorni ma k farak?

ghuda ko jorni dhoka ko kabja (hinge) jastai ek tira matra khulchha ra band hunchha. kaandh ko jorni gol bal khaldo ma basne kisim (ball and socket) ko hunchha, tyasaile haat charai tira ghumauna sakinchha.
mirgaula sharir ko kun thau ma hunchha?
mirgaula dui wata hunchhan ra dhaad ko dubai tira, karang ko tallo bhag muni pith tira hunchhan. yinko aakar simi (rajma) ko daana jasto hunchha.
chhala ma kati wata tah hunchhan?
chhala ma mukhya tin tah hunchhan: bahira ko patalo tah (epidermis), tyas muni nasa, ragat nali ra pasina granthi bhayeko tah (dermis), ra sabai bhanda tala boso ko tah.
thulo dimag (cerebrum) le k kaam garchha?
thulo dimag dimag ko sabai bhanda thulo bhag ho. sochne, samjhane, bolne, herne-sunne kura bujhne ra aafno ichchha le haat khutta chalaune kaam yahi bhag le garchha.
chiso pani piunda daat kina siririnchha?

daat ko bahira ko kada tah (enamel) khiyeko ya gija tala jhareko thau bata bhitri tah khulla hunchha. tyo tah bata chiso ko sanket daat bhitra ko nasa samma chhitai pugchha, tyasaile siririnchha; dherai bhaye daat ko doctor lai dekhaunus.
rato ragat koshika kati samaya samma bachchha?
rato ragat koshika lagbhag 120 din (4 mahina jati) samma kaam garchha. tyas pachhi pilhaa ra kalejo ma yo todinchha ra haddi ko majja ma naya koshika banchha.
ang pranali (organ system) bhaneko k ho?
eutai thulo kaam garna milera kaam garne ang haru ko samuha lai ang pranali bhaninchha. jastai mutu, ragat nali ra ragat milera rakta sanchar pranali banchha.
pachan pranali ma kun kun ang parchhan?
mukh, khana nali, pet, saano aandra ra thulo aandra pachan pranali ka mukhya ang hun. kalejo, pittathaili ra agnyashaya le pachan ras dinchhan.
sas ferne pranali ka ang bhana na
naak, ghaanti, sas nali (trachea), phokso ka saakha nali ra phokso shwas pranali ka ang hun. diaphragm mamsapeshi le phokso ma hawa bharna maddat garchha.
snayu pranali bhitra k k parchha?
snayu pranali ma dimag, merudanda ra sharir bhari phailieka nasa parchhan. yasle sharir ka sabai bhag bata sanket lyaune ra aadesh pathaune kaam garchha.
sharir le fohor kun kun bato bata falchha?
mirgaula le pisab bata, phokso le sas bata carbon dioxide, aandra le disa bata ra chhala le pasina bata sharir ko fohor bahira falchha.
naak bata singan kina aauchha?
naak bhitra ko tah le sadhai singan (mucus) banauchha, jasle dhulo ra kitanu lai tasaera phokso samma pugna dinna. rugha lagda yo dherai banchha, tyasaile naak bagchha.
hiddda haat aafai kina hallinchha?
hiddda khutta sanga ulto haat hallaunda sharir ko santulan milchha ra jiu ghumna paudaina. yasle hidna ma lagne shakti pani bachauchha.
daudda sas kina phulchha?
daudda mamsapeshi lai dherai oxygen chahinchha ra tiniharu le dherai carbon dioxide banauchhan. tyasaile dimag le sas chhito ra gahiro ferna lagauchha.
sharir ma sabai bhanda dherai kun tatva hunchha?
taul (mass) ko hisab le hamro sharir ma sabai bhanda dherai oxygen hunchha. sharir ko thulo bhag pani ho, ra pani ma oxygen hunchha.
jado ma pisab kina dherai lagchha?
jado ma pasina kam aauchha, ra chiso le chhala ko ragat nali khumchanda sharir bhitra ragat ko matra badhchha. mirgaula le baki pani pisab bata nikalchha, tyasaile jado ma pisab dherai lagchha.
nangra ma seto thopla aaunu calcium kam bhayeko ho?
dherai jaso haina. nangra ma seto thopla prayah nangra ko jara ma saano chot lageko le aauchha ra nangra badhdai jaanda aafai hatchha.
din ma kehi kapal jharnu sadharan ho?
ho, purana kapal jhardai ra naya kapal umrindai garnu sadharan prakriya ho. tara dherai kapal ek saath jharna thalyo ya tauko ma khali thau dekhiyo bhane doctor sanga salah linus.
ghau ma pip (pus) kina aauchha?
pip kitanu sanga ladda mareka seto ragat koshika, kitanu ra mareko tantu milera banchha. ghau ma pip, sunnine ra dherai dukhai bhaye sankraman bhayeko huna sakchha, tyasaile doctor lai dekhaunus.
aansu kina nunilo hunchha?
aansu ma pani sangai thorai nun ra aru khanij hunchhan, jun ragat bata aauchhan. yasle aankha lai osilo ra safa rakhna maddat garchha.
bihana uthda aankha ko kuna ma fohor kina jammaa hunchha?
din bhari aankha jhimkauda aansu le dhulo ra tel puchhera bahira falchha. raati aankha band hunda yo sab kuna ma jammaa bhaera sukchha, tyasaile bihana kuna ma fohor dekhinchha.
tauko ma kapal kina hunchha?
tauko ko kapal le ghaam ko charko kiran bata khappar ko chhala jogauchha. jado ma tauko bata garmi bahira jana pani kam dinchha.
hamro nangra kina hunchha?
nangra le aunla ko tuppa lai chot bata jogauchha. yasle saana chij tipna, khurkera kholna ra aunla ko tuppa lai thichda baliyo sahara dina maddat garchha.
chhati ko bich ma agadi pattiko chepto haddi ko naam k ho?
chhati ko bich agadi ko chepto haddi lai sternum (chhati ko haddi) bhanchhan. dherai karang ka haddi yasai sanga jodieka hunchhan ra yasle mutu lai agadi bata jogauchha.
What is the collarbone?

The collarbone is the long, thin bone between the base of the neck and the shoulder on each side. It holds the arm away from the body, and it is one of the bones most often broken in a fall on the shoulder or an outstretched hand.
What is the tailbone?
The tailbone is a small group of joined bones at the very bottom of the spine. Some muscles and ligaments are attached to it, and it supports us when we lean back while sitting.
Why does the skin on our knuckles look wrinkled?
The skin over the knuckles has extra folds so that it can stretch when we bend our fingers. When the fingers are straight, that spare skin bunches up into wrinkles.
How long do baby teeth stay?
Baby teeth start coming in during the first year of life and begin to fall out at around six years of age. By the early teens most children have lost all of them and have their permanent teeth.
How many baby teeth does a child have?
A child has 20 baby teeth, 10 in the upper jaw and 10 in the lower jaw. Later they are replaced one by one by bigger permanent teeth.
Why does the heart of a child beat faster than an adult's?
A child's heart is smaller, so it pushes out less blood with each beat. It beats faster to move enough blood around a body that is busy growing.
What is the hardest substance in the human body?
Tooth enamel, the white outer layer of the teeth, is the hardest substance in the body. It is even harder than bone.
Why is the human thumb so useful?
Our thumb can turn to touch the tips of all the other fingers. This lets us grip a pen, thread a needle and hold tools firmly, which most animals cannot do.
Why does the heart keep beating without us thinking about it?
The heart has its own natural pacemaker, a small group of cells that sends an electrical signal for every beat. The brain can speed it up or slow it down, but it does not have to start each beat.
Why can't we keep our eyes open when we sneeze?

Closing the eyes is an automatic reflex that comes with a sneeze; the nerves that trigger the sneeze also make the eyelids shut. The old story that your eyes could pop out if they stayed open is not true.
Why does the voice sound different when we hold our nose?
When we speak, some of the sound goes through the nose and adds to the voice. Holding the nose blocks that path, so the voice sounds flat and "nasal".
How do we keep our balance when standing still?
The brain combines signals from the inner ear, the eyes and the muscles and joints. It makes tiny adjustments all the time, which is why it is harder to stand on one leg with closed eyes.
Why do our legs feel shaky after climbing many stairs?
Climbing works the thigh muscles very hard. Tired muscles cannot control movement as smoothly for a while, so the legs feel shaky until they rest.
Why do fingers get cold first in winter?
When the body is cold, it sends less blood to the hands and feet to keep the heart, brain and other inner organs warm. With less warm blood, the fingers and toes cool down first.
What is the windpipe called in Nepali?
The windpipe is called "sas nali" in Nepali, and the food pipe is called "khana nali". Both start in the throat, but the windpipe goes to the lungs and the food pipe goes to the stomach.
kesh nali (capillary) bhaneko k ho?
kesh nali sharir ko sabai bhanda masino ragat nali ho, kapal bhanda pani patalo. yasko bhitta bata oxygen ra khana ko tatva koshika samma pugchhan ra fohor ragat ma aauchha.
khutta ko shira ma ragat tala kina jharirahandaina?
shira bhitra ek tira matra khulne saana valve hunchhan, jasle ragat lai tala farkana dinna. hiddda khutta ko mamsapeshi le shira lai thichda ragat mutu tira dhakelinchha.
laaj lagda gaala kina rato hunchha?
laaj ya dar lagda sharir ma adrenaline badhchha, jasle anuhar ko saana ragat nali phailaidinchha. tyaha dherai ragat aaune bhayeko le gaala rato ra taato hunchha.
hamro aandra ma jiwanu baschhan bhanchhan, ti naramra hun?
dherai jaso haina. aandra ma baseka dherai jiwanu le khana pachauna, kehi vitamin banauna ra naramra kitanu lai badhna nadina maddat garchhan.
sharir le baanta (ulti) kina garchha?
pet ma naramro, bigreko ya dherai khana pugyo bhane dimag le pet lai tyo bahira falna aadesh dinchha. yo sharir ko aafulai jogaune tarika ho; dherai ulti bhaye pani piunus ra doctor lai dekhaunus.
dimag lai chot nalagos bhanera khappar bhitra k hunchha?
khappar bhitra dimag ek kisim ko patalo tarala (cerebrospinal fluid) ma tairieko jasto hunchha. yo tarala le dhakka lagda gadda jastai dimag lai jogauchha.
dhaad ko haddi sidha nabhai ali bango kina hunchha?
dhaad ko haddi (merudanda) ma prakritik "S" aakar ko ghumai hunchha. yasle hiddda ra uphrinda aaune dhakka lai spring jastai sosera sharir ko bhaar milauchha.
paitala ko bich ma khaldo (arch) kina hunchha?
paitala ko bich ko ghumai le hiddda ra daudda aaune dhakka soschha ra sharir ko bhaar paitala bhari baadchha. kasai kasai ko paitala chepto (flat feet) pani hunchha.
sharir ko sabai bhanda lamo nasa kun ho?
sharir ko sabai bhanda lamo ra moto nasa sciatic nerve ho. yo kammar ko tallo bhag bata suru bhaera dubai khutta ko pachhadi hudai tala samma pugchha.
rato ragat koshika ma nucleus hunchha?
manchhe ko paripakwa rato ragat koshika ma nucleus hudaina. tyasaile yasma oxygen bokne hemoglobin ko lagi dherai thau hunchha.
achanak uthda aankha agadi andhyaro kina hunchha?
sutera ya basera chhito uthda ragat ek chhin khutta tira jharchha ra dimag samma kam pugchha. ali ber ma sharir le milaauchha, tyasaile bistarai uthnu ramro; pataka pataka bhaye doctor lai dekhaunus.
naya kura bharkharai sikda kina garo lagchha tara abhyas le sajilo hunchha?
kunai kura pataka pataka garda dimag ka nasa koshika bich ko jodai baliyo hunchha. jodai baliyo bhaepachhi tyo kaam chhito ra sajilai garna sakinchha.
hami dukhai lagda kina karaunchhau ra haat chhamchhau?
chot lageko thau malda ya chhamda chhuneko sanket dimag samma pugchha ra dukhai ko sanket ali kam mahasus hunchha. karaunda pani man ali halka bhayeko anubhav hunchha.
khana pachna kati samaya lagchha?

khana ko kisim ra manchhe anusar samaya farak parchha, tyasaile ekdam thik samaya bhanna mildaina. khana pet ra saano aandra ma kehi ghanta rahanchha, ra thulo aandra ma sabai bhanda lamo samaya lagchha.
sharir ma sabai bhanda baliyo mamsapeshi kun ho?
yo "baliyo" lai kasari naapne bhanne ma bhar parchha. thichne bal ko hisab le bangara ko mamsapeshi (masseter) lai dherai baliyo maninchha, ra kaam ko hisab le mutu kahilyai naroki chalirahanchha.
chhala chhuda nyano-chiso ra dukhai kasari thaha hunchha?
chhala ma chhuna, thichna, taato, chiso ra dukhai thaha paaune chhuttai chhuttai nasa ka tuppa hunchhan. tiniharu le sanket dimag samma pathauchhan ra dimag le k bhayo bhanera bujhchha.
kaandh dukhda doctor le "frozen shoulder" bhanchhan, tyo ke?

frozen shoulder ma kaandh ko jorni waripari ko tah kasieko ra sunnieko hunchha, tyasaile haat mathi uthauna garo hunchha. yasko upachar ra byayam doctor ra physiotherapist ko salah anusar garnu parchha.
haat ma chot lagda bhitra ko haddi bhachhiyo ki nai kasari thaha hunchha?
chot lageko thau dherai sunnine, bango dekhine ra haat chalauna nasakine bhaye haddi bhachhieko huna sakchha. pakka thaha paauna x-ray chahinchha, tyasaile tyo bhag nachalai aspatal jaanus.
hamro sharir ko kun bhag kahilyai naroki kaam garchha?
mutu ra sas ferne kaam jiwan bhari naroki chalirahanchhan. dimag le pani sutda samet sharir ka bhitri kaam chalai rakhchha.
Why do muscles get bigger with exercise?
Hard exercise causes tiny strains in muscle fibres. During rest the body repairs them a little thicker and stronger, which is why muscles also need enough protein and sleep to grow.
Why does skin get wrinkles with age?
As we age, the skin makes less of the springy fibres that keep it firm, and it becomes thinner and drier. Years of strong sunlight speed this up, so wrinkles appear first on the face and hands.
What makes hair curly or straight?

It depends mostly on the shape of the tiny pocket in the skin that each hair grows from. Round pockets grow straight hair, and flatter, oval ones grow wavy or curly hair, and this shape comes from our genes.
What is the little thing hanging at the back of the throat?
It is called the uvula. When we swallow it helps close the passage to the nose so food and drink do not go up there, and it also plays a small part in speech.
What is a growth spurt?
A growth spurt is a time when a child grows taller much faster than usual. The biggest one usually comes in the early teenage years, and the child often feels hungrier and needs more sleep then.
pet (stomach) sharir ko kun thau ma hunchha? nabhi tira?
pet nabhi bhanda mathi, chhati ko tallo bhag muni ali debre tira hunchha. dherai manchhe le nabhi waripari ko bhag lai pet bhanchhan, tara tyaha dherai jaso aandra hunchhan.
mutu chhati ko debre tira hunchha hoina?
mutu chhati ko bich ma, dui phokso ko bich hunchha, tara yasko tuppa ali debre tira dhalkeko hunchha. tyasaile dhadkan debre tira badhi mahasus hunchha.
saana bachcha ladda thulo manchhe ko jasto haddi kina kam bhachchinchha?
bachcha ko haddi ma kurkure haddi (cartilage) badhi hunchha ra haddi lachilo hunchha. tyasaile ladda haddi bhachchinu bhanda ali bangiyera dhakka sahana sakchha.
jado ma oth kina phutchha?
oth ma chhala ko aru bhag ma jastai tel nikalne granthi hudainan. jado ko sukkha hawa le oth ko pani chhitai sukaidinchha, tyasaile oth phutchha; ghiu, tel ya lip balm lagaunu ramro.
hiundo ma kurkuchha ko chhala kina chiriera phutchha?
jado ma hawa sukkha hunchha ra chhala ko osilopan chhitai harauchha. kurkuchha ko chhala bakla ra bhaar parne thau bhayeko le sukepachhi chirinchha; nuhaepachhi tel ya lotion lagauda kam hunchha.
garmi ma jiu ma ghamauri kina niskanchha?

dherai garmi ra pasina ma pasina bahira jane saana nali band hunchhan ra pasina chhala muni adkinchha. tyasaile saana rata daana ra chilaune ghamauri niskanchha; khukulo suti luga lagaera chiso thau ma basda kam hunchha.
parela (eyelashes) ko kaam k ho?
parela le dhulo ra saana kira aankha bhitra pasna rokchha. kehi chij parela ma chhoyo bhane aankha aafai jhimkinchha.
hamle aafno naak sadhai kina dekhdainau?
hamro naak sadhai aankha agadi hunchha, tara dimag le sadhai rahirahane yo kura lai bewaasta gardinchha. dhyan diera heryo bhane matra naak dekhinchha.
aankha ma kahile kahi saana dhago jasta chij tairieko dekhinchha, tyo ke ho?

tyaslai floaters bhanchhan; aankha bhitra ko jelly jasto bhag ka saana kan le aankha ko pachhadi chhaya parda yesto dekhinchha. thorai hunu sadharan ho, tara achanak dherai dekhiye ya bijuli chamkeko jasto dekhiye turuntai aankha ko doctor lai dekhaunus.
lamo samaya computer herda aankha kina sukchha?

screen ma dhyan diera herda hami sadharan bhanda dherai kam aankha jhimkauchhau. jhimkaunda aansu le aankha bhijauchha, tyasaile kam jhimkaunda aankha sukchha ra polchha; bich bich ma tadha herera aankha jhimkaunus.
nuhauda kaan ma pani pasyo bhane k garne?
tauko tyo kaan tira dhalkaera ek khutta ma halka uphrinda dherai jaso pani aafai niskanchha. kaan bhitra sinka ya aunla nahalnus; dukhai ya sunai kam bhayo bhane doctor lai dekhaunus.
bhari saman uthauda ghuda khumchaera kina uthaunu parchha?
ghuda khumchaera uthauda bhaar khutta ko baliyo mamsapeshi le bokchha ra dhaad sidha rahanchha. dhaad jhukaera uthaunda kammar ma dherai bhaar parchha ra chot lagna sakchha.
bachcha janmana bittikai kina runchha?
pet bhitra hunda bachcha ko phokso ma hawa hudaina. janmepachhi pahilo choti runda gahiro sas bhitra jaanchha ra phokso hawa le bharinchha, tyasaile bachcha ko pahilo runu ramro sanket ho.
hatkela ra paitala ma kina chhitai pasina aauchha?
hatkela ra paitala ma sharir ko aru bhag bhanda dherai pasina granthi hunchhan. tyasaile garmi, dar ya tanab huda yi thau chhitai bhijchhan.
sutda mutu ko dhadkan kina dhilo hunchha?
sutda sharir aaram ma hunchha ra mamsapeshi lai kam oxygen chahinchha. tyasaile mutu le dhilo dhadkera pani pugne ragat pathauna sakchha.
phool ka mukhya bhag k k hun?
phool ka mukhya bhag pankhuda, tyasko bahira ko hariyo pat (sepal), parag banaune pumkesar (stamen) ra bich ko strikesar (pistil) hun. strikesar ko tallo bhag (ovary) pachhi phal banchha.
phal phool ko kun bhag bata banchha?
parag sechan bhaepachhi strikesar ko tallo phuleko bhag (ovary) badhera phal banchha, ra tyas bhitra ka saana dana (ovule) biu banchhan. tyasaile phal bhitra biu hunchha.
biu bhitra k k hunchha?
biu ko bahira kada khol (biu ko bokra) hunchha, bhitra naya biruwa banne saano bhag (bhrun) ra tyaslai khana dine bhandar hunchha. umrinda biruwa le yahi bhandar ko khana khanchha.
chana ra kerau ko daana dui phalla kina hunchha tara makai ko hudaina?
chana, kerau, simi jasta biu ma dui ota biupatra (cotyledon) hunchhan, tyasaile dui phalla hunchha. makai, dhan, gahu ma eutai biupatra hunchha, tyasaile tiniharu ko daana phutdaina.
mula ko jara ra dhan ko jara ma k farak?
mula ko eutai moto mul jara sidha tala jaanchha, jaslai mul jara (taproot) bhanchhan. dhan, gahu ra ghans ko jara bhane masina dherai jara jhuppa jastai phailinchhan.
biu ulto gade pani jara tala nai kina jaanchha?
biruwa le gurutwakarshan thaha paauchha, ra jara sadhai gurutwakarshan tira tala badhchha. kaand chahi ujyalo tira mathi badhchha, tyasaile biu jasari gade pani biruwa sidha umrinchha.
jhyal najik rakheko gamala ko biruwa jhyal tira kina dhalkinchha?
biruwa ko tuppa le ujyalo bhayeko tira badhna khojchha. kaand ko andhyaro pattiko bhag ali chhito badhne bhayeko le biruwa ujyalo tira dhalkinchha.
pipal ko paat ra kera ko paat ko nasa ma k farak?
pipal ko paat ma nasa jaal jastai phailieka hunchhan. kera, makai ra ghans ko paat ma bhane nasa ek arka sanga samanantar (parallel) lamo lamo hunchhan.
paat ma sas ferne pwal hunchhan?
hunchhan, paat ma dekhna nasakine saana pwal (stomata) hunchhan, dherai jaso paat ko tallo satah ma. yinai pwal bata hawa bhitra-bahira hunchha ra pani baph bhaera udchha.
sallo ko paat siyo jasto kina hunchha?
siyo jasto patalo paat bata pani kam udchha, jasle chiso ra sukkha mausam ma sallo lai bachna maddat garchha. hiu pani yasma kam adkinchha ra sajilai khasidinchha.
biruwa lai pani nahalda kina oilainchha?
biruwa ko koshika pani le bhariera kasieka hunchhan, jasle paat ra kaand lai thado rakhchha. pani kam huda koshika khukula hunchhan ra biruwa jhukera oilainchha.
gamala ma dherai pani halda pani biruwa kina marchha?
jara lai pani sangai hawa (oxygen) pani chahinchha. mato sadhai pani le bharieko bhaye jara le sas ferna paudaina ra kuhina thalchha, tyasaile biruwa marchha.
rukh ko jara bata paat samma pani kasari pugchha?
rukh bhitra pani bokne masina nali (xylem) jara dekhi paat samma hunchhan. paat bata pani baph bhaera udda tala ko pani mathi tanidai jaanchha.
paat ma baneko khana rukh ka aru bhag samma kasari jaanchha?
paat ma baneko guliyo khana arko kisim ka nali (phloem) bata kaand, jara, phal ra biu samma pugchha. tyahi khana jara ra phal ma jamma hunchha.
rukh ma bokra kina hunchha?
bokra rukh ko chhala jastai ho. yasle bhitra ko kamalo bhag lai kira, rog, chot, aago ra pani sukne bata jogauchha.
jangal ma rukh haru kina aglo aglo hunchhan?
jangal ma sabai rukh ghaam ko prakash khojchhan. aru bhanda mathi pugne rukh le badhi ujyalo paauchha, tyasaile rukh haru prakash ko lagi mathi mathi badhchhan.
ghans katepachhi pheri kasari umrinchha?
ghans ko badhne bhag paat ko tuppa ma haina, jamin najik tala hunchha. mathi bata katda tyo bhag bachne bhayeko le ghans pheri chhitai badhchha.
jangal ma jhareko paat ko k hunchha?
jhareko paat lai kira, gadyaula, dhusi ra jiwanu le bistarai kuhaera mal (humus) banaidinchhan. yo mal le jangal ko mato lai urbar banauchha ra rukh lai pheri khana dinchha.
aakashbeli kasto biruwa ho?
aakashbeli pahelo dhago jasto, paat nabhayeko lahare biruwa ho. yasle aru biruwa ma bertera tyasko ras chusera bachchha, tyasaile yaslai parjivi (parasite) biruwa bhaninchha.
sunakhari rukh ma umrinchha, tyasle rukh lai noksan garchha?
dherai jaso gardaina. sunakhari (orchid) le rukh lai aadhar ko lagi matra prayog garchha; pani hawa ra barsat bata linchha ra rukh ko ras chusdaina.
dhunga ra rukh ma laagne hariyo jhyau (moss) ko jara hunchha?
moss ko sachcha jara hudaina, saana dhago jasta bhag le matra tasinchha. yasma phool ra biu pani hudaina; yo osilo ra chhahari thau ma spore bata phailinchha.
unyu ko paat ko tala khairo thopla kina hunchha?
unyu (fern) ma phool ra biu hudaina. paat ko tala ka khairo thopla bhitra dherai saana spore hunchhan, jun hawa le udaera arko thau ma naya unyu umrauchhan.
pokhari ko pani kina hariyo hunchha?
pokhari ma leu (algae) badhda pani hariyo hunchha. ghaam ra pani ma mal (fohor, gobar) dherai bhaye leu chhitai badhchha ra pani ko oxygen ghataera machha lai pani asar garchha.
roti ra achar ma dhusi kina parchha?
dhusi ek kisim ko fungus ho, jasko saana spore hawa ma sadhai udirahanchhan. osilo ra nyano thau ma khana bhetepachhi tiniharu chhitai badhchhan; dhusi pareko khana nakhanus.
What is the difference between annual and perennial plants?
An annual plant grows, flowers, makes seeds and dies within one year, like rice and mustard. A perennial plant lives for many years, like mango, bamboo and most trees.
Why do plant cells have walls but animal cells do not?
Plant cells have a stiff wall around them that helps plants stand upright without bones. Animal cells have only a soft outer layer, and animals get their support from bones or shells instead.
What happens if you put iodine on a potato?
The cut potato turns dark blue-black where the iodine touches it. Iodine does this when starch is present, so it shows that potatoes store food as starch.
What is hydroponics?
Hydroponics is growing plants without soil, with their roots in water that has the nutrients they need mixed in. It is used for growing lettuce, tomatoes and herbs in greenhouses and small spaces.
Can a new plant grow from a piece of stem?
Yes, many plants can. Farmers plant sugarcane from pieces of cane with buds on them, and roses and some other plants can grow roots from a cut stem placed in moist soil.
Why does an unripe mango ripen faster next to ripe bananas?
Ripe bananas give off a gas called ethylene, which tells fruit to ripen. Keeping unripe fruit near ripe bananas in a bag makes it ripen sooner.
Why does fruit become sweet when it ripens?
As fruit ripens, the starch inside it changes into sugar, and the sour acids decrease. The fruit also gets softer and smells nicer, which makes animals want to eat it and spread its seeds.
Why are unripe fruits green, hard and sour?
While the seeds inside are not ready, the fruit stays green, hard and sour so that animals leave it alone. Once the seeds are ready, it changes colour and becomes sweet to attract animals.
Why do some flowers smell strongest at night?
Flowers like raat ki rani are pollinated by moths that fly at night. They release their scent after dark, and pale flowers are also easier for moths to find in the dark.
Why do roses have thorns?
Thorns protect the rose plant from animals that would eat its stems and leaves. They also help some climbing roses hook onto other plants as they grow.
Why do lotus leaves stay dry?
Lotus leaves are covered with tiny bumps and wax. Water cannot spread on them, so it rolls off in drops and carries dirt away, keeping the leaf clean.
What is the largest single flower in the world?
The largest single flower is the rafflesia, found in the rainforests of Southeast Asia. It has no leaves or stem of its own and smells like rotting meat to attract flies.
How long can trees live?
Some trees live for thousands of years. Certain pine trees in North America are among the oldest living things on Earth.
Why does the baobab tree have such a thick trunk?
The baobab grows in dry parts of Africa, and its thick, spongy trunk stores a lot of water. This helps it survive long dry seasons.
Where did potatoes first come from?
Potatoes first came from the Andes mountains of South America. They spread to the rest of the world a few hundred years ago and are now grown all over Nepal.
Did chillies always grow in Nepal?
No. Chillies first came from the Americas and reached Asia a few hundred years ago. Today they are so common that it is hard to imagine Nepali food without them.
Where did maize come from?
Maize was first grown by farmers in Mexico thousands of years ago. It later spread around the world and became one of the main crops of Nepal's hills.
Where does coffee come from originally?
The coffee plant first came from Ethiopia in Africa. Tea, on the other hand, first came from China.
nepal ma uchai anusar jangal kasari farak hunchha?

terai ra bhitri madhesh ma sal ko jangal dherai hunchha. pahad ma chilaune, katus, sallo, gurans ra banjh paainchhan, ani mathi gobre sallo, bhojpatra ra dhupi; tyo bhanda mathi rukh hudaina, ghans ra jhaadi matra hunchha.
bhojpatra lai kina prasiddha manchhan?
bhojpatra himal najik uchai ma paine rukh ho. yasko patalo bokra lai purano samaya ma kagaj jastai lekhna prayog garinthyo.
dhupi ko paat k ma prayog hunchha?
dhupi ko paat ra haanga ma mitho baasna hunchha. yaslai jalaera dhup jastai baasna phailaune chalan himali ra pahadi kshetra ma chha.
chilaune rukh lai kina chilaune bhanchhan?
chilaune ko bokra ra ras chhala ma lagda chilaune hunchha, tyasaile yasko naam chilaune rahyo. yo pahad ma dherai paine baliyo kath bhayeko rukh ho.
ritha ko phal k kaam ma aauchha?
ritha ko phal lai pani ma malda saabun jastai fij (lather) aauchha. pahile kapal ra luga dhuna ritha prayog garinthyo, ra aajkal pani kati thau ma garinchha.
khayar ko rukh bata k paainchha?
khayar ko rukh ko bhitri kath bata katha nikalinchha, jun paan ma halne ra rang ko kaam ma prayog hunchha. yo terai ra bhitri madhesh ka jangal ma paainchha.
simal ko rukh ko bishesh kura k ho?
simal ma basanta ritu ma paat jharera thula rata phool fulchhan. pachhi yasko kosa futda bhitra bata kapas jasto naram rui niskinchha, jun sirak-sirani bharna kaam lagchha.
babiyo bata k banainchha?
babiyo ek kisim ko lamo ra baliyo ghans ho. yasko masino ra baliyo paat batera dori banaine chalan chha.
dubo kina sajilai marne ghans hoina?
dubo ko kaand jamin mathi ra muni tadha samma phaildai gaanth gaanth bata naya jara halchha. tyasaile ukhelda thorai tukra baki rahe pani dubo pheri umrinchha.
ghiu kumari ko paat kina moto ra rasilo hunchha?
ghiu kumari (aloe vera) le aafno moto paat bhitra pani jamma garchha. yasle garda sukkha mausam ma pani yo dherai din samma bachna sakchha.
jalkumbhi le tal lai kasari noksan garchha?
jalkumbhi pani mathi chhito phailine biruwa ho. yasle pani ko satah dhakidinchha, ghaam ra oxygen pani bhitra pugna dinna, ra machha tatha aru jiw lai garo parchha.
nepal ma ban dadelo dherai kahile lagchha?
nepal ma ban dadelo dherai jaso sukkha mausam, falgun dekhi baisakh samma, lagchha. yo bela jhareko paat ra ghans sukeka hunchhan, ra manchhe le lagaeko aago chhitai phailinchha.
utpadak, upabhokta ra bighatak bhaneko k ho?

hariyo biruwa le ghaam bata aafno khana banaune bhayeko le utpadak (producer) hun. biruwa ya janawar khane janawar upabhokta (consumer) hun, ra mareka kura kuhaune dhusi ra jiwanu bighatak (decomposer) hun.
khadya jaal (food web) ra khadya shrinkhala ma k farak?
khadya shrinkhala euta matra sidha bato ho, jastai ghans -> mriga -> bagh. khadya jaal ma dherai shrinkhala ek aapas ma jodieka hunchhan, kinabhane euta janawar le dherai kisim ka khana khanchha.
jangal ma bagh jasta shikari kina thorai matra hunchhan?
khana ko harek taha ma dherai jaso shakti chalna, sas ferna ra garmi ma kharcha hunchha. tyasaile ghans dherai, mriga kam, ra bagh jasta mathillo taha ka shikari sabai bhanda kam hunchhan.
bagh harayo bhane jangal lai k farak parchha?
bagh harayo bhane mriga ra bandel jasta shakahari ko sankhya dherai badhchha. tiniharu le saana biruwa ra bali dherai khane bhayeko le jangal ra kheti dubai lai noksan pugchha.
jangal ma sukeko ra dhaleko rukh pani kaam ko hunchha?
hunchha. dhaleko rukh ma kira, dhusi ra jiwanu baschhan, kathfor jasta charaa le dulo banauchhan, ra kuhidai jaanda yasle mato lai mal dinchha.
biruwa le kun kun karan le aafno biu tadha pathauchha?
biu ama-biruwa najik matra khasyo bhane naya biruwa le ujyalo, pani ra mal ko lagi ama sanga nai pratispardha garnu parchha. tadha pugda naya thau ma ramrari badhna paauchha.
sukkha biu barshau samma kasari bachchha?
sukkha biu bhitra ko bhrun aaram ko awastha ma hunchha. pani, uchit tapkram ra hawa pugepachhi matra yo umrinchha, tyasaile biu barshau samma rakhna sakinchha.
kati biruwa ma bhale phool ra pothi phool chhuttai kina hunchha?
makai, farsi, kankro jasta biruwa ma bhale ra pothi phool chhuttai hunchhan. parag arko phool samma pugnu parne bhayeko le kira ra hawa le parag sarna maddat garchhan.
farsi ma phool lagchha tara phal kina lagdaina kahile kahi?
farsi ma bhale ra pothi phool chhuttai hunchhan, ra pothi phool samma parag napugda phal lagdaina. mahuri kam bhayeko bela kisan le bhale phool ko parag haat le pothi phool ma lagaidinchhan.
aanp ko rukh ma phal kahile dherai, kahile kam kina lagchha?

aanp jasta kehi rukh le ek barsha dherai phal diepachhi arko barsha kam phal dinchhan, kinabhane dherai phal falauda rukh ko shakti sakinchha. mausam, tusaro ra phool fulda pareko pani le pani asar garchha.
biruwa ra janawar ma sabai bhanda thulo farak k ho?
biruwa le ghaam ko prakash bata aafai khana banauchha, tara janawar le arko jiw khaera khana paauchhan. dherai biruwa ek thau mai rahanchhan bhane dherai janawar hidchhan.
hariyo nabhayeko biruwa pani hunchha?
hunchha. aakashbeli jasta parjivi biruwa ma hariyo rang hudaina, kinabhane tiniharu le aafai khana nabanai aru biruwa bata ras chuschhan.
What is a seed bank?

A seed bank is a place where seeds of many crops and wild plants are dried and stored in the cold for a long time. If a plant variety is lost to disease or disaster, it can be grown again from the stored seeds.
What would happen if all the decomposers disappeared?
Dead plants and animals would pile up without rotting, and the nutrients locked inside them would never return to the soil. Soon plants would run short of nutrients and stop growing well.
Why do some trees drop all their leaves in the dry season?
Leaves lose a lot of water through tiny pores. In a long dry season, dropping the leaves helps the tree save water until the rains return and new leaves can grow.
What is an invasive plant?
An invasive plant is one brought from another place that spreads quickly and takes over, pushing out local plants. Water hyacinth in ponds and lakes is one example.
Is a mushroom a plant?
No. Mushrooms belong to the fungi, a separate group from plants and animals. Fungi cannot make food from sunlight; they feed on dead or living things around them, and moulds and yeast are fungi too.
Why do forests matter for rivers and springs?
Forest soil and fallen leaves soak up rainwater like a sponge and release it slowly. This keeps springs and streams flowing long after the rain has stopped.
How do trees help keep a city cool?
Trees shade roads and buildings from the sun, and the water evaporating from their leaves cools the air around them. A street with trees feels much cooler on a hot day than a bare one.
Why do mangrove trees have roots sticking up out of the mud?
Mangroves grow in salty coastal mud that has very little air in it. Some of their roots grow upward out of the mud like snorkels so the tree can take in air.
What is pollen?

Pollen is the fine powder made by the male parts of a flower. When it reaches the female part of a flower of the same kind, seeds can form; in some people pollen in the air causes sneezing and itchy eyes.
kera ma biu hudaina bhane naya kera ko bot kasari aauchha?
hamle khane kera ma biu hudaina. naya bot purano bot ko jara najik niskane saana bot (pathera) bata aauchha, jaslai chhutyaera arko thau ma ropinchha.
badam (peanut) mato muni kasari falchha?
badam ko phool jamin mathi fulchha. parag sechan pachhi phool ko danth lamo bhaera mato bhitra paschha, ani tyahi mato muni badam ko kosa banchha.
kaju ko daana phal ko bhitra hunchha?
hudaina. kaju ko rukh ma rasilo phal (kaju syau) jasto banchha, ra kaju ko daana tyo phal ko tala bahira jhundieko hunchha.
nariwal bhitra pani kaha bata aauchha?
nariwal ko pani nariwal ko biu bhitra ko khana ko bhandar ho. nariwal pakdai jaanda yo pani bistarai seto gudi (nariwal) ma badalinchha.
anannas (pineapple) rukh ma falchha?
haina. anannas jamin najik ko saano bot ko bich ma falchha, ra euta anannas dherai saana phool milera baneko phal ho.
hybrid biu bata falyeko anna feri biu banaera ropda kina ramro faldaina?
hybrid biu dui farak jaat milayera banaieko hunchha. tyasko phal bata niskeko biu ma ama-buwa ka gun chhutiera farak farak biruwa aauchhan, tyasaile dosro barsha utpadan ghatna sakchha.
naya biruwa ropna barsha ko suru kina ramro manchhan?
nepal ma rukh ropna barsha ko suru, asar-shrawan, ramro maninchha. mato osilo hune bhayeko le naya biruwa ko jara chhitai basna sakchha ra pani halne jhanjhat kam hunchha.
ghar ko jag najik thulo rukh kina naropnu bhanchhan?
thulo rukh ko jara pani khojdai tadha samma phailinchha ra bhitta, jag ra pani ko pipe charkauna sakchha. hawa huri ma thula haanga ghar mathi khasne khatara pani hunchha.
bans fulyo bhane k hunchha?
dherai jaati ko bans dherai barsha ma ek choti matra fulchha, ra fulepachhi biu chhodera prayah sukchha. kahile kahi euta thau ka sabai bans eksaath fulchhan.
tapari ra duna k le banchha?
tapari (paat ko thal) ra duna (paat ko kachaura) dherai jaso sal ko paat lai sinka le jodera banainchha. bhoj ma yasma khana khaepachhi fyaakda yo mato ma kuhera jaanchha.
tejpat kun rukh ko paat ho?
tejpat dalchini ko parivar ko rukh ko paat ho, jun nepal ko pahad ma paainchha. sukaeko tejpat lai masu, bhat ra tarkari ma baasna ko lagi halchhan.
amriso kun kaam ma aauchha?
amriso ko phool sukaera kucho (broom) banainchha. bhiralo jamin ma lagaunda yasko jara le mato samatchha ra paat gai bastu le khanchhan.
dhaturo ko biu khana milchha?
mildaina, dhaturo ko phal, biu ra paat sabai bishalu hunchhan. bachcha haru le kaada bhayeko yo gol phal nachhoun ra nakhaun bhanera sikaunu parchha.
aalu ko bot ma pani phal lagchha?
lagchha, aalu ko bot ma phool fulepachhi saana hariyo golbheda jasta phal lagna sakchhan. ti phal bishalu hunchhan, khanu hudaina; hami mato muni ko aalu (kanda) matra khanchhau.
golbheda, aalu, khursani ra bhanta eutai parivar ka hun?
hun, yi charai eutai biruwa parivar (nightshade) ka hun. tyasaile tiniharu ko phool ra paat ali ali ustai dekhinchhan.
kankro, farsi ra lauka ma k samanata chha?
yi sabai eutai lahara parivar (cucurbit) ka biruwa hun. sabai ko lamo lahara, thula paat ra pahelo ya seto phool hunchhan, ra bhale ra pothi phool chhuttai hunchhan.
tori, rayo, cauli ra mula eutai jaat ka hun bhanchhan, sahi ho?
sahi ho, yi sabai tori parivar (mustard family) ka biruwa hun. bandakopi, gyanth kopi ra chamsur pani yahi parivar ma parchhan.
gulab ra syau ko parivar eutai ho?
ho, gulab, syau, naspati, aaru, aarubakhara ra strawberry eutai gulab parivar (rose family) ka biruwa hun. tiniharu ko phool ko banot milchha.
dherai phool basanta ritu mai kina fulchhan?
basanta ma mausam nyano hunchha ra din lamo hundai jaanchhan, jasle biruwa lai fulne sanket dinchha. yo bela mahuri ra putali pani dherai hune bhayeko le parag sechan sajilo hunchha.
rukh, jhaadi ra jhaar ma k farak?
rukh ko eutai baliyo kaath ko kaand hunchha ra aglo hunchha. jhaadi ko dherai kada kaand hunchhan tara hocho hunchha, ra jhaar (herb) ko kaand naram ra hariyo hunchha.
barsat ma chyau kina dherai umrinchha?
chyau lai osilo ra nyano mausam chahinchha. barsat ma mato ra kuhieka kath osila hunchhan, tyasaile mato bhitra lukeko chyau ko dhago bata chhitai chyau niskanchha.
kati kisan le khet ma biruwa ropera fulnu aghi nai kina jotidinchhan?
yaslai hariyo mal bhanchhan. kosa falne jasta biruwa ropera fulnu aghi nai mato ma jotera milauda tiniharu kuhera mato ma nitrogen ra jaivik mal thapchhan.
makai sangai simi kina lagauchhan?
makai ko thado bot le simi ko lahara lai chadhne aadhar dinchha. simi ko jara le mato ma nitrogen thapchha, tyasaile dubai lai fayada hunchha ra eutai bari bata dui bali paainchha.
tarkari ko purana paat pahelo hunda k bujhne?
tala ka purana paat pahelo hunu dherai jaso mato ma nitrogen mal kam bhayeko sanket ho. tara dherai pani, kam ghaam ya rog le pani paat pahelo hunchha, tyasaile karan herera upaya garnu parchha.
biu kati gahirai gadnu parchha?
sadharan niyam anusar biu lai tyasko aakar ko dui-tin guna gahirai gadinchha. saana biu mato ko mathi thorai chhopera matra rakhinchha, thula biu ali tala gadinchha.
nadi ma bish halera ya current lagaera machha marnu kina naramro?
bish ra current le thula machha matra haina, saana machha, anda ra pani ka aru jiw pani marchhan. nadi ko pani pani bigrinchha, ra yasto garnu nepal ma kanun le niyantrit chha.
CFL bulb phutyo bhane kina hoshiyar hunu parchha?

CFL (ghumaune aakar ko seto bulb) bhitra thorai mercury hunchha, jun bishalu dhatu ho. phutyo bhane kotha ko jhyal kholera hawa chalna dinus, kaanch ra dhulo kagaj le batulera band thaili ma rakhnus ra haat dhunus.
kathmandu ma hiundo ma dhuwa-dhulo kina badhi hunchha?

kathmandu chautarfi pahad le gherieko upatyaka ho. hiundo ma chiso hawa tala thunninchha ra mathi jaana paudaina, pani pani kam parchha, tyasaile gadi ra itta bhatta ko dhuwa-dhulo upatyaka mai jammaa hunchha.
gobar gyas (biogas) kasari banchha?

gobar ra pani lai hawa napasne khaldo (digester) ma rakhda jiwanu le kuhaera methane gyas banauchhan. yo gyas pipe bata chulo samma lagera khana pakauna sakinchha, ra baki rahne lede ramro mal hunchha.
kankro garmi ma kina ramro manchhan?
kankro ma dherai pani hunchha ra yo halka hunchha. garmi ma kankro khanda sharir ma pani pugna maddat garchha ra mukh chiso hunchha.
Why does grass turn yellow under a stone or a plank?
Without light, grass cannot make chlorophyll, the green pigment, so it turns pale yellow. If the stone is removed, the grass slowly turns green again in the sunlight.
Why do plants kept in a dark room grow tall and thin?
In the dark, a plant uses its stored food to stretch upward as fast as it can, trying to reach light. It grows long, weak and pale because it cannot make chlorophyll or food without light.
Why do plants grow slowly in winter?
In winter there is less sunlight and the days are short, so plants make less food. The cold also slows down the chemical work inside the plant.
Can plants feel touch?
Plants have no nerves or brain, but many can respond to touch. The touch-me-not plant folds its leaves when touched, and the tendrils of climbing plants curl around anything they touch.
How do climbing plants climb?
Some climbing plants, like peas and cucumbers, send out thin tendrils that wrap around a support. Others, like beans, wind their whole stem around a pole as they grow.
Why do some plants have hairy leaves?
Tiny hairs on leaves trap a layer of still air that slows down water loss. They also make the leaves harder for insects to walk on and eat.
Is all the wood in a tree trunk alive?
No. Only a thin layer just under the bark is alive and growing. The darker wood in the centre is dead, but it is very strong and holds the tree up.
How is rubber collected from trees?
Workers make a thin slanting cut in the bark of the rubber tree, and a milky liquid called latex slowly drips into a cup. The latex is collected and processed into rubber.
What is cork made from?
Cork is the thick, spongy bark of the cork oak tree. The bark can be peeled off every several years without killing the tree, and it grows back.
Where does cotton come from?
Cotton is the soft, fluffy fibre that grows around the seeds of the cotton plant. When the seed pod opens, the cotton is picked, cleaned of seeds and spun into thread.
Where does chocolate come from?
Chocolate is made from the seeds of the cacao tree, which grow inside large pods. The seeds are fermented, dried and roasted, then ground and mixed with sugar and milk.
Which tree gave an old medicine for malaria?
Quinine, an old medicine for malaria, comes from the bark of the cinchona tree of South America. Today other medicines are mostly used, but quinine saved many lives in the past.
Which medicine is linked to willow trees?
Willow bark contains a substance that people used for pain and fever for centuries. Scientists later made aspirin from a similar chemical.
How important is rice in the world?
Rice is the main food for more than half of the people in the world, especially in Asia. In Nepal too, dal bhat is the everyday meal for most families.
What is the tree line on a mountain?
The tree line is the height above which trees cannot grow, because it is too cold and windy and the growing season is too short. Above it there are only shrubs, grasses and then rock and snow.
syau ramro falna chiso hiundo kina chahinchha?

syau ko rukh lai hiundo ma kehi samaya chiso mausam chahinchha, tyas pachhi matra basanta ma ramrari phool fulchhan. tyasaile nepal ma syau jumla, mustang, manang jasta chiso uchcha thau ma ramro falchha.
alaichi ko kheti rukh muni kina garchhan?
thulo alaichi lai osilo mato ra chhahari chahinchha, charko ghaam ma yasko paat polchhan. tyasaile kisan le uttis jasta rukh muni chhahari ma alaichi lagauchhan.
chiya ko kheti kasto jamin ma ramro hunchha?
chiya lai pani naadine bhiralo jamin, ali amilo mato ra prashasta barsat chahinchha. jara ma pani jamyo bhane chiya ko bot bigrinchha, tyasaile ilam jasta pahadi bhiralo ma chiya bagan dherai chhan.
pipal ko paat ko tuppa kina lamo ra patalo hunchha?
pipal ko paat ko lamo tuppa bata pani ko thopa chhitai chuhera jharchha. paat chhitai sukne bhayeko le tyasma dhusi ra leu kam laagchha.
suntala ko bokra nichoda kina saana saana thopa udchhan?
suntala ko bokra ma dherai saana tel ka thaili hunchhan. nichoda ti thaili phutera baasna aaune tel ko thopa udchhan, ra hatma suntala ko baasna aauchha.
lasun kutda kina tikho gandha aauchha?
lasun ko koshika phutda bhitra ka padartha milera tikho gandha bhayeko gandhak (sulphur) wala tatva banchhan. sabut lasun ma tyati gandha hudaina, kutda ya katda matra badhi aauchha.
khursani ko piro sabai bhanda badhi kun bhag ma hunchha?
khursani ko piro sabai bhanda badhi biu jodieko seto naram bhag (bhitri ris) ma hunchha. biu aafai bhanda tyo seto bhag nai badhi piro hunchha, tyasaile tyo hatauda khursani kam piro hunchha.
terai ka ghans maidan kina mahatwapurna chhan?
terai ka aglo ghans maidan gaida, barahsinga, khar majur jasta janawar ra dherai charaa ko ghar hun. yi maidan bina yi janawar lai khana ra lukne thau pugdaina.
kun fohor kuhinchha, kun kuhidaina?
bhansa ko fohor, tarkari ko bokra, paat ra kagaj kuhera mato ma milchhan. plastic, sisa ra dhatu bhane kuhidainan, tyasaile tiniharu lai chhuttyaera rakhnu parchha.
chiya patti kasari banainchha?
tipeko chiya ko paat lai pahile oilauna dinchhan, ani batera (roll) hawa ma rakhda paat khairo hunchha. tyas pachhi sukaera kalo chiya patti banainchha.
hariyo chiya kina hariyo nai rahanchha?

hariyo chiya banauda tipeko paat lai chhitai tataera (bafaera ya bhutera) paat bhitra ko rang badalne kriya rokinchha. tyasaile paat hariyo rahanchha, jaba ki kalo chiya ma paat lai khairo hune samaya dinchhan.
kagaj kasle banchha ra recycle garda k fayada?
dherai kagaj rukh ko kath lai pisera baneko lugdi (pulp) bata banchha. purano kagaj recycle garda naya kagaj banauna kam rukh kaatnu parchha ra pani tatha bijuli pani bachchha.
khairo chamal ma seto chamal bhanda k badhi hunchha?
khairo chamal ma bahira ko bokra matra hatieko hunchha ra bhitri patalo khairo tah rahanchha. yo tah ma resha ra vitamin hunchhan; dherai kutera seto banauda yo tah hatchha.
khane tel kun kun biu bata banchha?
nepal ma tori, bhatmas, suryamukhi, til ra badam ko biu bata khane tel dherai banchha. nariwal ko tel nariwal ko gudi bata ra jaitun ko tel jaitun ko phal bata nikalinchha.
kesar biruwa ko kun bhag ho?
kesar ek kisim ko phool ko bich ma hune rato dhago jasto bhag (strikesar ko tuppa) ho. ek phool ma tin wata matra hune bhayeko ra haat le tipnu parne bhayeko le kesar dherai mahango masala ho.
jute (sanpat) ko resha biruwa ko kun bhag bata aauchha?
jute ko resha biruwa ko kaand ko bokra bata aauchha. katera pani ma kehi din dubaera rakhda bokra kuhinchha ra resha chhutyauna sajilo hunchha.
sal ko kath ghar banauna kina rojinchha?
sal ko kath dherai baliyo, gahrungo ra lamo samaya samma tikne hunchha. tyasaile dhoka, jhyal, dalin ra khamba banauna sal ko kath dherai prayog hunchha.
sallo ko khoto bata k banchha?
sallo ko rukh bata niskane chiplo ras lai khoto bhanchhan. yasbata turpentine (rang patalo garne tel) ra rosin banainchha.
sallo ko jangal ma aago kina chhito phailinchha?
sallo ko sukeko siyo jasto paat ra khoto ma tel jasto padartha hunchha, jun sajilai balchha. sukkha mausam ma jhareko paat ko bakla tah le aago chhitai phailaunchha.
khet ko bhyaguto lai kisan ko sathi kina bhanchhan?
bhyaguto le khet ka kira, lamkhutte ra bali khane saana jiw khanchha. bhyaguto dherai bhayeko khet ma kira kam hunchhan.
gaun ma dekhine sabai sarpa lai kina marnu hudaina?
dherai jaso sarpa bishalu hudainan, ra sarpa le bali ra anna khane musa khanchhan. sarpa dekhda nachalaunus ra tadha basnus; ghar bhitra pasyo bhane jankar manchhe lai bolaunus.
ullu lai kisan ko sathi kina bhanchhan?
ullu le raati khet ra bhakari najik ka musa samatera khanchha. euta ullu ko parivar le ek barsha ma dherai musa khane bhayeko le bali joginchha.
kera pakdai jaanda bokra ma kalo thopla kina aauchha?
kera pakda bhitra ko starch guliyo ma badalinchha ra bokra ma kalo-khairo thopla dekhinchhan. yasto kera guliyo hunchha ra bigreko hudaina, bhitra kuhieko chhaina bhane khana milchha.
aalu katera kina pani ma rakhchhan?
kateko aalu hawa ma rakhda chhitai khairo-kalo hunchha. pani ma dubaera rakhda hawa lagdaina, tyasaile aalu ko rang ramro rahanchha.
katahar rukh ko kun thau ma falchha?
katahar haanga ko tuppa ma matra haina, rukh ko moto kaand ra thula haanga mai jhundiera falchha. katahar rukh ma falne sabai bhanda thulo phal ho.
mewa (papaya) ko sabai bot ma phal kina lagdaina?
mewa ko bot bhale, pothi ra dubai phool bhayeko gari farak kisim ka hunchhan. bhale bot ma dherai jaso phal lagdaina, tyasaile kisan le phal dine bot matra rakhchhan.
okhar ko hariyo bokra chhuda haat kina kalo hunchha?
kancho okhar ko hariyo bahiri bokra ma rang dine padartha hunchha, jasle haat ra luga lai khairo-kalo banauchha. yo rang sajilai jaadaina, tyasaile tipda panja lagaunu ramro.
khet ko aali ma bhatmas ra mas kina ropchhan?
dhan khet ko aali (dil) khali thau hunchha. tyaha bhatmas ya mas ropda thap anna paainchha, ra gedagudi ko jara le mato lai nitrogen pani dinchha.
kera ko euta bot ma kati choti kera falchha?
kera ko euta bot ma ek choti matra kera ko kosa falchha. kera kaatepachhi tyo bot kaatinchha ra jara najik ka naya bot (pathera) hurkera pheri phal dinchhan.
golbheda ko bot lai dandi kina gadinchha?
golbheda ko bot phal ko bhaar le jhukera bhui ma ladchha. dandi gadera bandhda phal mato ma chhoindaina, kuhine kam hunchha ra hawa ramrari lagchha.
kankro ko tuppa kahile kahi kina tito hunchha?
kankro jasta biruwa ma tito swad dine tatva hunchha, jun dherai jaso danth najik ko tuppa ma badhi jamma hunchha. tyasaile kankro ko dubai tuppa ali kaatera falne chalan chha.
What are the layers of a rainforest?

A rainforest has a tall top layer called the canopy, where most leaves and fruit are, with a few giant trees poking above it. Below are the shady understorey, then shrubs, and the dark forest floor covered in fallen leaves.
Why should old batteries not be thrown in normal rubbish?
Batteries contain metals and chemicals that can leak out and poison soil and water. They should be collected and taken to a place that handles them safely.
Why does freshly cut grass smell so strong?
When grass is cut, the damaged leaves quickly release chemicals into the air. These give the fresh "green" smell and are thought to help the plant heal and warn off insects.
Why do stored onions start to sprout?
An onion is full of stored food meant for a new plant. When it is kept somewhere warm and damp, it uses that food to send up green shoots, so onions keep longer in a cool, dry, airy place.
What do lichens on trees tell us about the air?
Many lichens are very sensitive to air pollution. Plenty of lichens growing on trees and rocks usually means the air in that place is fairly clean.
Where does vanilla come from?
Vanilla comes from the long pods of a climbing orchid. The pods are picked green and then cured and dried for weeks until they turn dark brown and smell sweet.
phool bhitra mitho ras (nectar) kina hunchha?
phool ko mitho ras mahuri, putali ra charaa lai bolaune inam jastai ho. ras khana aauda tiniharu ko jiu ma parag laagchha ra arko phool ma pugchha, jasle biu banna maddat garchha.
gamala ko pindh ma pwal kina rakhinchha?
pindh ko pwal bata badhi pani bahira niskinchha. pani jamyo bhane jara le hawa paudaina ra kuhinchha, tyasaile gamala ma pani nikasne pwal chahinchha.
biruwa lai diuso charko ghaam ma pani halnu bhanda bihana-saanjh kina ramro?
bihana ra saanjh ghaam kam hune bhayeko le haleko pani chhitai baph bhaera udna paudaina ra jara samma pugchha. charko ghaam ma haleko dherai pani mato mai sukera jaanchha.
ghana rukh muni ghans kina kam umrinchha?
ghana rukh ko paat le dherai ghaam rokchha, tyasaile muni ko ghans lai khana banauna pugne ujyalo pugdaina. rukh ko jara le mato ko pani ra mal pani dherai linchha.
biruwa ko jara le dhunga samma futauna sakchha?
sakchha. saano jara dhunga ko chiraa ma pasera bistarai moto hundai jaanda chiraa thulo banauchha, ra lamo samaya ma dhunga futchha. yasari jara le dhunga lai mato banauna pani maddat garchha.
biruwa kun kun tarika le naya bot banauchhan?
dherai biruwa biu bata naya bot banauchhan. aalu kanda bata, ukhu ra gulab kaand ko tukra bata, kera jara najik ko pathera bata, ra pyaj-lasun gano bata pani naya bot umrinchhan.
dhunga kati kisim ka hunchhan?

dhunga mukhya rup ma tin kisim ka hunchhan: pagleko magma chiso bhaera baneko agneya (igneous), tah tah thuprera baneko pathariya (sedimentary), ra garmi tatha chap le badalieko rupantarit (metamorphic) dhunga.
granite dhunga kasari banchha?
granite jamin bhitra pagleko magma bistarai chiso bhaera kada bhaeko agneya dhunga ho. bistarai chiso bhaeko le yasma saana saana chamkila daana dekhinchhan.
dhunga ma tah tah dharka kina dekhinchhan?
tyasto dhunga pathariya (sedimentary) dhunga ho. nadi ra samudra ma lakhaun barsha samma baluwa, mato ra kan ek mathi arko thuprera thichiyera dhunga bandai jaanda tah dekhinchhan.
marble (sangamarmar) kun dhunga bata banchha?
marble chuna dhunga (limestone) jamin bhitra dherai garmi ra chap le badalinda banchha. tyasaile marble rupantarit (metamorphic) dhunga ho.
chhana ma halne chepto dhunga (slate) kasari banchha?
slate mato bata baneko naram dhunga (shale) lai jamin bhitra ko chap le thichera banchha. yasko tah chepto chepto futne bhayeko le chhana ra patti banauna sajilo hunchha.
fossil bhaneko k ho?
fossil bhaneko lakhaun barsha aghi bacheka jiw ko haddi, khol, paat ya paila ko chhaap dhunga ma surakshit rahanu ho. yasle purana samaya ma kasta jiw thiye bhanera thaha dinchha.
mato kasari banchha?

ghaam, pani, hiu ra jara le dhunga lai lamo samaya samma futaudai saana kan banauchhan. tyasma kuhieka paat ra jiw ko mal (humus) milera mato banchha; yo kaam saya-hajar barsha lagne bistarai hune prakriya ho.
baluwa mato, chikni mato ra domat mato ma k farak?

baluwa mato ko daana thulo hunchha ra pani chhitai chhirera jaanchha. chikni mato ko kan dherai masina hunchhan ra pani dherai rokchha; domat mato dubai ko ramro mishran ho, jun kheti ko lagi sabai bhanda ramro maninchha.
chiso thau ma pani le dhunga kasari futauchha?
din ma dhunga ko chiraa ma pani paschha ra raati tyo pani jamda phailinchha. pataka pataka jamne-paglane hunda chiraa thulo hundai jaanchha ra dhunga futchha.
gufa bhitra jhundieka dhunga ka dandi kasari banchhan?

chuna dhunga ko gufa ko chhana bata chuhine pani ma ghuleko chuna thopa thopa gari jamdai jaanchha. mathi bata jhundine lai stalactite ra bhui bata mathi uthne lai stalagmite bhanchhan; yi banna hajarau barsha lagchha.
bhukampa ko kendra (epicentre) bhaneko k ho?
jamin bhitra jaha chattan sarera bhukampa suru hunchha, tyo thau lai focus bhanchhan. tyas thik mathi jamin ko satah ko thau lai epicentre bhanchhan, jaha prayah sabai bhanda dherai hallinchha.
thulo bhukampa pachhi pani pataka pataka kina jamin hallinchha?
thulo bhukampa pachhi chattan haru pheri milna khojda saana saana bhukampa aauchhan, jaslai parakampan (aftershock) bhanchhan. yo dherai din, kahile mahina samma aauna sakchha.
bhukampa kahile aauchha bhanera aghi nai bhanna sakinchha?
sakindaina. bigyan le kun kshetra ma bhukampa ko khatara badhi chha bhanna sakchha, tara thik kun din ra kati baje aauchha bhanera pahile nai bhanna sakdaina; tyasaile sadhai tayari garnu ramro.
bhukampa ko magnitude 7 ra 6 ma kati farak hunchha?
magnitude ko ek ank badhda jamin ko hallai lagbhag 10 guna badhchha ra niskane urja lagbhag 32 guna badhchha. tyasaile 7 ko bhukampa 6 ko bhanda dherai shaktishali hunchha.
bhukampa kun yantra le naapinchha?
bhukampa seismograph bhanne yantra le naapinchha. yasle jamin ko kampan lai rekha ma lekhchha, ra tyasbata bhukampa kati thulo thiyo ra kaha gayo bhanera thaha hunchha.
magma ra lava ma k farak?
jamin bhitra hune pagleko taato chattan lai magma bhanchhan. tyahi magma jwalamukhi bata jamin bahira niskepachhi tyaslai lava bhaninchha.
jwalamukhi kina futchha?
jamin bhitra ko magma ma gyas ghuleko hunchha ra yo mathi uthdai jaanda chap badhchha. chap dherai bhaepachhi magma, gyas ra kharani jod le bahira niskanchha.
jwalamukhi najik ko mato kina urbar hunchha?
jwalamukhi bata niskeko kharani ra lava ma biruwa lai chahine dherai khanij hunchhan. samaya sanga yo mato ma milera urbar banchha, tyasaile kati desh ma jwalamukhi najik pani kheti hunchha.
sakriya ra nibhiyeko jwalamukhi ma k farak?

haal sammai futne ya chhitai futna sakne jwalamukhi lai sakriya bhanchhan. lamo samaya dekhi nafuteko tara pheri futna sakne lai sutiraheko (dormant), ra pheri kahilyai nafutne lai nibhiyeko (extinct) jwalamukhi bhanchhan.
himnadi (glacier) pani bagchha?
bagchha, tara dherai bistarai. hiu ko thulo thupro aafno bhaar le dherai bistarai bhiralo tira sarchha, ra tala pugera pagliyera nadi ko muhan banchha.
nadi ko muhan bhaneko k ho?
nadi suru hune thau lai nadi ko muhan bhanchhan, jastai himnadi, tal ya jamin bata niskane mul. tyaha bata bagdai gaera nadi ant ma arko nadi, tal ya samudra ma misinchha.
sahayak nadi (tributary) bhaneko k ho?
thulo nadi ma aaera misine nadi lai sahayak nadi bhanchhan. jastai marsyangdi nadi mugling najik trishuli ma misinchha, tyasaile marsyangdi trishuli ko sahayak nadi ho.
samtal jamin ma nadi sarpa jastai bango bango kina bagchha?
samtal thau ma nadi dhilo bagchha ra ghumti ko bahiri kinar katdai bhitri kinar ma baluwa thupardai jaanchha. yasari ghumti jhan jhan thula hundai nadi sarpa jastai bango hunchha.
samudra ma chhal (wave) kina aauchha?
samudra ko satah ma hawa chalda pani dhakelinchha ra chhal banchha. hawa jati jod le ra lamo samaya chalchha, chhal tyati nai thulo hunchha.
dhruva najik aakash ma rangin batti (aurora) kina dekhinchha?

surya bata aaune bidyut bhayeko saana kan prithvi ko chumbakiya kshetra le dhruva tira lagchha. tiniharu mathi ko hawa sanga thokkinda aakash ma hariyo, rato ra baijani ujyalo naachirahe jasto dekhinchha.
What is a geyser?

A geyser is a hot spring that now and then shoots a column of hot water and steam into the air. Water underground is heated by hot rock until the pressure forces it out; the most famous ones are in Iceland and in Yellowstone in the USA.
Where are fossils usually found?
Fossils are usually found in sedimentary rocks such as limestone and shale. These rocks formed from mud and sand that buried dead plants and animals before they could rot away.
What is a fault line?
A fault is a long crack in the Earth's crust where two blocks of rock can slide past each other. When the rocks suddenly slip along a fault, the ground shakes in an earthquake.
Can quicksand swallow a person completely?

No. Quicksand is sand so full of water that it cannot hold weight, so a person sinks in, but the human body floats in it and usually stops at the waist. The danger is being stuck, so move slowly, lean back and work the legs free.
What is a sinkhole?
A sinkhole is a hole that opens when the ground above collapses into an empty space below. It often happens where underground water has slowly dissolved soft rock like limestone.
What is an oasis?
An oasis is a green spot in a desert where water from underground comes near the surface. Palm trees and crops can grow there, and travellers and animals stop there to drink.
How are islands formed?
Some islands are the tops of volcanoes that rose from the sea floor, like Hawaii. Others are built by coral, and some were once part of the mainland until the sea rose around them.
How does a waterfall form?
A waterfall often forms where a river flows over hard rock onto softer rock. The water wears away the soft rock faster, making a step, and over time the step grows into a waterfall.
Why are pebbles in a river round and smooth?
As a river carries stones along, they roll and knock against each other and the riverbed. Over many years their sharp edges wear away, leaving round, smooth pebbles.
What is a mineral?
A mineral is a natural solid substance with a fixed chemical makeup, such as quartz, mica or rock salt. Rocks are made of one or more minerals mixed together.
Why does a river carry more mud after heavy rain?
Heavy rain washes soil off the land into streams, and the faster, bigger river also scrapes mud from its own bed and banks. That is why rivers turn brown in the monsoon.
What is a plateau?
A plateau is a large area of high, fairly flat land, raised above the land around it. The Tibetan Plateau north of Nepal is the highest and one of the largest in the world.
badal kati kisim ka hunchhan?

mukhya rup ma, kapas jasta phuleka ra seto cumulus, aakash bhari chhapieko kharani tah jasto stratus, dherai mathi ka patala raun jasta cirrus, ra aglo kalo garjane cumulonimbus badal hunchhan. cumulonimbus le nai garjan, bijuli ra thulo pani lyaunchha.
sukkha mato ma pahilo pani parda mitho baasna kina aauchha?

sukkha mato ma biruwa ko tel ra mato ka saana jiwanu le banaeka padartha jammaa bhaeka hunchhan. pani ko thopa khasda yi padartha hawa ma udchhan, ra tyahi baasna hamle pahilo pani ko mato ko baasna bhanchhau.
barsat ma dhoeko luga kina chhito sukdaina?
barsat ma hawa ma pahile nai dherai baph (humidity) hunchha. hawa ma thap pani linne thau kam hune bhayeko le luga ko pani bistarai udchha.
badal nabhayeko raat kina dherai chiso hunchha?

diuso jamin le ghaam ko taap soschha ra raati tyo taap aakash tira bahira jaanchha. badal bhaeko raat badal le kambal jastai taap rokchha, tara safa aakash ma taap sidhai udera jamin chhitai chiso hunchha.
purbi hawa bhaneko purba tira jane hawa ho?
haina, hawa lai jun disha bata aauchha tyasai ko naam dinchhan. purbi hawa bhaneko purba bata pashchim tira chalne hawa ho.
hiu ko daana (snowflake) ko aakar kasto hunchha?
hiu ka daana dherai jaso chha kune (6 kune) aakar ka hunchhan. pani ka anu jamda chha kune banot ma milne bhayeko le yesto hunchha, ra prayah euta daana arko sanga thyakkai ustai hudaina.
indreni sadhai ghaam ko ulto tira kina dekhinchha?

indreni hernu ghaam pithyu tira parera pani ka thopa tira hernu parchha. ghaam ko prakash thopa bhitra pasera farkanda rang chhuttinchhan, tyasaile bihana indreni pashchim tira ra saanjh purba tira dekhinchha.
jun waripari gol ghero (halo) kina dekhinchha?
dherai mathi ko patalo cirrus badal ma saana hiu ka kan hunchhan. jun ko prakash ti kan bata badlinda jun waripari ujyalo gol ghero dekhinchha.
hiundo ma nepal ma pareko pani kaha bata aauchha?
hiundo ko pani ra himal ko hiu dherai jaso pashchim tira bata aaune badal ko pranali (westerly disturbance) le lyaunchha. tyasaile hiundo ko pani prayah pashchim nepal bata suru hunchha.
garmi ma diuso pachhi kina garjan sahit pani parchha?
bihana dekhi ghaam le jamin ra hawa tataunchha ra osilo taato hawa mathi uthchha. mathi pugera chiso bhaepachhi thulo kalo badal banchha ra diuso pachhi ya saanjh garjan sahit pani parchha.
himal ko tuppa waripari badal kina adkiyeko jasto dekhinchha?
hawa himal ma thokkiera mathi uthna baadhya hunchha ra mathi chiso bhaepachhi tyasko baph badal banchha. tyasaile dherai jaso himal ko tuppa waripari badal jammaa bhaeko dekhinchha.
garmi ma kalopatre sadak ma tadha pani jasto kina dekhinchha?

taato sadak mathi ko hawa dherai taato hunchha, ra tyaha bata prakash bango hunchha. aakash ko prakash bango bhaera aankha samma pugda sadak ma pani tal jasto dekhinchha, jaslai mrigatrishna (mirage) bhanchhan.
pahad ko uttar farkeko bhiralo kina chiso hunchha?

nepal bhumadhya rekha ko uttar ma bhayeko le ghaam dherai jaso dakshin tira bata lagchha. dakshin farkeko bhiralo ma dherai ghaam parchha, uttar farkeko bhiralo ma chhaya badhi hunchha, tyasaile tyaha chiso, osilo ra ghana jangal hunchha.
ghar ko mukh dakshin tira farkaera banaunda k fayada hunchha?
nepal ma ghaam dakshin tira bata aaune bhayeko le dakshin farkeko jhyal bata hiundo bhari ghaam bhitra paschha. tyasaile kotha nyano ra ujyalo rahanchha.
baadal futnu (cloudburst) bhaneko k ho?
dherai saano kshetra ma dherai chhoto samaya ma asaadhaaran dherai pani parnu lai baadal futnu bhanchhan. yasle achanak badhi ra pahiro lyauna sakchha.
hiu pahiro (avalanche) kasari jaanchha?

bhiralo ma thuprieko hiu ko tah gahrungo bhaera ya tala ko tah kamjor bhaera achanak bhiralo bata tala chiplinchha. yo dherai chhito aauchha, tyasaile himal ma bhiralo hiu ko bato bata hidda dherai hoshiyar hunu parchha.
baisakh-jestha ma achanak huri batas ra asina kina aauchha?
monsoon aaunu agadi garmi badhchha ra hawa ma osilopan pani thapinchha. taato osilo hawa chhito mathi uthda thula garjane badal banchhan, jasle huri, bijuli ra asina lyaunchhan.
jado ma upatyaka ko bhui ma dada ko tuppa bhanda badhi tusaro kina parchha?
raati chiso hawa gahrungo hune bhayeko le dada bata bagera upatyaka ko pindh ma jammaa hunchha. tyasaile hiundo ko bihana upatyaka ko khet ma badhi tusaro ra dada mathi ali nyano hunchha.
himal bata aaune nadi ma garmi ma pani kina badhchha?
garmi ma ghaam le himal ko hiu ra himnadi paglauchha, ra tyo pani nadi ma misinchha. tyasma monsoon ko pani pani thapiepachhi garmi ra barsha ma nadi dherai thula hunchhan.
himal ma ghaam ma ubhida taato tara chhaya ma pasda dherai chiso kina hunchha?
uchai ma hawa patalo hunchha ra hawa le taap kam samatchha. ghaam ko kiran sidhai lagda taato lagchha, tara chhaya ma pasna bittikai hawa nai chiso bhayeko le dherai jado hunchha.
Why do clouds float if they are made of water?
Clouds are made of billions of tiny droplets, each far smaller than a raindrop. They are so light that rising air keeps them up, until they join together into drops heavy enough to fall as rain.
Are raindrops shaped like tears?
No. Small raindrops are round, and bigger ones are pushed flat on the bottom by the air as they fall, a bit like a bun. The teardrop shape is only how people draw them.
Why does wind make us feel colder?
Our body warms a thin layer of air right next to the skin. Wind keeps blowing that warm layer away, so we lose heat faster and feel colder than the thermometer shows.
Why is the second rainbow in a double rainbow fainter?
The second rainbow is made by light bouncing twice inside each raindrop instead of once. Some light escapes at each bounce, so it is dimmer, and its colours are in the opposite order.
What is a cyclone?

A cyclone is a huge spinning storm that forms over warm sea water, bringing very strong winds and heavy rain. The same kind of storm is called a hurricane in the Atlantic and a typhoon in the western Pacific.
What is a tornado?
A tornado is a narrow, violently spinning column of air that reaches down from a thunderstorm cloud to the ground. It is much smaller than a cyclone but its winds can be even stronger.
What does falling air pressure usually tell us about the weather?
When air pressure falls, warm moist air is usually rising, which often brings clouds, wind and rain. Rising pressure usually means calmer, clearer weather.
Why do deserts get so little rain?
Many deserts lie where dry air sinks from high up, which stops clouds from forming. Others are far from the sea or sit behind mountains that squeeze the rain out of the air before it arrives.
Why is it so quiet after fresh snow falls?
Fresh snow is full of tiny air spaces between the flakes. These spaces soak up sound like a sponge, so noises fade quickly and the world sounds hushed.
What is acid rain?
Acid rain forms when smoke from burning coal and oil puts gases into the air that mix with rain and make it acidic. It can damage forests, lakes and stone buildings.
What is El Nino?

El Nino is a change in which the surface of the Pacific Ocean near the equator becomes warmer than usual. It shifts weather around the world, and in El Nino years the South Asian monsoon is often weaker.
surya sadhai thik purba bata nai ulaauchha?
thik purba bata surya barsha ma dui patak matra, din ra raat barabar hune bela ulaauchha. garmi ma surya uttar-purba tira bata ra jado ma dakshin-purba tira bata ulaauchha.
nepal ma diuso 12 baje tira ghaam kun disha ma hunchha?
nepal ma diuso ghaam sadhai aakash ko dakshin tira hunchha, kahilyai thik tauko mathi pugdaina. tyasaile diuso hamro chhaya uttar tira parchha.
jun harek din ali dhilo kina ulaauchha?
jun prithvi ko waripari ghumdai agadi sardai jaanchha. tyasaile prithvi le pheri jun lai bhetna harek din ali badhi ghumnu parchha, ra jun aghillo din bhanda lagbhag 50 minet dhilo ulaauchha.
jun ma gol gol khaldo (crater) kina dherai chhan?
arbau barsha dekhi antariksha ka dhunga ra ulka jun ma thokkiera khaldo banae. jun ma hawa, pani ra mausam nabhayeko le ti khaldo metindainan ra aile samma raheka chhan.
jun ma manchhe ko paila ko chhaap aile pani chha?
dherai sambhawana chha. jun ma hawa, pani ra mausam nabhayeko le paila ko chhaap metaune kehi hudaina, tyasaile antariksha yatri le chhodeka chhaap lamo samaya samma rahan sakchhan.
shani graha pani ma tairina sakchha bhanchhan, kina?
shani dherai thulo bhae pani mukhya rup ma halka gyas le baneko chha. yasko ghanatwa pani bhanda kam chha, tyasaile kalpana garna sakine thulo pani ma rakhna sake shani tairinchha.
surya bata sabai bhanda tadha ko graha kun ho?
