surya bata sabai bhanda tadha ko graha varun (neptune) ho. yo nilo rang ko chiso graha ho, jaha dherai tej hawa chalchha.
asteroid belt kaha chha?
asteroid belt mangal ra brihaspati ko bich ma chha. yaha surya ko parikrama garne lakhaun saana-thula dhunga ra dhatu ka tukra chhan.
tara haru ko rang farak farak kina hunchha?
tara ko rang tyasko tapkram anusar hunchha. dherai taato tara nilo-seto, ali kam taato pahelo (hamro surya jastai) ra tulanatmak chiso tara rato dekhinchhan.
surya pachhi hamro sabai bhanda najik ko tara kun ho?
surya pachhi sabai bhanda najik ko tara proxima centauri ho. tara pani yasko prakash prithvi samma aauna 4 barsha bhanda badhi samaya lagchha.
saptarishi mandal ma kati wata tara hunchhan?
saptarishi mandal ma 7 wata chamkila tara hunchhan, jun hasiya ya dadu jasto aakar ma dekhinchhan. yasko agadi ka dui tara ko sidha rekha le dhruva tara khojna maddat garchha.
brahmanda kati purano chha?
bigyan haru ko anuman anusar brahmanda lagbhag 13.8 arab barsha purano chha. yo ek dherai saano, taato ra ghana awastha bata phailidai aaeko ho, jaslai big bang bhanchhan.
hamro surya kati purano chha?
hamro surya lagbhag 4.6 arab barsha purano chha. yo aru arbau barsha samma chamkirahanchha bhanne bigyan haru ko anuman chha.
antariksha station le prithvi ko ek chakkar kati samaya ma lagauchha?
antarrashtriya antariksha station (ISS) le prithvi ko ek chakkar lagbhag 90 minet ma lagauchha. tyasaile tyaha baseka yatri le ek din ma dherai patak surya ulaaeko ra astaeko dekhchhan.
mausam ko satellite le k kaam garchha?
mausam ko satellite le dherai mathi bata prithvi ka badal, aandhi ra tapkram ko tasbir lagatar khichchha. yinai tasbir herera mausam bigyan le pani ra huri ko purvanuman garchhan.
prithvi ghumdaichha bhane hamilai kina thaha hudaina?

prithvi ek samaan gati ma bina jhatka ghumchha, ra hami, hawa ra ghar sabai sangai ghumchhau. chiplo bato ma ek samaan gati ma chaleko gadi bhitra jastai, gati badalindaina bhane hami mahasus gardainau.
sahar ma gaun ma jasto dherai tara kina dekhidainan?
sahar ka batti ko ujyalo le raati ko aakash ujyalo banaidinchha, jaslai prakash pradushan bhanchhan. dhamila tara tyo ujyalo ma harauchhan, tara andhyaro gaun ma tara dherai dekhinchhan.
jun bata aakash kasto dekhinchha?
jun bata diuso pani aakash kalo dekhinchha. jun ma hawa nabhayeko le ghaam ko prakash chharera aakash nilo banaune kehi hudaina.
grahan harek mahina kina lagdaina?
jun ko parikrama ko bato prithvi ko bato bhanda ali dhalkeko chha. tyasaile dherai jaso mahina ma jun surya ra prithvi ko thik sidha rekha ma pardaina, ra grahan barsha ma kehi patak matra lagchha.
supermoon bhaneko k ho?

jun ko parikrama ko bato thyakkai gol haina, kahile najik ra kahile tadha hunchha. jun prithvi ko najik bhaeko bela purnima pareko bhaye jun ali thulo ra ujyalo dekhinchha, tyaslai supermoon bhanchhan.
hamro surya aakash ganga ko kun bhag ma chha?
hamro surya aakash ganga ko bich ma haina, bich bata dherai tadha euta ghumne baahu (arm) ma chha. aakash ganga ma surya jasta arbau tara chhan.
prithvi thyakkai gol bal jasto ho?
thyakkai haina. prithvi ghumne bhayeko le bhumadhya rekha tira ali phuleko ra dhruva tira ali chepto chha. tara antariksha bata herda yo gol nai dekhinchha.
surya grahan ma jun le thulo surya lai kasari pura chhopna sakchha?

surya jun bhanda lagbhag 400 guna thulo chha, tara jun bhanda lagbhag 400 guna tadha pani chha. tyasaile aakash ma dubai lagbhag eutai aakar ka dekhinchhan ra jun le surya lai thyakkai chhopna sakchha.
graha ra tara lai aakash ma kasari chhuttyaune?
tara le aafnai prakash dinchhan ra dherai timtimaauchhan. graha le surya ko prakash farkauchhan, kam timtimaauchhan, ra kehi din herda tara haru ko bich ma sardai gaeko dekhinchhan.
dhruva ma 6 mahina din ra 6 mahina raat hunchha bhanchhan, sahi ho?
sahi ho, uttari ra dakshini dhruva ma lagbhag 6 mahina surya naastaune din ra 6 mahina surya naulaaune raat hunchha. prithvi ko aksha dhalkeko bhayeko le yesto hunchha.
bhumadhya rekha najik din ra raat kati lamo hunchha?
bhumadhya rekha najik barsha bhari din ra raat lagbhag barabar, 12-12 ghanta jati hunchha. tyaha ritu anusar din chhoto ra lamo hune farak dherai kam hunchha.
ghaam ghadi (sundial) le kasari samaya dekhauchha?
ghaam ghadi ma euta thado dandi ko chhaya ankit gareko gol patti ma parchha. surya aakash ma sardai jaanda chhaya pani ghumchha, ra chhaya pareko ank le samaya dekhauchha.
graha haru gol nai kina hunchhan?
thula graha ko aafnai gurutwakarshan le sabai bhag lai kendra tira tanchha. charai tira barabar tanda graha bistarai gol bal jasto aakar ma milchha.
antariksha yatri le bishesh luga (spacesuit) kina lagauchhan?
antariksha ma sas ferne hawa hudaina ra dherai chiso ra dherai taato dubai hunchha. spacesuit le sas ferne hawa, uchit chap ra tapkram dinchha ra charko kiran bata pani jogauchha.
jun bata prakash prithvi samma aauna kati samaya lagchha?
jun ko prakash prithvi samma aauna lagbhag 1 second bhanda ali badhi samaya lagchha. tara surya ko prakash aauna bhane 8 minet bhanda badhi lagchha, kinabhane surya dherai tadha chha.
hapta ka bar ko naam graha sanga kasari jodieka chhan?

aaitabar surya (aaditya), sombar chandrama (som), mangalbar mangal, budhabar budha, bihibar brihaspati, sukrabar shukra ra sanibar shani bata naam rakhieka hun. hapta ka 7 din ko naam purano samaya ma aakash ma dekhine yi 7 ota bata rakhieko ho.
sankranti bhaneko k ho?
surya aakash ma euta rashi bata arko rashi ma pasne din lai sankranti bhanchhan. nepali sauryamas ko mahina sankranti bata suru hunchha, jastai maghe sankranti magh ko pahilo din ho.
nepali mahina kunai 29 din ra kunai 32 din samma kina hunchhan?

bikram sambat ko mahina surya ek rashi bata arko rashi samma pugna lagne samaya ma adharit hunchhan. prithvi ko parikrama ko bato thyakkai gol nabhayeko le surya kahile chhito kahile dhilo sarchha, ra mahina ko lambai farak hunchha.
jun ko mahina kati din ko hunchha?
ek purnima dekhi arko purnima samma lagbhag 29.5 din lagchha. tithi ra chandra mahina yahi jun ko chakra ma adharit hunchhan.
prithvi ma matra jiwan bhayeko thaha chha, kina?

prithvi surya bata thik duri ma chha, jaha pani tarala rup ma rahan sakchha. yaha sas ferne hawa, ozone ko tah ra uchit tapkram chha; aru thau ma jiwan chha ki chhaina bhanera bigyan haru aile pani khojdai chhan.
Why can we sometimes see the moon in the daytime?
The moon is bright enough to be seen in a blue sky whenever it is above the horizon and not too close to the sun. It is up during the day for part of almost every month.
Why does the moon look bigger near the horizon?
It is an illusion; the moon is the same size in the sky all night. Near the horizon the brain compares it with trees and buildings, so it looks larger than when it is high and alone.
What are the dark patches on the moon?
The dark patches are huge plains of old, hardened lava. Long ago lava filled giant craters there, and this darker rock shows up against the lighter mountains around it.
Why is Mercury so hot by day and so cold at night?
Mercury has almost no air around it to act as a blanket. In sunlight its ground gets hot enough to melt lead, but the heat escapes into space at night and the surface becomes freezing cold.
What is the Great Red Spot on Jupiter?
The Great Red Spot is a giant storm on Jupiter that has been watched through telescopes for well over a hundred years. It is wider than the whole Earth.
Which planet spins on its side?
Uranus spins tipped over on its side, so its poles point almost toward the sun at times. Scientists think a huge collision long ago may have knocked it over.
What colour is the sun really?
The sun's light is really white, a mix of all colours. It looks yellow or orange from the ground because our air scatters away some of the blue light, especially when the sun is low.
What is a black hole?
A black hole is a place in space where so much matter is squeezed into a small space that its gravity is incredibly strong. Nothing that falls in, not even light, can get back out.
Which is the nearest large galaxy to ours?
The Andromeda Galaxy is the nearest large galaxy to our Milky Way. On a very dark night it can be seen without a telescope as a faint, fuzzy patch.
What is the Hubble Space Telescope?
Hubble is a large telescope that orbits the Earth above the air. Without the blurring of the atmosphere, it has taken very sharp pictures of planets, stars and distant galaxies since 1990.
Why don't people in Australia fall off the Earth?
Gravity pulls everything toward the centre of the Earth, not "down" in one direction. So people everywhere on the globe feel pulled toward the ground under their feet.
Why does the moon turn red during a total lunar eclipse?

During a total lunar eclipse, the Earth blocks direct sunlight from the moon. Some sunlight still bends through the Earth's atmosphere, and only the red part reaches the moon, giving it a coppery colour.
Is the moon moving away from the Earth?
Yes, very slowly. The moon moves about 3.8 centimetres farther from the Earth every year, roughly as fast as our fingernails grow.
Why is the inside of the Earth hot?
Some heat is left over from when the Earth formed, and more is made by radioactive elements slowly breaking down deep inside. That is why mines get hotter the deeper they go.
How do fish survive when a lake freezes?
Ice is lighter than water, so it forms a layer on top, and the water underneath stays above freezing. Fish keep living in that water below the ice through the winter.
Where is most of the world's fresh water?
Most of the world's fresh water is frozen in the ice sheets of Antarctica and Greenland and in glaciers. Only a small part is in lakes, rivers and underground.
Would I weigh less on Mars?
Yes. Mars has weaker gravity than the Earth, so you would weigh only a little more than a third of your Earth weight there, though your body would have the same amount of matter.
Why do planets keep going around the sun?
Each planet is moving fast sideways, while the sun's gravity keeps pulling it inward. The two together bend its path into a loop around the sun instead of letting it fly off or fall in.
What are sunspots?
Sunspots are darker patches on the sun that are cooler than the area around them. They come and go in a cycle of about 11 years; never look at the sun directly to see them.
What is a constellation?
A constellation is a group of stars that people long ago joined into a picture, such as a hunter or a bear. The stars in it may be very far apart in space but look close together from Earth.
What is a meteor shower?
A meteor shower happens when the Earth passes through a trail of dust left by a comet. Many tiny bits burn up in the air at the same time of year, and we see many shooting stars in one night.
What is the biggest volcano in the solar system?
Olympus Mons on Mars is the biggest known volcano in the solar system. It is roughly two and a half times as tall as Mount Everest is above sea level.
Is Everest the tallest mountain from base to top?
Everest is the highest above sea level, but Mauna Kea in Hawaii is taller if measured from its base on the ocean floor. Most of Mauna Kea is hidden under the sea.
How do diamonds form?
Diamonds form from carbon squeezed under enormous heat and pressure deep inside the Earth. Volcanic eruptions long ago carried some of them up near the surface, where they are mined.
How is glass made?
Glass is made by melting sand, which is mostly silica, together with soda ash and limestone in a very hot furnace. The hot liquid is shaped and then cooled quickly into clear glass.
Where does our cooking salt come from?
Salt comes either from sea water that is dried in shallow pools in the sun or from layers of rock salt mined underground. The rock salt layers are what is left of ancient seas that dried up.
What is sand made of?
Most sand is tiny pieces of rock, often the hard mineral quartz, broken off by water, wind and ice. Some white beach sand is made of crushed shells and coral.
koila (coal) kasari baneko ho?
karodau barsha aghi daldal ka ban ka rukh ra biruwa mare ra mato muni puriye. mathi bata thichai ra jamin bhitra ko garmi le lamo samaya ma tiniharu kalo kada koila ma badalie.
cement k bata banchha?
cement mukhya rup ma chuna dhunga (limestone) ra mato lai dherai taato bhatti ma polera banchha. polepachhi baneko dalla lai masino pisera cement ko dhulo tayar hunchha.
itta kasari banchha?
itta chikni mato lai saancho ma halera aakar dinchha, ghaam ma sukaunchha ani bhatta ma dherai taato aago ma polinchha. polda mato kada ra rato hunchha.
pahile himali gaun ma nun kaha bata aauthyo?
pahile himali kshetra ka manchhe tibbat ka nunila tal bata aaune nun lyauthe. uniharu nun ra un ko badla ma pahad bata lageko chamal ra anna satne gardathe.
rashi bhaneko aakash ma k ho?
barsha bhari surya aakash ma tara haru ko bich bata euta nischit bato ma sareko dekhinchha. tyo bato ma parne 12 tara-mandal lai rashi bhanchhan, jastai mesh, brish, mithun.
andhyaro gaun ma raati aakash ma seto dhuwa jasto patta dekhinchha, tyo ke ho?
tyo hamro aakash ganga (milky way) ho. dherai tadha ka arbau tara ko dhamilo ujyalo milera aakash bhari seto patta jasto dekhinchha.
tal kasari banchhan?

tal dherai tarika le banchhan: himnadi le khaneko khaldo ma pani jamda, pahiro le nadi thunda, ra jamin bhaskiera khaldo parda. kati thau ma manchhe le baandh banaera pani rokda jalashaya banchha, jastai kulekhani.
kuwa ko pani garmi ma chiso ra jado ma nyano kina lagchha?
jamin muni ko pani ko tapkram barsha bhari lagbhag eutai rahanchha. garmi ma bahira ko hawa taato bhayeko le tyo pani chiso lagchha, ra jado ma bahira chiso bhayeko le nyano lagchha.
asoj-kartik ma aakash kina safa ra nilo hunchha?
monsoon ko pani le hawa ko dhulo ra dhuwa pakhalera lagchha, ra barsha sakiepachhi hawa sukkha ra safa hunchha. tyasaile asoj-kartik ma himal ra aakash sabai bhanda spashta dekhinchhan.
chaitra-baisakh ma himal kina dhamilo dekhinchha?
sukkha mausam ma hawa ma dhulo, ban dadelo ko dhuwa ra pradushan jammaa hunchha, ra pani napareko le safa hudaina. yo dhuwalo le tadha ko himal dhamilo dekhinchha.
mausam purvanuman ma "70% pani parne sambhawana" bhaneko k ho?
yasko arth yasto mausam bhaeko 10 din madhye lagbhag 7 din ma tyo thau ma pani parchha bhanne ho. din ko 70% samaya pani parchha bhaneko haina.
bihana ra saanjh ko ghaam diuso ko jasto charko kina hudaina?
bihana-saanjh surya tala hunchha ra kiran jamin ma tersho parchhan. tersho kiran thulo thau ma phailinchha ra hawa ko lamo bato hudai aaunu parchha, tyasaile kam taato hunchha.
kun kun graha khali aankha le dekhna sakinchha?
budha, shukra, mangal, brihaspati ra shani khali aankha le dekhna sakinchha. tiniharu chamkilo tara jasta dekhinchhan, tara kam timtimaauchhan.
jun bata herda prithvi pani ghatne-badhne dekhinchha?
dekhinchha. hamilai purnima hunda jun bata prithvi ko andhyaro bhag matra dekhinchha, ra hamilai aunsi hunda jun bata prithvi pura ujyalo dekhinchha.
jun bata herda prithvi ulaaune-astaaune hunchha?
jun ko hamitira farkeko bhag bata herda prithvi aakash ma lagbhag eutai thau ma adiyeko dekhinchha. jun le sadhai eutai bhag prithvi tira farkaune bhayeko le yesto hunchha.
manchhe le banaeko pahilo satellite kun ho?
manchhe le banaeko pahilo satellite sputnik 1 ho, jun 1957 ma soviet sangh le antariksha ma pathaeko thiyo. yo saano dhatu ko bal jasto thiyo ra radio sanket pathauthyo.
saanjh aakash ma bistarai sarne chamkilo batti dekhinchha, tyo ke ho?
dherai jaso tyo satellite ho. surya astaepachhi pani mathi ko satellite ma ghaam parchha ra tyo prakash farkera bistarai sarne tara jasto dekhinchha; timtimaaune rato batti bhaye hawaijahaj hunchha.
prithvi surya ko waripari kati chhito ghumchha?
prithvi surya ko waripari lagbhag 30 kilometer prati second ko gati ma ghumchha. yati chhito bhae pani gati ek samaan bhayeko le hami thaha paudainau.
kunai mato rato ra kunai kalo kina hunchha?
rato mato ma falam ko khiya jasto padartha (iron oxide) badhi hunchha. kalo mato ma kuhieka paat ra jiw ko mal (humus) badhi hunchha, jun prayah urbar hunchha.
baluwa ra dhunga ma chamkine saana patra jasta kan k hun?
ti dherai jaso abhrak (mica) ka kan hun. abhrak patalo patra patra ma chhutine chamkilo khanij ho, jun ghaam ma tiltilaauchha.
falam kaha bata paainchha?
falam jamin ma shuddha rup ma bhetidaina; yo falam ko matra dherai bhayeko dhunga (iron ore) ma milieko hunchha. tyo dhunga lai dherai taato bhatti ma pagaalera falam chhuttyainchha.
himal herna bihanai kina jaanu bhanchhan?
bihana hawa shanta ra chiso hune bhayeko le aakash prayah safa hunchha. diuso ghaam le tateko jamin bata baph mathi uthera badal banchha ra himal dhakinchha.
himal ko khola diuso pachhi kina thulo hunchha?

diuso ghaam le hiu ra himnadi paglauchha, ra tyo pani bagera khola samma pugna kehi ghanta lagchha. tyasaile hiu bata aaune khola bihana saano ra diuso pachhi thulo hunchha; tarna parne khola bihanai tarnu ramro.
compass nabhae disha kasari thaha paaune?
surya purba tira ulaauchha ra pashchim tira astaauchha. nepal ma diuso ghaam dakshin tira hunchha, ra raati dhruva tara le uttar disha dekhauchha.
bhukampa ma nadhalne ghar kasto hunchha?

bhukampa pratirodhi ghar ma jag, khamba ra dalin (beam) lai dandi le ek aapas ma baliyo gari jodieko hunchha. halka chhana ra niyam anusar ko banot le garda hallinda pani ghar sajilai dhaldaina; banauna engineer ko salah linus.
himnadi le baneko upatyaka ra nadi le baneko upatyaka ma k farak?
nadi le khaneko upatyaka "V" aakar ko gahiro ra sankhuro hunchha. himnadi le ghotdai baneko upatyaka "U" aakar ko chaudaa ra pindh samtal hunchha.
marubhumi ma diuso dherai garmi tara raati kina chiso hunchha?
marubhumi ko hawa sukkha ra aakash safa hunchha. hawa ma baph ra badal nabhayeko le diuso ko taap raati chhitai aakash tira udchha ra jamin chiso hunchha.
pani parepachhi hawa kina safa lagchha?
pani ka thopa le hawa ma udiraheka dhulo, dhuwa ra kan lai sangai lagera jamin ma jharaidinchhan. tyasaile pani parepachhi hawa safa ra tadha samma spashta dekhinchha.
airport ma rangin kapada ko thaili (wind sock) kina jhundyaunchhan?
wind sock le hawa kun disha bata ra kati jod le chaliraheko chha bhanera dekhauchha. pilot le yo herera hawaijahaj utarne ra udne disha milauchhan.
nepal bhumadhya rekha bhanda uttar ma chha ki dakshin ma?
nepal bhumadhya rekha bhanda uttar ma chha, lagbhag 26 dekhi 30 degree uttari akshansh ko bich. tyasaile nepal uttari golardha ma parchha.
kark rekha (tropic of cancer) nepal bata bhaera jaanchha?
jadaina. kark rekha nepal bhanda dakshin, bharat ra bangladesh hudai jaanchha. tyasaile nepal ma surya kahilyai thik tauko mathi pugdaina.
surya ulaaunu bhanda aghi nai aakash ujyalo kina hunchha?
surya chhitij muni hunda pani tyasko prakash mathi ko hawa ma pugera chharinchha. tyo chhareko prakash le surya ulaaunu aghi ra astaepachhi kehi ber aakash ujyalo rakhchha.
nadi bata dherai gitti ra baluwa jhikda k hunchha?
dherai gitti-baluwa jhikda nadi ko pindh gahiro hundai jaanchha ra kinar bhatkinchha. pul ko jag ra kheti ko jamin khatara ma parchhan, tyasaile kanun le tokeko thau ra matra ma matra jhiknu parchha.
hawa nabhayeko thau ma pwankh ra hathauda sangai khasaye kun pahila jamin ma pugchha?
dubai sangai pugchhan. hawa ko rokawat nabhae gurutwakarshan le sabai chij lai eutai gati le tanchha; jun ma antariksha yatri le yo prayog garera dekhaeka thie.
parachute le manchhe lai bistarai kasari orlauchha?
parachute khulda thulo chhata jastai bhaera dherai hawa thunchha. hawa ko rokawat le khasne gati dherai ghataidinchha, ra manchhe bistarai jamin ma orlinchha.
dherai mathi bata khaseko pani ko thopa le kina chot lagdaina?
khasdai jaanda hawa ko rokawat badhdai jaanchha, ra ek samaya pachhi thopa ko gati badhna rokinchha. saano ra halka thopa ko yo antim gati kam hune bhayeko le hamilai chot lagdaina.
hawa bhareko bal kina uphrinchha tara hawa nikaleko bal kina uphrindaina?
bal bhui ma thokkinda bhitra ko hawa thichinchha ra spring jastai pheri dhakelera bal lai mathi pathauchha. hawa kam bhaeko bal thokkinda chepto hunchha ra urja dherai taap ma kharcha hunchha.
pith ma doko bokda manchhe agadi kina jhukchha?
pith ma bhaar rakhda sharir ra bhaar ko santulan bindu (centre of gravity) pachhadi sarchha. agadi jhukda tyo bindu pheri khutta mathi aauchha ra manchhe pachhadi dhalkindaina.
lattu ghumirahanda kina dhaldaina?
chhito ghumne chij le aafno ghumne aksha lai eutai disha ma rakhna khojchha. lattu ko gati ghatdai jaanda yo shakti kam hunchha ra lattu ghaldai dhalchha.
bus ghumti ma modinda hami bahira tira kina dhalkinchhau?
hamro sharir sidha agadi gai rahana khojchha, tara bus ghumchha. tyasaile bus le ghumaunda hami ghumti ko bahiri tira dhalkeko jasto mahasus garchhau.
bhari ko truck rokna saano car bhanda kina garo hunchha?
gahrungo ra chhito chaliraheko chij ma dherai gati-urja (momentum) hunchha. truck ko bhaar dherai bhayeko le eutai gati ma pani rokna dherai bal ra lamo duri chahinchha.
dhoka ko hyandal kabja bata tadha kina rakhinchha?
kabja bata jati tadha bal lagayo, dhoka ghumauna tyati kam bal chahinchha. tyasaile hyandal dhoka ko arko chheu ma rakhinchha; kabja najik dhakelda dhoka kholna dherai garo hunchha.
pechkas (screwdriver) ko hyandal kina moto hunchha?
moto hyandal ghumauda haat le thulo ghero ghumauchha ra tuppa ma dherai ghumaune bal pugchha. yo wheel and axle bhanne saral yantra ko udaharan ho.
pahad ko sadak ghumti ghumti gari kina banainchha?

sidha ukalo bhanda ghumti bhayeko lamo bato kam bhiralo hunchha. bato lamo bhae pani gadi lai chadhna kam bal chahinchha ra brake pani surakshit hunchha; yo bhiralo satah (inclined plane) ko siddhanta ho.
hilo khet ma chalne tractor ko pangra kina chaudaa hunchha?
chaudaa pangra le tractor ko bhaar dherai thau ma baadchha, tyasaile ek thau ma pareko chap kam hunchha. yasle pangra hilo ma kam dhasinchha.
baandh (dam) ko bhitta tala moto ra mathi patalo kina hunchha?
pani ko chap gahirai jaanda badhdai jaanchha. baandh ko tallo bhag ma sabai bhanda dherai chap parne bhayeko le tyaha bhitta moto banainchha.
pipe le tanki bata pani kasari aafai bahira nikalinchha?
pipe lai pura pani le bharera ek chheu tanki ma ra arko chheu tanki ko pani bhanda tala rakhda pani aafai bagchha. yaslai siphon bhanchhan; bahiri chheu jati tala hunchha, pani tyati chhito bagchha.
straw le juice kasari mukh samma aauchha?
straw bata chusda straw bhitra ko hawa kam hunchha. gilas ko juice mathi thichne bahira ko hawa ko chap le juice lai straw bata mathi dhakelchha.
bhitta ma tasaune rubber ko hook kasari tasinchha?
hook thichda bhitra ko hawa bahira niskinchha. bahira ko hawa ko chap le rubber lai bhitta ma thichirakhchha, tyasaile hook tasieko rahanchha.
pani bhitra huda hami halka kina mahasus garchhau?
pani le hamro sharir lai tala bata mathi dhakelchha, jaslai utplavan bal (buoyancy) bhanchhan. yo bal le hamro bhaar ko thulo bhag bokidinchha, tyasaile pani ma hami halka mahasus garchhau.
bakla kaanch ko gilas ma ekdam taato pani halda kina chirinchha?
taato pani parne bhitri bhag chhitai tatera phailinchha, tara bahiri bhag ali chiso nai rahanchha. dui bhag farak gati ma phailanda kaanch ma tanab parchha ra chirinchha.
tel chhitai tatchha tara pani tataun kina dherai samaya lagchha?
pani lai tataun dherai taap chahinchha; pani le taap dherai sosna sakchha. tyasaile eutai aago ma tel bhanda pani lai tatna dherai samaya lagchha, ra tateko pani pani bistarai chiso hunchha.
umleko pani mathi dekhine seto dhuwa sachchai baph ho?
sachcho baph dekhidaina. bhaada bata niskeko baph chiso hawa ma pugda saana saana pani ka thopa ma badalinchha, ra hamle dekhne seto dhuwa tinai thopa hun.
bhaada ma birko (dhakkan) lagaera pakauda kina chhito pakchha?
birko le bhaada ko taap ra baph bhitrai rokchha. tyasaile kam aago ma pani khana chhitai tatchha ra gyas tatha daura bachchha.
pani ma nun halda pani chhito umlinchha?
haina, nun halda pani ko umalne tapkram thorai badhchha, chhito umlidaina. hamle halne thorai nun le asar dherai kam parchha; nun swad ko lagi matra ho.
Why do we feel heavier for a moment when a lift starts going up?
To make us speed up upward, the floor of the lift has to push on our feet harder than usual. We feel that extra push as being heavier until the lift moves at a steady speed.
What is the centre of gravity?

The centre of gravity is the point where an object's weight seems to act, as if all of it were gathered there. An object stays balanced when this point is over its base, which is why a wide base makes things harder to tip over.
Why do we lean when we ride a bicycle around a corner?
To turn, the bicycle needs a sideways push toward the inside of the curve. Leaning lets the tyres push against the road in that direction and stops us from falling outward.
Why do ears hurt when we dive deep in a pool?
Water pressure gets stronger the deeper we go. It presses on the eardrum from outside, and until the air pressure inside the ear catches up, it hurts.
Why do cars skid more on wet roads?
A thin layer of water between the tyre and the road reduces grip. Tyre grooves push the water out of the way, which is why worn, smooth tyres are dangerous in the rain.
Why does a ball stop rolling on grass sooner than on a cement floor?
Grass rubs against the ball and bends under it much more than smooth cement does. That extra friction takes away the ball's energy faster, so it stops sooner.
Why are ships built heavy at the bottom?
Keeping heavy parts and cargo low puts the ship's centre of gravity low. Then when waves tilt the ship, its weight pulls it back upright instead of rolling it over.
Why is it hard to walk on dry sand?
Dry sand moves and slides under our feet, so each step sinks and pushes the sand away instead of pushing us forward. We use a lot more effort for every step.
Why do heavy loads on a bicycle make it hard to balance?
A heavy load placed high or to one side moves the centre of gravity, so small tilts quickly become big ones. Keeping heavy things low and in the middle makes the bicycle easier to balance.
Why do athletes bend their knees when they land after a jump?
Bending the knees makes the landing last a little longer. Stopping more slowly means a smaller force on the legs, which protects the bones and joints.
Why is it easier to push a cart than to drag a box of the same weight?
Wheels roll instead of rubbing along the ground, so there is much less friction. That is why the wheel was one of the most useful inventions.
Why does a swing go higher when you pump your legs?
Pumping at the right moment in each swing adds a little energy every time, just as well-timed pushes from a friend do. Small pushes at the right rhythm build up into big swings.
Why do tightrope walkers carry a long pole?
A long pole spreads weight far out on both sides, so the walker tips over much more slowly. That gives time to correct small wobbles, and moving the pole helps shift balance back.
hami kunai chij kasari dekhchhau?
ghaam ya batti ko prakash chij ma thokkiera farkanchha ra hamro aankha ma paschha. andhyaro ma prakash nai nabhae chij bata farkane prakash hudaina, tyasaile kehi dekhidaina.
aaina ma debre haat uthauda chhabi le daahine haat uthaeko jasto kina dekhinchha?
aaina le debre-daahine ulto gardaina, agadi-pachhadi ulto garchha. hamro agadi farkeko chhabi banne bhayeko le hamle tyaslai arko manchhe jastai sochda debre-daahine ulto bhaeko jasto lagchha.
pahadi sadak ko ghumti ma gol aaina kina rakhinchha?
tyo bahira tira phuleko (convex) aaina ho, jasle sadharan aaina bhanda dherai chaudaa drishya dekhauchha. ghumti ko arko tira bata aaune gadi chalak le aghi nai dekhna sakchhan.
torch ko bulb pachhadi chamkilo khaldo aaina kina hunchha?
tyo bhitra tira khaldo (concave) aaina ho. bulb bata pachhadi ra chheu tira jane prakash lai yasle agadi tira sojho pharkaera ujyalo ko dhar banauchha.
magnifying glass le ghaam ma kagaj kasari jalauchha?

magnifying glass le dherai thau ma pareko ghaam ko prakash lai eutai saano thopla ma jammaa garchha. tyo thopla dherai taato bhaera kagaj jalna sakchha, tyasaile yasle khelda hoshiyar hunus ra aankha le ghaam tira nahernus.
rato sharta rato kina dekhinchha?
seto prakash ma sabai rang hunchhan. rato sharta le aru rang soschha ra rato rang matra farkauchha, tyasaile hamro aankha ma rato prakash matra pugchha.
phone ko screen ma sabai rang kasari banchhan?
phone ko screen ma dherai saana thopla (pixel) hunchhan, ra harek ma rato, hariyo ra nilo batti hunchhan. yi tin rang ko ujyalo kam-badhi milaera screen le dherai rang banauchha.
saano pwal bata kotha bhitra pareko bahira ko drishya ulto kina dekhinchha?

prakash sidha rekha ma yatra garchha. mathi bata aaune prakash pwal bata tala tira ra tala bata aaune mathi tira janda bhitta ma bahira ko drishya ulto banchha; pinhole camera yasari nai kaam garchha.
sarangi ya guitar ko taar kasda aawaj kina masino hunchha?
taar kasda ya chhoto parda taar chhito kaampchha, ra chhito kaampne taar le masino (uchcha sur) aawaj nikalchha. moto ra khukulo taar bistarai kaampchha ra moto aawaj dinchha.
madal jod le bajauda aawaj kina thulo hunchha?
jod le handa madal ko chhala dherai thulo gari kaampchha ra hawa lai jod le dhakelchha. thulo kampan le thulo aawaj banchha, tara sur bhane uhi rahanchha.
raati aawaj diuso bhanda tadha samma kina sunninchha?
raati jamin najik ko hawa chiso ra mathi ko hawa ali nyano hune garchha. yasto bela aawaj mathi jaana nasaki tala bangiera farkanchha, ra raati ko shanti le pani tadha ko aawaj sunna sajilo hunchha.
khali kotha ma bolda aawaj kina gunjinchha?
khali kotha ko kada bhitta ra bhui le aawaj lai pheri pheri farkauchhan. kapada, gadda ra furniture bhaeko kotha ma naram chij le aawaj soschhan, tyasaile gunjan kam hunchha.
siti (whistle) phukda aawaj kasari niskinchha?
siti ko sankhuro pwal bata hawa jod le jaanda hawa ko dhar kaampchha ra siti bhitra ko hawa lai pani kampauchha. tyo kampan nai hamle sunne masino aawaj ho.
ambulance najik aauda siren ko aawaj masino ra tadha jaanda moto kina sunninchha?

najik aaudai gareko ambulance ko aawaj ka lahar hamro kaan samma thichiera chhito chhito aauchhan, tyasaile sur masino sunninchha. tadha jaanda lahar phailiera aauchhan ra sur moto sunninchha; yaslai doppler prabhav bhanchhan.
bijuli ko thula taar ma dherai uchcha voltage kina pathaunchhan?
uchcha voltage ma eutai urja pathauna kam current chahinchha. kam current le taar kam tatchha ra tadha samma pathauda bijuli kam khera jaanchha.
transformer le k kaam garchha?

transformer le bijuli ko voltage badhaune ya ghataune kaam garchha. power house bata uchcha voltage ma pathaeko bijuli lai gaun-sahar najik transformer le ghatayera ghar ma prayog garna milne banauchha.
hawa le bijuli kasari banauchha?
hawa le wind turbine ka thula pankha ghumauchha. pankha sanga jodieko generator ghumda bijuli banchha.
urja ka kun kun rup hunchhan?
urja dherai rup ma hunchha: gati ko urja, uchai ma rakheko chij ko urja, taap, prakash, aawaj, bijuli ra khana tatha indhan bhitra ko rasaayanik urja. urja ek rup bata arko rup ma badalinchha.
short circuit bhaneko k ho ra kina khatarnak chha?

bijuli ko taar ka dui bhag bich ko insulation bigrera sidhai chhoyo bhane current le chhoto bato paauchha, jaslai short circuit bhanchhan. dherai current bagda taar dherai tatchha ra aago lagna sakchha; tyasaile purana ra futeka taar phernu parchha.
Why do diamonds sparkle so much?
A cut diamond bends light strongly and bounces it around inside many times before it comes back out. The light also splits into colours, so the stone flashes with bright sparkles as it moves.
What is an optical fibre?
An optical fibre is a glass thread thinner than a hair that carries light. The light bounces along inside it without escaping, so fibres can carry internet data over long distances very fast.
Why do we hear the sea when we hold a shell to our ear?
It is not the sea. The shell catches the quiet sounds around us and makes some of them louder as they echo inside it, which sounds like waves.
How does a periscope work?
A periscope is a tube with two mirrors set at an angle, one at each end. Light enters the top, bounces off both mirrors, and comes out at the bottom, so you can see over a wall.
How do some sunglasses cut glare from water and roads?
Light reflected from water or a wet road is mostly lined up in one direction. Polarised sunglasses have a special filter that blocks light lined up that way, so the glare disappears.
How does a kaleidoscope make patterns?

A kaleidoscope has two or three long mirrors inside, set at angles, with coloured beads at the end. The mirrors reflect the beads again and again, making a repeating pattern that changes when you turn it.
Why do we see rainbow colours in a drop of oil on a wet road?

The thin oil layer reflects light from both its top and bottom surfaces. These reflections mix in a way that makes some colours stronger and others weaker, depending on the thickness, so bands of colour appear.
Why can we hear someone around a corner but not see them?
Sound waves are much longer than light waves, so they bend around corners and doorways easily. Light mostly travels in straight lines, so the wall blocks the view.
How does a microphone work?
Sound makes a thin part inside the microphone vibrate. The microphone turns these vibrations into a changing electric signal that can be recorded or made louder.
How does a loudspeaker make sound?
A loudspeaker gets an electric signal that makes a magnet and coil push a cone back and forth. The moving cone pushes the air, and those air waves reach our ears as sound.
What is infrared light?
Infrared is light our eyes cannot see, just beyond red. We feel it as heat from a fire or the sun, and TV remotes use it to send signals.
What is ultraviolet light?
Ultraviolet light is invisible light just beyond violet. The sun gives off a lot of it, and it causes sunburn and tanning, which is why sunscreen and hats help at high altitude.
Can we cool a room by leaving the fridge door open?
No. A fridge moves heat from inside to the coils at the back, and its motor adds more heat. With the door open, the room actually gets a little warmer.
bhautik parivartan ra rasaayanik parivartan ma k farak?

barf paglanu jasto bhautik parivartan ma padartha ko rup matra badalinchha ra pheri pahile jastai banauna sakinchha. kagaj jalnu jasto rasaayanik parivartan ma naya padartha (kharani, dhuwa) banchha ra pheri kagaj banaauna sakindaina.
rasaayanik parivartan bhayo bhanera kasari thaha paaune?
naya gyas ka bulbula niskanu, rang badalinu, taap ya prakash niskanu, ra naya gandha aaunu rasaayanik parivartan ka sanket hun. jastai dudh bigrida amilo gandha aaunu.
dhamilo pani kapada le chhanda k hunchha?
kapada ko masina pwal bata pani niskinchha tara mato ra fohor ka thula kan adkinchhan. yaslai chhanne (filtration) bhanchhan, tara yasle kitanu hataundaina, tyasaile piuna agadi umalnu parchha.
gagri ma dhamilo pani kehi ber rakhda kina safa hunchha?
shanta rakhda pani bhanda gahrungo mato ra baluwa bistarai pindh ma baschhan. mathi ko safa pani bistarai arko bhaada ma khanyaune lai thigraune (decanting) bhanchhan.
pitho chalni le chalda k chhuttinchha?
chalni ko pwal bata masino pitho tala jharchha ra pwal bhanda thula chokar (bran) ra dhulo mathi rahanchhan. aakar farak bhayeko kan chhuttyaune yo tarika lai sieving bhanchhan.
baluwa ma milieko falam ko dhulo kasari chhuttyaune?
chumbak le baluwa mathi ghumaunda falam ko dhulo chumbak ma tasinchha ra baluwa chhuttinchha. chumbak le baluwa lai tandaina.
nun-pani ma solute kun ho ra solvent kun ho?
nun-pani ma ghulne padartha nun ho, jaslai solute bhanchhan, ra ghulaune pani solvent ho. dubai milera baneko lai ghol (solution) bhanchhan.
pani ma nun halda halda ek samaya pachhi kina ghuldaina?
euta tapkram ma pani le ek nischit matra samma matra nun ghulauna sakchha. tyo bhanda badhi nun haleko bhae pindh ma baschha; yasto ghol lai santripta (saturated) ghol bhanchhan.
litmus kagaj le amla ra kshar kasari chhuttyauchha?
amla le nilo litmus kagaj lai rato banauchha. kshar le rato litmus kagaj lai nilo banauchha, ra shuddha pani le kunai rang badaldaina.
saabun le dhoda besar ko pahelo daag kina rato hunchha?
besar ma bhayeko rang kshar (base) ko samparka ma aauda rato-khairo hunchha, ra saabun kshar ho. tyasaile besar lai prakritik suchak (indicator) bhanna sakinchha.
kamila le tokda kina polchha?
kamila ko tokai ma formic acid bhanne amla hunchha. tyo chhala ma pasda polne ra chilaune hunchha.
dahi kina amilo hunchha?
dudh ma bhayeko jiwanu le dudh ko guliyo lai lactic acid ma badalchhan. yahi amla le dahi lai amilo swad dinchha ra dudh lai gadha banauchha.
hamle prayog garne kshar (base) haru kun kun hun?
saabun, khane soda (baking soda) ra chuna kshar ka udaharan hun. kshar chhuda chiplo lagchha ra swad tito hunchha, tara kunai pani rasaayan chakhnu hudaina.
amla ra kshar milda k hunchha?
amla ra kshar milda ek arka ko gun ghatchha, jaslai neutralization bhanchhan. yasbata prayah nun jasto padartha ra pani banchha.
bhitta ma chuna potepachhi kina seto ra kada hunchha?
pani ma ghuleko chuna potepachhi hawa ko carbon dioxide sanga milera seto kada chalk jasto padartha banchha. tyasaile chuna sukepachhi bhitta chamkilo seto dekhinchha.
steel ra falam ma k farak?
steel falam ma thorai carbon milayera baneko mishra dhatu (alloy) ho. yo sadharan falam bhanda dherai baliyo hunchha, tyasaile pul, gadi ra bhaada banauna prayog hunchha.
jasta pata ma kina khiya chhitai lagdaina?
jasta pata falam ko pata mathi jasta (zinc) ko tah lagaera banainchha. jasta le falam lai pani ra hawa bata jogauchha, tyasaile khiya dherai dhilo lagchha.
samudra najik falam ko saman kina chhitai khiyainchha?
samudra ko hawa ma nun ko masino kan ra osilopan dherai hunchha. nun le falam ma khiya lagne prakriya lai chhito banauchha.
tihar ko aatishbaji ma rangin aago kasari banchha?

aatishbaji ma farak farak dhatu ka nun milaieko hunchha. jalda harek dhatu le aafnai rang dinchha: sodium le pahelo, tama le hariyo-nilo ra strontium le rato; aatishbaji balda tadha basnus ra bachcha lai eklai nadinus.
gas chulo ko aago nilo ra daura ko aago pahelo kina hunchha?
gas lai prashasta oxygen pugda pura jalchha ra nilo aago dinchha. daura ya oxygen kam pugeko aago ma najaleka carbon ka kan taato bhaera pahelo chamkinchhan ra kalo kalikh (soot) banauchhan.
anda pakauda paardarshi bhag kina seto ra kada hunchha?
anda ko seto bhag ma protein hunchha. tatauda protein ka anu ko banot badalinchha ra ek aapas ma jodinchhan, tyasaile paardarshi tarala seto ra kada hunchha; yo pheri pahile jasto bandaina.
garmi ma pokhari ka machha satah ma aaera kina mukh baunchhan?
taato pani ma chiso pani bhanda kam oxygen ghulna sakchha. garmi ma pokhari ko pani ma oxygen ghatda machha sas ferna satah tira aauchhan.
kettle bhitra seto tah kina jamchha?

kehi pani ma chuna jasta khanij ghuleka hunchhan, jaslai khara pani (hard water) bhanchhan. umalda pani udchha ra khanij seto tah ko rup ma kettle ma jamchhan; yasto pani ma saabun ko fij pani kam aauchha.
nun ra baluwa milieko chha bhane kasari chhuttyaune?
pahile pani halnus, nun ghulchha tara baluwa ghuldaina. kapada le chhanda baluwa chhuttinchha, ani nun-pani lai tatayera pani udaunda nun matra baki rahanchha.
nariwal ko tel ra ghiu jado ma kina jamchha tara tori ko tel jamdaina?
ghiu ra nariwal tel ko anu ko banot farak hunchha, tyasaile yi ali nyano tapkram mai jamna thalchhan ra jado ma seto kada hunchhan. tori ko tel dherai chiso nabhae samma tarala nai rahanchha.
kalo chiya ma kagati nichoda rang kina halka hunchha?
chiya ma bhayeko rang dine padartha amla (acid) ko samparka ma badalinchhan. kagati ko amla le tiniharu ko banot badalda chiya ko rang halka ra rato-sunaulo hunchha.
pakauda ko ghol ma khane soda kina halchhan?
khane soda tatda ya amilo kura sanga milda carbon dioxide gyas ka bulbula banchhan. ti bulbula ghol bhitra thunninda pakauda phuleko ra halka hunchha.
24 carat ra 22 carat sun ma k farak?
24 carat bhaneko lagbhag shuddha sun ho, jun dherai naram hunchha. 22 carat sun ma thorai aru dhatu milaieko hunchha, jasle gahana baliyo hunchha ra sajilai bangidaina.
pital ra tama ko bhaada ma kalai kina garinchha?
amilo ra nunilo khana tama sanga pratikriya garera bishalu padartha banauna sakchha. bhaada bhitra ranga (tin) ko patalo tah lagaune kaam lai kalai bhanchhan, jasle khana ra tama lai chhuna dinna.
What acid is in vinegar?
Vinegar contains acetic acid, which gives it its sour taste and sharp smell. It is made when bacteria turn the alcohol in fruit juice or grain mash into acid.
How can red cabbage show if something is an acid?
The purple juice from boiled red cabbage changes colour with acids and bases. It turns pink or red with lemon juice and vinegar, and green or yellow with soap or baking soda.
Why does stainless steel not rust easily?
Stainless steel has chromium mixed in with the iron. The chromium forms a very thin, invisible layer on the surface that stops air and water from reaching the iron.
Why do old copper roofs and statues turn green?
Over many years, copper reacts slowly with air and rain and forms a thin green coating. This coating protects the copper underneath from further damage.
Why doesn't aluminium rust like iron?
Aluminium reacts with air very quickly, but it forms a thin, tough layer on its surface that seals it. Iron rust is flaky and falls off, so it lets the damage keep going deeper.
How does a match light when we strike it?
Rubbing the match head on the rough strip of the box makes heat by friction. That heat sets off chemicals in the strip and the head, which catch fire and then light the wooden stick.
Why is the symbol for iron Fe?
Fe comes from "ferrum", the Latin word for iron. Several other symbols also come from Latin, such as Au for gold, Ag for silver, Cu for copper and Pb for lead.
Why do neon signs glow?
A neon sign is a glass tube filled with a little neon gas. When electricity passes through it, the gas glows with a bright orange-red light; other gases give other colours.
What is dry ice?
Dry ice is frozen carbon dioxide. It is so cold that it turns straight from a solid into a gas without becoming a liquid, making a white fog; it must never be touched with bare hands.
Why does toast turn brown?
Heat makes the sugars and proteins in bread react with each other. This reaction creates the brown colour and the tasty toasted smell, and too much heat turns it black.
Why do fizzy drinks bubble when we open the bottle?
Carbon dioxide gas is forced into the drink under pressure when it is bottled. Opening the cap releases the pressure, so the gas comes out of the drink as bubbles.
What is distillation?
Distillation is boiling a liquid, catching the steam and cooling it back into a liquid somewhere else. Salt and other dissolved things are left behind, so distilled water is very pure.
What are plastics made from?
Most plastics are made from chemicals that come from crude oil and natural gas. They are made of very long chain-like molecules, which is why they are strong and take a very long time to break down.
Why are synthetic clothes risky near a fire?
Fabrics like polyester and nylon melt when they get hot and can stick to the skin, causing bad burns. Cotton and wool do not melt, so they are safer to wear while cooking over an open flame.
pani ma tairine hiu ko pahad (iceberg) ko kati bhag pani muni hunchha?

hiu ko pahad ko dherai thulo bhag, lagbhag 90 pratishat, pani muni lukeko hunchha ra thorai matra mathi dekhinchha. tyasaile "hiu ko pahad ko tuppa matra" bhanne bhanai thorai matra dekheko kura ko lagi prayog hunchha.
haat ma sanitizer malda kina chiso lagchha?
sanitizer ma bhayeko alcohol dherai chhito baph bhaera udchha. udda yasle haat ko taap sangai lagchha, tyasaile haat chiso mahasus hunchha.
ghaam ma rakheko falam ko bench kath ko bench bhanda dherai taato kina lagchha?
dubai ghaam ma tatchhan, tara falam le taap dherai chhito hamro chhala samma pugauchha. kath le taap bistarai sarchha, tyasaile eutai ghaam ma pani falam badhi polne lagchha.
cycle ko pump chalaunda pump kina tatchha?
pump le hawa lai thichera sano thau ma kochda hawa tatchha. pataka pataka thichda pump ko tallo bhag ra pipe chhuda nyano-taato lagchha.
jado ma haat malda kina nyano hunchha?
haat ek aapas ma malda gharshan (friction) le gati ko urja taap ma badalchha. tyasaile jado ma haat malda haat tatchhan.
ghaam ma chhaya dhar-dhar tara badal laageko din kina dhamilo hunchha?

ghaam euta saano chamkilo srot jasto ho ra tyasko prakash eutai disha bata aauchha, tyasaile chhaya ko kinar spashta hunchha. badal laageko din prakash charai tira bata chharinchha, tyasaile chhaya dhamilo hunchha.
pani umalnu agadi kettle le kina sui-sui aawaj garchha?
pindh ma baneka taato baph ka bulbula mathi ko chiso pani ma pugda chhitai thichiera futchhan. yi bulbula futda aawaj aauchha; pura pani umalepachhi aawaj ali kam hunchha.
kaanch ko bottle ko dhakkan kasieko bela taato pani ma dubauda kina khulchha?
taato pani le dhatu ko dhakkan kaanch bhanda chhitai phailinchha. dhakkan ali khukulo bhaepachhi ghumauna sajilo hunchha.
kath pani ma kina tairinchha?
dherai kath ma saana saana hawa bhareka khalla hunchhan, tyasaile kath pani bhanda halka (kam ghanatwa) hunchha ra tairinchha. kehi dherai bakla ra gahrungo kath bhane pani ma dubna pani sakchhan.
pani ma fruit salt halda kina fij-fij bulbula aauchha?
fruit salt ma khane soda ra amla jasto padartha hunchha. pani ma ghulda yi dui milera carbon dioxide gyas banauchhan, ra tyo bulbula ko rup ma niskanchha.
chuna ko pani ma pipe le sas phukda kina dudh jasto seto hunchha?
hamro sas ma carbon dioxide hunchha. tyo chuna ko safa pani sanga milda pani ma naghulne seto kan banchhan, tyasaile pani dudhilo dekhinchha; yo carbon dioxide chhinne sajilo prayog ho.
khukuri ko dhaar dhunga ma ghotda kina tikho hunchha?
kada dhunga ma ghotda khukuri ko dhaar ko masino dhatu khiyera jaanchha ra dhaar patalo hunchha. patalo dhaar le saano thau ma dherai chap dinchha, tyasaile sajilai katchha.
solar cooker le ghaam bata kasari khana pakauchha?
solar cooker ko chamkila aaina jasta patta le dherai ghaam ko prakash eutai thau ma jammaa garchhan. tyaha rakheko kalo bhaada le prakash sosera tatchha ra khana bistarai pakchha.
dori tanne khel ma kun team jitchha?

dori ma dubai team le barabar bal lagaunchhan bhanne hudaina; jun team ko khutta ko pakad bhui ma baliyo hunchha ra jasle bhui lai jod le dhakelchha, tyo team jitchha. tyasaile ramro juta ra jhukera tanne tarika le farak parchha.
changa hawa ma kasari udchha?
changa ali tersho bhaera hawa samu rahanda hawa le yaslai tala bata mathi dhakelchha. dori le changa lai hawa sanga ulto taneko le yo hawa ma adiyera mathi rahanchha.
saabun ko bulbula sadhai gol kina hunchha?
saabun ko patalo jhilli ko satah le sadhai sabai bhanda saano satah banauna khojchha. bhitra ko hawa lai chhopne sabai bhanda saano satah gol aakar ho, tyasaile bulbula gol hunchha.
paat mathi ko pani ko thopa gol kina hunchha?
pani ka anu ek arka lai tanchhan, jasle pani ko satah lai tanieko jhilli jasto banauchha (surface tension). yasle thopa lai sabai bhanda saano aakar, arthat gol, ma rakhchha.
diyo ko batti le tel lai mathi samma kasari tanchha?
kapas ko batti ma dherai masina khalla hunchhan, ra tel ti khalla ma aafai mathi chadhchha. yaslai capillary action bhanchhan, ra tissue paper le pani soshnu pani yahi karan le ho.
barsat ma kath ko dhoka ra jhyal kina kasinchha?
kath le hawa bata osilopan sosera ali phulchha. barsat ma dhoka phulera chaukos ma kasinchha, ra sukkha mausam ma pheri khumchinchha.
barsat ma nun kina dalla parchha?
nun le hawa bata osilopan soschha, ra osilo nun ka daana ek aapas ma tasiera dalla banchhan. nun ko bhaada ma thorai chamal halda chamal le osilopan sosera nun lai khukulo rakhna maddat garchha.
ghaam ma sukaeko luga ko rang kina udchha?
ghaam ko prakash, khas gari ultraviolet kiran, le kapada ko rang dine padartha bistarai todchha. tyasaile rangin luga chhaya ma ulto paltaera sukauda rang lamo samaya tikchha.
pani ma ek thopa masi halda nachalai pani rang kasari phailinchha?
pani ka anu sadhai chalirahanchhan ra masi ka kan lai dhakeldai charai tira phailaunchhan. yaslai prasaran (diffusion) bhanchhan; kotha ma dhup ko baasna phailinu pani yahi karan le ho.
mainbatti nibhaepachhi niskeko seto dhuwa ma salai lagauda kina pheri balchha?
tyo seto dhuwa ma main (wax) ko baph hunchha. main ko baph sajilai balne bhayeko le salai ko aago le dhuwa hudai batti samma aago pugera mainbatti pheri balchha.
kagaj ko kap ma pani raakhera aago mathi rakhda kagaj kina jaldaina?
pani le kagaj ko taap sosirahanchha, ra pani 100 degree bhanda badhi tatdaina. kagaj jalna tyo bhanda dherai taap chahine bhayeko le pani rahunjel kagaj jaldaina.
luga ma ragat ko daag kina chiso pani le dhunu parchha?
ragat ma protein hunchha, jun taato pani ma pakera kapada ma jhan kasinchha. chiso pani le daag naharaunjel nai dhoe sajilai jaanchha.
machha katepachhi haat ko gandha kagati le kina hatchha?
machha ko gandha dine padartha kshar jasto gun bhayeka hunchhan. kagati ko amla le tiniharu sanga milera hawa ma naudne padartha banauchha, tyasaile kagati le haat malda gandha kam hunchha.
khane soda ra luga dhune soda eutai ho?
haina. khane soda (baking soda) halka kshar ho ra khana ma prayog hunchha. luga dhune soda (washing soda) dherai tikho kshar ho, yo khanu hudaina ra chhala ma pani polna sakchha.
aago tapda agadi taato tara pith chiso kina hunchha?
aago ko taap prakash jastai sidha rekha ma (radiation) aauchha ra aago tira farkeko bhag ma matra lagchha. pith tira aago ko kiran nalaageko le chiso nai rahanchha.
cycle ko chain ma tel kina halnu parchha?
tel le chain ka bhag bich ko gharshan ghatauchha, ra cycle chalauna sajilo hunchha. tel le chain lai pani ra khiya bata pani jogauchha.
juta ko tala ma kina dharka ra khaldo banaieko hunchha?
tala ko dharka ra khaldo le bhui sanga ko pakad badhauchha ra chiplo thau ma pani ladna dinna. bhijeko bhui ma pani ra hilo yi khaldo bata bahira jaanchha.
pangra ko bich ma saana gol goli (ball bearing) kina rakhinchha?
ball bearing ka gol goli rolinda ghisrine bhanda dherai kam gharshan hunchha. tyasaile cycle, pankha ra motor ka pangra sajilo ra chhito ghumchhan ra kam khiyinchhan.
torch ma battery ulto halda kina baldaina?
aajkal ko torch ma LED hunchha, ra LED ma bijuli eutai disha bata matra bagna sakchha. battery ulto halda bijuli ulto disha ma bagna khojchha ra LED baldaina; battery ko + ra - chinha milaera halnus.
fridge ko dhoka aafai kasari tasiera band hunchha?
fridge ko dhoka ko rubber ko kinar bhitra chumbak ko lamo patti hunchha. yasle dhoka lai fridge ko dhatu ko bhag sanga tanera kasera band rakhchha, ra chiso bahira jaana dinna.
ghanti bajepachhi haat le chhuda aawaj kina rokinchha?
ghanti ko aawaj yasko dhatu ko kampan bata aauchha. haat le chhuda tyo kampan rokinchha, ra kampan rokepachhi aawaj pani banda hunchha.
shanta tal ma himal ko chhaya aaina jastai kina dekhinchha?

shanta pani ko satah chiplo hunchha ra prakash lai aaina jastai eutai disha ma farkauchha. tyasaile hawa nachaleko bihana phewa tal ma machhapuchhre ko spashta chhabi dekhinchha; chhal aaepachhi chhabi phutchha.
jhyal bata aaeko ghaam ko kiran ma dhulo kina dekhinchha?
hawa ma sadhai saana dhulo ka kan udirahanchhan. ghaam ko dhar tini kan ma lagera chharinchha ra hamro aankha samma pugchha, tyasaile andhyaro kotha ma kiran ko dhar ra dhulo spashta dekhinchha.
taato tel ma pani ko thopa paryo bhane kina chhitkinchha?
pani tel bhanda gahrungo hune bhayeko le tala jaanchha ra taato tel bhitra eksaath baph banchha. baph jod le phailanda taato tel bahira chhitkinchha, tyasaile bhijeko tarkari halda hoshiyar hunus.
pahile luga ma bhat ko maad kina lagauthe?
bhat ko maad ma starch hunchha. luga lai maad ma dubaera sukauda starch le dhago lai kada banauchha, ra luga chamkilo ra chaunra-rahit dekhinchha.
dherai taato tawa ma pani ko thopa kina nachdai ghumchha?

dherai taato tawa ma pareko thopa ko tallo bhag tatkalai baph banchha. tyo baph ko patalo tah mathi thopa tairiera ghumchha, tyasaile thopa chhitai sukdaina; tawa kam taato bhae thopa sidhai chhyaa garera sukchha.
istri garda luga ko chaunra kasari hatchha?
istri ko taap ra baph le kapada ka resha naram ra lachila banauchhan. istri ko thichai le tiniharu lai sidha banauchha, ra chiso bhaepachhi resha tyasai gari rahanchhan.
aago lai dhungro le phukda kina jhan balchha?
aago jalna oxygen chahinchha. dhungro le phukda aago ma dherai hawa ra oxygen pugchha, tyasaile aago jhan jod le balchha.
Why does deodorant spray feel cold?
The spray comes out of a can where it was squeezed under pressure. As it spreads out and quickly evaporates on the skin, it takes heat away, so it feels cold.
Why do we see our reflection in a window at night?
Glass always reflects a little light. In the daytime the bright outdoors hides that faint reflection, but at night the room is brighter than outside, so we see ourselves clearly.
Why could you throw a ball much farther on the moon?
The moon's gravity is only about one sixth of the Earth's, so a ball falls much more slowly and stays in the air longer. With no air to slow it down, it also keeps its speed.
Can you get sunburned through a window?
Ordinary window glass blocks most of the ultraviolet rays that cause sunburn, so it is very unlikely. You still feel warm, because glass lets through visible light and some heat.
Why is water called the universal solvent?
Water can dissolve more kinds of substances than almost any other liquid, including salt, sugar and many gases. That is why rivers carry dissolved minerals and our blood can carry food to every cell.
Why does food not stick to a non-stick pan?
A non-stick pan is coated with a very slippery plastic layer that food cannot grip. It should not be heated empty on high flame or scratched with metal spoons, because the coating can be damaged.
How can some insects walk on water?

The surface of water acts like a thin stretchy skin, which is called surface tension. Light insects such as pond skaters spread their weight on long legs, so they press on that skin without breaking through.
Why do biscuits go soft when the packet is left open?
Crisp biscuits soak up moisture from the air. The water softens the starch inside them, so they lose their crunch; keeping them in a closed tin keeps them crisp.
Why are metals shiny?
Metals have many electrons that move freely between their atoms. These electrons bounce light straight back, which gives metals their shine.
Why does a rubber band snap back when stretched?
Rubber is made of long, tangled, chain-like molecules. Stretching straightens them out, and when we let go they pull back into their tangled shape.
Can electricity split water?
Yes. Passing electricity through water with a little salt or acid in it splits the water into hydrogen and oxygen gases. This is called electrolysis.

Why is Iceland called the land of fire and ice?
Iceland has many active volcanoes and hot springs, and it also has huge glaciers. Fire and ice sit side by side on the same island.
What is the Great Barrier Reef?

What is the Channel Tunnel?

What is Stonehenge?

Stonehenge is a circle of huge standing stones in southern England, built thousands of years ago. No one knows for certain what it was used for, but it lines up with the sunrise on the longest day of the year.
What is Mount Rushmore?
Mount Rushmore in the United States has the giant faces of four American presidents carved into a granite cliff: Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln.
What is the Parthenon?
The Parthenon is an ancient Greek temple on the Acropolis hill in Athens. It was built about 2,400 years ago and its marble columns are famous around the world.
What is Borobudur?
Borobudur, on the island of Java in Indonesia, is one of the largest Buddhist monuments in the world. It is built in stepped stone terraces covered with carvings.
What is the Kremlin?
The Kremlin is a walled fortress in the middle of Moscow with palaces and churches inside. It is the seat of the Russian government, and Red Square lies just outside its walls.
Where are the Iguazu Falls?
The Iguazu Falls are on the border between Argentina and Brazil in South America. They are made up of hundreds of separate waterfalls spread along the edge of a river.
What happens in the Serengeti every year?

In the Serengeti grasslands of Tanzania and Kenya, more than a million wildebeest, along with zebras, travel in a huge circle every year following the rain and fresh grass. It is called the Great Migration.
What is Uluru?
Uluru is a huge red sandstone rock rising out of the flat desert in the middle of Australia. It is a sacred place for the Aboriginal people of that area and changes colour at sunrise and sunset.
What are the big stone heads on Easter Island?
They are called moai, giant statues carved from volcanic rock by the island's early people hundreds of years ago. Easter Island lies far out in the Pacific Ocean and belongs to Chile.
Why does Tower Bridge in London open?
Tower Bridge has two halves in the middle that lift up. They open so that tall ships can pass along the River Thames underneath.
What is the Terracotta Army?
The Terracotta Army is thousands of life-size clay soldiers and horses buried near Xi'an in China with the first emperor of China. Farmers digging a well found them in 1974.

Is Singapore a city or a country?
