japan ko jhanda ma k chha?
japan ko jhanda seto ma bich ma euta rato gol ghero ho, jun ulaaundai gareko surya ko pratik ho.
bangladesh ko jhanda kasto chha?
bangladesh ko jhanda hariyo ma rato gol ghero ho. rato gol ghero thik bich bhanda ali dhwaja ko dandi tira sareko hunchha.
bharat ko jhanda ko bich ko chakra ma kati wata dharka hunchhan?
bharat ko jhanda ko bich ma nilo ashok chakra hunchha, jasma 24 wata dharka (spoke) hunchhan. jhanda ma mathi kesari, bich ma seto ra tala hariyo rang hunchha.
chaukos aakar ko jhanda bhayeka desh kun kun hun?
switzerland ra vatican city ko jhanda chaukos (square) chhan. nepal ko jhanda bhane sansar ko ekmatra chaar kune nabhayeko jhanda ho.
What is on the flag of Canada?
The flag of Canada has a red maple leaf in the middle of a white square, with a red band on each side.
What do the stars and stripes on the USA flag mean?
The 50 stars stand for the 50 states, and the 13 red and white stripes stand for the 13 original colonies that became the first states.
bharat ko rastriya janawar, charaa ra phool kun hun?
bharat ko rastriya janawar bagh, rastriya charaa majur ra rastriya phool kamal ho.
What is the national bird of the United States?
The bald eagle is the national bird of the United States. Despite its name it is not bald; its head is covered with white feathers.
Which animals are on Australia's coat of arms?
A kangaroo and an emu hold up the shield on Australia's coat of arms. Both are native Australian animals.
pizza kun desh bata suru bhayeko khana ho?
aajko pizza italy bata, khas gari naples sahar bata, suru bhayeko maninchha. pasta pani italy ko prasiddha khana ho.
sushi kun desh ko khana ho?
sushi japan ko khana ho, jasma sirka milayeko chamal ra kancho ya pakaeko machha, tarkari rakhinchha.
kimchi bhaneko k ho?
kimchi korea ko paramparik khana ho, jun bandakopi ra mula lai nun, khursani ra lasun sanga kuhayera (ferment) banainchha. hamro gundruk jastai yo pani kuhayera baneko amilo khana ho.
arabi lipi kun tira bata lekhinchha?
arabi lipi daahine bata debre tira lekhinchha. tara sankhya bhane debre bata daahine tira nai lekhinchha.
japani bhasa kati kisim ko lipi ma lekhinchha?
japani bhasa 3 kisim ko lipi milayera lekhinchha: hiragana, katakana ra china bata aayeko kanji. bidesi shabda lekhna dherai jaso katakana prayog hunchha.
How many characters does written Chinese have?
Written Chinese has many thousands of characters, and each one stands for a syllable with its own meaning. A person needs to know a few thousand of them to read a newspaper.
Who created the Korean alphabet?
The Korean alphabet, Hangul, was created in the 15th century under King Sejong. It was designed to be easy to learn, with letters that are put together into syllable blocks.
cricket khel kun desh bata suru bhayo?
cricket england bata suru bhayeko khel ho. aaja yo bharat, pakistan, australia ra nepal sahit dherai desh ma lokpriya chha.
chess khel ko suruwat kaha bhayo?
chess ko suruwat purano bharat ko chaturanga bhanne khel bata bhayeko maninchha. tyo khel persia hudai europe pugyo ra aajko chess banyo.
kabaddi kun desh ko rastriya khel ho?
kabaddi bangladesh ko rastriya khel ho. yo dakshin asia ma, nepal ra bharat sahit dherai thau ma lokpriya chha.
Where were the rules of modern football first written?
The rules of modern football were first written in England in 1863, when the Football Association was formed. Today football is the most popular sport in the world.
chiniya naya barsha kahile parchha?
chiniya naya barsha chandrama ma adharit patro anusar manainchha, tyasaile harek barsha farak din, january ko antya dekhi february samma kunai din parchha.
Why does the English new year start on 1 January?
Most of the world uses the Gregorian calendar, in which the year starts on 1 January. Nepal officially uses Bikram Sambat, where the new year starts on Baisakh 1, in mid-April.
Which units does the United States use instead of kilometres and kilograms?
The United States mostly uses miles for distance, pounds for weight and degrees Fahrenheit for temperature. Most other countries, including Nepal, use the metric system.
nepal ma sadak ko kun tira gadi chalaunchhan, ra aru kun desh ma ustai?
nepal ma sadak ko debre tira gadi chalaunchhan. bharat, belayat, japan, australia ra malaysia ma pani debre tira nai chalaunchhan.
Which countries drive on the right side of the road?
Most countries drive on the right, including the United States, China, Canada, Korea, the Gulf countries and most of Europe. Drivers from Nepal need to get used to this when they drive abroad.
america ma ghar ko bijuli kati volt ko hunchha?
america ma ghar ko bijuli lagbhag 120 volt ko hunchha, jaba ki nepal ma 230 volt hunchha. tyasaile america bata lyaeko saman nepal ma lagaunu aghi volt milchha ki nai hernu parchha.
What are the New Seven Wonders of the World?

In 2007, a worldwide vote chose the Great Wall of China, Petra in Jordan, Christ the Redeemer in Brazil, Machu Picchu in Peru, Chichen Itza in Mexico, the Colosseum in Italy and the Taj Mahal in India.
purana saat ashcharya madhye aile kun matra bacheko chha?
purana saat ashcharya madhye aile misra ko giza ko thulo pyramid matra bacheko chha. aru sabai bhukampa, aago ra samaya le nasta bhaisake.
resham marga (silk road) bhaneko k ho?
resham marga purano samaya ma china lai madhya asia hudai europe samma jodne byapar ka bato haru ko jaal ho. yasma resham, masala ra aru saman sangai bichar ra dharma pani phailie.
sansar ko sabai bhanda dherai pani parne thau madhye kun parchhan?
bharat ko meghalaya ko mawsynram ra cherrapunji sansar ko sabai bhanda dherai pani parne thau madhye parchhan. yaha monsoon ma dherai pani parchha.
Which is the second largest rainforest in the world?
The Congo rainforest in central Africa is the second largest tropical rainforest, after the Amazon. Gorillas, chimpanzees and forest elephants live there.
netherlands ko dherai jamin samudra bhanda tala kasari bachchha?
netherlands ko thulo bhag samudra ko satah bhanda tala chha. manchhe le samudra rokna lamo baandh (dyke) banaera, ra pahile hawa chakki (windmill) le pani pump garera jamin sukkha rakhe.
What is a fjord?
A fjord is a long, narrow, deep inlet of the sea between steep cliffs, carved out by glaciers long ago. Norway is famous for its fjords.
japan ko bullet train kasto hunchha?
japan ko bullet train (shinkansen) dherai chhito chalne rail ho, jun samay ma chalne ra surakshit hune lagi prasiddha chha. yasle tadha ka sahar haru lai chhoto samaya ma jodchha.
siberia kasto thau ho?
siberia russia ko asia tira ko dherai thulo kshetra ho. yaha ko hiundo sansar ko sabai bhanda chiso madhye parchha, ra yaha sallo jasta rukh ka bisal jangal chhan.
amazon nadi ma kasto dolphin paainchha?
amazon nadi ma gulabi rang ko dolphin paainchha. yo samudra haina, nadi ma baschhe dolphin ho, nepal ko sons jastai.
khadi (gulf) ka desh dhani kasari bhae?
saudi arab, qatar, kuwait ra UAE jasta khadi ka desh ma jamin muni dherai petrol (khanij tel) ra prakritik gyas chha. yahi bechera yi desh dhani bhae.
maldives lai samudra ko satah badhda kina khatara chha?
maldives ka dherai tapu samudra ko satah bhanda thorai matra mathi chhan. jalvayu parivartan le samudra ko satah badhdai gaye kati tapu dubne khatara chha.
bhutan le desh ko bikas kasari naapchha bhanchhan?
bhutan le paisa matra haina, manchhe ko khushi ra kalyan lai pani mahatwa dinchha. yaslai "gross national happiness" bhanne bichar bhanchhan.
mangolia ka gothala kasto ghar ma baschhan?
mangolia ka dherai gothala ger bhanne gol paal (tent) jasto ghar ma baschhan. yo sajilai kholera arko thau lagna sakinchha, tyasaile pashu sangai sarna sajilo hunchha.
sri lanka kun kura ko lagi prasiddha chha?
sri lanka chiya (ceylon tea) ko lagi dherai prasiddha chha. pahile yo desh lai ceylon bhaninthyo.
bangladesh ma barsat ma badhi kina dherai aauchha?
bangladesh ganga ra brahmaputra jasta thula nadi milne samtal ra hocho delta ma chha. monsoon ma himal ra pahad bata aaune pani yaha jammaa hune bhayeko le badhi ko khatara dherai hunchha.
browser ra search engine eutai ho?
haina. browser bhaneko website kholne program ho, jastai chrome ra firefox. search engine bhaneko internet ma kura khojne website ho, jastai google, jun browser bhitra kholinchha.
arko desh ko website ko data nepal samma kasari aauchha?
dherai jaso data samudra muni bichhyaeko lamo fibre cable bata ek desh bata arko desh pugchha. tyas pachhi jamin ka cable, mobile tower ra wifi hudai hamro phone ya computer samma aauchha.
wifi ra mobile data ma k farak?

wifi ghar ya office ko router bata aaune najik ko tar-bina sanjal ho, jun internet ko line sanga jodieko hunchha. mobile data bhane mobile company ko tower bata sidhai phone ma aauchha, tyasaile bahira hiddda pani chalchha.
modem ra router ko kaam k ho?

modem le internet company ko line lai hamro ghar ko upakaran le bujhne sanket ma badalchha. router le tyo internet ghar ka phone, laptop jasta dherai upakaran ma wifi ya taar bata baadchha; aajkal dherai jaso dubai eutai box ma hunchhan.
bluetooth le kati tadha samma kaam garchha?
bluetooth najik ka upakaran jodne tar-bina prabidhi ho, jasle sadharan rup ma kehi meter (lagbhag 10 meter jati) bhitra ramro kaam garchha. earphone, speaker ra smartwatch jodna yo prayog hunchha.
phone ko hotspot bhaneko k ho?
hotspot le phone ko mobile data lai wifi jastai banaera arko phone ya laptop lai baadchha. hotspot khulla rakhda data chhitai sakinchha ra battery pani chhito ghatchha.
4G ra 5G ma G ko arth k ho?
G ko arth generation (pusta) ho. 4G mobile network ko chautho pusta ra 5G pacham pusta ho; naya pusta dherai jaso chhito ra dherai upakaran eksaath jodna sakne hunchha.
phone ma airplane mode le k garchha?
airplane mode le phone ko mobile network, wifi ra bluetooth ka radio sanket band garchha. hawaijahaj ma ra battery bachauna yo kaam lagchha; yo bela call ra internet chaldaina.
phone ko IMEI number k ho ra kasari herne?

IMEI harek mobile phone ko aafnai 15 ank ko chhuttai number ho. phone ma *#06# dial garda yo dekhinchha; phone harayo bhane yo number le phone pattaa lagauna maddat garna sakchha, tyasaile kahi lekhera rakhnus.
phone ko battery purano bhaepachhi kina chhitai sakinchha?
phone ma lithium-ion battery hunchha, jasko kshamata pataka pataka charge-discharge garda bistarai ghatdai jaanchha. tyasaile dui-tin barsha pachhi eutai full charge le pahile jati samaya chaldaina.
dherai chiso thau ma phone ko battery kina chhitai sakinchha?
battery bhitra rasaayanik pratikriya bata bijuli banchha, ra chiso ma yo pratikriya dhilo hunchha. himal ma trek garda phone lai jiu najik nyano khalti ma rakhda battery lamo tikchha.
phone ko battery phulyo bhane k garne?
phuleko battery bhitra gyas baneko hunchha ra yo aago lagne khatara hunchha. tyo phone charge nagarnus, thichnu hudaina, ra chhitai mobile marmat garne thau ma battery pheraunus.
panja lagaera phone ko screen kina chaldaina?

dherai jaso phone ko touchscreen le hamro aunla ko halka bijuli ko asar chhinchha. kapada ko panja le tyo asar rokchha, tyasaile screen le chhuneko thaha paudaina; touchscreen chalne panja ma bishesh dhago hunchha.
camera ko megapixel badhi bhae photo sadhai ramro hunchha?
sadhai hudaina. megapixel le photo ma kati lakh saana thopla (pixel) chhan bhanera matra dekhauchha; lens, sensor ko aakar ra ujyalo le pani photo ko gunastar ma dherai asar garchhan.
phone ko storage bhariyo bhane k hunchha?
storage bhariepachhi naya photo, video ra app rakhna paudaina, ra phone dhilo chalna sakchha. purana video, chahine nabhayeka app ra pathaieka file hataunda thau khali hunchha.
1 GB ma kati MB hunchha?
computer ko hisab ma 1 GB ma 1024 MB hunchha, tara company haru prayah 1000 MB pani bhanchhan. tyasaile 1 GB lai lagbhag 1000 MB samjhe pugchha.
byte ra bit ma k farak?
bit computer ko sabai bhanda saano ekai ho, jasko man 0 ya 1 hunchha. 8 bit milera 1 byte banchha, ra euta angreji akshar rakhna lagbhag 1 byte chahinchha.
computer le sabai kura 0 ra 1 ma kina rakhchha?
computer bhitra ka saana switch haru ma bijuli bagchha (1) ya bagdaina (0) bhanne dui awastha matra hunchhan. akshar, photo ra geet sabai lai 0 ra 1 ko lamo kram ma badalera computer le rakhchha.
computer ko motherboard ko kaam k ho?
motherboard computer ko mukhya circuit board ho, jasma CPU, RAM, storage ra aru bhag jodinchhan. yasle sabai bhag lai bijuli dinchha ra ek aapas ma sanket pathauna bato dinchha.
hard disk ra SSD ma k farak?
hard disk bhitra ghumne chakka (disk) hunchha ra suiro le data padhchha. SSD ma chalne bhag hudainan, chip ma data rakhinchha, tyasaile SSD dherai chhito, halka ra ladda kam bigrine hunchha.
keyboard ko akshar ABC kram ma kina hudaina?

aajko keyboard lai QWERTY bhanchhan, kinabhane mathillo pankti ka pahila 6 akshar Q, W, E, R, T, Y hun. yo kram purano typewriter ko samaya ma banaieko thiyo, ra sabai manchhe yasaima bani pareko le aile samma tyahi chalan rahyo.
smartphone ra sadharan (button wala) phone ma k farak?
sadharan phone le dherai jaso call, SMS ra radio jasta kaam matra garchha. smartphone ma internet, camera, map ra dherai app chalchhan, tara yasko battery chhitai sakinchha.
phone ra app lai update garna kina bhanchhan?
update ma galti (bug) sudharieko hunchha ra hacker le prayog garna sakne suraksha ka pwal band gariyeko hunchha. kahile kahi naya suvidha pani thapinchhan, tyasaile update garnu ramro.
website ko thegana agadi taala (lock) ko chinha ra https le k janauchha?

https ra taala ko chinha le tapai ko browser ra website bich ko data guptarup ma (encrypt) jaanchha bhanne janauchha. yasle bich ma kasaile padhna garo banauchha, tara website nai sachcho ho bhanne gyaranti bhane dindaina.
website ko naam ko antya ma .np le k janauchha?
.np nepal ko desh-sanket (country code) domain ho. .np ma antya hune website dherai jaso nepal sanga sambandhit hunchhan, jastai bharat ko .in ra japan ko .jp.
IP address bhaneko k ho?
IP address internet ma jodieko harek upakaran ko number wala thegana ho. ghar ko thegana bata chithi pugejastai, yahi thegana bata data sahi upakaran samma pugchha.
QR code kasari kaam garchha?

QR code kalo-seto saana barga ko banot ma lekhieko jankari ho. phone ko camera le yo banot padhera tyas bhitra ko website, khata number jasta jankari turuntai dekhauchha; paisa tirnu aghi naam milchha ki nai hernus.
pasal ma saman ko barcode le k garchha?
barcode ka mota-patala kala dharka bhitra saman ko number lekhieko hunchha. scanner le tyo padhda computer le saman ko naam ra daam aafai bill ma thapchha.
mobile wallet bhaneko k ho?
mobile wallet phone ko app ma rakhine digital khata ho, jasbata bijuli-pani ko bill tirna, recharge garna ra paisa pathauna sakinchha. aafno PIN ra OTP kasailai nadinus.
What does the name Bluetooth come from?
Bluetooth is named after Harald Bluetooth, a Danish king from more than a thousand years ago who united parts of Scandinavia. The idea was that the technology "unites" different devices.
Does Wi-Fi stand for something?
Not really. Wi-Fi is a brand name chosen because it was catchy. Many people think it means "wireless fidelity", but it was never officially short for anything.
What does www stand for?
www stands for World Wide Web, the system of web pages linked to each other that we open in a browser. The web runs on the internet, but the internet also carries email, calls and much more.
What does SMS stand for?
SMS stands for Short Message Service. It is the basic text message that works on any mobile phone over the mobile network, without internet.
What does CCTV mean?
CCTV means closed-circuit television: cameras whose video goes only to a particular set of screens or recorders, not to the public. It is used for security in shops, banks and streets.
What is buffering in a video?
Buffering is when a video pauses to load more data before it can keep playing. It happens when the internet connection is slower than the video needs.
What is ping or latency in internet speed?
Ping, or latency, is the time it takes for a small piece of data to go to a server and come back. A low ping matters for video calls and online games, even more than download speed.
What is a firewall on a computer?
A firewall is a program or device that watches the data going in and out of a computer or network. It blocks connections that look unsafe or that the user has not allowed.
What is encryption?
Encryption scrambles information with a secret key so that only someone with the right key can read it. Chat apps, banks and secure websites use it to keep messages and passwords private.
What is a CAPTCHA?
A CAPTCHA is a small test, like typing wobbly letters or picking pictures with buses, that websites use to check you are a person and not an automatic program.
Does dark mode save battery?
On phones with OLED screens it does, because black pixels on those screens are switched off and use almost no power. On ordinary LCD screens the backlight stays on, so the saving is small.
algorithm bhaneko k ho?
algorithm bhaneko kunai samasya hal garna kram anusar lekhieko spashta charan haru ho. khana pakaune recipe jastai, computer le pani algorithm ka charan ek ek gardai palana garchha.
programming bhaneko k ho?
programming bhaneko computer lai k garne bhanera bishesh bhasa (programming language) ma nirdeshan lekhnu ho. app, website ra game sabai programmer le lekheko code bata chalchhan.
robot bhaneko k ho?
robot bhaneko computer ko nirdeshan anusar aafai kaam garna sakne yantra ho. karkhana ma gadi jodne, aspatal ma saman bokne ra ghar ma bhui safa garne robot hunchhan.
FM ra AM radio ma k farak?

dubai radio tarang (wave) bata aawaj pathaunchhan, tara farak tarika le. FM ko aawaj dherai safa hunchha tara tadha samma pugdaina; AM ko aawaj ali khasro hunchha tara tadha samma, khas gari raati, pugna sakchha.
chhana ma rakheko dish antenna le k garchha?
dish antenna le antariksha ma ghumne satellite bata aaune TV ka sanket jammaa garchha. yasko gol khaldo aakar le kamjor sanket lai bich ko saano yantra tira kendrit garchha.
website ko server bhaneko k ho?
server bhaneko website ra app ka file rakhne ra mangda pathaune shaktishali computer ho, jun din raat chaliraheko hunchha. hamle website kholda browser le server sanga file mangchha.
video download garnu ra streaming garnu ma k farak?
download garda pura file phone ma rakhinchha ra pachhi internet bina pani herna sakinchha. streaming ma video herdai gardai internet bata aauchha ra phone ma sthayi rup ma bachdaina.
video herda mobile data kina chhitai sakinchha?
video ma harek second dherai tasbir ra aawaj hunchha, tyasaile yasko file dherai thulo hunchha. HD jasto ramro quality ma herda jhan dherai data lagchha, tyasaile data bachauna quality ghataunus.
internet bina pani phone ko GPS chalchha?

chalchha, GPS le satellite bata sidhai sanket linchha, tyasaile internet chahindaina. tara map ko chitra internet bata aaune bhayeko le internet nabhae offline map pahile nai download garera rakhnu parchha.
phone le hami kaha chhau bhanera kasari thaha paauchha?
phone le dherai GPS satellite bata aaune sanket ko samaya tulana garera hamro thau hisab garchha. sahar ma mobile tower ra wifi ko jankari le pani thau ali chhito ra thik thaha paauna maddat garchha.
bijuli ko kettle pani umlepachhi aafai kasari band hunchha?
kettle ma taap thaha paaune switch (thermostat) hunchha. pani umlera baph switch samma pugda tyo switch tatera bijuli kaatidinchha.
rice cooker le bhat pakepachhi kasari "warm" ma janchha?
pani bhaunjel bhaada ko tapkram 100 degree bhanda badhdaina. pura pani sosiepachhi tapkram badhchha, ra tyo thaha paaune switch le cooker lai "warm" ma pharkaidinchha.
inverter le bijuli jada kasari batti balchha?
bijuli bhaunjel inverter le battery charge garchha. bijuli gaepachhi battery ko DC bijuli lai ghar ma chalne AC bijuli ma badalera batti ra pankha chalauchha.
voltage stabilizer kina chahinchha?
bijuli ko voltage kahile badhi ra kahile kam hunda TV, fridge jasta saman bigrina sakchhan. stabilizer le voltage lai lagbhag ekai nasar ma rakhera saman jogauchha.
washing machine le luga ko pani kasari nichorchha?
spin garda machine ko drum dherai chhito ghumchha. drum ko bhitta ka saana pwal bata pani bahira phyalinchha ra luga bhitta mai thichiera rahanchha, tyasaile luga chhitai sukchha.
ghar ko wifi ma password kina rakhne?
password nabhae chhimeki ya aru jo pani le tapai ko internet chalauna sakchhan ra speed ghatchha. kasaile tapai ko network ma jodiera data herna khojne khatara pani hunchha.
internet chalena bhane router band garera kholda kina thik hunchha?

router pani saano computer jastai ho, ra lamo samaya chalda yasma saana galti ra atkaai jammaa hunchhan. restart garda ti safa hunchhan, tara pheri pheri samasya aaye internet company lai khabar garnus.
internet speed ko Mbps ra MB ma k farak?
Mbps bhaneko megabit prati second ho, ra MB megabyte ho; 1 byte ma 8 bit hunchha. tyasaile 8 Mbps ko internet le second ma lagbhag 1 MB matra download garchha.
computer lai switch thichera matra band garnu kina ramro haina?
shut down garda computer le chaliraheka program ra file ramrari band garchha. achanak bijuli kaatda save nagareka kaam harauchha ra kahile kahi file bigrina sakchha.
pendrive ma data kasari rakhinchha?

pendrive bhitra flash memory bhanne chip hunchha, jasma bijuli nabhae pani data rahanchha. yo saano ra sajilai bokna sakine bhayeko le file sarna prayog hunchha, tara mahatwapurna file ko arko copy pani rakhnus.
HDMI cable le k kaam garchha?
HDMI cable le eutai taar bata ramro quality ko video ra aawaj dubai pathauchha. laptop ya set-top box lai TV ma jodna yo dherai prayog hunchha.
phone ko camera le photo kasari kheechchha?
lens le prakash lai bhitra ko sensor ma kendrit garchha. sensor ka lakhaun saana bhag le prakash lai bijuli ko sanket ma badalchhan, ra phone le tyaslai photo ko file banauchha.
phone ghumauda screen pani aafai kasari ghumchha?
phone bhitra accelerometer bhanne saano sensor hunchha, jasle gurutwakarshan kun tira chha bhanera thaha paauchha. phone terso bhaeko thaha paaepachhi screen pani ghumchha.
phone ko fingerprint lock le kasari chinchha?
fingerprint sensor le aunla ko tuppa ka saana dharka ra ghumti ko naksa banauchha. pahile save gareko naksa sanga milyo bhane matra phone khulchha.
app le camera, location ko anumati (permission) magda k garne?
app lai kaam garna chahine anumati matra dinus. torch ko app le contacts ra location magchha bhane shanka garnu parchha; settings ma gaera anumati pachhi pani hataauna sakinchha.
sarbajanik free wifi ma bank ko kaam kina nagarne?
khulla wifi ma aru manchhe pani jodieka hunchhan ra kasaile data chorera herna sakchha. password, bank ko kaam ra OTP chahine kaam mobile data ya surakshit network bata matra garnus.
open source software bhaneko k ho?
open source software ko code jasle pani herna, sikna ra sudharna paauchha. linux operating system ra firefox browser yaska udaharan hun.
computer ma nepali akshar sabai thau ma kasari ekai dekhinchha?

computer le harek akshar lai euta number ko rup ma rakhchha. unicode bhanne antarrashtriya niyam le devanagari sahit sansar ka lagbhag sabai lipi ka akshar lai chhuttai number dinchha, tyasaile nepali sabai upakaran ma milchha.
AC (air conditioner) le kotha kasari chiso banauchha?

himal chadhda satellite phone kina lagchhan?

What does "Reply all" do in an email?
"Reply all" sends your answer to the sender and to everyone else who received the original email. Use plain "Reply" when only the sender needs your answer, so others are not flooded with messages.
What is the difference between an inkjet and a laser printer?
An inkjet printer sprays tiny drops of liquid ink onto the paper. A laser printer uses a fine powder called toner that is stuck to the paper with heat, which is faster for printing many pages.
How does a photocopier work?

A photocopier shines light on the page and uses static electricity to make toner powder stick to a drum in the same pattern as the dark parts. The toner is then pressed onto new paper and fixed with heat.
How do noise-cancelling headphones work?
Small microphones in the headphones listen to the noise around you. The headphones then play an opposite sound wave that cancels much of that noise, especially steady sounds like engines.
How does a projector make a big picture on the wall?
A projector shines a very bright light through or off a small image inside it. A lens then spreads that image out so it becomes large on the wall or screen.
What is the difference between optical zoom and digital zoom?
Optical zoom moves the camera's lenses to bring the subject closer, so the photo stays sharp. Digital zoom just enlarges part of the picture, which makes it blurry and blocky.
What is a tab in a web browser?
A tab lets you keep several web pages open in the same browser window. You can switch between them by clicking the tabs at the top.
What is a bookmark in a browser?
A bookmark saves the address of a web page so you can open it again later with one click, without searching for it.
What happens to files in the recycle bin?
Deleted files usually go to the recycle bin first, where you can still restore them. They are removed for good only when the bin is emptied.
What does formatting a pen drive do?
Formatting erases everything on the pen drive and prepares it to store files again. Copy anything important to another place first, because formatted files are hard or impossible to get back.
What is a zip file?
A zip file packs one or more files into a single, usually smaller file. It is handy for sending many files together by email, and you "unzip" it to get the files back.
What does a graphics card do?
A graphics card is a part of the computer that draws pictures, videos and games on the screen. A strong one is needed for 3D games and video editing.
What is NFC on a phone?
NFC, or near-field communication, lets two devices share information when they are held a few centimetres apart. It is used for tap-to-pay cards and phones.
What is roaming on a mobile phone?
Roaming means using your phone in another country through a foreign mobile network that works with your own company. It can be much more expensive, so check the charges or use a local SIM.
What is an eSIM?
An eSIM is a SIM card built into the phone as a chip instead of a small removable card. You add a mobile plan to it by scanning a code from the mobile company.
Why do websites ask us to accept cookies?
Cookies are small files a website saves in your browser to remember things like your login or settings. Many countries require websites to ask before saving cookies that track you.
What is a spreadsheet?
A spreadsheet is a program with a grid of rows and columns where you can enter numbers and let the computer add, average and sort them. It is used for accounts, marks and budgets.
What is a word processor?
A word processor is a program for typing, editing and printing documents such as letters and reports. It can check spelling and change fonts and layout.
What is an e-book?
An e-book is a book in digital form that you read on a phone, tablet or e-reader. One device can hold hundreds of books, and you can change the text size.
What is a podcast?
A podcast is a series of recorded talks or shows that you can listen to on a phone or computer whenever you like. Many podcasts are about news, stories or learning a skill.

Why does a world map make Greenland look so big?

The Earth is round, and flattening it onto a rectangle stretches places near the poles. On many common maps Greenland looks about as big as Africa, but on a globe you can see that Africa is far larger.
What is the difference between a biography and an autobiography?
A biography is the story of a person's life written by someone else. An autobiography is a person's life story written by that person.
What is the difference between fiction and non-fiction?
Fiction is writing about invented people and events, like novels and short stories. Non-fiction is about real facts and events, like history books, biographies and science books.
What does an archaeologist do?
An archaeologist studies how people lived in the past by digging up and examining things they left behind, such as tools, pots, buildings and bones.
What does "prehistory" mean?
Prehistory is the long period of human life before writing was invented. We learn about it from tools, cave paintings, bones and other remains rather than from written records.
What do BC and AD mean in dates?
In the common Western calendar, BC means years before the traditional date of the birth of Jesus, and AD means years after it. Many books now write BCE and CE instead, for the same years.
What does SOS stand for?
SOS does not really stand for any words. It was chosen as a distress signal because in Morse code it is simple and easy to recognise: three dots, three dashes, three dots.
What is Morse code?
Morse code sends letters as patterns of short and long signals, called dots and dashes. It was used with the telegraph in the 1800s and can be sent with sound, light or taps.
Is sign language the same all over the world?
No. Deaf communities in different countries have their own sign languages, each with its own grammar. Nepal has Nepali Sign Language, which is different from American or British Sign Language.
Why is a rainbow curved?

A rainbow is actually part of a circle centred on the point exactly opposite the sun. From the ground the horizon cuts the circle off, but from an aeroplane people can sometimes see a full round rainbow.
What is a lighthouse for?
A lighthouse is a tower with a bright light near a dangerous coast. Its flashing light warns ships of rocks at night and helps sailors know where they are.
What is a plane's "black box"?
The black box is actually bright orange so it is easy to find. It records the plane's flight data and the voices in the cockpit, which helps investigators find out what went wrong after an accident.
Why are aeroplane windows round?
Sharp corners on windows collect stress when the cabin is pressurised, and early planes with square windows suffered cracks. Rounded windows spread the stress evenly and are much safer.
Why do big passenger planes fly so high?
Air is thinner high up, so planes meet less resistance and use less fuel. Flying high also keeps them above most clouds, storms and bumpy air.
How does a quartz watch keep time?

A tiny quartz crystal inside the watch vibrates at a very steady speed, 32768 times a second, when the battery's electricity passes through it. A chip counts these vibrations and moves the time forward once every second.
When was the first call made on a mobile phone?
The first public call from a handheld mobile phone was made in 1973 in New York by Martin Cooper, an engineer at Motorola. The phone was heavy and its battery lasted only a short time.
Who sent the first email?
The engineer Ray Tomlinson sent the first network email in 1971. He also chose the @ sign to separate the user's name from the computer's name.
Why do we write 1,00,000 in Nepal but 100,000 in English books?

Nepal and India count in lakhs and crores, so commas come after every two digits once the first three are done: 1,00,000 is one lakh. The international system groups digits in threes, so the same number is 100,000, a hundred thousand.
Why do we count in tens?
Our number system uses ten digits, 0 to 9, and each place is worth ten times the one to its right. Most people think this started because humans have ten fingers to count on.
What is the difference between a debit card and a credit card?

A debit card takes money straight from your own bank account when you pay. A credit card lets you borrow money from the bank to pay, and you must pay it back later, often with interest if you are late.
